title: Fleet & Tooling Coordinator
description:
Forbes Bros. Group of Companies delivers transmission, distribution, substation, and related power infrastructure projects across Canada and the United States.

Our work spans field construction, project delivery, operations, and corporate support in an environment where safety, execution, and reliability matter.

The Opportunity

Keep powerline construction crews equipped, ready, and working safely.

Reporting to the Fleet & Tooling Manager, the Fleet & Tooling Coordinator supports the R-Project in Stapleton, Nebraska, helping ensure crews have the vehicles, equipment, and certified tools they need. You’ll coordinate inventory, maintenance, inspections, and logistics while keeping safety, reliability, and costs in focus.

This role suits someone who enjoys solving practical problems, organizing competing priorities, and working closely with Operations, mechanics, and suppliers. Your work will directly support equipment readiness, reduce downtime, and help crews stay on schedule.

What You’ll Do

  • Plan for operational needs: Work with Operations and Estimating to understand project schedules, anticipate fleet and tooling requirements, and adjust availability as priorities change.

  • Manage inventory and utilization: Maintain accurate equipment and tooling inventories, track usage and availability, and identify opportunities to make better use of existing resources.

  • Coordinate daily maintenance: Lead daily tailboards, set mechanic priorities, dispatch mechanics, order parts, and coordinate repairs and preventive servicing.

  • Keep inspections and certifications current: Track required inspections, certifications, and annual renewals. Review daily vehicle and equipment inspection reports and follow through on deficiencies.

  • Support safe, compliant operations: Maintain fleet standards and processes, support compliance with applicable FMCSA/DOT and occupational health and safety requirements, and keep shops and yards safe and organized.

  • Control costs and improve reliability: Review vehicle and tooling condition and performance, recommend replacements or upgrades, and assess major repairs with the Fleet & Tooling Manager.

  • Coordinate logistics: Arrange the movement of equipment, tools, and parts between project locations. Work with Operations on safe, secure transport planning for magazines and implodes.

  • Manage vendor performance: Hold suppliers and service providers accountable for quality, pricing, delivery timelines, and contractual commitments.

What You’ll Bring

  • At least three years of experience in inventory management.

  • Working knowledge of industry regulations and requirements relevant to fleet, tooling, and safe operations.

  • Knowledge of cross-border shipping, including shipping documentation, Harmonized System (HS) codes, and customs requirements.

  • Familiarity with logistics and less-than-truckload (LTL) transportation.

  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to coordinate competing equipment, maintenance, and delivery priorities.

  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with field teams, mechanics, vendors, and internal stakeholders.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Word and Excel.

  • A valid Class D driver’s license and the ability to meet company driver qualification requirements.

Project, Pay & Work Schedule

  • Location: Site-based on the R-Project in Stapleton, Nebraska.

  • Overtime: Overtime applies after 40 hours worked per week.

  • Per diem: $200.00 USD per day.

  • Rotation: 3 weeks on / 1 week off

  • Safety: This is a safety-sensitive position.

The range shown is the expected base pay range for this role. Final compensation will be determined based on role requirements, experience, qualifications, work location, applicable project/site requirements, internal equity, and any applicable collective agreement or union requirements.

This range does not include overtime, premiums, per diem / LOA, bonuses, benefits, or other forms of compensation unless specifically stated in the job posting.

$40—$46 USD

title: HLO Afstudeerstage R&D – Analytische Chemie
description:
Binnen de afdeling Research & Development (R&D) werk je aan innovatieve en inhoudelijk uitdagende projecten binnen het laboratorium. Dit betekent dat je niet bezig bent met routinematige analyses, maar juist met het ontwikkelen, verbeteren en testen van methodes en processen.

Tijdens je stage ga je zelfstandig aan de slag met een onderzoeksproject, waarbij je wordt begeleid door ervaren collega’s. De projecten binnen R&D zijn vaak complex en dynamisch.

Tijdens je stage houd je je onder andere bezig met:

  • Het uitvoeren van een afstudeeronderzoek binnen de analytische chemie
  • Het ontwikkelen, testen of optimaliseren van analysemethoden
  • Het analyseren en interpreteren van meetresultaten
  • Het rapporteren van je bevindingen en resultaten

Je werkt in een omgeving waarin veel ruimte is voor eigen initiatief en verdieping, en waar jouw onderzoek daadwerkelijk bij kan dragen aan verbeteringen binnen het lab.

Wat zoeken wij in een stagiaire?

  • Je volgt een HLO-opleiding (bij voorkeur 4e jaars) in de richting van analytische chemie
  • Je bent op zoek naar een afstudeerstage voor minimaal 3 maanden
  • Je hebt interesse in onderzoek en ontwikkeling (R&D)
  • Je werkt zelfstandig en hebt een analytische instelling
  • Je bent nauwkeurig en kritisch op je eigen werk
  • Je hebt een proactieve en leergierige houding

Je wordt onderdeel van Eurofins, een snelgroeiend en internationaal laboratoriumbedrijf. Tijdens je stage krijg je de kans om je inhoudelijk sterk te ontwikkelen en waardevolle ervaring op te doen binnen een professionele R&D-omgeving.

Eurofins Scientific is een internationaal beursgenoteerd life sciences bedrijf dat haar klanten voorziet van hoogwaardig laboratoriumonderzoek en advies. Eurofins is wereldwijd marktleider op het gebied van bio-analytische testen voor levensmiddelen, water, milieu, cosmetica, farmaceutische producten en contract research voor agro science. Onze mensen bij Eurofins leveren een belangrijke bijdrage aan wereldwijde thema’s op het gebied van onder meer milieu, voedselveiligheid en algehele gezondheid.

De geaccrediteerde laboratoria van Eurofins Milieu bieden in Nederland een uitgebreid pakket aan chemische, fysische en biologische analyses in alle milieu matrices. Door jarenlange ervaring heeft zij uitvoerige kennis op het gebied van zowel routinematige analyses als niet standaard analyses waaronder analyses van bijzondere verbindingen en microverontreinigingen. Eurofins is marktleider op het gebied van specialistisch onderzoek; opdrachtgevers zijn onder meer waterkwaliteitsbeheerders, Rijkswaterstaat, provinciale en gemeentelijke overheden, milieu-adviesbureaus, industrie en aannemers. Circa 600 gemotiveerde deskundigen verzorgen het traject van monstername tot aan de digitale rapportage van de analyseresultaten. Analyses vinden voornamelijk plaats in de grote laboratoria in Amsterdam (Eurofins Omegam) en Barneveld (Eurofins Analytico).

title: Receiving and Stock Lead
company: Country Music Hall of Fame and Museum
location: Country Music Hall of Fame and Museum
description:
Receiving and Stock Lead

FLSA Classification: Full-Time, Non-Exempt

Company Overview: Accredited by the American Alliance of Museums, the Country Music Hall of Fame and Museum has been called the “Smithsonian of country music,” celebrated for its broad cultural impact, educational mission, and unrivaled collection of historically important artifacts. Chartered by the state of Tennessee in 1964, the Museum is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit, educational organization that documents and interprets the history of country music. The Museum collects objects and archival materials that illustrate the evolving history and traditions of country music and provides diverse learning opportunities through educational programs, publications, and exhibitions.

First opened in 1967 on Nashville’s Music Row, the Country Music Hall of Fame and Museum launched its current downtown location in 2001. In 2014, the Museum unveiled a $100 million expansion that doubled its footprint. The Museum now encompasses 350,000 square feet of exhibition galleries, archival storage, retail stores, and event space. The Museum owns Hatch Show Print, a letterpress print shop opened in 1879, and it operates Historic RCA Studio B, where Dolly Parton, Elvis Presley, and many others recorded. In addition, the Museum offers the Taylor Swift Education Center for students, teachers, and families, and dedicated performance spaces in the CMA Theater and Ford Theater, both of which regularly host nationally recognized live music and cultural events.

In 2024, the Museum was awarded the prestigious National Medal of Arts by President Joe Biden. The medal is the highest award given to artists and arts institutions by the United States government. The White House Citation, which accompanied the medal, recognized the Museum’s work, which “preserves history, honors giants of the genre, and inspires future generations to write their own songs about the American story.”

What We Offer for Full-Time Hourly Staff:

  • Medical, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance Options
  • Competitive Pay
  • Paid Vacation and Sick Days
  • Paid Floating Holidays (2)
  • Time and a Half Holiday Pay
  • 401(K) with Up to 3% Employer Match
  • Employee Assistance Program (Free Counseling and Legal Services)
  • Eligibility for Public Service Student Loan Forgiveness
  • FREE 24/7 Downtown Parking and Transit Benefits
  • Continuing Professional Offerings
  • Complimentary Museum Admission (For Yourself, Family, and Friends)
  • Reciprocal Partnerships with Local Venues (The Nashville Zoo, National Museum of African American Music, tours at The Opry and The Ryman Auditorium, and more)
  • Up to 25% Discount in Retail Stores and Onsite Restaurant Venues
  • Opportunities to Attend Exhibit Openings, Concerts and Special Events
  • Employee Engagement Activities and Opportunities
  • FSA and Dependent Care Options
  • Volunteering and Community Engagement Opportunities

Departmental Overview: The retail department includes two retail stores within the Country Music Hall of Fame and Museum building, as well as an off-site warehouse. E-commerce, wholesale and product development are key components of the business. The department generates revenue through the sales of goods that provide vital operating revenue for the museum.

Position Overview: The Receiving and Stock Lead is based in our off-site warehouse. They assist with overseeing the receipt, verification, and stocking of all incoming retail products to warehouse, as well as loading and unloading of company van for bi-weekly stock replenishment trips to the Country Music Hall of Fame and Museum building.

Specific Job Duties:

  • Receive all incoming product shipments and check for damage/accuracy.

  • Assist with weekly transfer of inventory from warehouse to stores, including loading/unloading company van and driving to/from Museum building.

  • Ability to effectively maneuver around warehouse, repetitive bending, prolonged standing, twisting, stooping, squatting.

title: Principal, Portfolio Strategy and Growth - Services
description:
Intuit is the global platform company powering prosperity for over 100 million consumers and businesses across TurboTax, Credit Karma, QuickBooks, and Mailchimp. Within Intuit's business platform, the Global Business Solutions Group is $11B in annual revenue, and its Services portfolio of Payments, Lending, Bill Pay, and Workforce Solutions represents its biggest priorities and fastest-growing businesses. Across these experiences, we are evolving from workflows our customers run themselves to done-for-you experiences powered by AI, where Intuit helps customers get invoices paid faster, do payroll with less work, and access capital right when it's needed.

Each of these businesses is scaling fast. Together, they are an integrated portfolio that helps small businesses run and grow on one platform. Making these services grow together, not just side by side, is one of the biggest opportunities at Intuit, and that's the mandate of this role.

As Principal on the Services Portfolio Strategy & Growth team, you will drive clarity on cross-portfolio strategy and growth: where the portfolio should play, how the services win together, and what it takes to accelerate growth across them. Strategy and execution happen in parallel here; you'll build the 3-year view and collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to execute.

You will operate as a senior individual contributor with Services-wide reach, working directly with Services leadership and partners across the Intuit ecosystem, including Product, Engineering, Commercial, and Finance.


Responsibilities

Shape the portfolio growth strategy

  • Shape the 3-year growth strategy for the Services portfolio: priority customers, competitive landscape, and where the next horizons of growth come from.

  • Develop the frameworks and choices that clarify tradeoffs for senior leadership: where to invest, where to sequence, where to say no.

  • Identify and champion 'better together' plays across services (attach, bundling, cross-sell, and shared customer journeys) that no single business would build alone.

  • Develop the fact base that grounds annual and long-range planning, positioning Services at the company level.

Build the fact base that drives decisions

  • Own the analytical foundation for portfolio strategy: how the portfolio grows, what drives it, and where the leverage is.

  • Distill insights from imperfect data into executive-ready narratives.

  • Establish repeatable systems for diagnosing performance and evaluating initiatives, so decisions are data-backed and fast.

Turn strategy into action

  • Move from long-term thinking to short-term unblock: identify the highest-leverage growth actions, drive alignment on them, and land outcomes.

  • Lead priority cross-portfolio initiatives from problem definition through results, mobilizing partner teams across the segment.

  • Anticipate where alignment will break down across businesses and proactively drive resolution.

Create clarity across a complex portfolio

  • Act as connective tissue across the services businesses, surfacing what each is learning, where they overlap, and where the portfolio is leaving growth on the table.

  • Deliver a clear narrative of portfolio strategy and growth opportunities to Services and Intuit senior leadership.

  • Influence with and without authority: build trust with GMs and functional leaders so the portfolio view shapes their choices.


Qualifications

Experience

  • 10+ years in strategy consulting or strategy & business operations in high-growth environments. Top-tier strategy consulting experience strongly preferred. Fintech, payments, and financial services expertise helpful but not required; you'll come up the curve on the Services businesses quickly, supported by internal experts.

Strategic & Analytical Strength

  • Exceptional structured problem-solving: you can take an ambiguous, multi-business question and turn it into a clear set of choices.

  • Deep analytical fluency: comfortable building the model, pressure-testing the data, and standing behind the number in front of executives.

  • Ability to distill complexity into insight and insight into a compelling story.

Execution & Ownership

  • Track record of moving a business from strategy to action to results, not just producing the deck.

  • Extreme ownership mindset; comfortable operating with urgency, ambiguity, and evolving priorities.

Collaboration & Influence

  • Proven ability to influence senior leaders and drive alignment across organizations you don't control.

  • Low ego, high trust: you make the businesses you partner with better, and they want you in the room.

Communication

  • Executive-level written and verbal communication; able to simplify complexity and influence at scale.

AI Fluency

  • Native user of AI tools to accelerate analysis, synthesis, and communication.

title: Principal Software Engineer (Java Full stack)
description:
Eurofins IT Solutions, Bengaluru, Karnataka, India

With facilities in Europe, the United States, and Asia, Eurofins Genomics is an internationally leading provider of DNA sequencing services, genotyping services, DNA synthesis products, and bioinformatics services for pharmaceutical, diagnostics, food, agriculture, biotechnology, and research markets.

The Genomics business is powered by global engineering teams building and evolving next-generation applications, Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS), customer portals, and enterprise platforms. Collaborate closely with product, QA, DevOps, and architecture teams to deliver end-to-end solutions.

title: Body Repair Technician (Marine United - Lehi)
description:
Fiberglass and Gelcoat Technician Job Description

The Fiberglass and Gelcoat Technician serves as a skilled specialist responsible for the repair, restoration, and finishing of fiberglass hulls, decks, and other marine components. This position requires hands-on technical expertise in fiberglass lamination, gelcoat application, surface preparation, and cosmetic restoration to return vessels to like-new condition. The technician works closely with the service team, service writers, and customers to assess damage, perform high-quality repairs, and ensure structural integrity and aesthetic excellence. A strong understanding of marine composites, materials, and safety practices is essential.

Key Responsibilities:

Repair and Restoration:

  • Inspect vessels to identify fiberglass damage, delamination, osmosis, cracks, and gelcoat failures.
  • Perform structural fiberglass repairs including lay-up, laminating, and reinforcement using appropriate resins, matting, and core materials.
  • Repair, apply, and finish gelcoat surfaces to match original color, texture, and gloss.
  • Execute fairing, sanding, and blending techniques to achieve seamless cosmetic results.
  • Repair or replace marine components such as stringers, transoms, bulkheads, and deck fittings as needed.

Surface Preparation and Finishing:

  • Prepare surfaces through grinding, sanding, and chemical treatment prior to repair or refinishing.
  • Apply high-quality gelcoat, paint, and protective coatings using spray equipment, brushes, and rollers.
  • Perform color matching and custom finishing to meet customer expectations and industry standards.
  • Polish and detail completed surfaces to achieve a showroom-quality appearance.

Service Coordination:

  • Collaborate with Service Writers and the Service Manager to understand repair scopes and priorities.
  • Provide accurate time and material estimates for fiberglass and gelcoat work.
  • Document repair processes, materials used, and before/after photos for customer records and warranty purposes.
  • Communicate progress and any additional findings or recommendations to the service team and customers.
  • Ensure all work meets safety standards, manufacturer guidelines, and quality expectations.

Parts and Materials Management:

  • Identify and requisition necessary materials including fiberglass cloth, resins, gelcoat, fillers, and related supplies.
  • Verify compatibility and quality of materials with specific vessel makes and models.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work area while managing hazardous materials according to regulations.

Technical Expertise:

  • Stay current with advancements in marine composites, repair techniques, and products.
  • Troubleshoot complex fiberglass and gelcoat issues and develop effective repair solutions.
  • Mentor junior technicians and share best practices within the team.
  • Maintain detailed records of repairs for quality control and future reference.

Safety and Shop Operations:

  • Adhere to all safety protocols when working with resins, solvents, and power tools.
  • Maintain tools and equipment in good working condition.
  • Support overall shop cleanliness and organization.

Qualifications:

  • Proven experience as a Fiberglass/Gelcoat Technician in the marine, automotive, or composites industry required.
  • Strong working knowledge of fiberglass lamination, gelcoat application, osmosis repair, and marine refinishing techniques.
  • Ability to work with various resins (polyester, vinylester, epoxy), core materials, and finishing products.
  • Experience with spray equipment, color matching, and detailed surface preparation.
  • Valid driver’s license and ability to work in a shop and boatyard environment.
  • Ability to lift moderate to heavy loads (e.g., fiberglass panels, equipment) and stand for extended periods.
  • Strong attention to detail, problem-solving skills, and commitment to quality craftsmanship.
  • Manufacturer-specific training or certifications (e.g., gelcoat, composites) preferred.
  • Basic computer skills for time tracking and documentation.

Job Details:

  • Type: Full-time
  • Compensation: DOE (with potential for performance incentives)
  • Work Location: Onsite. Possible travel to offsite locations or customer boats may be required.

Benefits:

  • Paid Time Off
  • Competitive medical, dental, and vision insurance rates
  • 401k Plan
  • Employee discounts on machines/boats, parts and service

SEASONAL POMEGRANATE HARVEST – YARD COORDINATION RESPONSIBILITIES

During the pomegranate season, the Conveyance Coordinator will provide additional support for the coordination and control of fresh-fruit trailer traffic and yard operations. These responsibilities include:

Trailer Coordination & Yard Management

  • Manage and monitor the arrival, movement, placement, staging, and departure of inbound and outbound trailers carrying fresh pomegranates and other fresh fruit.

  • Prioritize trailer movement based on receiving schedules, unloading requirements, production needs, product condition, dock availability, and overall plant priorities.
  • Coordinate with receiving, production, inventory, quality, shipping, and other departments to ensure trailers are available when needed and moved efficiently.
  • Monitor trailer dwell times and identify delays, congestion, or operational issues that could affect receiving, production, or shipping activities.
  • Verify trailer identification, load information, and required documentation before directing trailers to designated locations.
  • Assist with maintaining orderly traffic flow and safe separation of pedestrians, forklifts, yard goats, trucks, and trailers.
  • Communicate trailer status and yard changes to the appropriate departments and supervisors throughout the shift.
  • Ability to read, write, and understand work instructions in English
  • Bilingual in English and Spanish preferred
  • Working knowledge of shipping, receiving, warehousing, inventory, or material-handling operations

description:

***As this position in based in the United States, the job description is available in English only.***
_______________________________________________________
Head of Audio – “O”
Technical Management
We are looking for the next Head of Audio to lead our Audio team at “O”! The main objective of this role is to assist the show’s Technical Director and the Technical Services Audio Manager in managing team activities and all operations of Audio systems and equipment (installations, troubleshooting, maintenance, repairs, show operations).The ideal candidate for this position will have strong leadership and effective communication who works well under pressure to solve problems in a live entertainment environment.
The Head of Audio will:
  • Collaborate with Show and Technical Service leaders to coordinate and supervise special projects including the research, purchase, installation, testing, troubleshooting, integration and ongoing maintenance and inspections of all equipment and systems required for rehearsal, training and show applications as well as inter- or intra-departmental needs;
  • Oversee weekly departmental task lists and crew scheduling, including day maintenance, rehearsal, training and show calls with the guidance of Show and Technical Services leadership;
  • Manage HR/administrative tasks for the department, such as, but not limited to, payroll, scheduling, onboarding, and disciplinary actions with the guidance of leadership;
  • Assist with establishing yearly budgets with Show and Technical Services leaders;
  • Operate the front of house mix console and troubleshoot audio, RF, video and communication equipment as directed for performances, Artist training and maintenance;
  • Ensure all departmental designs, equipment, systems, functions, procedures, show tracks, maintenance and inspection logs, special projects, etc. are properly and adequately documented;
  • Adhere to and promote all Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) regulations as they pertain to the safe operation of all elements related to the show; participate in all required health and safety classes and emergency rescue procedure training;
  • Develop a thorough knowledge of all Audio department equipment specific to the production in order to operate equipment safely;
  • Establish emergency procedures for show systems and situations with the Technical Services Audio Manager, Technical Director, Stage Management, and the rest of the Technical team and ensure that all Artists, Technicians and staff are familiar with and trained on all pertinent procedures and equipment;
  • Participate in and oversee special projects, including the installation of new audio show elements;
  • Ensure all Health and Safety training records are up to date and recorded properly and assist in crew schedule to allow for training, in collaboration and compliance with leadership;
  • Complete all other job-related duties as assigned.
What does it take for this role? The following hard skills are the basics of what’s needed to be successful in this position:
  • At least 5 years of previous experience working with Audio in a live entertainment environment;
  • Strong leadership capabilities;
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft applications (AutoCAD preferred);
  • Strong understanding of wireless microphone systems and automated systems;
  • In-depth knowledge of operating and repairing Audio gear, including LCS, audio console mixing, RF, video, and communications systems;
  • Skilled in LCS Cue Station programming;
  • Electronics training and audio equipment repair skills is an asset;
  • Ability to pass a swim test;
  • Ability to obtain OSHA 30 course completion card;
  • Fluent in English, both written and spoken; French is an asset;
  • Ability to perform the essential functions of the job including, but not limited to crouching, kneeling, standing, lifting, sometimes for extended amounts of time; lifting at least 50lbs unassisted, etc.; Full list of essential functions will be sent in the offer. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions;
  • Verification of the right to work in the United States for Cirque du Soleil Entertainment Group, as demonstrated by completion of the Form I-9 upon hire and the submission of acceptable documentation (as noted on the Form I-9) verifying one’s identity and work authorization.
As you can imagine, working with a circus can be quite different from other organizations, and at Cirque du Soleil Entertainment Group, we embrace these differences loudly with enthusiasm. We realize that one size fits none and invite you to come create your own specialized experience with us to see exactly what we’re talking about, firsthand.
Our emotion-provoking shows are just the tip of the iceberg: laced throughout our organization, you will find creative minds who are empowered to use their voices and be themselves, their truest selves. Diversity to us means various perspectives, fresh ideas and continuous improvement of the way we do things. We won’t pretend like we have every answer, that’s why we need you! The employees here are the center of what we do, the voices behind the final product and amazing performances on stage.
When you think of your ideal workplace, what comes to mind? For us, it looks (and really is) like this:
  • Teamwork – we thrive with collaborative teams, regardless of titles or departments;
  • Respect – when we ask someone to join our team, it’s because we trust and respect you;
  • Integrity – whether you work behind-the-scenes or in the office, you’re being counted on. We are a team and integrity goes a long way here, and like we mentioned previously, trust is important;
  • Authenticity – we want you to bring your full self to work, this is a place where you don’t need to fit into a box to belong; diverse perspectives foster even more creativity in the workplace. We embrace the human behind the employee number;
  • Being heard – you have access to everyone in the organization, use your voice on development questions or suggestions on how to improve the experience. We value open and transparent communication, and we want you to be heard!
Cirque du Soleil Entertainment Group is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate against applicants or employees because of their race, creed, color, age, religion, sex, disability, sexual orientation, marital status, military status, national origin or ancestry.

Job Category: Hourly | Non-Exempt | Full-Time

Job Site: Remote (must reside in Colorado)


Job Summary:

The Benefits Verification Specialist is responsible for verifying insurance benefits and eligibility for prospective and current patients. This entry-level role supports the admissions and clinical teams by ensuring accurate benefit information, timely communication, and proper documentation to facilitate access to behavioral health services.


Education and Experience:

  • High school diploma or equivalent required; associate or bachelor’s degree preferred.

  • Willingness to learn and accept feedback.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.

title: Software Engineer
description:
Company Overview



Docusign brings agreements to life. Over 1.5 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using Docusign’s Intelligent Agreement Management platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the #1 company in e-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).


What you'll do



In this role, you will be a member of the Admin platform development team. We are responsible for ensuring that customers receive the features and services that they've purchased across a growing suite of Docusign products and features and are able to successfully manage them. You will work closely with product and other engineers to deliver and develop backend platform service features in a scalable and secure manner. You will use your experience working with production web applications at scale to design, implement and maintain RESTful and GRPC APIs, micro services and integrations with external services. A successful person in this role will want to work in an environment where you are challenged to continue learning and growing. Where your voice and opinions will be heard and you can make a real difference. You will work closely with Product Management, Core Engineering, and internal Business and Partner teams to enable delivering value to customers faster. Docusign is transforming the way that our customers create, commit, and manage agreements. Our team is working on highly visible and impactful work to simplify and modernize the way that Docusign packages and manages features across single and multi-account customers and we need talented developers to help us get there! We move at a fast pace, solve hard problems, and are continuously innovating in the space and raising the bar. If you share our enthusiasm for building robust distributed systems, this is the team for you.

This position is an individual contributor role reporting to the Manager, Software Engineering.

Responsibility

  • Design, develop and maintain modern web features and service integrations for our backend platform services
  • Deliver secure, performant, scalable and reusable enterprise quality code utilizing Agile practices and a Continuous Integration and Deployment CI/CD pipeline
  • Collaborate through code reviews, pair programming and online remote communication to help ensure we ship scalable, secure and highly available code
  • Mentor team members who are learning skills which you have mastered
  • Keep current with the latest software engineering best practices and share with the team to continuously increase quality, efficiency and productivity
  • Apply strong analytical skills and ability to investigate and update code that you are unfamiliar with


Job Designation



Hybrid: Employee divides their time between in-office and remote work. Access to an office location is required. (Frequency: Minimum 2 days per week; may vary by team but will be weekly in-office expectation)


Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law.


What you bring



Basic

  • A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or other related engineering field, or comparable industry experience within a software organization
  • 3+ years of experience implementing and maintaining backend services, including RESTful or grpc API endpoints using a modern software language and/or framework
  • Experience with server-side development
  • Experience with microservice architecture, design, and implementation on Azure, AWS, GCP or other cloud environments
  • Experience writing logging, monitoring, alerts and dashboards to detect and diagnose live issues

Preferred

  • Experience developing in C#
  • Experience working in an agile development environment
  • Experience in integrating with web-based products
  • Strong organizational, problem-solving and communication skills
  • A demonstrated willingness to assist other team members through brainstorming, mentorship, pair-programming, knowledge-sharing and creative problem solving

Wage Transparency



Pay for this position is based on a number of factors including geographic location and may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

Based on applicable legislation, the below details pay ranges in the following locations:

Washington, Maryland, New Jersey and New York (including NYC metro area): $111,900.00 - $162,250.00 base salary


This role is also eligible for the following:

  • Bonus: Sales personnel are eligible for variable incentive pay dependent on their achievement of pre-established sales goals. Non-Sales roles are eligible for a company bonus plan, which is calculated as a percentage of eligible wages and dependent on company performance.
  • Stock: This role is eligible to receive Restricted Stock Units (RSUs).

Global benefits provide options for the following:

  • Paid Time Off: earned time off, as well as paid company holidays based on region
  • Paid Parental Leave: take up to six months off with your child after birth, adoption or foster care placement
  • Full Health Benefits Plans: options for 100% employer paid and minimum employee contribution health plans from day one of employment
  • Retirement Plans: select retirement and pension programs with potential for employer contributions
  • Learning and Development: options for coaching, online courses and education reimbursements
  • Compassionate Care Leave: paid time off following the loss of a loved one and other life-changing events

Work Authorization Notice: Please note that we do not provide visa sponsorship or immigration support for this position. Applicants must already be authorized to work in the United States on a full-time, permanent basis without the need for current or future sponsorship.


Life at Docusign



Working here

Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal.

We each have a responsibility to ensure every team member has an equal opportunity to succeed, to be heard, to exchange ideas openly, to build lasting relationships, and to do the work of their life. Best of all, you will be able to feel deep pride in the work you do, because your contribution helps us make the world better than we found it. And for that, you’ll be loved by us, our customers, and the world in which we live.

Accommodation

Docusign is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures. If you need such an accommodation, or a religious accommodation, during the application process, please contact us at accommodations@docusign.com.

If you experience any issues, concerns, or technical difficulties during the application process please get in touch with our Talent organization at taops@docusign.com for assistance.

Applicant and Candidate Privacy Notice


States Not Eligible for Employment



This position is not eligible for employment in the following states: Alaska, Hawaii, Maine, Mississippi, North Dakota, South Dakota, Vermont, West Virginia and Wyoming.


Equal Opportunity Employer



It's important to us that we build a talented team that is as diverse as our customers and where all employees feel a deep sense of belonging and thrive. We encourage great talent who bring a range of perspectives to apply for our open positions. Docusign is an Equal Opportunity Employer and makes hiring decisions based on experience, skill, aptitude and a can-do approach. description:

This role brings deep total rewards expertise into a technology-driven compensation and pay intelligence environment. You’ll advise on complex compensation questions spanning job architecture, market data, pay ranges, offer construction, and geographic differentials. As a senior individual contributor, you’ll own a compensation domain and guide the roadmap for related content, tools, and product capabilities. You’ll work directly with Product, AI, data science, and development teams to translate practitioner expertise into scalable technology. The role also involves engaging with senior customer stakeholders when compensation design decisions require experienced judgment and clear communication. It is an opportunity to shape how compensation expertise is embedded into products while building resources that scale your impact across a broad customer base.

Accountabilities:

  • Own a defined area of total rewards content and product capabilities, such as job architecture, market data integration, pay range design, offer intelligence, or a related domain.
  • Guide the roadmap for the assigned domain, prioritize initiatives, and maintain a high practitioner standard for content and product outputs.
  • Advise customers and internal stakeholders on complex compensation questions, including architecture redesigns, market data conflicts, range strategies, offer logic, and geographic differentials.
  • Provide expert guidance on total rewards strategy, explain design tradeoffs, and support defensible compensation decisions.
  • Create scalable resources such as customer briefings, design guides, communication templates, frameworks, and worked examples.
  • Partner directly with Product and AI teams to embed compensation expertise into product capabilities, including offer recommendation logic, compensation structures, and market data workflows.
  • Translate customer analytics, recurring questions, and practitioner needs into product requirements and recommendations for development teams.
  • Identify edge cases and design gaps before they affect customers and contribute to product and implementation decisions.
  • Participate selectively in customer QBRs, offer strategy discussions, architecture reviews, and other high-impact conversations involving senior HR and compensation stakeholders.
  • Surface emerging customer patterns and gaps in existing frameworks and collaborate with senior colleagues and Product teams to continuously improve compensation intelligence capabilities.

    • Requirements

    • 5+ years of hands-on experience in total rewards, compensation, organizational design, or a closely related field.
    • Meaningful experience with job architecture, market data, pay range design, organizational design, or enterprise-scale compensation projects.
    • Deep knowledge of compensation practices, including leveling frameworks, benchmarking methodologies, salary structures, offer construction, geographic differentials, and incentive design.
    • Demonstrated ability to translate compensation expertise into scalable resources such as playbooks, tools, products, standards, or enablement materials.
    • Experience communicating credibly with senior HR leaders, CHROs, compensation committees, or HR business partner leadership teams about compensation design and tradeoffs.
    • Strong judgment when presenting compensation options versus recommending specific outcomes.
    • Proven ability to create high-quality documentation and content that enables broader teams and reduces dependence on one-to-one expertise.
    • Comfort considering how compensation expertise can be translated into AI-enabled product capabilities, particularly around offer recommendations and compensation structure design.
    • Strong written and verbal communication, analytical thinking, and stakeholder management skills.
    • Experience in HR technology, compensation SaaS, or another enterprise technology environment is strongly preferred.
    • Curious, collaborative, and adaptable mindset with a willingness to learn and contribute in a rapidly evolving environment.

title: Senior ML Platform Engineer I - Financial Crime
description:
About the role:

  • Wise is one of the fastest-growing global financial platforms, and as we scale, so does the sophistication of the ML systems protecting every transaction. Our Risk ML team is building the model lifecycle platform that makes it possible to develop, deploy, and monitor ML models for financial crime detection - reliably, reproducibly, and at scale.
  • We're looking for a Senior ML Platform Engineer to build this platform from the ground up. You'll design the infrastructure that turns model development from a bespoke, manual process into a scalable, standardised one - so our data and applied scientists can focus on improving detection rather than managing operations.

This is a greenfield build with strong investment and direct engagement from Wise's senior leadership.

How we work:

  • Risk ML sits within Wise’s FinCrime organisation, owning the full ML and AI foundation for financial crime detection. We're scaling into three dedicated pillars - Feature Platform, Learning Loop, and Risk Modelling. You'll sit in Risk Modelling, building the platform layer that makes scaling our detection capabilities possible.
  • You’ll work closely with data scientists, feature platform engineers (upstream infrastructure), and Wise's central ML platform team (shared foundations). We value engineers who build for adoption - internal platforms succeed when teams want to use them.

What will you be working on?

  • Designing and building the declarative training pipeline - standardised, config-driven model training that any data scientist can use without writing deployment code
  • Building model packaging and serving abstraction - a unified interface that handles multiple model types (classical ML, deep learning, emerging architectures) through a consistent API
  • Implementing the model evaluation framework - standardised metrics, reproducible comparison, and automated validation gates
  • Building model monitoring - drift detection, performance degradation alerts, automated retraining triggers, and full audit trails for regulatory compliance
  • Owning the integration layer with Wise's central ML infrastructure - aligning on boundaries so FinCrime-specific lifecycle tooling builds cleanly on shared foundations
  • Maximising data science productivity - your platform's success is measured by how much time shifts from operational maintenance to improving detection performance

What do you need?

  • Experience building ML platform infrastructure in production - training pipelines, model serving, evaluation frameworks, or monitoring systems. Infrastructure that other teams depend on, not individual model work.
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals - you build reliable, well-tested, maintainable systems. Python, Kotlin/Java, SQL.
  • Experience with ML orchestration (Airflow, Kubeflow, or equivalent), model registries (MLflow or similar), and container-based deployment
  • End-to-end understanding of the ML lifecycle - data ingestion through training, packaging, serving, and monitoring - and knowledge of where things break
  • A product mindset for internal tooling - you think about data scientists as users and build for adoption, not just functionality

Nice to Have:

  • Model serving at scale - latency optimisation, ONNX packaging, canary deployments for models
  • Experience in FinCrime, fraud, AML, or regulated environments where audit trails and model governance are non-negotiable
  • Experience with model monitoring and drift detection systems in production
  • Track record of migrating teams from manual ML workflows to platform-based approaches

description:
Master’s Level Clinician – Outpatient

Employment Status: Full-Time / Non-Exempt / Primarily Remote Transitioning to Hybrid

Pay: $21.15 per hour ($44,000.00 annually), at minimum productivity, with additional earning potential.

**This position offers a base hourly rate plus productivity-based compensation, providing clinicians with the opportunity to increase their earnings based on services provided.


About the Position

IMPOWER is seeking a Master’s Level Clinician to provide outpatient behavioral health services to adults, adolescents, children, and families in the Glades/Hendry County area, including LaBelle and Clewiston.


This position will initially provide services primarily through telehealth and will gradually transition to a hybrid role providing both telehealth and face-to-face services in the Clewiston area. The clinician will provide assessments, treatment planning, and evidence-based therapeutic services while managing an assigned caseload and supporting individuals throughout their care.


This is a full-time position offering a flexible 40-hour workweek, base pay, incentive compensation, benefits, and qualified supervision for licensure. IMPOWER provides referrals, giving clinicians the opportunity to build and maintain their caseload while increasing earning potential through incentive compensation.


Key Responsibilities

  • Provide individual, family, and group therapeutic services through telehealth and, as the position transitions, face-to-face services in the Glades/Hendry County area.
  • Complete behavioral health assessments, treatment plans, ongoing clinical documentation, and other required records.
  • Manage an assigned caseload and maintain a minimum productivity standard of 24 billable units per week.
  • Contact newly assigned referrals within 48-hours and schedule initial sessions within established timeframes.
  • Coordinate care with referral sources, support personnel, providers, and other authorized parties.
  • Assist with referrals, appointment coordination, clinic visits, medication-related needs, telehealth support, releases of information, and other care coordination activities as appropriate.
  • Maintain accurate and timely documentation in IMPOWER’s electronic health record and applicable external systems
  • Participate in clinical supervision, consultation, staff meetings, and other required team activities.
  • Provide services in accordance with HIPAA, professional ethical standards, payer, and funder requirements, and IMPOWER policies and procedures.

Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in social work, counseling, psychology, marriage and family therapy, or another related human services field from an accredited college or university.
  • Minimum of one year of experience providing behavioral health or clinical services to children and families.
  • Strong clinical assessment, treatment planning, documentation, organizational, and time-management skills.
  • Ability to independently manage a caseload while appropriately seeking clinical supervision and consultation
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to complete all credentialing requirements established by IMPOWER, funders, payers, and applicable accreditation requirements, including required applications and documentation within established timeframes.

Benefits

  • Medical, Dental and Vision Benefits
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan
  • Generous PTO & Sick Time
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Employer-Paid Life & AD&D Insurance
  • Supplemental Coverage including:
  • Life Insurance
  • Short-Term & Long-Term Disability
  • Critical Illness
  • Accident Insurance
  • Student Forgiveness Programs
  • Qualified Supervision for licensure

Pre-Employment Requirements

Employment is contingent upon successful completion of all applicable pre-employment requirements, which may include Level II background screening, local law enforcement checks, drug screening, verification of education and credentials, and E-Verify and drug screening. A valid driver’s license, proof of auto insurance, and satisfactory Motor Vehicle Report (MVR) are required as applicable to the position.


Schedule & Work Environment

This position begins primarily remote and requires a designated workspace with reliable internet access that supports productivity, professionalism, confidentiality, and compliance with HIPAA requirements and IMPOWER policies.As services expand in the Glades/Hendry County area, the position will transition to a hybrid schedule that includes face-to-face services in and around LaBelle and Clewiston. Candidates must therefore reside within a reasonable commuting distance of the service area and be able to travel locally as needed.

title: Associate Research Scientist - In Vivo Science
description:
Each of us cares about someone who will need medicines. That’s why our vision is to repeatedly beat the odds to deliver breakthrough medicines to patients that need them. We pursue truth and scientific rigour and have the courage to work at the edge of the unknown.

We are looking for a highly motivated and detail-oriented Associate Research Scientist to join our In Vivo Pharmacology team. Working hands-on in the lab alongside experienced pharmacologists, you’ll help build the foundation of scientific rigour that our programs are built on. You’ll support the preparation and analytical phases of in vivo studies that reveal how our drug candidates behave in relevant biological settings - work that feeds directly into the go/no-go decisions shaping which programs move forward to becoming medicines.

How you might spend your days

  • Developing, performing and optimizing assays to analyze samples, including tissue dissociation, flow-cytometry, ELISA, MSD, cell culture, and other molecular biology assays on study samples (e.g., RNA extraction, qPCR or western blotting)
  • Supporting scientists in the coordination of external studies conducted by CROs, managing laboratory sample handling (aliquoting and shipping) and core administrative operations, including PO generation and invoice processing
  • Maintaining the lab space, ensuring all reagents and specialized equipment are ready for study days
  • Generating high-quality, reliable data by maintaining meticulous records in an electronic lab notebook and analyzing results using GraphPad Prism and other specialized software
  • Coordinating internal in vivo studies by supporting reagent preparation, aliquoting, sample inventory, and handling

We’d love to hear from you if

  • You have an MSc, or a BSc with 2-5 years of experience, preferably in an industry setting, with 2+ years of hands-on experience in relevant bioanalytical assays; experience with animal handling and/or tissue collection is an asset
  • You are genuinely curious and thrive in cross-functional teams and a fast-paced environment
  • You have a strong understanding of research ethics
  • You communicate scientific and technical concepts clearly, with a focus on practical application
  • You are able to support project needs and follow up with constructing and implementing solutions
  • You enjoy the teamwork that comes with working through complicated biological questions and building data sets that help to predict the success of therapies together

What we offer

AbCellera’s hiring range for this role is CAD $68,000 - $80,000 annually, commensurate with your education and job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. In addition to base salary, we offer equity, annual bonus dependent on team and company performance, and a 6% (non-match) RRSP contribution.

You will have a CAD $1,500 annual Active Lifestyle Allowance, annual vacation, professional development opportunities, and comprehensive health benefits. Scientific and technical mentorship is a priority. And you’ll find a strong sense of community and connections across AbCellera through our work, clubs, and socials.

About AbCellera

Creating medicines is the most important work we can do.

We are a clinical-stage biotechnology company focused on discovering and developing antibody-based medicines in the areas of endocrinology, women’s health, immunology, and oncology. We have built a platform for advancing antibody drug programs from target to clinic, and we are using it to build our internal pipeline.

Today, our pipeline includes two drug candidates in clinical development, two preclinical development candidates (DCs) in Investigational New Drug (IND)-enabling activities, and more than 20 active discovery programs across multiple modalities and indications.

We believe that when tenacious people share a vision and work together, they can truly have a positive impact. That’s why we hire for character and intelligence, not just for CVs or experience.

We look for people with drive and energy. People we trust. People who need to know their days are being well spent. That their work really matters. In the end, our success will be measured by the impact of our medicines.

To apply

Please submit your application through our website and refer to Job ID 23403 in your cover letter. We receive a large volume of applications and are only able to contact those who are selected for an interview. All communication from our Talent Discovery team will come from an @abcellera.com email address.

title: Divisional Director, Engineering
description:
Senstar has been safeguarding people, places, and property for more than 45 years, and today stands as the world's leading provider of perimeter intrusion detection and video management solutions, building the broadest security portfolio in the industry (fiber optic and buried sensors, AI powered video analytics, access control) designed, manufactured, and tested in North America. With over 50,000 kilometers of perimeter sensors deployed and more than 25,000 video management installations across 100-plus countries, and backed by three dedicated R&D centers, the world's largest private test facility of its kind, and a global network of service centers and partners, Senstar protects the critical infrastructure, energy, corrections, transportation, and logistics sites that keep the world moving, detecting threats early and cutting risk for organizations everywhere.

Scope of the Position

This is a senior leadership role responsible for the full breadth of Senstar's engineering organization: the hardware and embedded sensor team behind the perimeter intrusion detection portfolio. The leader will own end to end delivery across custom hardware, embedded software, signal processing, and will report directly to the Chief Technology Officer.

This is a hands-on, motivational leadership role for someone who can build credibility with senior specialists who can shape the organization into a high performing, energetic, and motivated group that drives the technology roadmap and participates at the executive level.

The Team

The combined organization totals roughly a dozen people. The sensor engineering group including an embedded software development manager, senior hardware and RF or optical design engineers, verification staff, and a design services function. The leader will also partner, through influence rather than direct authority, with a principal systems architect who holds cross-system design authority for the sensor line.

Key Responsibilities

Sensor Hardware and Embedded Engineering

  • Own end to end delivery of the sensor product portfolio across hardware design, embedded software, signal processing, and verification

  • Lead an engineering organization that includes development managers, senior individual contributors, and early career staff

  • Drive execution of the next-generation perimeter intrusion detection platform while sustaining and supporting fielded products through long product lifecycles

  • Balance new product development against sustaining engineering, field escalations, and manufacturing support, making the trade-offs explicit

  • Partner with the systems architect who owns cross-system design authority for the sensor line; the architect is accountable for the design itself, while this leader is accountable for delivery, staffing, and execution

  • Own planning and roadmap commitments with Product Management, including estimation, resourcing, and make-or-buy decisions

  • Oversee the design services and documentation interface into manufacturing, including design-for-manufacture and regulatory or compliance requirements

  • Own quality outcomes for the sensor line, including escalation and resolution of complex field issues spanning hardware, firmware, and installation environments

  • Establish engineering standards, design review practices, and delivery discipline across hardware and embedded software

Organizational and People Leadership

  • Develop people deliberately: coach a first-time development manager, progress a technical lead toward formal team leadership, and advance early-career engineers into independent development roles

  • Manage senior, long-tenured individual contributors who need technical engagement and prioritization rather than close supervision

  • Lead across sites, since both the engineering team and the customer base are distributed

  • Coach direct reports on cultivating and enhancing strong relationships with key customers

  • Collaborate with other engineering managers on a common vision across products and solutions

  • Serve as a trusted point of contact for internal Sales and Marketing teams on product functionality, competitive comparisons, and implementations

  • Recruit and retain senior engineering talent in competitive hardware and software markets

  • Proven engineering leadership across both hardware and software disciplines, including managing other managers, within an organization of comparable scale

  • Deep technical grounding in at least one core sensor domain (embedded systems, signal processing, RF, electro-optics/photonics, or electronics design), or equivalent, sufficient to hold credibility with senior specialists on either side

  • Experience delivering products end to end, from concept through design, verification, certification or release, and field support

  • A track record of developing engineers and managers, including growing first-time managers, technical leads, and early-career staff

  • Demonstrated ability to lead senior individual contributors and to work effectively alongside architect-level peers who are not direct reports

  • Experience leading distributed or multi-site engineering teams

  • Strong delivery and planning discipline, including estimation, prioritization, and predictable execution across parallel hardware and software work streams

  • A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, with seven to ten years of experience leading technology product development and product architecture

Nice to Have

  • Experience with perimeter security, physical security, defence, or other safety- and security-critical products

  • Experience with fiber-optic sensing, distributed acoustic sensing, radar/microwave detection, or similar sensing technologies

  • Familiarity with regulatory certification for electronic products (for example, CE, FCC, UL) and design-for-manufacture practices

  • Experience with Scrum and other Agile methodologies

Competency Profile

Motivating

Encourages others by creating enthusiasm, a feeling of investment, and a desire to excel; inspires others to follow and recognizes positive contributions.

Visioning

Imagines future possibilities, thinks broadly, investigates a wide range of alternatives, and communicates a clear vision to others.

Results Orientation

Focuses strongly on achieving agreed-upon outcomes, conveys a sense of urgency, and drives issues to closure.

Leading Change

Recognizes when change is necessary, challenges the status quo, and develops effective action plans to carry it out.

title: Souschef, Brugsen Ørholm
description:
**Souschef – Brugsen Ørholm
**Grib chancen hos Danmarks største detailhandelsvirksomhed og få en spændende mulighed for at:

  • være med til at lede en butik med stærk lokal forankring og et godt sammenhold

  • få en tæt relation til dine kunder og være blandt kunderne i dagligdagen

  • udvikle dig som leder og samtidig få mange karrieremuligheder i Coop

Brugsen Ørholm

Brugsen Ørholm er en selvstændig og veldrevet brugsforening beliggende i det købestærke område Ørholm i Lyngby. Butikken er blandt de større Brugsen-butikker og har egen slagterafdeling. Vi har gennem mange år oplevet stabil vækst og har en stor, loyal kundekreds fra hele lokalområdet.

Butikken er løbende renoveret og fremstår moderne med optimerede faciliteter. Samtidig er vi kendt for vores stærke fællesskab, gode arbejdsmiljø og høje grad af frihed under ansvar.

Du bliver en del af en butik med 28 medarbejdere og refererer direkte til uddeler Claus Banholtz.

Bliv en del af den lokale købmand

Som Souschef i Brugsen er du uddelerens sparringspartner, og du er med i alle de driftsmæssige beslutninger i butikken. Du får dermed erfaring med alle ledelsesmæssige opgaver, hvilket betyder, at du:

  • har medansvar for den praktiske ledelse i butikken

  • tager medejerskab og forpligter dig professionelt og engageret i forhold til at nå de givne budget- og omsætningsmål

  • udvikler butikken og præger sortimentet

Størstedelen af din tid bruger du blandt medarbejdere og kunder i butikken. Det er vigtigt, at du lærer vores kunder at kende, så vi kan tilbyde et sortiment, der imødekommer deres behov. Her er der i vid udstrækning frie rammer til at udøve ægte købmandsskab og være med til at påvirke sortimentet samt bringe lokale varer ind.

Hos os får du samtidig gode muligheder for udvikling – både fagligt og ledelsesmæssigt – i en butik med højt til loftet, korte beslutningsveje og plads til initiativ.

Vær med til at udvikle lokalsamfundet

Som lokal Brugs spiller vi en aktiv rolle i nærområdet. Sammen med uddeleren og resten af teamet er du med til at skabe aktiviteter og arrangementer, som samler kunder og lokalsamfund omkring butikken.

Vores DNA

I Brugsen er mening og fællesskab en vigtig del af hverdagen. Vi tror på, at de bedste resultater skabes, når vi løfter i flok, hjælper hinanden og tager ansvar sammen. Hos os bliver du en del af et stærkt team, hvor samarbejde, trivsel og engagement prioriteres højt – både blandt medarbejdere og i mødet med kunderne.

Som Souschef får du mulighed for at gøre en reel forskel i butikken og i lokalsamfundet. Vi skaber værdi gennem nærvær, godt købmandsskab og stærke relationer til vores kunder, og vi arbejder hver dag for at skabe en butik, som både medarbejdere og kunder har lyst til at være en del af.

Købmand til fingerspidserne

  • Du er uddannet som f.eks. salgsassistent

  • Du har mindst 3 års praktisk butikserfaring fra detailhandlen

  • Du har god forståelse for tal og regnskaber

  • Du har gerne erfaring med ledelse og kendskab til Coops systemer

Som person er du først og fremmest udadvendt, og du kan lide at tale med mennesker. Som leder har du gennemslagskraft og kan sikre resultater. Du er initiativrig og tænker ud af boksen, så vi sikrer kunderne en inspirerende butik.

Du går forrest i hverdagen og viser engagement, som smitter positivt af på medarbejdernes motivation og samarbejde.

Arbejdstid og fleksibilitet

Vi ved, at balance mellem arbejde og privatliv er vigtigt:

  • Mulighed for weekendfri, hvis det ønskes

  • Alternativt arbejde hver 3. lørdag (ingen søndage)

  • Ingen lukkevagter og kun få åbnevagter

  • Arbejdsplanen tilrettelægges i samarbejde med dig

Vil du vide mere om stillingen?

Du er velkommen til at kontakte uddeler Claus Banholtz på telefon 31 49 49 79 – eller kig forbi butikken til en snak.

Send din ansøgning via "Ansøg nu" senest den 4. oktober 2026

Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende og lukker stillingen, når den rette kandidat er fundet.

I Brugsen er vi tættere på kunderne

I Brugsen arbejder vi ud fra vores DNA, som er kvalitet, ansvarlighed og fællesskab. Det betyder at vi tager ansvar for vores beslutninger, arbejder sammen på tværs for at skabe de bedste resultater, og vi tror på at kvalitet opstår, når vi deler viden, løfter i flok og tager et fælles ansvar.

Brugsen er den lokale købmand og et vigtigt aktiv I de byer, vi er repræsenteret. Vi nyder fordelene af at være en del af en kæde samtidig med, at vi kan drive butikkerne med fokus på lokale Initiativer, lokale varer, osv. Vi er en vigtig brik i byens liv – vi både støtter og tager initiativ til lokale arrangementer, som giver et twist i det daglige arbejde. Vi er desuden mindre butikker med et rigtig godt sammenhold, hvor hver medarbejder får meget ansvar, og vi hjælper hinanden med alle opgaver.

Bliver du ansat i Brugsen bliver du en del af Coop-familien. Vi er omkring 40.000 medarbejdere og sammen med brugsforeningerne har vi en samlet omsætning på mere end 40 milliarder kr. i vores ca. 900 butikker over hele Danmark. Derfor er der mange muligheder for både nye opgaver og uddannelse og ikke mindst jobskifte internt i Coop. Vi er ejet af vores 2 million medlemmer og det andelsejede Energiselskab OK.

Vi værdsætter mangfoldighed og søger kvalificerede kandidater uanset baggrund. Sammen skaber vi plads til forskellighed, faglighed og kvalitet. Derfor sikrer vi en retfærdig rekrutteringsproces, hvor det er op til dig, om du vil vedhæfte ansøgning og billede.

description:
We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Why this role is on the menu

Instacart's global privacy program is scaling rapidly alongside the growth of its e-commerce, advertising, health, and AI-driven product lines, and the regulatory landscape is evolving faster than ever. This role exists to embed privacy into how Instacart builds and operates, ensuring product, engineering, data science, advertising, health, and business development teams have clear, practical guidance as they move quickly. Without this partnership, cross-functional teams lack the legal support needed to navigate complex data governance decisions, from adtech and retail data sharing to AI product development. A year from now, Instacart's privacy program is stronger, more scalable, and recognized as a trusted partner embedded across every part of the business.

What you'll cook up in your first year

  • Global privacy and data protection developments are actively monitored, with enforcement trends translated into clear, actionable guidance that business stakeholders can act on.
  • New products and business initiatives across e-commerce, advertising, health, and AI-driven product lines are reviewed and counseled through privacy requirements, with compliant design embedded from the start.
  • Instacart's advertising business operates with clear frameworks for data use, audience targeting, measurement, and consent, including well-governed restrictions on sensitive data in advertising contexts.
  • Data sharing arrangements with retail partners, advertisers, vendors, and subsidiaries are assessed and governed, with DPA, BAA, and cross-border transfer mechanisms (SCCs, DPF) in place.
  • Privacy program operations are strengthened: PRAs and DPIAs are supported, intake and documentation processes run effectively, and standard guidance, templates, playbooks, and training materials make privacy requirements accessible and scalable across the organization.

The secret ingredients we're looking for

Must-have pantry staples (Minimum Qualifications)

  • J.D. from a top-tier law school; membership in at least one U.S. state bar (California required or ability to register as in-house counsel)
  • 6+ years of experience focused on privacy and data protection, at a leading law firm, in-house, or both
  • Deep working knowledge of CCPA, GDPR, HIPAA, and the evolving landscape of U.S. state privacy and health data laws
  • Experience advising on adtech, data sharing, and consumer data use in a retail, e-commerce, or platform environment
  • Strong ability to translate complex legal requirements into practical, business-oriented guidance for non-legal stakeholders

Optional garnishes (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Experience with AI governance and privacy-by-design in ML/AI product development
  • Experience in AdTech

title: Cultivation Supervisor
description:
Company Description

Ayr Wellness is a leading U.S. multi-state cannabis operator with more than 90 licensed retail locations across Florida, Massachusetts, Pennsylvania, Ohio, New Jersey, Nevada, and soon, Virginia. We cultivate, manufacture, and sell a broad portfolio of high-quality cannabis products, proudly serving both medical patients and adult-use consumers across our markets.

At Ayr, our strength lies in our people. We’re re-imagining how we work across every part of our business, and we’re looking for builders and doers to roll up their sleeves and help shape what’s next.

The cannabis industry is fast-moving, complex, and full of opportunity. Together, we’re not only shaping a company, but also building the future of cannabis. At Ayr you’ll have the opportunity to make a lasting impact while growing your career alongside a company positioning itself for long-term success.

For more information, please visit

Job Summary

The Cultivation Supervisor is responsible for managing the day-to-day operations of the cultivation facility in accordance with standards set by the state and Ayr Wellness. The Cultivation Supervisor provides support for all cultivation agents, including schedules, training, policy and procedure updates, industry news, and product information. Responsible for the documentation, ordering, and receiving of all inventory and products, arranging deliveries, maintaining facility compliance, and cleanliness in accordance with state regulations and standards set by Ayr Wellness.

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Assists the Cultivation Manager with managing cultivation staff, schedules, cultivation processes, inventory, and vendor relations.
  • Serves as a role model and resource for cultivation staff concerning products and services, policies and procedures, industry news, and changes in regulations.
  • Assists the Cultivation Manager with responding to all agent questions, concerns, or suggestions and takes action when necessary to resolve conflicts.
  • Assists the Cultivation Manager with delegating tasks to cultivation agents to maintain a compliant and clean cultivation facility.
  • Oversees grow zone and maintains ownership of all cultivation tasks and processes, ensures proper documentation of all applicable activities in accordance with standards set by the state and the company.
  • Assists the Cultivation Manager with planning, coordinating, and overseeing the transition of product development by ensuring that the proper tasks are executed and that the environmental conditions support the cultivation of superior quality product in accordance with state regulations and standards set by the company.
  • Assists the Cultivation Manager in meeting crop production schedule deadlines – cloning, transplanting, manicuring, harvesting, sanitation, etc.
  • Assists the Cultivation Manager in monitoring and maintaining the health of all plants.
  • Assists the Cultivation Manager in the maintenance, sanitation, and documentation of all horticulture equipment.

Qualifications

  • Must meet age requirement as outlined by state cannabis agencies.
  • Able to pass all background checks/fingerprinting as required by state cannabis agencies.
  • Able to provide valid badging/credentials as required by state cannabis agencies.
  • Two years of experience in commercial cannabis production.
  • Thorough understanding of state and local medical and/or recreational cannabis laws and how they apply to the operations of Ayr Wellness.
  • Excellent communication skills and attention to detail.
  • Effective time-management skills and ability to multitask.

Education

Two-year degree in a horticultural or agricultural field or demonstrated experience in horticulture or agricultural production.

Experience

1-3 years’ experience working in an agricultural/horticultural field preferred

Competencies (Knowledge, Skills, and Attitude)

Priority Setting - Invests their time and others on what's important to deliver business results; quickly and effectively collaborates bringing together the collective intelligence of critical team members and prioritizes what needs to be done to reach the goal; quickly senses opportunities and obstacles in accomplishing a goal; eliminates roadblocks and creates focus that drives success and results.

Relationship Building - Viewed as a truthful individual who shares authentic and constructive feedback in a respectful manner in the spirit of being a force for good; builds mutual respect and trust by listening, learning, and acting with compassion to encourage others in discovering their genius; takes responsibility for mistakes and offers impactful solutions; recognizes personal strengths and weaknesses; seeks and openly welcomes feedback for continuous improvement and personal growth.

Results Oriented - Empowered with the knowledge of their potential this person learns quickly when facing new problems; a relentless and versatile learner, open to change, analyzes successes and failures for continuous improvement, experiments and will try anything to find solutions that support an ecosystem of knowledge; enjoys challenge of unfamiliar tasks, quickly grasps the essence and underlying structure of anything.

Functional/Technical Skill - Possesses functional and technical knowledge and skills to perform at a high level of accomplishment; understands how their job function supports being a force for good

Working conditions

  • The person in this position may be exposed to dust, kief, cleaning chemicals and fumes. Although systems are in place to remove these byproducts, there is still exposure to some degree.
  • Frequently works in rooms with bright light where eye protection is required.
  • Frequently works in rooms with moderate heat and humidity.
  • The person in this position is constantly exposed to moderate background noise due to environmental systems, equipment, and fans.
  • Must be able to work on weekends or alternate shifts.

Physical requirements

  • Prolonged sitting, standing, and walking motion/movement will be required throughout the shift.
  • Constant movement of hands/fingers and limbs; this position requires good manual dexterity, coordination, and stamina.
  • Constantly position self throughout task at hand.
  • Frequently ascends/descends a ladder to inspect/maintain plants.
  • Occasionally operates power hand tools and other cultivation machinery.
  • Must be able to inspect and detect quality deviations and defects.
  • Occasional lifting, positioning, or moving items up to 100 pounds.

Nothing in this job description restricts management’s right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time.
