title: Research Scientist II - In Vivo Science
description:
Each of us cares about someone who will need medicines. That’s why our vision is to repeatedly beat the odds to deliver breakthrough medicines to patients who need them. We pursue truth and scientific rigour and have the courage to work at the edge of the unknown.

We are looking for a lab-based Research Scientist II to join our Vancouver team and become a bridge between our in vivo models and the biological insights that shape our pipeline’s future. Working alongside experienced pharmacologists, you will support the design, execution, and analysis of in vivo studies that reveal how our drug to candidates behave in physiologically relevant settings to inform important go/no-go decisions on our programs. This is hands-on, detail-driven science, and your rigour and curiosity will play a direct role in getting new medicines closer to the patients who need them.

How you might spend your days

  • Working with team members and project teams to define the preclinical in vivo strategy to advance pipeline programs from hit identification through candidate selection
  • Collaborating with the In Vivo Models Team to design, develop, and validate novel animal models to expand internal capabilities and capture complex disease biology
  • Designing, coordinating, and interpreting robust in vivo efficacy and pharmacology studies to generate efficacy data and build high confidence in lead candidate selection
  • Collaborating with in vitro biology, protein engineering, and pharmacokinetics (PK/PD) scientists, as well as external CROs, to execute translational studies to screen and optimize lead molecules and advance programs toward human clinical trials
  • Developing, performing, and supervising sample analysis to assess target engagement, biomarker modulation, and downstream pathway effects
  • Training and mentoring junior scientists in ex vivo experimental plans and analytical methodologies
  • Synthesizing and reporting complex research findings to internal program teams and senior leadership to enable clear, data-driven decisions

We’d love to hear from you if

  • You have a PhD in pharmacology, immunology, or a related field with 2-5 years of relevant industry experience, or an MSc with 5-8 years of experience, including hands-on work in oncology, immuno-oncology, and biologics drug development
  • You have hands-on experience designing and interpreting in vivo pharmacology models to assess PK, PD, and efficacy of test articles
  • You have a strong understanding of research ethics specific to animal care
  • You are genuinely curious, with an interest in discussing innovative ideas in a highly collaborative, cross-functional and fast paced environment
  • You communicate scientific and/or technical concepts effectively, with an emphasis on application
  • You have a proven track record of independently identifying project needs and translating them into practical, well-executed solutions
  • You enjoy tackling complex biological questions and building datasets that help predict which therapies will succeed

What we offer

AbCellera’s hiring range for this role is CAD $95,000 - $112,000 annually, commensurate with your education and job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. In addition to base salary, we offer equity, annual bonus dependent on team and company performance, and a 6% (non-match) RRSP contribution.

You will have a CAD $1,500 annual Active Lifestyle Allowance, annual vacation, professional development opportunities, and comprehensive health benefits. Scientific and technical mentorship is a priority. And you’ll find a strong sense of community and connections across AbCellera through our work, clubs, and socials.

About AbCellera

Creating medicines is the most important work we can do.

We are a clinical-stage biotechnology company focused on discovering and developing antibody-based medicines in the areas of endocrinology, women’s health, immunology, and oncology. We have built a platform for advancing antibody drug programs from target to clinic, and we are using it to build our internal pipeline.

Today, our pipeline includes two drug candidates in clinical development, two preclinical development candidates (DCs) in Investigational New Drug (IND)-enabling activities, and more than 20 active discovery programs across multiple modalities and indications.

We believe that when tenacious people share a vision and work together, they can truly have a positive impact. That’s why we hire for character and intelligence, not just for CVs or experience.

We look for people with drive and energy. People we trust. People who need to know their days are being well spent. That their work really matters. In the end, our success will be measured by the impact of our medicines.

To apply

Please submit your application through our website and refer to Job ID 23402 in your cover letter. We receive a large volume of applications and are only able to contact those who are selected for an interview. All communication from our Talent Discovery team will come from an @abcellera.com email address.

title: Sr. IT Systems Engineer, DevOps
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

SR. IT SYSTEMS ENGINEER, DEVOPS

SpaceX is looking for a Senior IT Systems Engineer with a focus on DevOps to join our growing team. You will own the architecture, design, implementation, and evolution of our CI/CD platforms, infrastructure automation, and reliability engineering practices at scale, including on-premise VM and Kubernetes infrastructure. This employee will be a senior member of the Information Technology IT Applications team. The ideal candidate will be a technical leader who is flexible and flourishes in a fast-paced, high-stakes environment. He or she should be a self-starter, self-motivator, and possess the ingenuity and ownership to excel at this position while mentoring others.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Architect, design, implement, and manage enterprise-scale CI/CD pipelines and platforms running on both on-premise VM infrastructure and Kubernetes clusters.
  • Lead automation of deployment, configuration, monitoring, and operations to drive reliability, scalability, and efficiency across hundreds of on-premise servers, VMs, and containerized environments.
  • Define and enforce DevOps, SRE, and release engineering best practices, standards, and security controls across on-premise VM and Kubernetes infrastructure.
  • Partner closely with software engineering, development, and operations teams to streamline code integration, testing, delivery, and feedback loops.
  • Own system performance, capacity planning, troubleshooting, and optimization of on-premise VM clusters and Kubernetes environments; drive root-cause analysis and long-term improvements.
  • Design, maintain, and enhance observability (logging, metrics, tracing, alerting) for on-premise infrastructure using tools such as Grafana, Prometheus, Influx, Splunk, or equivalents.
  • Lead high-availability, disaster recovery, and business continuity strategies for on-premise VM and Kubernetes platforms, including planning, executing, and improving routine annual disaster recovery exercises.
  • Administer, scale, and evolve CI/CD platforms, source control systems (e.g., GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Jenkins, Bamboo, or modern equivalents), and the supporting on-premise Kubernetes clusters or VM-based infrastructure they run on.
  • Propose, champion, and implement infrastructure-as-code, GitOps, and automated release processes for both VM and Kubernetes environments.
  • Mentor junior engineers, review designs and code, and contribute to team technical direction for on-premise infrastructure.
  • Evaluate and introduce new tools, platforms, and practices to improve developer productivity and operational excellence on on-premise systems.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or information systems with 5+ years’ experience in DevOps, SRE, platform engineering, or related role, OR 10+ years’ equivalent experience.
  • Experience administering and scaling Linux environments (physical, virtual/on-premise VMs, and containerized/Kubernetes).
  • Experience administering and scaling code hosting/collaboration platforms (GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket) and CI/CD systems (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Bamboo, or similar) on on-premise infrastructure.
  • Experience designing and operating production CI/CD pipelines and automation at scale on VM and Kubernetes platforms.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Strong experience with observability and monitoring stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, ELK, etc.) for on-premise VM and Kubernetes environments.
  • Advanced scripting and programming (Python, Bash, Go, Groovy, or similar).
  • Proficiency with containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes) including on-premise Kubernetes distributions (e.g., kubeadm, Rancher, OpenShift, Tanzu).
  • Experience with configuration management and IaC (Ansible, Terraform, Chef, Puppet, or similar) for on-premise VMs and Kubernetes clusters.
  • Deep knowledge of Git, branching strategies, semantic versioning, and release management.
  • Experience with on-premise virtualization platforms (VMware vSphere, Hyper-V, KVM, or similar) and hybrid VM/Kubernetes environments.
  • Experience with security hardening, networking, and compliance for on-premise infrastructure.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead technical initiatives, influence across teams, and thrive in a fast-paced, high-ownership environment.
  • Excellent communication, documentation, and mentoring skills.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Willing to work extended hours or weekends as necessary.
  • Ability to pass Air Force background checks for Cape Canaveral and Vandenberg.

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

Pay Range:
Level 3: $155,000.00 - $215,000.00

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees accrue paid sick leave pursuant to Company policy which satisfies or exceeds the accrual, carryover, and use requirements of the law.

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

  • To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. title: Legal Externship (Spring 2027)
description:
The Tahirih Justice Center is a national, nonprofit organization that serves women, girls, and all immigrant survivors of domestic violence, sexual assault, trafficking, and other violence. Our whole-person approach to services provides each survivor with free legal support and social services to secure their rights and build stable lives. We translate our client services work into expert training, outreach, and policy advocacy to ensure that systems, laws, and policies protect immigrant survivors from violence and exploitation. Our programs efficiently and effectively leverage donated professional services from a vast network of attorneys, medical professionals, and other experts to serve as many immigrant survivors as possible. By amplifying the experiences of survivors, our mission is to create a world in which all people share equal rights and live in safety and with dignity.


We specialize in the representation of immigrant survivors of domestic violence, trafficking, and other violent crimes who seek immigration relief under the Violence Against Women Act and the Trafficking Victims Protection Act, as well as of refugees fleeing gender-based persecution who seek protection under U.S. asylum laws. Our legal advocacy includes both direct service to individuals and broader efforts to transform policies, develop regulations, and set precedent so that systemic change will ensure the long-term protection of individuals from violence due to their gender.


Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Support the legal team’s representation of clients who are eligible for asylum, withholding of removal, relief under the Convention Against Torture, VAWA, T visas, U visas, and Special Immigrant Juvenile Status.
  • Client communication: assist the legal team with client communications and interview prospective clients.
  • Preparing immigration forms: supporting legal team in compiling and completing applications for filing submission to USCIS.
  • Immigration court hearing preparation: assist attorneys with preparing for court hearings at Baltimore and Hyattsville Immigration Courts, such as with compiling trial binders, preparing requests for prosecutorial discretion, drafting and preparing motions, and observing court hearings if there is availability and interest.

  • Legal writing and research: with attorney supervision, draft legal documents such as client letters, client declarations, legal memoranda, and briefs. Research country conditions for asylum, VAWA, Special Immigrant Juvenile Status, and/or U visa/T visa cases.
  • Opportunities may arise to participate in community outreach and/or advocacy work, if the intern is interested, but this would not be a major focus of the externship.

title: System Engineer DevOps

title: Psychiatrist – Come Make an Impact
description:
Psychiatrist

Behavioral Health | Alpert Jewish Family Service | West Palm Beach, FL

Make an Impact. Help Us Build What Comes Next.

Alpert Jewish Family Service is looking for a Psychiatrist who wants more than just another clinical position.

This is an opportunity to join a mission-driven organization where your work has a direct impact on individuals and families throughout our community, and to play an important role in the continued growth of our behavioral health services.

We are also preparing to open our new Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation (TMS) clinic, and our Psychiatrist will provide clinical oversight for this exciting new service. Previous TMS experience is highly valued, but it is not required. We are prepared to provide training for the right candidate.

If you are looking for a place where you can practice psychiatry, collaborate with an experienced clinical team, help shape new programs, and genuinely make a difference in people's lives, we would love to speak with you.


What You’ll Do

In this role, you will provide psychiatric assessment, diagnosis, treatment, medication management, and crisis intervention for clients with a broad range of behavioral health needs. You’ll work collaboratively with clinicians and other members of our behavioral health team to develop thoughtful, individualized treatment plans.

You will also:

  • Conduct psychiatric evaluations and develop treatment plans.
  • Provide psychopharmacological treatment and medication management.
  • Monitor client response to medication and adjust treatment when appropriate.
  • Maintain accurate clinical and patient records.
  • Collaborate with therapists, psychologists, clinicians, and other members of the care team.
  • Provide consultation and guidance within a collaborative-care environment.
  • Help provide clinical oversight and leadership for our developing TMS program.
  • Work with individuals and families experiencing complex behavioral health needs and, when necessary, crisis situations.

What We’re Looking For

We are seeking a psychiatrist who is clinically strong, collaborative, compassionate, and excited about helping an organization continue to expand its behavioral health services.

Candidates should have:

  • Graduation from an accredited medical school and completion of an approved psychiatry residency/training program.
  • Current Florida physician licensure.
  • Appropriate psychiatry certification/licensure.
  • Active DEA licensure.
  • Experience providing evidence-based psychiatric care.
  • At least two years of clinically relevant experience treating adults.
  • Experience with psychopharmacology and medication management.
  • Strong clinical documentation and recordkeeping skills.
  • Comfort working as part of a multidisciplinary clinical team.
  • Familiarity with telehealth and the ability to work with diverse populations, including individuals with developmental disabilities.

TMS Experience

TMS experience is a plus, not a requirement.

With our new TMS clinic preparing to open, this position offers a unique opportunity to help develop and oversee an innovative treatment service within an established behavioral health program. For an excellent psychiatrist who has not previously worked with TMS, Alpert JFS is willing to provide the necessary training.


Why Alpert JFS?

At Alpert JFS, psychiatry is about more than appointments and prescriptions. It is part of a broader commitment to helping people navigate behavioral health challenges, crises, family needs, and other difficult moments in their lives.

You’ll have the opportunity to work alongside dedicated behavioral health professionals in a collaborative environment while helping us continue to expand access to high-quality mental health services in our community.

If you became a psychiatrist because you wanted your work to matter, we want to hear from you.


Ready to make a difference? Apply today and help us shape the next chapter of behavioral health services at Alpert JFS.

Alpert JFS is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any characteristic protected by federal or state law.

title: Senior Forward Deployed Platform Engineer (m/w/d)
description:
As one of the leading German HealthTech companies, we are reshaping discharge management – technology-driven, patient-centered, and free from bureaucracy. In addition to our market-leading SaaS platform, we develop AI solutions that radically simplify processes in hospitals and for aftercare providers, relieve healthcare professionals, and refocus attention on patients. Today, we already connect two-thirds of all German hospitals with over 650 rehabilitation clinics and 25,000 nursing and homecare providers. With currently around 100 employees, we continue to grow – and we are looking for people with character who want to help us improve the healthcare system and solve administrative complexity across care journeys in Europe.

Our AI portfolio spans model development through to production inference at scale, in a highly regulated healthcare context. This role exists to make sure that infrastructure runs reliably, scales predictably, and gets AI engineers' work safely into production.

What to expect

This is what you can expect from us as a Senior Forward Deployed Platform Engineer:

  • Purposeful work – your work keeps our AI portfolio reliable and performant for hospitals and aftercare providers who depend on it daily.

  • Company culture – we believe in flat hierarchies that promote high performance and strong team dynamics. We foster an environment characterized by mutual respect, loyalty, and recognition. Together, we strive for our goals – and expect the same from you.

  • Flexibility – want to pick up your child from daycare? Like to exercise during lunch? We'll support you. We are a remote-friendly company offering flexible working hours. Workations are also possible by arrangement.

  • Edenred card – which you can use according to your needs.

  • Extra vacation day – so you can celebrate your birthday with your loved ones, you'll have the day off.

This is how you will make an impact as a Senior Forward Deployed Platform Engineer:

  • Our AI portfolio needs to run reliably and perform well. Thus it has to be properly monitored.

  • Capacity needs planning, support scaling initiatives, and ensure our systems remain stable as the company grows.

  • SageMaker models need to be continuously delivered, following AWS' best practices.

  • AI engineers need assistance with productionalizing AI workloads end-to-end, from code to container build, and rollouts using optimal deployment strategies.

How we build

We run a modern cloud-native stack to build, ship, and operate AI workloads reliably in a regulated healthcare environment.

  • Cloud: AWS (The European Sovereign Cloud partition)

  • Runtime: Kubernetes and Postgres

  • Inference: Bedrock, SageMaker, ClearML

  • Observability: Datadog, LangFuse, OTEL

  • CI/CD: GitHub Enterprise Cloud with Actions

  • Plus various auxiliary tools for security, compliance and operations: DockerHub, Google as IdP, SonarCloud, VPNs, QuickSight, CDN, Snowflake, ETLs, etc.

Requirements

Requirements

Here's how we picture you as our Senior Forward Deployed Platform Engineer:

These are the knowledge and skills you need:

  • Experience with AWS (CloudFormation, IAM, ECR, SageMaker, Bedrock, S3, SQS, DynamoDB, RDS, KMS).

  • Experience with Kubernetes (EKS) in production (kustomize, HPA and KEDA based autoscaling).

  • Experience deploying SageMaker models, setting up custom inference containers (HuggingFace and/or OSS model) and endpoints (provisioning, autoscaling, and blue/green rollouts).

  • Familiarity with observability & LLMOps best practices and solutions (Datadog, Langfuse, LLM/GenAI tracing, OTel, CloudWatch).

  • Proficiency in Python, specifically with FastAPI and async task management.

  • Knowing how to set up ML/LLM GPU inference on EKS (GPU-backed instances, Nvidia driver/plugin).

  • Ability to own technical decisions and collaborate directly with other teams.

  • Troubleshooting, RCA, and resolving problems. When things get stressful, you stay cool headed and work through issues step by step, asking for support from SMEs when needed.

  • Preference for writing over talking, resulting in clear, concise, yet complete documentation and asynchronous communications.

  • This is a cross-functional role bridging the gap between applications and the platform. Ability to both explain complex concepts clearly to non-domain experts, and extract information through well-formed questions during verbal communication, is a must.

Bonus points:

  • Healthcare or regulated-domain experience (e.g. ISO 27001, C5).

  • Self-hosting/home lab.

  • Nvidia Triton/vLLM or similar.

  • MLflow, Kubeflow, ClearML, DVC, Vertex AI.

  • Slack and GitHub automations (bots, workflows, apps, etc.).

This will help you decide if you want to join us – our values are:

  • Strong opinions, weakly held. We adapt, negotiate trade-offs, and reconsider decisions when necessary. We don't stick to one implementation – we re-evaluate and adjust as needed (including throwing away the old one).

  • Pragmatic choice of tools and avoidance of one-size-fits-all thinking.

  • Bringing professionalism and empathy to how you work with others.

  • Strong belief in solid technical fundamentals and preference for understanding and first principles over memorization.

  • Language proficiency (at least English, but the more, the better).

title: Information System Security Officer II
description:
Information System Security Officer II


(Req: 26-J-1758)



The ISSO is responsible for ensuring the appropriate operational security posture is maintained for an information system and as such, works in close collaboration with the ISSM and ISO. The position shall have the detailed knowledge and expertise required to manage the security aspects of an information system and, in many organizations, is assigned responsibility for the day-to-day security operations of a system. This also will include physical and environmental protection, personnel security, incident handling, and security training and awareness. It will be required to work in close coordination with the ISSM and ISO in monitoring the information system(s) and its environment of operation to include developing and updating the authorization documentation, implementing configuration management across authorization boundaries. This will include assessing the security impact of those changes and making recommendation to the ISSM. The primary function is working within Special Access Programs (SAPs) supporting Department of Defense (DoD) agencies, such as HQ Air Force, Office of the Secretary of Defense (OSD) and Military Compartments efforts. The position will provide “day-to-day” support for Collateral, Sensitive Compartmented Information (SCI) and Special Access Program (SAP) activities.


Performance shall include:

  • Develop physical or logical topologies for a system
  • Assist the ISSM in meeting their duties and responsibilities.
  • Prepare, review, and update authorization packages.
  • Ensure approved procedures are in place for clearing, sanitizing, and destroying various types of hardware and media.
  • Conduct periodic reviews of information systems to ensure compliance with the security authorization package.
  • Coordinate any changes or modifications to hardware, software, or firmware of a system with the ISSM and AO/DAO prior to the change.
  • Monitor system recovery processes to ensure security features and procedures are properly restored and functioning correctly.
  • Ensure all IS security-related documentation is current and accessible to properly authorized individuals.
  • Ensure audit records are collected, reviewed, and documented (to include any anomalies).
  • Attend required technical and security training (e.g., operating system, networking, security management) relative to assigned duties.
  • Execute the cyber security portion of the self-inspection, to include provide security coordination and review of all system assessment plans.
  • Identify cyber security vulnerabilities and assist with the implementation of the countermeasures for them
  • Prepare reports on the status of security safeguards applied to computer systems.
  • Perform ISSO duties in support of in-house and external customers.
  • Conduct security impact analysis activities and provide to the ISSM on all configuration management changes to the authorization boundaries.


EDUCATION:

· Bachelor’s degree or associate degree in a related area + 2 years’ experience OR equivalent experience (4 years)


CLEARANCE:

· TS/SCI

· Current clearance as defined in ATTACHMENT VI

· Eligibility for access to Special Access Program Information

· Willingness to submit to a Counterintelligence polygraph


EXPERIENCE MANDATORY:

2-5 years related experience, especially in developing RMF packages or bodies of evidence; Prior performance in roles such as System/Network Administrator or ISSO; SAP experience; TRAINING: DoD 8570.01-M IAM Level II (in lieu of IAT Level II).

Must meet position and certification requirements outlined in DoD Directive 8570.01-M for Information Assurance Technician Level II or Information Assurance Manager II within 6 months of the date of hire



Other Requirements:

· Must be able to regularly lift up to 50 lb


BENEFITS:

We offer a competitive compensation package including a generous PTO and Flexible holiday package, tax-free healthcare cost reimbursement, and an immediate vesting 401K with 4% matching.

description:
Forestil dig en fremtid, hvor du lærer at drive og vedligeholde et kraftværk og deltager i nye innovative projekter, som understøtter den grønne omstilling

Ansøgningsfrist

31. oktober 2026 , 23:59 CET

Land Denmark

Lokation Asnæs Power Station

Arbejdssted

On-site

_

On-site
On-site

_

Arbejdstid 37

Jobtype Apprentice

Juridisk enhed Ørsted Bioenergy & Thermal Power A/S

Nogle af vores fordele:

Dokumenteret høj medarbejdertilfredshed og motivation

Løbende muligheder for læring og udvikling

Konkurrencedygtig løn og attraktiv pensions- og ferieordning

Fokus på sundhed, herunder sundhedsforsikring, sund og lækker mad og fitness på flere lokationer.

I denne rolle som maskinmesteraspirant vil du være tilknyttet Asnæsværket under hele dit 4½-årige studieforløb. Her vil du få praktisk erfaring med at drive og vedligeholde værkets anlæg, der hver dag sikrer energi til den lokale industri og tusindvis af danske hjem. Du vil også blive del af bæredygtige projekter, der er med til at forme fremtidens grønne energiforsyning, og få mulighed for at præge dine opgaver efter interesser og kompetencer.

**Velkommen til Asnæsværket
**Du bliver del af Asset Operation, hvor du sammen med dine kolleger bliver en del af kraftværkets organisation og vil arbejde med og lære af nogle af landets dygtigste folk inden for kraftværker, fjernvarme og grøn energi. Vi tilbyder et aspirantforløb, som giver dig mulighed for at kombinere din teori fra skolen med praktisk erfaring. Samtidig er du sikret en fast praktikplads under hele dit studieforløb, hvor du får tildelt en buddy, som vil støtte dig i din faglige og personlige udvikling. Du vil være lønnet under hele dit uddannelsesforløb.

I vores team vil du bl.a. være en del af et hold af aspiranter og maskinmesterstuderende på forskellige uddannelsestrin, hvilket giver dig en unik mulighed for sparring.

I jobbet vil du:

  • dygtiggøre dig inden for termiske procesanlæg med fokus på energiproduktion
  • deltage i bæredygtige projekter med fokus på den grønne omstilling og biodiversitet
  • oparbejde forståelse for de menneskelige processer, som er forbundet med at drive et kraftværk på et organisatorisk plan
  • deltage i vurderinger af anlægsstatus for væsentlige procesområder
  • udføre vedligeholdelsesopgaver og lære de faglige discipliner.

For at få succes i denne rolle forventer vi, at du:

  • er påbegyndt M1 på maskinmesteruddannelsen med studiestart umiddelbart efter sommerferien 2026
  • har masser af gåpåmod og lyst til at lære af dine kolleger
  • har lyst til at bidrage til den grønne omstilling
  • trives både med at arbejde selvstændigt og tæt sammen i teams
  • vil indgå i et internt netværk for studerende på tværs af landet.

Selvom din profil ikke matcher alle punkterne, har du måske andre kompetencer, der vil være relevante. Mener du, at du kan bidrage til teamet, så send os din ansøgning.

**Form fremtiden med os
**Send din ansøgning og dit CV til os så hurtigt som muligt.

Hvis du ønsker at anmode om justering af arbejdsmetoder eller arbejdsmønstre eller hjælp til rekrutteringsprocessen, så send en e-mail til accommodation@orsted.com.

Bemærk venligst, at din ansøgning kun bliver taget i betragtning, hvis den indsendes via vores online karriereside. Vi tager ikke ansøgninger eller forespørgsler fra eksterne rekrutteringsbureauer eller bureauer i betragtning til denne stilling.

**Lønramme:
**For denne stilling er det forventede grundlønsniveau fastsat i henhold til gældende overenskomst for områdetfor lokationen i jobannoncen. Den endelige løn fastsættes på baggrund af relevante kompetencer, erfaring og forventet opfyldelse af rollen inden for det angivne løninterval for at sikre et fair og konkurrencedygtigt tilbud. Denne jobannonce henvender sig primært til kandidater, der er tidligt i deres karriere eller fortsat opbygger erfaring inden for området. Lønniveauet vil derfor typisk ligge i den lavere del af det samlede interval for stillingen. Vi byder dog også ansøgninger fra alle kvalificerede kandidater velkommen, uanset erfaringsniveau. Hvor det er relevant, kan du desuden være berettiget til variabel løn og en omfattende fordelspakke.

**Vores fordelspakke:
**I denne stilling får medarbejdere, der opfylder berettigelseskravene, adgang til: arbejdsgiverbetalt pension (11 % indbetaling), fuld forsikringsdækning (ulykke, liv, kritisk sygdom og sundhedsforsikring); fem ugers betalt ferie plus 10 ekstra betalte fridage/feriefridage pr. ferieår; 3 % feriepengetillæg; adgang til Ørsted Life & Fitness Vitality, herunder holdtræning, fysioterapi, massage og trivselstilbud; en multimediepakke (mobiltelefon, pc, og internet); medlemskab af personaleklub med sports- og kulturaktiviteter samt adgang til virksomhedens kantine (månedlig frokostordning eller dagsbilletter).

**Baggrundstjek før ansættelse:
**Denne stilling kræver et baggrundstjek som en del af ansættelsesprocessen, og jobtilbuddet er afhængigt af resultatet af dette tjek. Du vil modtage yderligere information i løbet af rekrutteringsforløbet. Baggrundstjekket udføres af en ekstern udbyder i overensstemmelse med lokal lovgivning.

title: IT Solutions DevOps Engineer
description:
In a nutshell

We are seeking a DevOps Engineer to support end-to-end software delivery and platform operations. The role covers infrastructure provisioning, request coordination with external teams, automated deployments, software instance setup, and cross-team delivery coordination. Key activities include applying Infrastructure as Code practices, using Terraform to provision and manage cloud infrastructure, maintaining deployment automation and configuration consistency, monitoring deployment outcomes, and supporting security, change, and release management controls.

Software instances are provisioned and maintained across development, test, and production environments. The engineer will collaborate with development, infrastructure, security, and operations teams to resolve delivery issues, improve deployment quality, and strengthen platform reliability.

This role requires strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, disciplined organisation, clear stakeholder communication, and a continuous-improvement mindset to reduce manual effort and error-prone activities.

Where will you be based and what business will you support?

This hybrid position is based in Belo Horizonte, Brazil with a minimum of two days per week in the office.

What can we do for you?

We offer the opportunity to work on impactful, global IT projects within a collaborative and international environment, providing exposure to business-critical systems, continuous learning, and professional growth opportunities.

Are you our kind of extraordinary?

We seek a professional with experience DevOps engineering, release and deployment management, infrastructure automation, or related fields, with exposure to:

  • Agile methodology
  • CI/CD pipelines
  • Platforms: Windows, Linux
  • Database: MSSQL
  • ITSM Tool: ServiceNow, BMC Helix, JIRA
  • Cloud: Microsoft Azure (Mandatory)
  • CI/CD Tools: Octopus Deploy
  • Version control and CI/CD platform: Azure DevOps
  • Monitoring: Grafana
  • Infrastructure as Code: Terraform (Mandatory)
  • Containerisation: Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS)

  • Exposure to AI tools and technologies is considered a plus.

  • Advanced English is a must

Soft Skills

  • Ability to communicate technical issues, risks, and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Professional proficiency in written and spoken English.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with infrastructure, application support, development, security, and business teams.
  • Proactive, accountable, and solution-oriented approach to operational issues.

We support your development! Do you feel like you don’t match 100% of the requirements? Don’t hesitate to apply anyway! Eurofins companies are committed to supporting your career development.

We embrace diversity! As an Equal Opportunity Employer, the Eurofins network of companies believes in strength and innovation through diversity. We prohibit discrimination against employees or applications based on gender identity and/or expression, race, nationality, age, religion, sexual orientation, disability, and everything else that makes employees of Eurofins companies unique.

Find out more on our Careers page: https://careers.eurofins.com/

Company description: Eurofins Scientific is an international network of independent life sciences companies, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate.
The Eurofins network of companies believes that it is a global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and agroscience contract research services. It is also one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in biopharma contract development and manufacturing. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products.

In under 40 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to over 65,000 employees across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of over 950 laboratories in over 1,000 independent companies across 59 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products.

The Eurofins network generated EUR 7.296 billion revenues in FY 2025, and has been one of the fastest growing listed European companies for almost three decades.

  • Experience with Kubernetes and Helm/Kustomize.
  • Experience with Docker/containerization.
  • Experience with Argo CD and/or other CI/CD frameworks.
  • Experience configuring and using observability tooling such as the Elastic Stack (Kibana) and Grafana/Prometheus.
  • Experience with certificate management and cloud-native security practices.
  • Experience supporting cloud-native architecture and maintaining production software and infrastructure.
  • Ability to take high-level mission goals and transform them into engineering outcomes.
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and leadership skills.
  • Ability to balance hands-on engineering with leadership and coordination responsibilities.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience developing technical policies and governance frameworks.
  • Experience with AI inference serving technologies (vLLM, LiteLLM, etc.).
  • Previous experience with agentic frameworks.
  • Knowledge of vector databases and embedding systems.
  • Familiarity with LLMs and AI hosting concepts.

A minimum of twelve (12) years of experience as a SWE in programs and contracts of similar scope, type, and complexity is required. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related discipline from an accredited college or university is required. Four (4) years of additional SWE experience on projects with similar software processes may be substituted for a bachelor's degree.

$241k-$295k (Annually)

The range displayed above is a likely salary range for this position. This is not, however, a guarantee of compensation or salary. Rather, salary will be set based on experience, geographic location and possible contractual requirements and could fall outside of this range.

Benefits

We offer a generous compensation package that includes 24 days PTO accrued annually and 11 federal holidays. Our 401k is 100% vested on your start date and the company makes a direct contribution worth 10% of your salary.
  • Akina covers 100% of healthcare costs for employees and 50% toward dependents. We offer educational assistance towards college classes and will cover costs associated with job related training and certifications.

title: Group Compliance Lead - Regional Platform
description:
This is a first-line product compliance role. You will work directly alongside engineers and product managers to translate regulatory obligations into product decisions that are scalable, defensible and globally consistent.


Your mission

Keeping pace with how money moves. As Wise expands into new markets, corridors, and payment schemes, the rules governing how transfers are processed, and who can send them, become increasingly complex. You will own the compliance strategy for core product flows that determine customer eligibility: how we verify where customers live, how we handle customers who move between countries, and how we allocate customers to the right licensed entity. These aren't abstract compliance questions, they manifest directly in product screens, data models, and engineering decisions. You will need to go deep quickly, surface the "so what," and drive alignment between legal, product, and engineering teams across multiple markets.

Strengthening the infrastructure for regulatory accountability. Wise is continuously evolving the regulatory infrastructure that helps us demonstrate compliance across our licences, markets, and products. This platform connects our regulatory obligations to the policies, controls, … You'll help shape and strengthen this capability by partnering with engineers, product teams, and compliance specialists to ensure regulatory obligations are accurately reflected in our systems and translated into appropriate controls. You’ll also help make this scalable.

Staying ahead of global payment standards. Wise operates across dozens of payment schemes and licensed entities worldwide. As international standards for payment messaging and data requirements evolve, you will own the compliance thread for how Wise's product and data infrastructure keeps pace, working closely with data engineering, scheme specialists, and regional legal counsel to ensure our payment flows are accurate, complete, and consistently applied across every market we operate in.


As Group Product Compliance Lead, you will:

  • Own compliance strategy and delivery across all of Wise for core domains such as payment processing, obligations to control mapping and verification standards

  • Translate complex, multi-jurisdictional obligations into actionable product and engineering decisions

  • Represent Wise's compliance position to regional regulators, internal forums, and external auditors where required

  • Build relationships with product, policy, and compliance teams globally to maintain a consistent and current view of obligations across markets

  • Help define and scale the assurance frameworks that give Wise confidence its controls are working


We are looking for someone who:

  • Has deep fintech compliance experience, with a track record of working directly in product teams, not alongside them

  • Is comfortable in codebases, engineering discussions, and architecture reviews; not intimidated by technical complexity

  • Can move between regulatory text and product specifications without losing either thread

  • Is a strong communicator who can synthesise regulatory complexity into a clear position for non-specialists

  • Is comfortable operating in ambiguity; capable of defining structure where none exists yet

  • Has a track record of influencing decisions across legal, engineering, and product at senior levels

  • Has familiarity with payment scheme rules (SEPA, SWIFT, domestic real-time rails)

  • Has experience with multi-entity or multi-licence compliance structures

  • Has working knowledge of KYC and identity verification frameworks and the product decisions that flow from them


In return, this role offers:

  • Real ownership: you ship things, you don't just advise

  • No regional or domain siloing; genuine cross-functional ownership spanning product, engineering, and compliance

  • The chance to shape infrastructure and frameworks that will operate at company scale, affecting every Wise customer and licensed entity

  • An exceptional cross-functional team across product, engineering, compliance, risk, and banking

For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.

We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.
Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.

If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit .

title: Director of Resource Centers
company: Community Food Bank of Southern Arizona
description:
Position Summary:

The Director of Resource Centers provides strategic and operational leadership for the Community Food Banks (CFB’s) Nogales, Green Valley, Amado, and Gabreille Giffords Resource Center in Tucson. This role oversees site operations, food distribution, community partnerships, resource center operations, and staff leadership across sites. Working in partnership with the Chief Operations Officer (COO) and Programs, this role helps develop and implement strategy for Resource Center services, strengthen food access, and ensure Resource Centers are responsive to community need. The Director works across departments to support coordinated service delivery, operational alignment, and community resource connections.

Key Responsibilities:

Resource Center Operations

  • Provide strategic and operational leadership for the Nogales, Green Valley, Amado, and Gabrielle Giffords Resource Centers.
  • Ensure consistent, safe, and effective food distribution and service delivery across sites.
  • Monitor operational performance and implement improvements that strengthen efficiency and community impact while complementing and strengthening CFB’s partner network.
  • Develop and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) that support consistent operations across Resource Centers.
  • Oversee Resource Center expansion, operational consistency, and service model implementation across assigned locations.

Leadership and Staff Development

  • Supervise and support Resource Center managers and site staff.
  • Foster a collaborative, values-driven workplace culture that supports accountability, professional development, and strong team performance.
  • Provide coaching and leadership development to support effective site management.
  • Build leadership capacity across Resource Center teams through delegation, mentorship, and performance accountability.

Community Needs and Partnerships

  • Assess community needs across assigned service areas through engagement with neighbors, partners, and local stakeholders.
  • Build and maintain relationships with community organizations and service providers to strengthen coordination of services.
  • Work in consultation with CFB Programs to align partnerships, referrals, and outreach activities with organizational services.
  • Identify service gaps and provide recommendations to improve access to food and supportive resources.
  • Oversee SNAP benefits outreach across CFB’s service area and support coordination of related services based on community need.

Community and Business Engagement

  • Provide leadership for community and business engagement efforts that strengthen partnerships and expand support for CFB’s mission.
  • Cultivate and maintain relationships with local businesses, civic groups, and community organizations to increase community awareness, volunteer engagement, and philanthropic support.
  • Coordinate with the Community Engagement team on special events and outreach opportunities, including efforts such as NALC and Hunger Walk.
  • Serve as a representative of CFB with community networks, civic groups, and business leaders to build long-term partnerships that support organizational priorities.

Operational Coordination

  • Work in consultation with Warehouse Operations to coordinate inventory needs, delivery schedules, and product flow for Resource Center distributions.
  • Communicate site demand and operational needs to support warehouse planning and food allocation.
  • Work with Facilities to address maintenance, safety, and site readiness needs across Resource Center locations.
  • Collaborate across departments to support coordinated, efficient, and mission-aligned service delivery.

Budget and Resource Management

  • Develop and oversee operational budgets for assigned Resource Centers.
  • Monitor budget performance and ensure responsible stewardship of organizational resources.
  • Support planning related to staffing, infrastructure, and operational needs across sites.
  • Oversee DES reporting and other required Resource Center reporting, documentation, and compliance activities.

Strategy and Organizational Alignment

  • Provide operational insight that informs organizational strategy and future Resource Center development.
  • Partner with the COO and Programs to develop and implement CFB priorities related to food access, community partnerships, and service delivery.
  • Collaborate with internal departments to support coordinated service delivery across the organization.
  • Provide leadership to ensure Resource Centers are responsive to community needs and promote equitable access, dignity, and respect for neighbors served.
  • Use operational insight, community input, and performance trends to guide recommendations for the future direction of Resource Centers

Compliance and Safety

  • Ensure Resource Center operations comply with CFB policies and applicable standards including AIB, DES, OSHA, Feeding America, and relevant regulations.
  • Support consistent implementation of food safety, sanitation, and operational procedures across sites.
  • Promote a culture of safety and support site readiness for inspections, audits, and operational reviews.

Data and Performance Management

  • Oversee data collection and reporting related to Resource Center operations.
  • Use operational and community data to inform decisions and support service improvements.
  • Oversee reporting related to Resource Center operations, service delivery, and benefits outreach, and use data to support planning and performance improvement

Other Duties

  • Perform other duties as assigned to support Resource Center operations and CFB’s mission.

Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice. title: Operations Assistant
description:
About Smoky Mountain Children’s Home: Smoky Mountain Children’s Home (SMCH) provides care, support, and hope to children and youth in need. Our Operations team keeps our campus running smoothly so our staff and residents can focus on growth and healing.


Position Summary: We are seeking a reliable, self-motivated Operations Assistant to support campus operations. You will work closely with the Operations Coordinator to handle warehouse activities, donations, resident supplies, cottage moves, and event logistics.


Key Responsibilities

  • Warehouse & Inventory: Maintain a clean, safe warehouse, process donations, and perform monthly inventory counts.
  • Donations: Pick up, transport, clean, store, and redistribute donated items from community partners.
  • Resident Support: Prepare "First Day" supply kits and track youth personal inventory during admissions, moves, and discharges.
  • Requisitions & Moves: Assist with monthly cottage supply requisitions, facility moves, packing, and furniture setup.
  • Inspections & Events: Help with facility inspections, campus projects, and event setup with the Co-Executive Director’s Office.


Qualifications & Requirements

  • Education & Age: High School Diploma (or equivalent) and 18+ years old.
  • Background Check & License: Clear all background checks and maintain a valid driver's license.
  • Skills & Availability: Highly organized, punctual, strong communication skills, and open to working some nights, weekends, and holidays.
  • Physical Demands: Able to lift 40+ lbs, walk hills/stairs briskly, and spend ~60% standing/walking and ~40% lifting/bending indoors and outdoors.


Compensation & Benefits

  • Salary: $29,200 – $32,200/year (based on education), plus eligibility for a $1,000/year increase after a favorable 90-day review.
  • Benefits: 100% employer-paid medical insurance (or $500/month stipend), free life insurance, retirement plan, paid vacation/sick/personal leave, and referral bonuses.


*Smoky Mountain Children's Home does not provide any form of sponsorship to applicants not authorized to work in the US.


Smoky Mountain Children's Home is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Associate Materials Scientist
description:
The Associate Scientist provides laboratory support in synthesizing salt forms and polymorphs of drug candidates and evaluates these forms for acceptability as drug substances with respect to chemical manufacturing and formulation into pharmaceutical products. The successful candidate will engage in solid form characterization and in particle characterization. The position is based in Groton, CT (USA).

Role Responsibilities:

  • Conduct solid state characterization (e.g., X-ray powder diffraction, thermal analysis, moisture sorption, microscopy, spectroscopy) of small molecules of pharmaceutical relevance.
  • Support multidisciplinary project teams and collaborate with colleagues to define and implement crystallization, polymorph, salt, and co-crystal screening activities according to project timelines.
  • Support multidisciplinary project teams and collaborate with colleagues to define and implement API particle characterization activities according to project timelines.
  • Conduct physical and surface characterization of powders of pharmaceutical relevance. This includes particle characterization (e.g., particle size, shape) and surface characterization (e.g., surface energy, surface roughness).
  • Collaborate with colleagues in Medicinal Chemistry, Formulation and Biopharmaceutics to define and implement screening and characterization strategies consistent with solid form selection for clinical studies.
  • Solve scientific problems using contemporary Materials Science experimental techniques.
  • Contribute to the development of new scientific approaches and knowledge within the Materials Science organization.
  • Ensure contemporaneous and accurate entries are made in the electronic laboratory notebook system according to accepted good practice.
  • Bachelor’s Degree (BS) with 2+ years of experience or a Master’s degree (MS) in pharmaceutical science, chemistry, chemical engineering, or related field.
  • Strong pharmaceutical, API, small molecules testing for drug production is strongly preferred
  • Experience in solid state characterization techniques (such as x-ray powder diffraction, polarized light microscopy, differential scanning calorimetry, thermogravimetric analysis, spectroscopy, etc.). Strong data analysis and interpretation skills.
  • Experience and understanding of infrared spectroscopy (FTIR, NIR, FT-Raman) and/or SSNMR is an advantage.
  • Experience with solving Materials Science problems, e.g., solid state chemistry and particle characterization using experimental approaches and team collaboration.
  • Understanding of physical, analytical, and organic chemistry.
  • Good organizational skills, the ability to work independently, and excellent oral and written communication skills are required.
  • A strong interest and motivation to learn new technologies and concepts is expected.

title: Salgsassistent, Brugsen Hejls
description:
Dagli’Brugsen Hejls søger ny salgsassistent (37 timer) til teamet!

Dagli'Brugsen Hejls er områdets lokale dagligvarebutik. Hejls er er sommerhusområde med udpræget trafiik i ferieperioder, så temposkift om omstillingsparathed er en del af hverdagen.

Vi er ca. 20 engagerede kolleger i alle aldre, som glæder os til at byde dig velkommen.

Om jobbet

I tæt samarbejde med butikkens øvrige medarbejdere sikrer du, at butikken altid fremstår frisk, indbydende og salgsklar. Du er med til at klargøre butikken til forskellige sæsoner, som f.eks. jul, påske, mv. Alle medarbejdere bidrager til at sætte kunden i fokus og yde en helt særlig kundeservice. Vi sætter trivsel højt, og ønsker os en kollega, som er i besiddelse af humor og en positiv indstilling.

De daglige opgaver består af:

  • Kundebetjening
  • Vareopfyldning
  • Bestilling af varer
  • Klargøring af butikken til avis- / sæsonstart
  • Gennemførsel af åbne- og lukkerutiner

Stillingen indebærer, at du selvstændigt er ansvarlig for lukning af butikken 1 gang om ugen.

Vi tilbyder:

  • En afvekslende hverdag hvor 2 dage aldrig er ens
  • Gode kolleger som sætter samarbejde og trivsel højt
  • Udviklingsmuligheder via Coops omfattende uddannelsesprogram
  • Medarbejderbonusordning
  • Mulighed for at leje ferieboliger i såvel DK som i udlandet til attraktive priser via Coop Ferie.

Om dig

Vi forventer, at du brænder for kundeservice og dagligvarer. Det er vigtigt, at du er udadvendt, synlig og imødekommende overfor kunderne. Du har interesse i købmandskabet og nysgerrig efter at lære endnu mere om salg og indtjening. Du evner at planlægge og prioritere de daglige opgaver, som du udfører selvstændigt og effektivt. Du tager ansvar for opgaverne og følger dem helt i mål.

Vil du vide mere?

Du er velkommen til at kontakte Uddeler Ole Andersen på telefon 75574211 – eller kig forbi butikken til en snak.

Send din ansøgning via "Ansøg nu" senest den 14 oktober 2026 - vi behandler ansøgningerne løbende, så tøv ikke med at søge!

I Brugsen er vi tættere på kunderne

I Brugsen arbejder vi ud fra vores DNA, som er kvalitet, ansvarlighed og fællesskab. Det betyder at vi tager ansvar for vores beslutninger, arbejder sammen på tværs for at skabe de bedste resultater, og vi tror på at kvalitet opstår, når vi deler viden, løfter i flok og tager et fælles ansvar.

Brugsen er den lokale købmand og et vigtigt aktiv I de byer, vi er repræsenteret. Vi nyder fordelene af at være en del af en kæde samtidig med, at vi kan drive butikkerne med fokus på lokale Initiativer, lokale varer, osv. Vi er en vigtig brik i byens liv – vi både støtter og tager initiativ til lokale arrangementer, som giver et twist i det daglige arbejde. Vi er desuden mindre butikker med et rigtig godt sammenhold, hvor hver medarbejder får meget ansvar, og vi hjælper hinanden med alle opgaver.

Bliver du ansat i Brugsen bliver du en del af Coop-familien. Vi er omkring 40.000 medarbejdere og sammen med brugsforeningerne har vi en samlet omsætning på mere end 40 milliarder kr. i vores ca. 900 butikker over hele Danmark. Derfor er der mange muligheder for både nye opgaver og uddannelse og ikke mindst jobskifte internt i Coop. Vi er ejet af vores 2 million medlemmer og det andelsejede Energiselskab OK.

Vi værdsætter mangfoldighed og søger kvalificerede kandidater uanset baggrund. Sammen skaber vi plads til forskellighed, faglighed og kvalitet. Derfor sikrer vi en retfærdig rekrutteringsproces, hvor det er op til dig, om du vil vedhæfte ansøgning og billede.

title: Project Manager
description:
Capio Group is looking for an experienced Project Manager!

Full-time employee - Remote
Salary: $130,000 - $140,000

About Us:

Capio Group is a California-based Information Technology Consulting firm serving the public sector since 2010. We assist the Government in delivering large, complex systems and solutions. Capio Group is a small, but quickly growing firm that mixes good ideas, with great people, to achieve extraordinary results for our clients. We offer the salary and benefits of the bigger companies, with the added bonus of a flexible workplace and a great work-life balance.

Scope of Work:

Capio Group is looking for an experienced Project Manager to work as part of a team on assisting with modernizing the client legacy systems by migrating to Salesforce and supporting integration efforts between legacy platforms and new technologies. The scope includes, but is not limited to, control cashier inventory management, vehicle registration, and integration to various legacy mainframe and Java applications within the enterprise. The Project Manager will help architect the solution, develop a detailed plan, and execute the transition to or with Salesforce. Additionally, will help with integrating legacy systems, including those built on Java, z/OS Connect, IBM Host Access Transformation Services (HATS), and other applicable technologies, ensuring seamless data flow and operational continuity. The Project Manager shall be able to provide expertise in client legacy systems and business processes, and Salesforce, and architectural design in support of the department’s modernization efforts. efforts. Support may be required in but is not limited to: IBM Host Access Transformation Services (HATS), Java, JavaScript, html, CSS, EDX/EDL integration with Modern C, Bash/Ksh, and J2EE, GitHub, Gitlab, Liberty/WebSphere applications, AIX, Red Hat Enterprise Linux, IBM Integration Bus (IIB), HP Exstream/OpenText, COBOL, DB2, VSAM, CICS, Endevor, Salesforce, MuleSoft, Copado, Talend, Red Hat Decision Manager, and mainframe support. Services requested may include, but are not limited to, business and technical analysis, project business and technical documentation, architectural and data plans, project management, code and report development and implementation, testing, conversion, training, and knowledge/skills transfer.

The Project Manager will be responsible for tasks including but not limited to:

1. Solution Specifications Development
  • Develop detailed solution specifications and recommendations.
  • Document all business rules relating to requirements.
  • Develop integrations with other systems.
  • Develop conceptual designs.
  • Develop data models.
  • Gather and document requirements for business process realignment.
  • Create Application Developer and Administrator Support Guides.
  • Create System Design Documents
2. Solution Development and System Testing
  • Develop and implement a new solution, as well as new code for the integration of applications.
  • Modify existing code and documentation.
  • Transition of code through various application environments, including documentation.
  • Deliver defect fix, including documentation.
  • Write automated tests to validate code functionality and coverage.
  • Complete development of system enhancements.
  • Complete unit testing and document results in a Unit Testing Report.
  • Run automated test scripts for mission critical and high-volume transactions and complete system integration testing (SIT) and document results in a SIT Report.
  • Provide defect fixes and resolutions for end-to-end (E2E) testing and document the results in an E2E Testing Report
  • Provide defect remediation for other relevant test cycles.
  • Complete user reports analysis, development, and/or conversion.
3. Perform Project Management
  • Assess and update Master Project Management Plan.
  • Perform Risk Management activities.
  • Perform Schedule Management activities.
  • Perform Communication Management activities.
  • Manage Work Breakdown Structure (WBS).
  • Perform Cost Management activities.
  • Create Project Reports.
  • Enforce Change Control Processes.
  • Perform Project Plan and Process Quality Assurance activities.
  • Perform Project Management team activities, facilitate team communication, track progress and maintain project plan documentation.
4. Analysis
  • Review the As-Is architecture, analyze legacy systems, and deliver solutions for platform-based architecture.
  • Gather and document requirements and identify gaps.
  • Analyze current processes and deliver solutions for business process realignment.
  • Analyze reports and provide architectural framework enhancements and defect fixes for data conversion efforts.
5. Release Management and Deployment
  • Create a Continuous Integration / Continuous Deployment pipeline.
  • Create and manage release management processes.
  • Build and align organization’s release calendar with external and internal customers.
  • Prioritize and plan release build activities for critical defect fixes and product enhancements and publish production incident, release and resolution reports.
6. Knowledge Transfer
  • Conduct knowledge sharing/mentoring sessions, walkthroughs including documentation.
  • Develop training materials.
  • Provide post-go-live defect triage and system monitoring activities.
  • Document critical information, responsibilities and workflows into a Knowledge Transfer Report.
  • Submit monthly Knowledge Transfer Reports summarizing activities completed for the period.
  • Provide/perform functional and technical mentoring sessions to maintain the application software.
  • Develop, and maintain system documentation for technical and non-technical staff to maintain and operate the application software.
7. Post-Implementation Support
  • Perform technical lead post-implementation support for production issues and resolution.
  • Deliver documentation for production and maintenance operations issues resolution and support.
  • Perform technical delivery on enhancements to address degradation of system or application.
  • Monitor the system applications through the hypercare phase.
8. Maintenance and Operations (M&O)
  • Create the M&O Plan – showing the processes, methodologies, and tasks to maintain and operate the Solution.
  • Create the Transition Exit and Interaction Plan - the approach to ensuring engagement transfer to the client.
  • Create Technical Guide
  • Create a glossary, definition of each module, and data dictionary.
  • Setup monitoring, automation, or reporting.

Mandatory Experience:

  1. Must have a minimum of five (5) years of broad, extensive and increasingly responsible Project Manager project experience applying project management principles, methods, techniques, and tools.
  2. Must have at least three (3) years of applying project management principles, methods, techniques, and tools experience must have been in a lead capacity.
  3. Must possess a valid Project Management Institute, Project management Professional (PMP) certification. A copy of the certification must be provided upon request. Certification is required and cannot be substituted with additional experience.
  4. Must possess a bachelor’s degree. Additional qualifying experience may be substituted for the required education on a year-for-year basis. A copy of the degree must be provided upon request.
  5. At least five (5) years of FTE experience in the last ten (10) years managing projects for the State of California using CA-PMF or PMBOK.
  6. At least seven (7) years of FTE experience leading large teams through the full application lifecycle (planning through post-implementation support).
  7. At least five (5) years of FTE experience maintaining large-scale integrated project schedules with multiple phases or sub-projects.
  8. At least five (5) years of FTE experience developing project status reports for executives and stakeholders.
  9. At least three (3) years of FTE experience designing and implementing waterfall, iterative, or Agile testing processes.
  10. At least one (1) year of FTE experience managing multi-vendor teams and delivering Salesforce or MuleSoft-based projects.
  11. Must be able to provide a client/user end reference contact information for each applicable project meeting the requirements upon request in the qualification form. The reference contact must be a representative of the company for which the project was developed and must have served in a management or supervisory role.
Equal Opportunity Employer:
At Capio Group, our employees are our greatest asset and diversity, equity, and inclusion are at the core of who we are. Our commitment to these values is unyielding and is central to our mission and to our impact. We know that having diverse perspectives helps to generate better ideas to solve the complex problems of our diverse clients and the communities they serve.

title: Senior Program Manager - Podcast Sales Strategy & Solutions
description:

We don’t just sell creative solutions to our clients and partners, we help to shape them; using our expert knowledge of ad products, sales channels and the industry to impact the way the world experiences music and podcasts.

Podcast Sales Strategy & Solutions (PS3) is the operational engine behind Spotify’s podcast advertising business. We work across sales, content, talent, and operations to bring podcast advertising to life — from ad formats and approvals to booking operations, sales enablement, and new show launches.

We’re looking for a Senior Program Manager to own key podcast ad operations across The Ringer portfolio. You’ll connect Spotify’s sales organization with content, talent, and operations teams, keeping high-volume approvals and booking workflows moving while helping our sales teams understand what can run, where, and when. You’ll be close to the full lifecycle of podcast advertising and help make sure nothing falls through the cracks.

What You'll Do

  • Own Integrated Solutions approvals and vetting across The Ringer podcast portfolio, triaging incoming sponsorship requests, coordinating with the right partners, and tracking requests through resolution.
  • Maintain a clear view of approvals across formats and shows, including what is approved, declined, pending, or escalated.
  • Be a day-to-day partner to sales teams on approval timelines, show availability, booking logistics, and podcast advertising formats, and help resolve campaign-specific blockers.
  • Serve as a key connection between Spotify’s sales organization and The Ringer Studios Business Operations team, translating new formats, processes, and advertising products into clear operational plans.
  • Manage The Ringer Podcast Booking Calendar, including inbound holds and bookings, new shows, editorial calendar updates, and post-sale booking changes.
  • Coordinate the PS3 workstream for new Ringer show launches, partnering across pricing, talent preferences, Creative Operations, sales enablement, and go-to-market readiness.
  • Support new advertising format rollouts and maintain accurate sales resources, including show sheets, FAQs, format guidance, booking tools, and other enablement materials.
  • Use campaign, booking, inventory, and revenue information to identify discrepancies, surface recurring questions, and improve how the team operates.

Who You Are

  • You have 4+ years of experience in media operations, advertising operations, sales support, program management, or another coordination-heavy environment.
  • You’re comfortable partnering closely with sales teams and can translate what a seller needs into clear operational next steps.
  • You understand the relationship between content and advertising and can navigate situations where talent preferences, brand suitability, format requirements, and commercial needs intersect.
  • You’re highly organized and have a reliable approach to managing multiple open requests, dependencies, and deadlines at once.
  • You communicate clearly and concisely across different audiences, from sales partners and talent representatives to content and operations teams.
