title: Supply Chain Associate (Logistics)
description:
Introduction

Established in 1951, IOM is a Related Organization of the United Nations and the leading UN agency in the field of migration. Working closely with governmental, intergovernmental and non-governmental partners, IOM promotes humane and orderly migration for the benefit of all. It saves lives and protects people on the move, drives solutions to displacement, and facilitates pathways for regular migration, while providing services and advice to governments and migrants.

IOM is committed to fostering a respectful, inclusive and supportive workplace where all employees can thrive professionally and feel valued. By creating such an environment, IOM aims to better harness the full potential of migration and strengthen its support to people on the move.

IOM invites candidates from diverse backgrounds to apply and provides reasonable accommodation throughout the recruitment process when required. Learn more about IOM’s workplace culture at IOM workplace culture | International Organization for Migration

Applications are welcome from internal and external candidates. For all IOM vacancies, applications from qualified and eligible first-tier candidates are considered before those of qualified and eligible second-tier candidates in the selection process. For the purpose of this vacancy, internal and internal-equivalent candidates are considered as first-tier candidates.

Organizational Context and Scope

The International Organization for Migration (IOM) in Libya has been operating in the country since 2006, supporting the Government of Libya and affected communities through a comprehensive range of humanitarian, stabilization, and migration management activities. IOM Libya’s work focuses on providing direct assistance and protection to migrants, internally displaced persons, returnees, and host communities, while strengthening national capacities in areas such as migration governance, border management, health, mental health and psychosocial support, displacement tracking, and voluntary humanitarian return. Through close coordination with national authorities, UN agencies, donors, and civil society partners, IOM Libya contributes to saving lives, promoting humane and orderly migration, and supporting recovery and longer‑term solutions across the country.

The IOM Supply Chain Unit supports the organization’s global humanitarian operations by ensuring timely, compliant, and cost-effective delivery of goods and services. It manages end to-end supply chain functions including procurement, warehousing, inventory, transport, and last-mile delivery while maintaining strong coordination with country and regional offices. The unit enables rapid emergency response through established supply pipelines, strategic vendor agreements, and partnerships with UN agencies and government counterparts. It also strengthens operational efficiency and compliance by promoting best practices, risk management, and capacity-building across missions. This TOR is developed within this operational framework to support ongoing improvements and ensure accountable delivery of assistance.

Under the overall guidance of the Head Supply Chain Unit and the direct supervision of the Procurement and Logistics Officer, the incumbent will be responsible and accountable for providing necessary support to the following tasks and responsibilities in IOM Libya office:

  1. Receive and consolidate all procurement requisition forms by verifying the completeness of the required information in accordance with the Purchase Authorisation Matrix and other office instructions and obtain any necessary additional information.

  2. Assist supervisors in more complex, higher-value purchases.

  3. Prepare tender documents, solicit bids and quotations as applicable, prepare bid analysis summary and share it with the requesting unit. Support in the evaluation process and provide technical inputs. Once the purchase is approved, confirm terms of agreement with selected suppliers, prepare the relevant documentation (purchase order, contract, etc.) and coordinate the required authorisations.

  4. Monitor status of open requisitions and follow up on the timely delivery of goods and services. Upon delivery, coordinate with the receiving unit to obtain satisfactory delivery notes.

  5. Review vendor invoices, prepare payment requests and coordinate the timely payment to suppliers/service providers with Finance.

  6. Create and maintain physical and electronic records of all documentation through the procurement cycle in accordance with IOM instructions and procedures. Retrieve, present and analyse information from the system and draft periodic reports highlighting issues that require attention.

  7. Conduct market surveys to identify potential new suppliers/service providers. Participate in their evaluation regarding quality, prices and services in line with the organisation’s best interests.

  8. Keep track of any contractual agreements and inform concerned parties for timely renewal. Monitor office supplies and service and prepare requisitions when required and coordinate with Finance Unit the payment of utilities invoices.

  9. Provide briefing and technical guidance to all staff in the office on procurement related instructions and procedures.

  10. Perform supply chain tasks related to property and asset management, warehousing, insurance coverage, maintenance, and transportation.

  11. Coordinate fleet operations activities including preparation of daily vehicle schedule, monitoring of vehicle logbooks, and coordination of vehicle maintenance.

  12. Provide training and guidance to the junior SCM staff of CO, while monitoring, evaluating and supporting their professional and career development.

  13. Perform such other relevant duties as maybe assigned.

Required Qualifications and Experience

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Accounting, Logistics, Supply Chain Management or a related field from an accredited academic institution with three years of relevant professional experience; or

  • High School diploma with five years of relevant professional experience

  • Certification in Procurement, Logistics or Supply Chain Management is an advantage

Accredited Universities are those listed in the UNESCO World Higher Education Database.

Experience

  • Experience in procurement and logistics and working with vendors and service providers;

  • Experience with asset management process;

  • Experience working with IOM/UN Procurement and Logistics Rules and Procedures is an advantage; and,

  • Experience working in an international organisation an advantage.

Skills

  • High level of computer literacy;

  • Ability to work with national and international institutions;

  • Ability to prepare clear and concise report;

  • Excellent communication and negotiation skills; and,

  • Ability to establish realistic resource requirements to meet IOM needs.

Languages

All IOM staff members in all categories are required to be fluent in one of the IOM's official languages (English, French, Spanish).

For this position, fluency in English is required

Proficiency of language(s) required will be specifically evaluated during the selection process, which may include written and/or oral assessments.

Required Competencies

IOM’s competency framework can be found at this link. Competencies will be assessed during the selection process.

Values - all IOM staff members must abide by and demonstrate these five values:

  • Inclusion and respect for diversity: Respects and promotes individual and cultural differences. Encourages diversity and inclusion.
  • Integrity and transparency: Maintains high ethical standards and acts in a manner consistent with organizational principles/rules and standards of conduct.
  • Professionalism: Demonstrates ability to work in a composed, competent and committed manner and exercises careful judgment in meeting day-to-day challenges.
  • Courage: Demonstrates willingness to take a stand on issues of importance.
  • Empathy: Shows compassion for others, makes people feel safe, respected and fairly treated.

Core Competencies – behavioural indicators Level 1

  • Teamwork: Develops and promotes effective collaboration within and across units to achieve shared goals and optimize results.
  • Delivering results: Produces and delivers quality results in a service-oriented and timely manner. Is action oriented and committed to achieving agreed outcomes.
  • Managing and sharing knowledge: Continuously seeks to learn, share knowledge and innovate.
  • Accountability: Takes ownership for achieving the Organization’s priorities and assumes responsibility for own actions and delegated work.
  • Communication: Encourages and contributes to clear and open communication. Explains complex matters in an informative, inspiring and motivational way.

Managerial Competencies – behavioural indicators Level 2, if with direct reports

  • Leadership: Provides a clear sense of direction, leads by example and demonstrates the ability to carry out the Organization’s vision. Assists others to realize and develop their leadership and professional potential.
  • Empowering others: Creates an enabling environment where staff can contribute their best and develop their potential.
  • Building Trust: Promotes shared values and creates an atmosphere of trust and honesty.
  • Strategic thinking and vision: Works strategically to realize the Organization’s goals and communicates a clear strategic direction.
  • Humility: Leads with humility and shows openness to acknowledging own shortcomings.

Notes

Please refer to this link for guidance on IOM Job Category.

Any offer made to the candidate in relation to this vacancy notice is subject to funding confirmation.

This selection process may be used to staff similar positions in various duty stations. Recommended candidates will remain eligible to be appointed in a similar position for a period of 24 months.

Appointment will be subject to certification that the candidate is medically fit for appointment, accreditation, any residency or visa requirements, security clearances.

IOM has a zero-tolerance policy on conduct that is incompatible with the aims and objectives of the United Nations and IOM, including sexual exploitation and abuse, sexual harassment, abuse of authority and discrimination based on gender, nationality, age, race, sexual orientation, religious or ethnic background or disabilities.

IOM does not charge a fee at any stage of its recruitment process (application, interview, processing, training or other fee). IOM does not request any information related to bank accounts.

IOM only accepts duly completed applications submitted through the IOM e-Recruitment system (for internal candidates link here). The online tool also allows candidates to track the status of their application.

No late applications will be accepted. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

For further information and other job postings, you are welcome to visit our website: IOM Careers and Job Vacancies

title: Kordegn og daglig leder søges
description:
Kordegn og daglig leder søges

Kordegn og daglig leder søges til Kristkirken, Kolding

Vil du stå i spidsen for vores engagerede medarbejdergruppe og indgå i et myldrende menighedsliv med mange frivillige?

Så søger vi nu en nærværende og samarbejdsorienteret daglig leder og kordegn, der kan skabe trivsel og administrativt overblik i vores kirke.

Stillingen, der er en fuldtidsstilling, ønskes besat pr. 1. december 2026 eller snarest muligt.

En central rolle i kirkens hverdag

Som daglig leder og kordegn får du en spændende og alsidig nøglefunktion. Du varetager ledelsen af kirkens ni medarbejdere (ekskl. præsterne) og den daglige administration af sognets kirkelige aktiviteter. Med din koordinerende rolle er du samtidig et vigtigt bindeled mellem menighedsråd, præster, ansatte og frivillige. Du refererer til menighedsrådets personaleansvarlige.

Dine primære arbejdsområder

Stillingen spænder bredt over ledelse, administration og kirkeligt liv:

  • Daglig ledelse og HR: Personaleledelse, trivselssamtaler/MUS, ferieplanlægning, sygefravær ansættelsesprocesser og onboarding af nye medarbejdere.
  • Kordegneopgaver og kirkeligt liv: Kirketjeneste ved gudstjenester, personregistrering og kirkebogsføring.
  • Administration og økonomi: Løbende budgetkontrol, betaling af fakturaer, lønindberetning, sekretærfunktion for menighedsrådet samt kalenderstyring for ansatte og præster.
  • Koordinering af frivillige: Rekruttering, koordinering og udvikling/motivering af kirkens frivillige i samarbejde med kirke- og kulturmedarbejderne.
  • Drift og arbejdsmiljø: Ansvar for den daglige sikkerhedsledelse, APV, sognets IT-drift, forsikringssager og overholdelse af GDPR.

Vi søger en leder og kollega, som:

  • har dokumenteret erfaring med daglig ledelse og administrative HR-opgaver.
  • har en empatisk lederstil, forebygger konflikter og forstår at motivere medarbejdere.
  • arbejder selvstændigt og struktureret og bevarer overblikket i en travl hverdag.
  • er serviceminded og møder menighed, frivillige og kolleger med venlighed og respekt.
  • er uddannet kordegn og har erfaring med personregistrering – eller har lyst til at tage uddannelsen.

Vi tilbyder

En arbejdsplads, hvor vi vægter trivsel, faglighed og samarbejde højt. Du får en central rolle med stor indflydelse på drift og udvikling af kirkekontorets arbejdsgange, og du vil opleve et stærkt fællesskab omkring det at drive og bygge kirke.

Praktiske oplysninger

Du bliver ansat ved Kristkirkens Sogns Menighedsråd, Haderslevvej 38, 6000 Kolding.

Lyder stillingen som noget for dig? Så send din ansøgning, CV og eventuelle relevante bilag senest 29. september 2026. via ansøgningsformularen som tilgås i stillingsopslaget på Jobnet eller via dette link: eller sendes pr. post til Kristkirkens Kontor, Kridthuset, Haderslevvej 38, 6000 Kolding.

Første samtale finder sted i uge 41. Efter første samtale indhentes referencer og udarbejdes personlighedsprofil.
Anden samtale finder sted i uge 44.

Der indhentes børneattest i forbindelse med ansættelsen.

Yderligere information om stillingen fås på www.kristkirken.dk og hos personaleansvarlig Line Munk Friis på tlf. 26430504.

Har stillingen vakt din interesse, så ser vi frem til at høre fra dig.

Der vil blive indhentet referencer i forbindelse med ansættelsesforløbet.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår

Ansættelse og aflønning sker efter gældende fællesoverenskomst mellem Finansministeriet og CO10,samt organisationsaftale for kordenge m.fl. og tilhørende protokollat indgået med Kirkeministeriet. Aftalerne kan ses på https://folkekirkensintranet.dk/vejledninger/menighedsraadet-som-arbejdsgiver/ok24.

Stillingen er indplaceret i løngruppe 3. Årslønnen aftales indenfor intervallet 417.184,39 kr. – 500.621,27 kr. (nutidskroner). Der er rådighedsforpligtelse til stillingen. Rådighedstillægget udgør årligt 39.596,64 kr. (nutidskroner).

Derudover ydes et OK24-tillæg på 3.475,85 kr. årligt (nutidskroner).

Lønnen aftales inden for det oplyste løninterval. Derudover betales 18,4 % i pensionsbidrag til CO10 pension i PFA.

Bemærk, at de oplyste lønninger og tillæg gælder for en fuldtidsstilling og beregnes forholdsmæssigt efter stillingens timetal. Endelig lønindplacering aftales mellem menighedsrådet og Danmarks Kordegneforening.

Nuværende tjenestemandsansatte kordegne har ret til at bevare deres tjenestemandsstatus ved ansættelse med direkte overgang. Der skal i så fald ske en klassificering af stillingen.

Ansøgere, der ikke allerede har uddannelse i Personregistrering, skal hurtigst muligt efter ansættelse gennemføre uddannelsen. Det er i øvrigt en betingelse, at den obligatoriske kordegneuddannelse på 5 uger gennemføres inden for to år efter ansættelsens start, hvis du ikke allerede har gennemført den.

De første 3 måneders ansættelse er prøvetid.

title: Commercieel Medewerker Binnendienst
description:
Over de functie

Ben jij commercieel ingesteld, werk je graag met klanten en krijg je energie van het vinden van de juiste oplossing voor een klantvraag? Heb je daarnaast affiniteit met techniek of laboratoriumdiensten? Dan is deze functie als Commercieel Medewerker Binnendienst iets voor jou.

Als Commercieel Medewerker Binnendienst ben je de verbindende schakel tussen klant, laboratorium en commerciële organisatie. Je vertaalt klantvragen naar passende offertes, volgt aanvragen actief op en zorgt voor een correcte overdracht van opdrachten naar het laboratorium. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met de Business Development Manager, Backoffice, Scientists en Operations.

Je speelt een sleutelrol in het commerciële proces. Door klantvragen snel en zorgvuldig te vertalen naar passende oplossingen draag je direct bij aan klanttevredenheid, omzetgroei en het succes van onze organisatie.

Taken en verantwoordelijkheden

  • Beoordelen en verwerken van klantaanvragen.
  • Afstemmen van technische en operationele haalbaarheid met interne afdelingen.
  • Opstellen en uitwerken van offertes.
  • Proactief opvolgen van offertes en klantvragen om opdrachten succesvol om te zetten.
  • Onderhouden van contact met bestaande en potentiële klanten.
  • Coördineren van een correcte overdracht van opdrachten naar het laboratorium.
  • Signaleren van commerciële kansen bij bestaande klanten.
  • Vastleggen en beheren van klantgegevens, offertes en afspraken.
  • Ondersteunen van de Business Development Manager bij commerciële activiteiten.
  • Bijdragen aan een professionele en klantgerichte dienstverlening.

Wat breng je mee?

  • HBO werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur in een commerciële, technische of bedrijfskundige richting.
  • Ongeveer 2 tot 5 jaar ervaring in Inside Sales, Customer Service of een vergelijkbare commerciële functie.
  • Antoonbare affiniteit met techniek, laboratoriumdiensten of een technische dienstverlening.
  • Ervaring met klantcontact en offertebeheer.
  • Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal.
  • Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden.
  • Je werkt nauwkeurig en gestructureerd.
  • Je kunt schakelen tussen meerdere aanvragen en prioriteiten.

title: Program Assistant (4866)
location: Santa Anita Family YMCA - Monrovia, CA 91016
description:
POSITION SUMMARY

This position supports the work of the Y, a leading nonprofit committed to strengthening community through youth development, healthy living, and social responsibility. The Program Assistant (youth programs) creates positive, nurturing relationships with children while building cooperative relationships with parents/caregivers, staff, and partners. Promotes and supports the potential of all youth in programs/classes and facilitates peer-to-peer connections as part of the overall program experience. Provides a quality experience to children that focuses on building achievement and belonging in youth and relationships among youth and within families.

YMCA COMPETENCIES (Leader):

Relationships, Communication, Developing Others, Inclusion, Quality Results, Project Management, Functional Expertise

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

  • Nurtures children through purposeful programming dedicated to building achievement and belonging in youth and relationships among youth and within families.

  • Maintains close visual supervision of a group of assigned children, following ratios based on specific program/class.
  • No child is left unsupervised or staff alone with a child at any time while attending program/class.
  • Help children manage behavior using a positive approach, including proactive strategies, redirection and using constructive discipline with natural and logical consequences.
  • Actively supports the YMCA is committed to inclusion and compliance with the American with Disabilities Act (ADA) where appropriate.
  • Planning and implementing classes based on a specific topic and skill mastery, culminating in an exposition/showcase at the end of the session.
  • Adheres to program standards including safety and cleanliness standards, maintains site and equipment, and maintains required program records in accordance YMCA expectations.
  • Cultivates positive relationships and maintains effective communication with parents. Engages parents as volunteers and connects them to the YMCA.
  • Attends and participates in family events, program activities, staff meetings and trainings.
  • Follows YMCA policies and procedures, including those related to medical and disciplinary situations, child abuse prevention and emergencies. Follows reporting procedures and proactively responds to situations to ensure a safe environment for all involved.
  • Understands and complies with current federal, state, local regulations, and YMCA policies and procedures at all times.
  • Maintains positive relationship with parents, other YMCA team members and community partners. Models relationship-building skills (including Listen First) in all interactions.
  • Attend meetings and trainings, as needed.
  • Uphold YMCA policies for safety, supervision, mandated reporting and risk management.
  • Demonstrate the Six Pillars of Character (Trustworthiness, Citizenship, Respect,
  • Responsibility, Caring, Fairness) as well as the YMCA Core Values of caring, respect, honesty and responsibility in all dealings with members, guests, volunteers and fellow staff.
  • Demonstrate competencies in and willingness to develop in the Cause Driven Leadership areas of mission advancement, collaboration, operational effectiveness and personal growth.
  • All other duties as assigned by your supervisor

YMCA LEADERSHIP COMPETENCIES

The Y’s Leadership Competency Model is comprised of 14 Leadership Competencies (leadership knowledge, skills, and behaviors required for success in the Y), organized by the four disciplines of Cause-Driven Leadership:

  • Advancing Our Mission & Cause: Provide visionary leadership to the organization and to ensure that all resources are mobilized to adapt to new challenges and needs in the community
    • Competencies Include: Change Leadership, Engaging Community, Philanthropy, & Volunteerism
  • Building Relationships: Connect people to the Y’s cause by developing inclusive relationships, partnerships and collaborations so that Ys can co-create solutions to pressing social needs
    • Competencies Include: Collaboration, Communication & Influence, & Inclusion
  • Leading Operations: ensure relevance, effectiveness, and sustainability of the organization so that we can continue to fulfill our promise to the community
    • Competencies Include: Critical Thinking & Decision Making, Fiscal Management, Functional Expertise, Innovation, & Program/Project Management
  • Developing & Inspiring Others: support the holistic development of self and others so that everyone can embrace the Y’s cause, sustain the Y’s culture, and inspire others to take individual and collective action to further our impact
    • Competencies Include: Emotional Maturity & Developing Self & Others

title: Senior Product Manager, Payments

This is an opportunity to lead a defined area within a high-scale payments product environment, where reliability, trust, and execution are critical. You will own product direction and delivery while working closely with engineering, design, support, partnerships, and product leadership. The role combines strategic product thinking with hands-on execution, from refining issues and triaging incidents to shaping user flows and creating product briefs. You will help improve experiences across onboarding, checkout, refunds, disputes, payouts, reporting, and overall reliability. Working with major payments partners, you will manage integrations, dependencies, and complex operational challenges. Your decisions will directly influence merchant revenue, shopper conversion, customer trust, and the quality of the overall commerce experience.

Accountabilities:

  • Own product direction and execution for a key payments product area, establishing clear priorities, goals, and measurable outcomes.
  • Improve merchant and shopper experiences across onboarding, checkout, refunds, disputes, payouts, reporting, and payment reliability.

  • Work closely with engineering and design teams to shape solutions, evaluate technical constraints, refine product flows, and drive execution.
  • Collaborate with strategic payments partners, including major payment platforms, to improve integrations, manage dependencies, deliver changes, and resolve issues.
  • Take a hands-on approach to product management through issue definition, bug and incident triage, flow reviews, lightweight prototyping, briefs, and PRDs.
  • Monitor product performance and use dashboards, instrumentation, and analytical insights to identify opportunities and measure impact.
  • Communicate progress, risks, decisions, and priorities clearly to stakeholders in a distributed and asynchronous working environment.
  • Maintain strong alignment across cross-functional teams while ensuring product decisions remain focused on customer needs and measurable outcomes.

    • Requirements:

    • 7+ years of experience in product management, including senior individual contributor experience owning complex product areas.
    • 4+ years of experience in payments or fintech, ideally working on products operating at significant scale.
    • Experience leading complex initiatives or large-scale/global product launches is a plus.
    • Strong product judgment and the ability to make practical decisions in ambiguous or fast-moving situations without requiring perfect information.

title: Principal Engineer, App Foundations
description:
Intuit's Consumer Group is responsible for two of the leading financial products in the country: TurboTax, which helps tens of millions of people file with confidence every tax season, and Credit Karma, which gives more than 130 million members a clear, personalized view of their financial health. Both products depend on shared, resilient application infrastructure to move fast without breaking trust, and that infrastructure is what App Foundations, part of Platform Foundations within Consumer Group, is responsible for.

We're investing in a culture of 'builders' by fostering an environment where innovation, creativity, and bold thinking are encouraged. The 'builder' mindset is necessary for us to accelerate our move toward AI-native experiences.   • Understanding of the latest tools and technologies that apply AI to real-world applications

Team Collaboration

Community


  • Contributes to standards, patterns, and best practices that improve the engineering community

  • Provides perspective on leading industry trends, recommendations on new and emerging technologies, technology prototypes, patent proposals, and engineering process improvements


Qualifications

  • Ability to drive velocity in a highly matrixed environment, partnering with numerous stakeholders

  • 8+ years of experience developing systems or software for large business environments

  • 5+ years of experience designing complex distributed systems, management products, or business applications

title: Customer Engineer
description:
About the Role

NeuroSpark Inc operates an enterprise AI inference platform that helps customers run and scale production AI workloads through reliable, high-performance infrastructure. As a Customer Engineer, you will own the technical onboarding and solution-engineering experience for customers from initial integration through production launch and expansion.

You will work directly with customer engineering teams to understand their architecture, integrate NeuroSpark's APIs and infrastructure, troubleshoot deployment issues, and translate customer requirements into practical technical solutions. This role sits at the intersection of customers, Engineering, Product, and Account Management.

Responsibilities

· Own technical onboarding for new customers, from initial architecture discussions and API integration through production launch.

· Design and recommend integration approaches based on each customer's application architecture, cloud environment, traffic profile, and operational requirements.

· Guide customers through API usage, authentication, deployment, cloud infrastructure, and Kubernetes-based environments.

· Troubleshoot technical blockers across APIs, networking, cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, model access, usage, and deployment workflows.

· Partner closely with NeuroSpark Engineering to investigate customer issues, drive resolution, and communicate technical findings clearly back to customers.

· Build solution examples, implementation guidance, technical documentation, and repeatable onboarding playbooks that improve time-to-production.

· Monitor onboarding progress and proactively identify risks, dependencies, or technical gaps that could delay customer launch or adoption.

· Translate recurring customer requirements and integration pain points into actionable Product and Engineering feedback.

· Support customer production launches, migrations, scaling events, and ongoing technical adoption as usage grows.

· Work with Account Management to identify technical opportunities for deeper platform adoption and account expansion.

Qualifications

· Hands-on experience integrating and supporting APIs in production environments.

· Strong working knowledge of cloud infrastructure and public cloud environments.

· Hands-on experience with Kubernetes, including deployment, configuration, and troubleshooting of containerized workloads.

· Strong technical problem-solving and debugging skills, with the ability to work through ambiguous customer issues.

· Ability to understand customer architecture and communicate effectively with software engineers, infrastructure teams, and technical leaders.

· Strong written and verbal communication skills and comfort working directly with customers.

· High ownership, responsiveness, and ability to operate effectively in a fast-moving startup environment.

· Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

Nice to Have

· Experience with SQL and production data systems.

· Experience with GPU infrastructure or AI/ML infrastructure.

· Programming experience in Python and/or C++.

· Experience in Customer Engineering, Solutions Engineering, Forward Deployed Engineering, Solutions Architecture, or Technical Account Management.

· Experience supporting AI/ML, infrastructure, developer-platform, or enterprise technology customers.

· Familiarity with LLM APIs, inference systems, observability, or distributed systems.

What Success Looks Like

Customers move from evaluation to production quickly, technical blockers are resolved with clear ownership, and onboarding becomes increasingly repeatable as the company scales. You become a trusted technical partner to customer engineering teams while helping NeuroSpark improve the platform based on real production use cases.

Compensation

The expected base salary range for this position is $130,000-$150,000 USD per year. Actual compensation will depend on experience, role scope, and qualifications. The position may also include equity and company benefits.

title: DNA Sequencing Technician - Tuesday-Saturday, 6:00 am – 2:30 pm
description:
We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Entry-Level DNA Sequencing Technician to join our production laboratory team. This role supports both Sanger sequencing and Oxford Nanopore Technologies (ONT) sequencing workflows in a fast-paced, high-throughput environment. The technician will be responsible for processing DNA samples, preparing sequencing reactions and libraries, operating laboratory instrumentation, maintaining accurate records, and supporting quality and turnaround time goals.

This position is ideal for someone with a strong scientific foundation who enjoys hands-on laboratory work, organization, and working as part of a team to deliver high-quality sequencing services.

Key Responsibilities

  • Organize, sort, prioritize, and process incoming DNA samples according to daily production needs.
  • Perform DNA extraction, purification, and preparation for sequencing workflows.
  • Pipette DNA sequencing reactions accurately and efficiently.
  • Prepare sequencing libraries using Oxford Nanopore protocols while ensuring quality and consistency.
  • Perform DNA purification and related sample preparation steps for Sanger and ONT workflows.
  • Load, operate, schedule, and monitor sequencing instruments, including ABI 3730xl sequencers and Oxford Nanopore sequencers.
  • Operate routine laboratory equipment such as thermocyclers, centrifuges, automated liquid handlers, and related instrumentation.
  • Assist with troubleshooting sequencing runs, workflow issues, and instrument-related concerns to support quality and throughput targets.
  • Maintain accurate production records, batch documentation, logs, and other required quality records in compliance with laboratory standards.
  • Follow work instructions, checklists, batch records, and other controlled documents relevant to assigned responsibilities.
  • Support quality control activities, including review of sequencing performance and basic data quality checks.
  • Collaborate effectively with team members, team leads, and cross-functional partners to meet turnaround time and production goals.
  • Perform other laboratory support duties as assigned by the Lab Team Lead or Supervisor.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Biology, Molecular Biology, Biochemistry, Genetics, Chemistry, or another related scientific field; or equivalent directly related experience.
  • Ability to follow written procedures, maintain accurate records, and comply with established quality systems and company policies.
  • Strong organizational, communication, and time-management skills.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Ability to learn new laboratory techniques and perform multiple tasks simultaneously.
  • Authorization to work in the United States indefinitely without restriction or sponsorship.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with basic molecular biology techniques such as PCR, nucleic acid quantification, DNA extraction, and purification.
  • Experience with DNA sequencing workflows, including Sanger sequencing and/or Oxford Nanopore Technologies.
  • Experience operating ABI 3730xl instruments is highly desirable.
  • Familiarity with automated liquid handlers and standard laboratory instrumentation.
  • Experience working in an ISO-9000, cGMP, or similarly regulated environment.
  • Exposure to basic bioinformatics or sequencing quality control tools is a plus.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.
  • Ability to maintain efficiency and accuracy under production deadlines.
  • Good scientific judgment and problem-solving ability.
  • Positive attitude, adaptability, and willingness to support team success.
  • Ability to troubleshoot routine technical issues and escalate appropriately.
  • Commitment to maintaining safety, compliance, and data integrity in all tasks.

Why Join Us

This is an excellent opportunity for an early-career scientist to gain hands-on experience with two widely used DNA sequencing platforms in a dynamic laboratory setting. The role offers exposure to high-throughput sequencing operations, laboratory instrumentation, quality systems, and real-world production workflows.

Schedule:

  • Tuesday-Saturday, 6:00 am – 2:30 pm

What we offer:

  • Excellent full time benefits including comprehensive medical coverage, dental, and vision options
  • Life and disability insurance
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Paid vacation and holidays

We are developing a network automation and orchestration platform that provides a real-time digital twin of large-scale, multi-vendor, multilayer networks (IP, optical, microwave). The system enables advanced features such as topology discovery, path computation, service provisioning, and network optimization. It is built with a modern Python-based backend, integrates with diverse controllers and APIs, and handles high-performance data processing to ensure scalability and reliability for carrier-grade environments.

Why Join Us?

If you enjoy tackling real-world challenges, working with Python, and being part of a skilled, collaborative team, this could be a great opportunity. You'll contribute to a meaningful project, stay on the cutting edge of SDN technology, and help shape the future of networking.

Requirements & Skills

title: 10120 Quality Control Operator
description:
The Quality Control Operator ensures the products meet their respective specifications and quality standards by performing physicochemical analyzing, measurement testing, and monitoring steps of the production process. This role also supports and promotes a strong quality and food safety culture by following established procedures, identifying potential risks, and encouraging continuous compliance with GMP, quality, and food safety requirements.

Responsibilities:

  • Collect product samples and conduct routine quality checks throughout the production process to verify compliance with established specifications.
  • Perform physicochemical analyses and measurement testing, including finished product weight, oxygen levels, and other required product evaluations.
  • Monitor and verify Critical Control Points (CCPs), process control points, product defects, foreign material controls, and packaging integrity in accordance with food safety procedures.
  • Maintain accurate and complete quality control records, including inspection results, laboratory analyses, deviations, corrective actions, and verification activities.
  • Conduct routine GMP, Food Defense, hygiene, and sanitation verification inspections to support compliance with Barcel USA quality and food safety standards.
  • Support allergen control, color-coding compliance, cleaning validation, and prevention of cross-contamination during production, changeovers, and start-ups.
  • Assist with quality and food safety investigations, root cause analysis, and follow-up of corrective and preventive actions when product safety or quality may be affected.
  • Promote a strong quality and food safety culture by following established procedures, reinforcing GMP expectations, and promptly reporting concerns or nonconforming conditions.
  • Support the 5S program by keeping work areas, utensils, and equipment clean, organized, and ready for production use.
  • Comply with company safety rules and procedures and help identify opportunities to eliminate unsafe conditions.
  • Support all quality shifts as needed and perform additional duties as assigned by management.

title: Real Estate Program Manager (WMS Band 2) Lacey, WA
description:
Description


Washington State Parks and Recreation Commission

Job Title: Real Estate Program Manager (WMS Band 2)
Location: Lacey, WA.
Closes: October 6th, 2026, at 11:55 p.m. PDT
Travel: This position may require periodic travel to parks throughout the State Park system.

___________________________
Washington State Parks is seeking an experienced highly skilled real estate leader for the position of Real Estate Program Manager (WMS 02). This position is located at Parks' headquarters' office in Lacey, Washington. The annual range of compensation is between $86,880 – $115,840 depending upon qualifications, although the expected hiring salary will typically be less than the top of the range.

The Real Estate Program Manager will lead the agency's efforts associated with acquiring and disposing of real property while ensuring agency compliance with any legal and regulatory requirements. They will grant and obtain legal documents as needed for less-than-fee simple property transactions and develop agency policy and programs, to improve the revenue generating capacity from commercial leases and improve sustainability and partner development in the agency's long-term lease program.

In this role, you will be the primary liaison between the Real Estate Program and leadership from other agency programs and divisions, the Commission, and external partners. The position's main purpose is to limit agency risk and legal exposure associated with acquiring and disposing of real property; ensuring agency compliance with any legal requirement of regulation obtained through legal contract; granting and obtaining legal documents as needed for less-than-fee-simple property transactions; developing agency policy and programs as needed to improve the revenue-generating capacity from commercial leases; developing agency policy and programs to improve sustainability and partner development in the agency's long-term lease program; and training, mentoring, and supervising Real Estate Program staff in accomplishing the above.

The ideal candidate is a strategic, highly skilled real estate leader with deep expertise in public-sector real property management, complex land transactions, and policy development. They bring a strong record of managing acquisitions, disposals, exchanges, leases, easements, water rights, and other less-than-fee-simple agreements with precision, sound judgment, and a clear focus on reducing agency risk. They excel at navigating legal requirements, collaborating with the Attorney General’s Office and OFM, and ensuring that all instruments, records, and transactions meet the highest professional standards.

This candidate is an experienced people leader who develops and mentors professional staff, builds a positive and accountable team culture, and ensures high-quality work products that support statewide operations. They are adept at representing the agency in high-visibility settings, communicating complex information to diverse audiences, and cultivating productive relationships with tribal partners, public agencies, private-sector entities, and park neighbors. They thrive in a role that requires statewide coordination, strategic planning, and stewardship of public lands, and they bring the analytical, interpersonal, and policy-shaping skills needed to guide the Real Estate Program’s long-term direction.

This position offers hybrid telework flexibility, though frequent on-site attendance is required to meet business needs. The default assigned work location of all Parks positions – both on-site and telework eligible positions – is within the State of Washington. Frequency of onsite work will vary based on business and operational needs.

Washington State Parks offers a collaborative culture focused on public service, environmental preservation, and outdoor equity. We offer a competitive salary, an outstanding state benefits package (medical, dental, and retirement plans), a generous leave policy, and the unique opportunity to spend your career protecting the most beautiful landscapes in the Pacific Northwest.

For more information on Washington State Parks, click here.

Duties

The Real Estate Program Manager is a management position that reports to the Planning and Real Estate Program Manager in the Parks Development Division. This is a leadership role responsible for managing, guiding, and promoting statewide real estate initiatives for the Washington State Parks and Recreation Commission.

Duties include but are not limited to:

  • Directs the implementation of all land exchanges, acquisitions by purchase and donations and administers the statewide system by which applications for licenses, permits, leases, and easements are evaluated, processed, implemented, and recorded.
  • Directs the program in identification, protection and evaluation of water rights associated with park land and as required for the operation of individual parks.
  • Surveys and records the Seashore Conservation line each decade and develops real estate policy regarding the Seashore Conservation Area.
  • Identifies and works towards curing trespassing and unauthorized use of state land; assures that park land is legally owned, managed and surveyed and maintains files with the relevant documentation.
  • Responds to requests from OFM for specific property information on a routine basis.
  • Responsible for identifying and executing large-scale land management agreements with federal, state, and local governments as well as with parties and partners from the private sector.
  • Strategically promotes and nurtures mutually advantageous relationships with the private business sector; develops policy as needed to create working-revenue lands as directed by adopted agency strategic initiatives.
  • Plans, leads, and determines when surplus properties are disposed of and makes recommendations on how subsequent proceeds from sales are re-invested back into the park system.
  • Responsible for a wide variety of specialized real estate services including real property condemnation, tenant relocation or relocation assistance.
  • Plans, coordinates, and oversees staff activities related to monitoring and compliance of lease provisions, real property agreements, and deed reservations.
  • Responsible for real estate related fiscal notes and bill analyses in response to proposed legislation.
  • Manages and leads professional real estate staff including all levels of Property and Acquisition Specialists. Trains, mentors, and assists with the professional development of program leaders and other professional staff. Models agency leadership principles for program staff.
  • Manages the lands database and contract management system.

Schedule: Generally, Monday through Friday with core work hours of 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Incumbent may be expected to adjust the work scheduled to meet business needs- occasional evening or weekends work may be required. A flexible or hybrid work schedule will be considered at the incumbent’s request, subject to supervisory approval.

Work Setting: This position works primarily in an office or home office environment.

Travel: Periodic travel will be required for statewide site visits, meetings, or public engagement with occasional overnight or multiple-day trips. You must have the ability to operate a state vehicle.

Qualifications

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE:

  • Bachelor's degree* in real estate, property management, business, geography or another closely related land use field. AND
  • Five (5) years of experience in real estate or property management that includes experience supervising professional staff.

*Additional qualifying experience may substitute year-for-year for education.


DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS:
  • Experience in water rights laws, regulations and adjudication procedures. Ability to research, interpret, explain and address water rights issues as they relate to individual parks and the park system.
  • Experience working with a wide range of interested second parties in granting to them or obtaining from them land-use rights through legal instruments as provided for by statutory law, regulation and Commission authority.
  • Advanced level knowledge of processing, implementing or removing liens, property defaults, restrictive covenants, and other forms of property encumbrances.

CORE COMPETENCIES:

Technical Expertise - expert knowledge of all standard real property use agreements or legal instruments necessary in managing real property; ability to minimize risk to the agency by exercising sound, independent, professional judgement in implementing all real property transactions, records management responsibilities.

Strategic Leadership & Program Management- provides statewide leadership and direction for real estate program. Develops and implements agency-wide policies, standards, and best practices.

Manages and leads professional real estate staff including all levels of Property and Acquisition Specialists. Trains, mentors, and assists with the professional development of program leaders and other professional staff. Models agency leadership principles for program staff.

Land Surveying and Mapping Principles – Knowledge of the procedures and practices pertaining to the establishment, locating, and defining of corners, monuments, lines, and boundaries. Experience using Geographic Information Systems (GIS) and professional-level ability to understand, interpret and communicate technical information related to legal property descriptions (metes & bounds) to nontechnical staff.

Legal Compliance & Risk Mitigation - expert knowledge of all standard real property use agreements or legal instruments necessary in managing real property; ability to minimize risk to the agency by exercising sound, independent, professional judgement in implementing all real property transactions, records management responsibilities.

Public Representation & Communication - expert level skills in communicating, verbally and in writing, with diverse audiences about technical and complex information (e.g., subordinates, peers, superiors, legislators, government officials, tribal members, corporate officials, the media and the general public.) Highly effective working with diverse audiences and in potentially hostile formats (e.g., public hearings, commission meetings). Sensitive to political and public-relations aspects of agency issues and decisions.

Ability to Learn and Grow – Takes responsibility for knowing own strengths and weaknesses and uses learning to make programs and processes more efficient and effective to serve all in Washington.

Ability to Take Action to Meet the Needs of Others – Flexible, adaptable, customer-service focused, and willing and able to empathetically respond to the unique needs of co-workers and customers.


OTHER CRITICAL SKILLS, ABILITIES, AND PERSPECTIVES:
  • Advanced-level knowledge of natural resource and asset management, conservation and highest-and-best use property principles, including knowledge of state and federal laws relating to resource lands and waters, and of governmental structures, policies, and processes.

Guesty is the all-in-one platform helping hospitality businesses around the world automate, optimize, and scale their operations. We’re a fast-growing global startup that’s transforming how the industry works — from guest experience to business growth.

We are looking for a Accounting Technical Program Manager to join our team. This role is open to candidates based remotely in Canada or the United States. Candidates located in the New York area will follow a hybrid schedule, with an expectation to work from our New York office two days per week.

As a Technical Program Manager (TPM) specializing in Accounting, you will serve as the dedicated Subject Matter Expert (SME) for the Guesty Accounting Module. In this role, you will act as a key technical and financial partner to our Enterprise and Strategic customers, guiding them through complex accounting workflows, owner statements, and critical end-of-month financial processes.

Beyond enterprise support, you will drive proactive product adoption, ensuring clients achieve the financial optimization necessary for long-term retention and expansion. You will work in close strategic partnership with the Customer Success Management (CSM) team to analyze client workflows, identify adoption gaps, and safeguard account health.

Internally, you will serve as the definitive "Voice of the Customer" to our Product and Engineering teams—advocating for enterprise financial needs to shape our product roadmap. Additionally, you will be the backbone of accounting expertise for the broader TPM team, handling advanced accounting escalations and driving ongoing team enablement on best practices and new features.

Responsibilities

Enterprise Partnership & Product Adoption

  • Month-End Financial Support: Provide dedicated guidance to enterprise and strategic accounts during high-stakes end-of-month closing cycles, ensuring smooth reconciliations, payouts, and statement generation.

  • CSM Strategic Partnership: Partner closely with Customer Success Managers (CSMs) on shared strategic accounts to align technical and accounting excellence with overall client retention and health goals.
  • Advanced Accounting Consultations: Lead complex consultations for enterprise clients to translate intricate property management accounting requirements into optimized Guesty Accounting Module configurations.

Internal Enablement & Voice of the Customer

﻿﻿Key Skills:

  • Proactive Drive: High level of initiative to identify adoption gaps, improve customer setup, and collect meaningful product feedback.
  • Analytical Thinking: The ability to identify trends across account cohorts and use data to track evolving product needs.
  • Adaptability & Evolution: A proven ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment and a proactive embrace of change—whether adopting new internal tools, evolving systems, or leveraging developing automations to improve efficiency.
  • (Bonus) Market Knowledge: Familiarity with the short-term rental market, the OTA landscape (Airbnb, Vrbo, etc.), and the property management software ecosystem.

title: Sr. Staff / Principal Physical Design Engineer
description:
About the Company:

At SK hynix memory solutions, we're at the forefront of semiconductor innovation, developing advanced memory solutions that power everything from smartphones to data centers. As a global leader in NAND flash technology and memory solutions, we drive the evolution of advancing mobile technology, empowering cloud computing, and pioneering future technologies. Our cutting-edge memory technologies are essential in today's most advanced electronic devices and IT infrastructure, enabling enhanced performance and user experiences across the digital landscape.

We're looking for innovative minds to join our mission of shaping the future of technology. At SK hynix memory solutions, you will be part of a team that's pioneering breakthrough memory solutions while maintaining a strong commitment to sustainability. We're not just adapting to technological change – we're driving it, with significant investments in artificial intelligence, machine learning, and eco-friendly solutions and operational practices. As we continue to expand our market presence and push the boundaries of what's possible in semiconductor technology, we invite you to be part of our journey to creating the next generation of memory solutions that will define the future of computing.

About the Role

Join our Physical Design(SoC Integration) team responsible for delivering high-performance SoC designs from RTL to GDS. As a Sr. Staff Physical Design Engineer, you will lead physical implementation efforts for advanced-node designs, driving critical blocks through synthesis, placement, CTS, routing, and signoff. You will work closely with front-end, DFT, power, and analog teams to optimize PPA (Power, Performance, Area) while ensuring silicon success. This role requires deep hands-on expertise across the full physical design flow as well as leadership to mentor junior engineers and define methodologies for the team.

Responsibilities

  • Lead physical design implementation from synthesis through GDS for high-performance blocks or full-chip SoC designs in advanced process nodes (7nm, 5nm, 3nm)
  • Execute and optimize synthesis, placement, clock tree synthesis (CTS), and routing using industry-standard P&R tools (Synopsys ICC2/Fusion Compiler or Cadence Innovus)
  • Drive timing closure and signoff using PrimeTime (PT), including advanced analysis such as SI, AOCV/POCV, crosstalk, and ECO implementation
  • Perform RC extraction using StarRC or Quantus and ensure strong correlation between extraction and STA results
  • Own physical verification signoff with Mentor/Siemens Calibre, resolving DRC, LVS, ERC, and antenna violations in complex FinFET layouts
  • Conduct power integrity analysis using Ansys RedHawk(Redhawk-SC), including static/dynamic IR drop and EM analysis; implement power grid and decap optimizations

title: Quantitative Researcher  / Developer (Data Science) - Treasury  FX
description:
We are seeking a quantitative researcher or quantitative developer to join our Treasury FX Data Science team. You will help build and operate the models and production systems behind FX pricing, risk and trading. Your work will have a direct impact on Wise’s mission and millions of our customers.

About the Role:

You'll join the Treasury FX Data Science team, helping own the quantitative models and production infrastructure that power how Wise manages FX risk across USD 250bn+ in annual FX volume - serving everyone from retail customers sending money abroad to tier-1 global investment banks via Wise Platform.

The wider Treasury FX team includes quants, traders, analysts, product managers and engineers working together to price, hedge, manage and scale FX operations within Wise in real time. Within that, the Data Science team owns a Python-first, production-grade quant platform which provides multi-instrument pricing, product modelling/monitoring, risk analytics and trading strategies.

We’re hiring for two complementary focus areas:

  • Quantitative Researcher: Bring deeper expertise in quantitative modelling to develop and improve pricing, forecasting, risk analytics and hedging methodology with rigorous backtesting and stakeholder engagement

  • Quantitative Developer: Bring deeper expertise in quantitative engineering to develop and improve production services, shared quant libraries and engineering reliability. You are expected to

Your focus will reflect your strengths, with opportunities to contribute across both areas and broaden your expertise. We expect depth in one area, with a strong shared foundation in Python, quantitative reasoning and production ownership.

What you’ll own

  • A primary focus in either production quantitative engineering or applied quantitative modelling

  • Python implementation of quantitative work from research or prototype through reliable production use

  • Validation, backtesting and monitoring of model and service performance against realised outcomes

  • Deployment, incident response, root-cause analysis and continuous improvement with stakeholders

  • Shared quant libraries used across multiple services

  • CI/CD pipelines, deployments and operational excellence

  • Monitoring, alerting, and reliability for real-time pricing and risk systems

Where you’ll grow

  • Market data management and onboarding new pipelines..

  • Designing new quant infrastructure and systems with the engineering team.

  • Backtesting frameworks, model validation and risk modelling alongside the Risk team (VaR, stress testing, scenario analysis).

  • Customer behaviour modelling, pricing strategy and product development.

  • Collaborating with product teams to translate quantitative insights into customer-facing decisions

What we’re looking for

  • 4+ years of relevant quantitative or engineering experience, with strong Python development skills.

  • Quantitative background - maths, physics, engineering or finance - you can read a model and reason about correctness.

  • It’s a bonus if you are familiar with

  • FX or financial markets experience

  • Term structure modelling, stochastic calculus or Monte Carlo methods

  • Interest rate curve bootstrapping

  • Algorithmic execution experience

  • Data lake or warehouse experience (Snowflake, Iceberg, Spark etc.)

  • A product mindset - you think about who uses your systems and why.

  • Clear communicator who can work cross-functionally with other quants, analysts, traders, product managers and engineers.

  • Experience taking quantitative work into production and owning its ongoing validation, monitoring and improvement.

For the Researcher track:

  • Strong experience in quantitative research or modelling in finance, with depth in an area such as pricing, forecasting, risk or trading.
  • Ability to translate an open-ended financial problem into a quantitative model, choose appropriate statistical or numerical methods, and explain assumptions and limitations.
  • Experience designing backtests and out-of-sample validation, accounting for data leakage, transaction costs and changing market conditions.

For the Developer track:

  • Experience with streaming systems, real-time data pipelines, or event-driven architectures (Kafka, Flink, Redis etc.)

  • Experience with testing, monitoring, and debugging complex systems under load

  • Strong experience with microservices, databases, and production infrastructure

description:
The role

We are seeking a senior risk professional to be an independent advisor within our Risk & Compliance function to lead in advising the firm on Technology, AI and Innovation Risk. This role will lead the assessment, governance, and ongoing management of risks and regulatory requirements arising from the firm’s use of emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence (AI), automation, and digital innovation.

The successful candidate will combine strong regulatory and risk expertise with commercial pragmatism and a deep understanding of technology risk in a professional services or legal environment.

Key responsibilities

Strategic Technology & AI Risk Oversight

  • Lead the firm’s approach to identifying, assessing, and mitigating risks associated with new and emerging technologies, including AI tools and platforms.
  • Develop and maintain a Technology and AI Risk Framework, aligned to legal sector regulatory expectations and industry best practice.
  • Advise senior stakeholders (including CIO, CTO, Innovation teams, and partners) on risk, regulatory and reputational implications of technology adoption.
  • Collaborate closely with key stakeholders to ensure that AI Risk oversight complements and supports the firm's information security, data privacy and enterprise risk management frameworks.
  • Ensure alignment with firm-wide risk appetite and governance standards.

Business Partnering with IT & Innovation Teams

  • Act as a dedicated Risk advisor to IT, cybersecurity, and innovation functions.
  • Embed risk-by-design principles into technology development, procurement, and implementation processes.
  • Participate in key technology governance forums, steering committees, and project boards as appropriate.

AI Governance & Responsible Use

  • Design and implement policies covering responsible AI use, that embed and reflect the firm's compliance policies including:
    • Confidentiality
    • Model risk and explainability
    • Bias and ethical considerations
    • Client confidentiality, professional conduct obligations and legal privilege risks
    • AI security threats (e.g. prompt injection, data poisoning, model and data exfiltration), adversarial testing / AI red-teaming, model inventory and validation
    • Establish approval, review, detection and containment processes for AI tools (including generative AI), covering sanctioned tools and unsanctioned “shadow AI” use in collaboration with IT Risk & Security.
  • Establish approval and review processes for AI tools (including generative AI).
  • Working with the General Counsel team, ensure appropriate client disclosures where required, including in relation to Outside Counsel Guidelines and client-specific security and AI-use requirements.

Horizon Scanning

  • Monitor and interpret global regulatory developments relating to:
    • AI regulation (e.g. EU AI Act and equivalents)
    • Legal sector obligations and professional standards
    • NIS2 / DORA and equivalent operational resilience or cybersecurity regimes where in scope
    • Client-jurisdiction AI, data and security regimes applicable to firm operations or client requirements
  • Translate regulatory requirements into actionable internal policies and controls.

Technology Risk Assessment & Controls

  • Conduct and advise on risk assessments, as appropriate, for new systems, vendors, and technology deployments.
  • Collaborate with IT on:
    • Regulatory and client-obligation mapping for third-party and technology risk
    • Control-adequacy challenge and policy sign-off for information security controls
    • Regulatory notification, AI-incident handling, client disclosure and privilege considerations in incident response
  • Ensure risks are documented, tracked, and reported through appropriate governance forums.

Training & Culture

  • Develop and deliver training on technology and AI risks for lawyers and business services teams.
  • Promote a culture of responsible innovation and risk awareness.

Reporting & Governance

  • Provide regular reporting to the Executive Risk Committee and Board-level stakeholders on technology and AI risk exposure.
  • Maintain risk registers and key risk indicators (KRIs) relating to technology and innovation integrated with the firm’s enterprise and information security risk registers.

Your experience

Essential

  • Demonstrable experience in risk, ideally within a law firm or professional services environment.
  • Demonstrated experience in technology risk, AI governance, or digital transformation risk.
  • A strong understanding of:
    • Confidentiality obligations
    • Existing and emerging AI regulatory frameworks
    • Legal sector obligations and professional standards
  • Working knowledge of relevant security and AI governance frameworks, including ISO 27001, NIST, ISO 42001 or the NIST AI RMF.
  • Proven ability to partner with senior technology stakeholders.
  • Excellent judgment with a commercial and pragmatic approach to risk.
  • Strong communication skills with experience advising senior leadership.

Desirable

  • Experience working directly with AI tools, automation programs, or legal tech platforms.
  • Knowledge of frameworks such as ISO 27001, NIST, or similar.
  • Experience in third-party/vendor risk management.
  • Legal or regulatory background (e.g. lawyer, compliance officer) is advantageous.

How we will support you

From your first day with us, you will have varied opportunities to continuously grow and develop your skills and knowledge. From formal training, informal coaching and mentoring through to skills-based and technical training and on the job learning.

Hybrid working

This role follows our 'balanced' hybrid working approach and as long as business needs allow, you will be supported to work in a hybrid way in line with the hybrid working policy.

What we offer including our broad range of benefits and working environment

When you join Clifford Chance, you will have access to a broad range of benefits to support you across many aspects of your personal and professional life including financial, wellbeing, lifestyle, and family friendly benefits. For more information on what we offer specifically in the UK, please visit our What We Offer page on our career site.

Equal opportunities

At Clifford Chance, we understand that our true asset is our people. Inclusion is good for our team and their families, our firm and society.

We are committed to treating all employees and applicants fairly and equally regardless of their gender, gender identity and expression, marital or civil partnership status, race, colour, national or ethnic origin, social or economic background, disability, religious belief, sexual orientation, or age. This applies to recruitment and selection, terms and conditions of employment including pay, promotion, training, transfer and every other aspect of employment.

We have a variety of flourishing employee networks. These networks are a place for colleagues to share experiences and advocate for change wherever they see an opportunity for improvement.

Our goal is to deliver an equality of opportunity, an equality of aspiration and an equality of experience to everyone who works in our firm.

Find out more about our inclusive culture here.

title: BAAM Control Specialist
description:
So, what's the role?

We are looking for a highly motivated individual to join our Treasury Team. Your key responsibilities evolve around the development and execution of Wise’s Bank Account & Access Management (BAAM) framework so that the risks around bank accounts, user access and payment activities are monitored in a secure and SOX control environment. You'll be integral to the daily operations of BAAM ensuring our processes and controls over bank account and user access management are executed effectively. This is a highly cross-functional position, demanding exceptional collaboration with a wide range of stakeholders, including Payment & Treasury Operations, Risk and Control teams, as well as internal and external auditors.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Collaborate closely with regional teams including Banking and Operations to outline the roadmap for new partnerships and bank accounts

  • Own the internal onboarding and offboarding process for bank accounts within Wise’s internal infrastructure

  • Liaise with technical stakeholder group to tackle complex situations or new types of products or implementation

  • Execute the controls in relation to maintaining complete and accurate internal records of our counterparties, bank accounts, authorised signatories and user accesses in the relevant systems

  • Review and ensure timely and appropriate closure of BAAM tickets and requests

  • Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to ensure the soundness of our BAAM infrastructure and its overall operating environment

  • Prepare periodic reporting materials on BAAM operations and control effectiveness

  • Support the lead and stakeholders to continuously enhance the BAAM processes to improve its efficiency

  • Keep all BAAM documentation, including user guides, flowcharts, and the risk and control matrix, up-to-date and relevant

  • Liaise with internal and external auditors to address any audit requests and queries

  • Support the Treasury function on other ad-hoc projects related to BAAM areas when required

What we are looking for:

  • At least 2 years of proven experience in treasury or audit in SOX control environment, coupled with a solid understanding of risk and control principles in a large and fast paced organisation

  • In depth understanding of treasury operational risk management, treasury best practices and SOX requirements

  • Experience in opening & closing bank accounts for an organisation and managing user accesses and authorised signatories, or experience in financial audit or control testing in these areas

  • Experience in managing a high number of bank accounts (500+) across different regions and setting up a control governance framework.

Skills:

  • A self-starter with the ability to work independently in a self-directed way to thrive in a collaborative, team oriented, and fast-paced environment

  • Critical thinking with ability to identify potential risks in a given situation

  • Great attention to detail and problem solving skill

  • Strong organisational skills with the ability to multitask, prioritise and work to meet tight deadlines

  • Ability to establish good relationships across the organisation and build an effective working atmosphere with teams like Banking, Treasury, Finance and Payment Operations

  • Strong communications skills, verbal and written, including ability to summarise key messages

  • Ability to process data using Microsoft Excel and produce presentation using Power Point is essential

  • Basic knowledge in data querying and visualisation including SQL, Excel VBA and Snowflake is preferable

  • Relevant professional qualifications such as ACT, CIMA, ACCA, ACA are desirable but not mandatory

title: Expert Horticulture
description:
Expert Horticulture

As an expert in the Horticulture programme, you bring technical knowledge of crop production and an understanding of business realities faced by small and medium sized horticulture companies in challenging and rapidly changing markets. You recognise both the innovative potential of horticulture, including fruit, vegetables and floriculture, and the pressures related to rising costs, stricter regulations and climate change. Are you ready to drive change within the Horticulture programme worldwide and make a real impact? This is your opportunity!

About PUM

PUM is a unique NGO committed to making a positive impact on a global scale. With a network of 1,200 skilled voluntary experts, we collaborate with ambitious entrepreneurs in 26 countries and 12 programmes, sharing expertise to strengthen business ecosystems and create economic, social, and environmental value. We work closely with small and medium-sized enterprises, as well as the organisations that support them. We believe in the power of collaboration and in the magic that happens when diverse perspectives come together; Together we grow!

Who are you?

  • You have a track record of relevant experience in horticulture, with hands-on expertise in crop production and crop-specific knowledge.

  • You have expertise in one of the following areas: Tissue culture; Open field vegetables production such as leafy greens, cabbage, beans, carrots, etc. (production, post-harvest aspects, processing); Soft fruit such as strawberries, blueberries or raspberries (production, post-harvest aspects); Nursery fruit trees (temperate and tropical fruit crops).

  • You appreciate cultural differences and interact with equality and respect.

  • You are eager to operate as a sparring partner in culturally diverse and changing circumstances.

  • You are hands-on and can translate knowledge into a practical plan.

  • You have excellent command of the English language, both verbally and in writing. Bonus points for French or Spanish proficiency!

  • You are comfortable with digital tools, including Microsoft Office 365.

  • Discover more about the Horticulture programme here.

Ready to make a difference?

As an expert at PUM, you play a key role. By sharing your knowledge and experience you’re empowering the sustainable growth of SMEs in countries worldwide. You’re not just an expert - you’re a change maker!

The role

Your application is for a place in our pool of experts for the Horticulture programme, not for a specific project. Once you've joined, you will be matched with up to three projects per year, either on location or remotely. Around one in three projects will be delivered as remote advice, though working solely on remote advisory projects is also possible.
On location, you’ll spend two weeks on-site with the client. PUM covers your flight and visa, while the client takes care of your accommodation, meals, and local transportation. You will also receive an expense allowance.
As PUM expert you not only share knowledge, you also:

  • Empower entrepreneurs, supporting their journey toward sustainable and inclusive business development.

  • Leave a lasting impact on the community: socially, environmentally, and economically.

  • Turn your knowledge into a hands-on project plan.

  • Expand your horizons at sector days and building a network that’s as diverse as it gets.

Eligibility and Requirements

The expert role is a voluntary position. You can apply up to and including the calendar year in which you turn 69.PUM engages experts who reside in the Netherlands, are registered in the Municipal Personal Records Database (BRP), and have Dutch basic health insurance. Prescreening (VOG) is part of the selection process. At PUM, we celebrate diversity and inclusion as essential pillars of our organisation. We embrace the uniqueness of each individual to foster an environment where everyone can thrive by being their authentic selves.

Join us!

By becoming a PUM expert, you’re not just stepping into a new role; you’re becoming a catalyst for positive change. It’s a two-way street of knowledge exchange that makes a global impact. Here’s what’s in it for you:

Continuous learning: Embrace new perspectives and gain insights by connecting with diverse people and cultures.
Professional network: Be part of a network of approximately 1,200 volunteer experts and let your network abroad grow as well.
Optimal knowledge utilization: Put your expertise to its best use, making tangible impact on businesses worldwide.
International exposure: Immerse yourself in a multicultural environment, broadening your horizons.
Building a brighter future: Contribute to the sustainable development of communities, cultivating a profound sense of fulfillment.
Stunning office moments: Enjoy regular meetups at our beautiful office in The Hague with breathtaking views.

We review applications on a rolling basis and encourage you to apply as soon as possible, as we may close the vacancy once we’ve found enough qualified candidates.

Highlights

You’ve got the skills! Why not share them? Join PUM as an expert to help build a better future for SMEs and their communities worldwide!
