title: Legislative Counsel
description:
We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Why this role is on the menu

Instacart operates at the intersection of food access, gig economy labor, and marketplace regulation, making legislative and regulatory engagement a core business function, not an afterthought. As the regulatory landscape around gig economy platforms, marketplace operators, and labor practices continues to evolve rapidly, the Legislative and Labor Team needs a skilled lawyer to analyze emerging requirements, build compliance frameworks, and shape the regulatory conversation before it shapes Instacart. Without this role, gaps in legal analysis and compliance strategy could create operational risk across multiple areas of the business. A year from now, Instacart will have stronger legal frameworks in place, clearer compliance strategies across regulatory domains, and a more coordinated voice in the cross-industry conversations that define the rules of the road for the gig economy.

What you'll cook up in your first year

  • Cross-functional regulatory responses are coordinated with clarity: Policy and Government Affairs, Operations, Product, and Communications teams have a consistent, well-analyzed legal perspective on legislative matters affecting Instacart's operations.
  • A comprehensive review of legislation impacting gig economy participants, marketplaces, retailers, and consumers is complete, with actionable legal guidance delivered to business partners to drive compliant operations.
  • Legal frameworks and compliance best practices for meeting legislative and regulatory mandates are developed and documented, giving the company a foundation to navigate evolving requirements with confidence.
  • Instacart's relationships with external counsel, trade associations, and industry partners are actively managed, with cross-industry initiatives underway that contribute to shaping the regulatory conversation in favor of gig economy innovation.
  • Expertise in emerging areas of law relevant to Instacart's business is built and shared internally, ensuring the team is prepared to respond to new legal challenges as they arise.

The secret ingredients we're looking for

Must-have pantry staples (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Juris Doctor (JD) degree.
  • 3+ years of experience practicing law.
  • Demonstrated ability to synthesize, analyze, and provide precise legal advice in response to legislative updates.
  • Experience working with legislative bodies, government agencies, or regulatory matters.
  • Proven success in supporting compliance initiatives and executing legal frameworks.
  • Understanding of legislative processes and the regulatory landscape.

Optional garnishes (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Experience with legislative or regulatory strategy.
  • Familiarity with issues facing marketplace platform companies, gig economy platform companies, or similarly highly regulated businesses

#LI-Remote

Instacart provides highly market-competitive compensation and benefits in each location where our employees work. This role is remote and the base pay range for a successful candidate is dependent on their permanent work location. Please review our Flex First remote work policy here.

Offers may vary based on many factors, such as candidate experience and skills required for the role. Additionally, this role is eligible for a new hire equity grant as well as annual refresh grants. Please read more about our benefits offerings here.

title: Director, Head of Protein Sciences
description:
Summary

We are seeking an accomplished scientific and organizational leader to serve as Head of Protein Sciences. This role is accountable for defining and executing the Protein Sciences strategy to accelerate portfolio progression through the delivery of high-quality protein reagents, target-enabling solutions, and scientific insights for small molecule and peptide discovery programs across therapeutic areas.

As the functional leader of Protein Sciences, the successful candidate will ensure the organization delivers scalable, high-impact support across the portfolio while balancing current program needs with future capability requirements. The leader will report to the Head of Target Enabling Technologies organization and serve on the extended leadership team of Small Molecule Therapeutics and Platform Technologies. Working in close partnership with Biology, Screening, Structural Biology, and other functions, this leader will influence discovery strategies, optimize resource deployment, and enable successful advancement of programs against challenging targets.

This role requires a leader who combines deep scientific expertise, strategic thinking, and operational excellence to maximize organizational impact, improve portfolio execution, and build a high-performing scientific organization.

Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership

  • Define and execute a Protein Sciences strategy that maximizes impact across the discovery portfolio through efficient delivery of target-enabling proteins, scientific solutions, and resource deployment.
  • Accountable for the overall performance, portfolio impact, scientific excellence, and organizational effectiveness of the Protein Sciences function.
  • Partner with cross-functional leaders to influence discovery strategies, address target-enabling challenges, and ensure Protein Sciences resources are deployed against highest-value portfolio opportunities.
  • Drive scientific innovation and adoption of emerging technologies, including AI/ML-enabled approaches, protein engineering, and next-generation protein production platforms to support emerging target classes and future portfolio needs.
  • Manage project intake and lead functional resource planning and prioritization to ensure effective support across the portfolio.
  • Manage external collaborations and CRO partnerships to augment capabilities and accelerate project delivery.
  • Balance short-term portfolio needs with long-term capability building and technology investments
  • Build external awareness of emerging scientific approaches and evaluate opportunities for scientific collaboration.

Scientific Leadership

  • Provide scientific leadership and oversight to ensure delivery of high-quality protein reagents and scientific data that support project advancement.
  • Lead teams in addressing complex scientific problems and developing innovative, fit-for-purpose solutions that advance discovery programs.
  • Foster scientific rigor, innovation, and data-driven decision-making across the department.
  • Represent Protein Sciences as a key scientific partner on cross-functional discovery teams.
  • Establish and maintain external scientific relationships to ensure awareness and adoption of innovative technologies and best practices.

Talent Development and Organizational Leadership

  • Build and lead a high-performing Protein Sciences organization that consistently delivers high-quality outcomes, develops talent, and contributes measurably to portfolio success.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.
  • Develop future scientific and people leaders through coaching, mentoring, performance management, and succession planning.
  • Foster strong cross-functional partnerships that accelerate progression of the programs and improve organizational effectiveness.
  • Champion continuous improvement and operational excellence across the function.
  • Ph.D. in Biochemistry, Biophysics, Structural Biology, or a closely related discipline.
  • 10+ years of industry experience in pharmaceutical or biotechnology settings with a proven track record of supporting small molecule drug discovery programs.
  • Demonstrated success in leading Protein Sciences or closely related scientific functions and developing organizational capabilities in a matrixed research environment.
  • Deep expertise in protein expression, purification, engineering, and characterization across multiple expression systems.
  • Proven track record of enabling successful discovery programs against complex or challenging targets.
  • Proven track record of influencing organizational strategy and delivering measurable portfolio impact through scientific leadership.
  • Demonstrated understanding of protein requirements for different screening technologies, biophysics, and structural biology.
  • Strategic mindset with the ability to balance immediate project deliverables and long-term technology development.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, influencing, and collaboration skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience managing external collaborations, CROs, or strategic scientific partners.
  • Demonstrated success in building capabilities, introducing new technologies, or improving functional productivity.
  • Experience developing scientific talent and building succession depth in a research organization.
  • Broad awareness of emerging protein science methods, technologies, and industry trends.

Leadership Competencies

  • Strategic thinking and functional leadership
  • Inclusive leadership
  • Scientific rigor and sound judgment
  • Ability to influence across functions and levels
  • Comfort making decisions in ambiguity
  • Talent development and coaching
  • Collaboration and relationship building
  • Accountability for results and follow-through
  • Innovation and problem-solving mindset

title: Technician III, Pest
description:

Own your route. Build a career. Get paid what you're worth.

Certus Home Services is one of the fastest-growing pest control companies in the country with 36 branches across 10 states, and we're hiring Pest Control Technicians ready to build something real. Steady income, a route they're proud of, and a clear path to more. No experience necessary. We'll train you, get you licensed, and pay you while we do it.

  • 90%+ customer satisfaction, because your name is on every visit
  • Zero preventable safety incidents — a professional runs a safe operation
  • Consistent monthly leads generated and converted — because you see opportunities others miss
  • A track record strong enough to open the door to your next role, whenever you're ready

Who You'll Work For

You won't be out there alone. Every route is backed by a local branch team and a manager who knows your market and is invested in your growth — real coaching, regular feedback, and honest conversations about what it takes to move up.

title: Electrical Integration Intern - Avionics (Winter 2027)
description:
Astranis builds advanced satellites for high orbits, expanding humanity’s reach into the solar system. Today Astranis satellites provide dedicated, secure networks to highly-sophisticated customers across the globe – large enterprises, sovereign governments, and the US military.

With five satellites on orbit and many more set to launch soon, the company is servicing a backlog of more than $1 billion of commercial contracts. Astranis is the preferred satellite communications partner for buyers with stringent requirements for uptime, data security, network visibility, and customization.

Astranis has raised over $1.2 billion from some of the world’s best investors, including Andreessen Horowitz, Baillie Gifford, Blackrock, Fidelity, Franklin Templeton, and Snowpoint, and employs a team of 500 engineers and entrepreneurs. Astranis designs, builds, and operates its satellites out of its 153,000 sq. ft. headquarters in Northern California, USA.

Electrical Integration Intern - Avionics (Winter 2027)

Internships at Astranis typically last for twelve weeks, and are hourly roles designed for students who are currently enrolled at a four-year university.

As an Intern, you will have an amazing opportunity to work on hard problems — we pride ourselves on giving everyone at Astranis a chance to do meaningful work on challenging projects, no matter their seniority. Many past interns have designed and tested hardware/software that is heading to space on our first satellite, and many of them are now full-time employees at Astranis.

If you have already graduated from a four-year university, please apply to be an Associate Engineer.

Role

  • Work on an interdisciplinary team to design, build, and test satellite hardware and software
  • Work with the Electrical, Mechanical, Radio Frequency, and Propulsion engineering teams to develop assembly and integration test plans and procedures based on concepts and designs
  • Learn to use various pieces of test equipment and instruments (thermal chambers, vibration tables, DAQs, oscilloscopes, etc.) to successfully execute test plans
  • Coordinate assembly, integration and environmental test efforts
  • Help solve complex electrical, software, and mechanical problems in an integrated system

Requirements

  • Pursuing a four-year degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science (or equivalent technical degree)
  • A passion for hardware development, including working in a fast-paced environment and hands-on design and development
  • Ability to handle multiple tasks and prioritize
  • Strong communication skills
  • Must be onsite 5 days a week

Bonus

  • Hands-on experience in designing, building, and testing complex electrical systems
  • Experience writing Python code to: Interface with test equipment, process large datasets, visualize data
  • Direct electrical or software design experience
  • Demonstrated ability to debug hardware and software problems under time pressure
The base pay for this position is $29.00 per hour.
Base Hourly Pay
$29—$29 USD
U.S. Citizenship, Lawful Permanent Residency, or Refugee/Asylee Status Required
(To comply with U.S. Government space technology export regulations, applicant must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the United States, or other protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3))

title: Consultant Data Engineer
description:
The Data Science team is young, diverse and growing. As we are still relatively small you will be in the driver seat to shape its future. We have a flat structure and value the entrepreneurial spirit of our members: initiative is highly encouraged. We are also striving for well-being, diversity and knowledge-sharing inside the team, so that we all grow.

As a Data engineer consultant you will be working on various client projects as well as on building our own Sia AI solutions, together with our French Data Engineering team:

  • Cloud Services at GCP, AWS and Azure: architecture choices, use of storage & compute services, cost monitoring and optimization, role management, Infrastructure as Code
  • Docker and Kubernetes: containerization & orchestration of applications, management of K8s clusters adapted to Data Science workloads
  • Python programming: development of server-side tools (bulk data processing, REST API server, authentication, ...)
  • CI/CD: managing the integration and ongoing deployment of our applications and internal platforms, supporting the deployment of Data Science projects at our clients' sites
  • Data pipelines: development of ETL scripts in Big Data environments
  • Infrastructures & Services adapted to Machine Learning: technology watch and implementation of solutions useful to Data Scientists in the learning and provision of their ML models.
  • You hold a Master’s Degree with a strong quantitative component (e.g. Econometrics, Physics, Mathematics, Statistics, Quantitative Finance)
  • You have 1-3 years of relevant experience in Data, DevOps, Cloud or Software Engineering.
  • You have a good level in Python and have a solid foundation in other languages. You are familiar with at least one SQL DBMS (ideally PostgreSQL) and ideally noSQL (ideally MongoDB).
  • Ideally, you are already familiar with at least one cloud services platform (GCP, AWS, Azure) with experience mixing different services within the same project. If not, you have a strong appetite to learn more about these topics.
  • You are comfortable using Docker, automating CI/CD pipelines and have a strong appetite for gaining competence in Kubernetes if you do not yet have experience with this solution.
  • You will be able to work in a DevOps culture, taking responsibility for the code lifecycle, from development to deployment and maintenance of applications (mastery of the Gitlab-CE ecosystem is a plus). You are also familiar with Infrastructure as Code concepts and tools (ideally Terraform).
  • You are sensitive to security issues and have experience in implementing application protection solutions (certificate management, HTTPS security, OAuth2 authentication, credential management)
  • You have a strong interest in data and AI-related topics, the ability to quickly build expertise in these areas, and you’re excited about helping our clients seize the opportunities they offer.
  • You have excellent interpersonal and team working skills
  • Excellent English and Dutch verbal and written skills are required.

We are unable to provide a work permit for this position

Sia is an equal opportunity employer. All aspects of employment, including hiring, promotion, remuneration, or discipline, are based solely on performance, competence, conduct, or business needs.

title: Software Developer IV
description:
Who are we?

Western National Insurance Group is a private mutual insurance company with over 120 years of experience serving customers' property-and-casualty insurance needs in the Midwestern, Northwestern, and Southwestern United States. Known as “The Relationship Company®,” we define success as a measure of the relationships we’ve built over time. Does this opportunity interest you?

title: Cyber Security Analyst III - Digital Forensics and Incident Response
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Cyber Security Analyst III - Digital Forensics and Incident Response based in United States.

This role supports enterprise cybersecurity operations and incident response within a highly regulated federal environment.
You will conduct hands-on digital forensic investigations, analyze security events, and help contain and recover from confirmed cyber incidents.
Working across SIEM, NIDS, SOAR, endpoint protection, firewalls, DLP, email filtering, scanners, and PCAP tools, you will investigate threats across the enterprise.
The position combines technical analysis with incident reporting, remediation, security monitoring, and operational support.
You will also contribute to audits, assessments, disaster recovery exercises, and continuous improvement of cybersecurity processes and tools.
As an experienced analyst, you will work with limited supervision while coaching and mentoring junior cybersecurity professionals.
This remote U.S. opportunity offers the chance to contribute to mission-critical cybersecurity operations supporting a major federal site.

Accountabilities:

  • Conduct digital forensic investigations on targeted endpoints using appropriate forensic tools and methodologies.
  • Monitor, analyze, and respond to security events across the enterprise using SIEM, NIDS, SOAR, endpoint protection, firewall, DLP, email filtering, vulnerability scanning, and PCAP technologies.
  • Identify reportable security incidents in accordance with established procedures and serve as an incident handler throughout investigation and response activities.
  • Collect and analyze relevant data, evidence, and artifacts; document findings; prepare incident reports; communicate results to management; and execute mitigation, containment, and recovery activities.
  • Monitor security reports and threat intelligence from multiple sources and translate relevant findings into actionable response activities.
  • Distribute threat advisories, vulnerability reports, and official cybersecurity directives to appropriate customers and leadership.
  • Participate in disaster recovery exercises and cybersecurity-related events.
  • Support the operation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of cybersecurity tools and technologies.
  • Contribute to cybersecurity audits, assessments, investigations, and information requests.
  • Independently manage assigned projects and processes while maintaining appropriate priorities and meeting operational objectives.
  • Review and coach the work of junior professionals and provide technical mentoring and training to developing analysts.
  • Perform additional cybersecurity duties and responsibilities as assigned.
  • Maintain the physical capabilities required for extended computer use, including repetitive keyboarding, visual and communication activities, occasional bending, kneeling, reaching, lifting, and safe travel by vehicle or aircraft.

    • Requirements

    • Bachelor’s degree and 5+ years of relevant experience, or an equivalent combination of education, training, and professional experience.
    • Experience in cybersecurity, information technology, systems analysis, or a related field, with hands-on experience in incident response and/or digital forensics.
    • Working knowledge of recognized cybersecurity compliance frameworks such as NIST, CIS Critical Security Controls, or ISO 27001/27002.
    • Strong analytical and investigative abilities, with the capacity to collect evidence, assess security events, identify threats, and determine appropriate response actions.
    • Ability to independently set priorities, manage multiple responsibilities, and complete projects with limited supervision.
    • Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical findings clearly to different audiences.
    • Strong teamwork and collaboration skills, combined with a customer-focused approach.
    • Experience working in industrial control system (ICS), operational technology (OT), or federal FISMA-regulated environments is preferred.
    • Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline is preferred.
    • Industry certifications such as GCFA, GCIH, GNFA, CySA+, or CEH are preferred.
    • Ability to pass required pre-employment background and drug screening.
    • Must have identification compliant with the REAL ID Act at the time of hire.
    • Ability to obtain and maintain a Department of Energy access authorization and HSPD-12 Personal Identity Verification (PIV) credential, including successful completion of the required federal background investigation.
    • Ability to comply with applicable federal requirements governing controlled substances as a condition of employment.

      • Benefits

      • Annual salary range of $100,457–$161,384 USD.
      • Paid holidays.
      • Paid time off.
      • 401(k) retirement plan with employer matching.
      • Health insurance options through the Federal Employee Health Benefits (FEHB) program.
      • Dental insurance.
      • Vision insurance.
      • Life insurance benefits.
      • Disability benefits.
      • Full-time remote work within the United States.
      • Opportunity to work on mission-critical cybersecurity operations in a federal environment.
      • Professional development through exposure to digital forensics, incident response, threat intelligence, security operations, and regulated cybersecurity frameworks.

title: Senior Scientist
description:
Unfortunately we do not offer sponsorship for this role.

Hours: 39 hours per week, 09:00 - 17:15 (4 days), 09:00 - 17:30 (1 day)

Purpose of the post

We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Scientist, Gas Chromatography (GC) Subject Matter Expert to provide technical leadership within our GMP-regulated Biopharmaceutical Chemistry laboratory. Acting as the department's recognised GC specialist, you will support the delivery of high-quality analytical testing services, lead complex scientific investigations, and drive excellence across method development, validation, troubleshooting, compliance, and continuous improvement activities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as the technical lead and subject matter expert for Gas Chromatography across the Chemistry department.
  • Perform and oversee complex analytical testing to support biopharmaceutical products and projects within a GMP-regulated laboratory environment.
  • Lead and support method development, validation, verification, transfer, and optimisation activities.
  • Provide technical guidance, troubleshooting expertise, and scientific support for chromatographic methods and instrumentation.
  • Conduct technical reviews, data reviews, and batch audits to ensure compliance with GMP, data integrity, and regulatory requirements.
  • Lead root cause investigations, quality risk assessments, CAPAs, change controls, and other quality-related activities.
  • Develop, review, and approve analytical procedures, protocols, reports, and controlled GMP documentation.
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships through technical discussions, project support, audit participation, and inter-company collaboration.
  • Support regulatory inspections, client audits, self-inspections, continuous improvement initiatives, and the delivery of technical training across the department.
  • Degree in Life Sciences, Chemistry, Analytical Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or a related scientific discipline.
  • Extensive experience within a GMP or GLP-regulated laboratory environment, with significant expertise in Gas Chromatography.
  • Strong knowledge of chromatographic method development, validation, transfer, verification, and troubleshooting.
  • Experience working with pharmacopoeial methods and requirements (USP, EP, BP, JP or equivalent).
  • Excellent understanding of GMP, data integrity, and regulatory compliance requirements.
  • Strong leadership, communication, problem-solving, and report-writing skills.
  • Ability to build effective client relationships and provide technical guidance, mentoring, and training.

title: PRN Associate Therapist I
description:
Position Summary

Associate Therapists provide individual, family and group therapy sessions for clients in an Intensive Outpatient and Partial Hospitalization mental health facility, under the supervision of fully licensed therapists. Associate Therapists assess the therapeutic needs of clients, develop appropriate treatment plans, and facilitate group, family and individual therapy sessions. Position collaborates with clients, team members, external clinical partners and family members, as appropriate, to coordinate care throughout the treatment process.

Relationships and Contacts

Within the organization: Maintains frequent and close working relationships with clinical, admissions, and leadership team members throughout the organization.

Outside the organization: Initiates and maintains strong professional relationships with clients and families, clinical providers, referral partners and vendors, as needed.

Position Responsibilities

Essential Responsibilities

  1. Facilitates group, individual, and family therapy sessions in accordance with the clinical program schedule.
  2. Completes session notes, contact logs, discharge plans and other reports in compliance with State, accrediting bodies, quality guidelines and payor source guidelines.
    1. Completes all necessary documentation within prescribed format and timelines.
    2. Ensures documentation reflects ongoing assessments of client’s clinical presentation and behaviors.
  3. Facilitates specialized groups as assigned based on education, training, and experience.
  4. Selects appropriate interventions to meet the clinical needs of individual clients.
  5. Maintains therapeutic relationships with clients using praise and other reinforcers to encourage appropriate behaviors and attitudes.
  6. Sets limits and holds boundaries in a kind and firm manner.
  7. Conducts effective verbal crisis intervention and de-escalation involving other team members, as needed.
  8. Collaborates with an interdisciplinary treatment team to coordinate client care from admission through discharge.
  9. Attends clinical, consultation, and operations meetings; serves as a clinical advocate for assigned cases.
  10. Communicates client progress with the referral sources, families, parents and/or guardians, as appropriate.
  11. Addresses clients, visitors, physicians, and co-workers in a welcoming and respectful manner.
  12. Responds to clients and families with empathy and positive professional skills.

Additional Responsibilities

  1. Can be relied upon to be at work as scheduled, proactively notifying supervisor of planned and unplanned time off needs.
  2. Reads, understands, and adheres to all company policy statements on ethics, conduct, and conflict of interests; adheres to facility policies, procedures, rules, and regulations.
  3. Maintains positive attitude and acts as a team player with others on the team.
  4. Attends and completes all trainings within assigned time frames.
  5. Completes other duties as assigned.

title: Service Delivery Manager | Penetration Testing
description:
Who are we?

It all starts with the mission: NVISO is here to protect European society from potentially devastating cyber attacks! This means we offer cyber security services to private and governmental organizations to help them better prepare for, prevent, detect and respond to cyber security incidents.

All of this is built on four fundamental values that define who we are: We are Proud, We Break Barriers, We Care and No BS!

Tasks

What will you do?

As a Service Delivery Manager within our Penetration Testing team, you are responsible for ensuring the effective planning, coordination and delivery of penetration testing engagements across our teams and customers.

You act as the operational link between our penetration testers, customers and internal stakeholders. You ensure that projects are properly planned, the right resources are available, commitments towards customers are realistic, and projects are delivered on time and according to our quality standards.

1. Capacity & Resource Planning

  • Own and maintain the capacity and resource planning of the Penetration Testing team.
  • Maintain visibility on available capacity, planned work, absences and upcoming demand.
  • Allocate penetration testers to projects based on availability, required skills, customer requirements and development opportunities.
  • Identify capacity constraints, overbooking and planning conflicts early and drive their resolution.
  • Work closely with sales and service leadership to translate the commercial pipeline and expected demand into resource requirements.
  • Provide visibility and forecasts on utilization, capacity and future resource needs.
  • Balance short-term project requirements with sustainable team utilization and longer-term capacity needs.

2. Project Management & Delivery

  • Own the operational planning and follow-up of penetration testing engagements.
  • Translate confirmed customer engagements into clear project plans, timelines and resource requirements.
  • Coordinate multiple concurrent penetration testing projects and ensure priorities are clear.
  • Ensure projects are properly staffed and confirmed within the agreed planning process.
  • Track project progress, deadlines, dependencies and deliverables.
  • Proactively identify delivery risks and take action when projects are at risk of delay, overrun or under-delivery.
  • Coordinate changes in scope, timing or resource requirements with the relevant stakeholders.
  • Ensure clear ownership throughout the project lifecycle, from planning and kick-off through testing, reporting and closure.
  • Continuously improve project management and planning processes based on delivery data and lessons learned.

3. Client & Stakeholder Management

  • Act as a key point of contact for customers regarding planning and delivery of penetration testing engagements.
  • Set and manage realistic expectations regarding timelines, availability, deliverables and dependencies.
  • Maintain strong relationships with customers and ensure delivery commitments are understood and followed up.
  • Coordinate with technical leads and penetration testers when technical input or escalation is required.
  • Work closely with sales and pre-sales to ensure proposed timelines and delivery commitments are operationally feasible.
  • Provide clear reporting on project status, delivery risks, capacity and relevant operational KPIs.

  • Monitor penetration testing delivery performance and identify recurring bottlenecks or improvement opportunities.
  • Ensure delivery processes are documented, consistently followed and continuously improved.
  • Help improve forecasting, planning accuracy, utilization and predictability of service delivery.
  • Contribute to the evolution of our penetration testing services and operating model.
  • Support the adoption of tooling and automation that improves planning, project management and service delivery.

Requirements

  • Experience in project management, service delivery, resource management or a similar operational role.

  • Experience working in cybersecurity, IT consulting or another professional-services environment.

  • Strong planning and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and changing priorities.

  • Demonstrated ability to manage capacity, resources and competing delivery requirements.

  • Strong stakeholder-management and communication skills.

  • Ability to engage confidently with customers as well as technical teams.

  • Sufficient technical understanding of penetration testing and cybersecurity to understand project requirements, skills requirements and delivery constraints.

  • Ability to identify problems early, make decisions and drive actions to resolution.

  • Strong analytical skills and comfort working with planning, utilization and delivery data.

  • Fluent English;

  • Citizenship in one of the 32 NATO member states;

  • People-management experience is a plus: Candidates with experience coaching, holding regular one-to-ones, contributing to goal setting, development plans and performance reviews, and fostering team engagement, collaboration and well-being are preferred. This is not a prerequisite; the role’s primary focus remains capacity planning, resource management and successful project delivery.

  • Hands-on penetration testing experience is an advantage but is not required. The role does not require the individual to perform penetration tests themselves.

Benefits

What do we offer?

At NVISO, we care. We are committed to offering you a highly competitive remuneration package including financial and non-financial components:

  • A training budget of 10.000€ and 10 days every 2 years.
  • Flexible working model and home office possibilities (+working abroad options).
  • Statutory leave plus 5 additional leave days by NVISO.
  • Additional benefits on a monthly and annual basis.
  • An entrepreneurial and agile company, where you will be stimulated and supported in driving new initiatives (either through internal innovation or by improving our service offering), without losing sight of having fun!
  • Working and learning from the best people in the European cyber security industry. We have multiple SANS Instructors working at NVISO, our staff has presented at popular hacking conferences (BlackHat, BruCON, OWASP, etc) and all of our technical staff can acquire deep technical security certifications (GSE, GXPN, GREM, GCFA, OSCP, etc).

IF YOU’RE INTERESTED, PLEASE SEND US YOUR APPLICATION!

WE’RE LOOKING FORWARD TO MEETING YOU!

Please be aware that the creation and submission of application documents (e.g. CV, cover letter, case studies, etc.) using AI-powered tools is only permitted to a limited extent.

Our expectations:

title: Director, Executive and Enterprise Storytelling - Remote
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start Caring. Connecting. Growing together.

You'll enjoy the flexibility to work remotely * from anywhere within the U.S. as you take on some tough challenges. For all hires in the Minneapolis or Washington, D.C. area, you will be required to work in the office a minimum of four days per week.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Serve as lead writer for Optum's senior corporate leaders, including the CEO, creating clear, compelling communications that advance strategic priorities and strengthen Optum's reputation
  • Develop speeches, presentations, executive remarks, articles, thought leadership, social media content, employee communications, video scripts, correspondence, and other high-visibility content for internal and external audiences
  • Partner with executive communications strategy leaders and subject matter experts to translate business priorities, enterprise narratives, industry trends, and complex health care topics into simple, engaging, and memorable stories
  • Ensure content reflects a consistent leadership voice, meets editorial standards, and strengthens Optum's reputation and thought leadership across live, written, digital, and social channels
  • Lead and develop two communications professionals who support enterprise and corporate content development
  • Manage multiple editorial priorities and deadlines while maintaining exceptional quality and using AI responsibly to streamline routine work and create more time for creativity, storytelling, and editorial judgment
  • Advance storytelling practices, executive voice development, editorial standards, and content excellence across the Storytelling & Writing team

You'll be rewarded and recognized for your performance in an environment that will challenge you and give you clear direction on what it takes to succeed in your role as well as provide development for other roles you may be interested in.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in humanities, communications, journalism, or a related field
  • 8+ years of executive, corporate, or agency writing experience, including 3+ years writing for senior business leaders
  • Knowledge of the U.S. health care industry and the roles of UnitedHealth Group and Optum, including the importance of technology and innovation in improving health care
  • Proven exceptional writing, editing, and storytelling skills, with the ability to capture executive voice and create compelling content that engages audiences, influences perception, and advances business priorities
  • Demonstrated experience developing executive content across speeches, presentations, articles, employee communications, social media, and thought leadership while maintaining a consistent voice and narrative across channels
  • Proven intellectual curiosity about health care, policy, business, innovation, and industry trends
  • Proven ability to travel occasionally

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Health care industry experience
  • Experience delivering high-quality content in a complex, matrixed organization
  • Proven creative, collaborative team player with strong interpersonal skills and a demonstrated ability to build trusted relationships across diverse groups

*All employees working remotely will be required to adhere to UnitedHealth Group's Telecommuter Policy

Pay is based on several factors including but not limited to local labor markets, education, work experience, certifications, etc. In addition to your salary, we offer benefits such as, a comprehensive benefits package, incentive and recognition programs, equity stock purchase and 401k contribution (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements). No matter where or when you begin a career with us, you'll find a far-reaching choice of benefits and incentives. The salary for this role will range from $134,600 - $230,800 annually based on full-time employment. We comply with all minimum wage laws as applicable.

Application Deadline: This will be posted for a minimum of 2 business days or until a sufficient candidate pool has been collected. Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants.

At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.

UnitedHealth Group is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer under applicable law and qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, national origin, religion, age, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by local, state, or federal laws, rules, or regulations.

UnitedHealth Group is a drug - free workplace. Candidates are required to pass a drug test before beginning employment.

title: Managing Director- Cybersecurity
description:
As a Managing Director within Sia’s Cybersecurity Business Line, this role is responsible for driving the growth and market positioning of the firm through business development, account management, and deep cybersecurity expertise across areas such as cyber strategy, security transformation, and risk and compliance. Responsibilities include the development of strategic client relationships and large-scale engagements across key markets and industries, as well as leading and growing a team of consultants and contributing to the firm's cybersecurity thought leadership and offering development. This position requires a strong external presence, an established senior executive network, and a proven track record of originating and closing new businesses, alongside the ability to lead complex engagements and convert deep technical expertise into sustained commercial impact.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead complex cybersecurity engagements from strategy through execution, serving as the senior executive accountable for delivery and client impact.
  • Provide executive-level guidance on cybersecurity governance, cyber resilience, and cyber transformation to Boards and C-suite leaders.
  • Lead delivery excellence by ensuring technical rigor, quality assurance, and consistency across engagements while driving optimized staffing and efficient delivery management.

Business Development:

  • Drive substantial revenue growth by originating new business through proactive client acquisition, expanding existing relationships, and managing strategic accounts.
  • Drive the hub’s cybersecurity business expansion by leading go-to-market strategy, commercial prospecting, pre-sales engagement, client sales discussions, and development of tailored solution offerings.
  • Champion cross-Business Line collaboration by identifying and facilitating opportunities to bring complementary Sia expertise (e.g., Risk, Data, Strategy) into client engagements, maximizing the firm's overall value proposition.

People Leadership and Team Development

  • Provide, oversight, and mentorship to project teams, ensuring high-quality delivery and alignment with client objectives.
  • Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous learning across engagements and internal initiatives.
  • Attract, develop and retain top talent by actively coaching team members, supporting professional growth, and contributing to performance management.
  • Implement the Business Line strategy and actively promote the firm’s mission, vision, culture and purpose
  • Participate in the major cybersecurity trade shows attended by C-Level executives
  • Drive the achievement of relevant cybersecurity clearances

Thought Leadership & Market Presence

  • Shape a differentiated point of view on industry trends, emerging technologies, and enterprise transformation, and represent Sia as a recognized voice through conferences, panels, and executive forums.
  • Build market credibility through advisory roles, council memberships, and active leadership in professional organizations.

This job description is not intended to be all inclusive. Duties, responsibilities, and qualifications may be added, deleted, or modified at any time based on business needs.

  • 10+ years of experience in cybersecurity, technology risk, or information security.
  • 7+ years in a senior leadership role within a consulting firm
  • Experience leading large-scale enterprise cybersecurity transformations.
  • Certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CRISC, or cloud security certifications are strongly preferred.

Compensation & Benefits

Sia invests in total rewards that support how our people work, live, and grow.

Compensation

  • Base Salary: $200,000–$280,000. Actual compensation within this range will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by applicable law.
  • Personal Sales Bonus (uncapped)
  • Annual Performance Bonus (appraisal)

Benefits

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Company-paid life and AD&D insurance; voluntary supplemental insurance and EAP at no cost
  • 401(k) with company match and immediate vesting; HSA and FSA
  • College savings and student loan repayment programs
  • Paid parental leave
  • Generous PTO, nine company holidays, and one floating holiday
  • Monthly cell phone stipend
  • Well-being and professional development programs

Benefits are subject to applicable plan terms and eligibility requirements.

Workplace

Sia embraces a flexible workplace model that balances autonomy with in-person connection. Management is expected to be in the office at least three days per week, serving as culture carriers who mentor teams, strengthen client relationships, and lead by example.

Work Authorization

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of application and throughout their employment. This position is not eligible for employment visa sponsorship now or in the future.

Our Commitment
At Sia, we believe in fostering a diverse, equitable, and inclusive culture where our employees and partners are valued and thrive in a sense of belonging.

Sia is an equal opportunity employer. All aspects of employment, including hiring, promotion, remuneration, or discipline, are based solely on performance, competence, conduct, or business needs.

title: Belonging and Well-Being Champion (4867)
location: West San Gabriel Valley Family YMCA - Alhambra, CA 91801
description:
POSITION SUMMARY

The Belonging and Well-Being Champion is responsible for fostering a culture of belonging, health, and connection across YMCA membership and wellness experiences. This role combines the personal engagement and health support of a Healthy Lifestyles Counselor with the sales and service expertise of a Membership Sales and Service Representative. The Belonging and Well-Being Champion serves as a frontline ambassador for the YMCA — welcoming all, connecting members to programs and people, helping them pursue their wellness goals, and driving membership growth and retention. Through relationship-building, proactive outreach, and exceptional service, this position advances the Y’s mission to strengthen the foundations of community through healthy living and inclusion.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

Membership Engagement and Belonging

  • Create a welcoming, inclusive, and supportive environment in all YMCA areas by greeting and engaging with members and guests.
  • Build meaningful relationships with members to understand their goals and connect them to Y programs, wellness services, and community activities.
  • Facilitate small-group connections to enhance member belonging and long-term engagement.
  • Conduct new member onboarding sessions and wellness consultations to help members set and achieve healthy living goals.
  • Respond promptly and courteously to all member inquiries, compliments, and concerns, resolving issues with care and accountability.

Membership Sales and Retention

  • Actively promote YMCA membership, programs, and services through tours, community outreach, and referral campaigns.
  • Conduct prospective member interviews, tours, and follow-ups — closing with an invitation to join the YMCA.
  • Meet or exceed individual and team membership sales and retention goals.
  • Implement grassroots and digital outreach strategies to engage local communities and attract new members.
  • Conduct member retention calls and exit interviews to strengthen relationships and address barriers to participation.

Healthy Living Support

  • Support members in achieving health and wellness goals by monitoring progress, offering encouragement, and connecting them to appropriate programs.
  • Demonstrate and instruct members in the safe and effective use of fitness equipment and exercise techniques as needed.
  • Monitor activity in the fitness center to ensure safety, cleanliness, and a positive environment for all.
  • Assist in implementing health education initiatives, fitness challenges, and community wellbeing events.

Operations and Compliance

  • Accurately process memberships, payments, and registrations while maintaining data integrity.
  • Adhere to cash-handling procedures and maintain confidentiality of member information.
  • Uphold YMCA policies related to safety, supervision, mandated reporting, and risk management.
  • Participate in staff meetings, trainings, and association-wide campaigns such as the Annual Support Campaign.
  • Model and enforce the YMCA’s Code of Conduct and Core Values of Caring, Respect, Honesty, and Responsibility.

Leadership

  • Engage with members regarding their participation in YMCA Programs, Annual Support Campaign, and special events.
  • Participate in community outreach through grassroots outings, building relationships and partnerships with community leaders, local businesses, and local government.
  • Attend staff meetings and trainings as required.
  • Uphold YMCA policies for safety, supervision, mandated reporting and risk management.
  • Demonstrate the Six Pillars of Character (Trustworthiness, Citizenship, Respect, Responsibility, Caring, and Fairness) as well as the YMCA Core Values of caring, respect, honesty and responsibility in all dealings with members, guests, volunteers and fellow staff.
  • Demonstrate competencies in and willingness to develop in the Cause Driven Leadership areas of mission advancement, collaboration, operational effectiveness and personal growth.
  • All other duties as assigned by your supervisor.

YMCA LEADERSHIP COMPETENCIES

The Y’s Leadership Competency Model is comprised of 14 Leadership Competencies (leadership knowledge, skills, and behaviors required for success in the Y), organized by the four disciplines of Cause-Driven Leadership:

  • Advancing Our Mission & Cause: Provide visionary leadership to the organization and to ensure that all resources are mobilized to adapt to new challenges and needs in the community
    • Competencies Include: Change Leadership, Engaging Community, Philanthropy, & Volunteerism
  • Building Relationships: Connect people to the Y’s cause by developing inclusive relationships, partnerships and collaborations so that Ys can co-create solutions to pressing social needs
    • Competencies Include: Collaboration, Communication & Influence, & Inclusion
  • Leading Operations: ensure relevance, effectiveness, and sustainability of the organization so that we can continue to fulfill our promise to the community
    • Competencies Include: Critical Thinking & Decision Making, Fiscal Management, Functional Expertise, Innovation, & Program/Project Management
  • Developing & Inspiring Others: support the holistic development of self and others so that everyone can embrace the Y’s cause, sustain the Y’s culture, and inspire others to take individual and collective action to further our impact
    • Competencies Include: Emotional Maturity & Developing Self & Others

While all competencies are significant, the following are critical to success in this position:

  • Engaging Community
  • Communication & Influence
  • Functional Expertise
  • Developing Self & Others

title: Admissions Coordinator
description:
Help Service Members Build Their Next Career — While Building Yours.

Troops Into Transportation, powered by The CDL School, is growing.

We’re looking for hungry, ambitious, people-oriented professionals to join our Admissions team serving the Fort Hood military community.


Every day, our team helps transitioning service members, veterans, and military families take the next step toward a civilian career in transportation. You’ll often be one of their first conversations — helping turn interest and uncertainty into a clear path forward.
You don’t need years of admissions experience. You do need energy, initiative, confidence, and the desire to grow.

What You’ll Do

This isn’t simply an administrative position. You’ll be on the front line of our admissions effort:

  • Connect with prospective students by phone, text, online, and in person — understand what they want to accomplish and help them take the next step.
  • Follow up consistently, set appointments, and support prospective students as they move from initial interest toward enrollment.
  • Work alongside our Admissions Representatives to deliver a professional, responsive student experience.
  • Own the details — keep applications, documentation, appointments, and student information accurate and moving.
  • Learn the business, produce results, and take on greater responsibility as you demonstrate what you can do.

Start Here. Earn Your Next Opportunity.

We aren’t simply looking to fill a coordinator seat.


We’re looking for people who can become our next Admissions Representative.

The Coordinator position gives you an opportunity to learn our programs, understand our students, develop your admissions skills, and demonstrate that you can perform. High-performing Coordinators may be considered for advancement to Admissions Representative after successfully completing their introductory/probationary period, based on performance and business needs. If you’re looking for a position where initiative and results can create opportunity, you’ll understand what we’re building.


Who We’re Looking For

Experience in admissions, recruiting, sales, customer service, hospitality, education, or a call-center environment is helpful — but potential matters too.


We’re particularly interested in people who:

  • Are confident talking with people and aren’t afraid to pick up the phone.
  • Follow through and don’t need to be chased.
  • Are organized, dependable, and comfortable being accountable for results.
  • Learn quickly and want greater responsibility.
  • Bring positive energy and a competitive desire to succeed.
  • Want a career opportunity, not simply another job.

A high school diploma or equivalent is required, along with basic computer proficiency and the ability to learn CRM and web-based systems.


Military experience or affiliation is welcomed.


Why Troops Into Transportation?

Because this work has a mission.


For more than a decade, Troops Into Transportation has helped members of the military community translate their service, discipline, and experience into new opportunities in the civilian workforce.Now we’re looking for people who want to help carry that mission forward.You’ll have the opportunity to help someone else begin their next chapter — while proving you’re ready for yours.


Ready?


If you’re ambitious, good with people, willing to work, and looking for an opportunity to prove what you can do, we’d like to meet you.


Apply today.

title: Senior Clinical Associate
description:

I further attest that all information I submit in my employment application is true to the best of my knowledge.

Job Description

Senior Clinical Study Associate


Location: Warsaw, Poland (Office-Based/Hybrid) Global Clinical Development Operations (GCDO)


About the Role

At Takeda, we are committed to transforming patient care through the development of innovative medicines. We are seeking a Senior Clinical Study Associate (Sr CSA) to join our Global Clinical Development Operations (GCDO) team in Warsaw, Poland.

As a key member of the Study Management team, you will support the operational execution of global clinical studies within a designated therapeutic area. Working closely with Clinical Study Managers (CSMs), Clinical Operations Program Leads (COPLs), and Study Execution Teams (SETs), you will play an essential role in delivering clinical studies in accordance with development plans, regulatory requirements, and Takeda standards.

This position is ideally suited to a proactive, detail-oriented clinical operations professional who thrives in a collaborative global environment and enjoys driving operational excellence across complex clinical studies.


Key Responsibilities

Study Execution & Operational Delivery

  • Proactively manage day-to-day clinical study activities, ensuring compliance with study protocols, ICH-GCP guidelines, and Takeda SOPs.
  • Support medium to high complexity global clinical studies, with responsibility for one or more studies and/or programs.
  • Collaborate closely with Clinical Study Managers and Study Execution Team members to deliver study objectives and timelines.
  • Anticipate operational needs, identify risks, and contribute to effective issue resolution.
  • Ensure study activities are executed in alignment with study-specific plans and the established operating model.

Study Start-Up & Site Activation

  • Support study start-up activities and site initiation processes.
  • Track site activation progress and escalate issues when required.
  • Review Site Initiation Visit (SIV) reports and Essential Document Packages (EDP) in collaboration with Study Start-Up teams where applicable.
  • Assist with the review and maintenance of study plans, documents, and operational deliverables.

Clinical Systems & Documentation

  • Maintain and update clinical trial systems and study documentation on behalf of the Clinical Study Manager.
  • Ensure accuracy and completeness across systems such as: Clinical Trial Management Systems (CTMS) Electronic Trial Master File (eTMF) COMPASS and other study platforms
  • Support inspection readiness activities by overseeing delegated tasks and ensuring documentation quality.

Vendor & Stakeholder Management

  • Contribute to sponsor oversight and vendor management activities.
  • Review site monitoring visit reports.
  • Track vendor deliverables and study budgets under the guidance of the Clinical Study Manager.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with internal and external stakeholders to support study objectives.

Study Close-Out & Inspection Readiness

  • Support study close-out activities, including: Documentation finalization Financial reconciliation Submission-support activities such as data review
  • Lead delegated close-out activities independently where appropriate.
  • Support audit preparation, participation, and inspection readiness initiatives.
  • Contribute to regulatory inspection preparations and attendance when required.

Continuous Improvement & Team Development

  • Identify operational risks, process gaps, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Escalate issues appropriately to ensure continuity of study operations.
  • Act as a subject matter expert within the CSA community.
  • Support onboarding, training, mentoring, and knowledge-sharing initiatives.
  • Contribute to department-wide and cross-functional projects as required.

What You'll Bring


Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Health Sciences, Technology, or a related discipline.
  • Equivalent combinations of education, training, and experience will also be considered.

Experience

  • Minimum 2-4 years of experience within the pharmaceutical industry, clinical research organization (CRO), or a related clinical research environment.
  • Experience supporting Phase II and/or Phase III clinical studies.
  • Experience working on global clinical trials.
  • Exposure to multiple therapeutic areas; oncology experience is advantageous.

Technical Knowledge

  • Strong understanding of: ICH-GCP Global clinical research regulations Clinical trial compliance requirements
  • Experience working with: CTMS eTMF platforms Other clinical trial technology systems
  • Understanding of vendor oversight and inspection readiness processes.

Skills & Competencies

  • Excellent organizational and task management skills.
  • Strong problem-solving and critical thinking abilities.
  • Effective stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently while contributing to a global team environment.
  • Demonstrated initiative, adaptability, and a solutions-focused mindset.
  • Commitment to quality, compliance, and operational excellence.

Languages

  • Fluent written and spoken English.

Locations

Warsaw, Poland

Employee

Worker Sub-Type

Regular

Time Type

Full time

title: Senior Engineering Lead II - Send Experience
description:
The team you will join: Send Experience

Send Experience sits at the heart of every transfer on Wise. It’s where new customers make their first international transfer, where people send money home every month, and where customers using Wise as a primary account move money every day.

Our teams make first transfers simple, with our AI Assistant there to guide customers. We make everyday transfers smart, fast, and effortless, while adding new capabilities to our international account.

More than 15 million customers send money through us every month. You’ll own the Send journey end to end and directly shape the experience at global scale.

This is a product and engineering leadership role. With Product, Design and Analytics, you’ll shape the strategy and roadmap, identify the customer problems that matter most, and decide how to solve them. You’ll also set the technical direction and balance execution speed with quality, security, and long-term scale.

You’ll initially lead two teams, with scope to grow the group further.

What will you be working on:

  • Defining the product roadmap: You’ll work side-by-side with Product to decide what we build next. You’ll be making the calls between speed, security, and long-term scale.

  • Turning strategy into execution: You’ll set clear outcomes, priorities and ownership, remove blockers and enable fast, reliable delivery without teams depending on you for every decision.

Technical responsibilities:

  • Technical authority: You’ll act as the primary technical owner for Send, with the senior-level technical depth to lead architectural decisions and address technical debt.

  • Operational excellence: You’ll improve reliability, security, and operational health, ensuring the teams proactively manage the services that millions of customers rely on.

Leadership responsibilities:

  • Growing the teams: You will start with two cross-functional, high-output teams with the expectation to scale the group further.

  • People development: You’ll own the performance, career growth, and wellbeing of your Engineering Leads, while remaining accountable for the engineers they lead.

  • Cross-functional alignment: You’ll work closely with Global Product, Regional, and other functions to align our roadmap with the wider Wise strategy. You’ll help the teams navigate complex priorities and make trade-offs between speed, quality, and risk.

What do you need?

  • Experience leading customer-facing engineering: You’ve led teams building apps or websites that make complex problems feel simple.

  • Strong technical background: Experience with backend and client engineering. You understand the difference between "working code" and "scalable architecture."

  • Leadership experience: You have led high-performing teams (hiring, performance management, coaching). You know how to scale your impact through strong Engineering Leads and senior engineers.

  • Product mindset: You understand the "why" behind the "what." You can map technical efforts directly to business goals and customer value.

  • Strategic thinking: You can switch between reviewing a Pull Request and planning the 12-month technical strategy for a critical business domain.

  • Communication: You explain complex technical decisions to non-technical partners, challenge constructively, and build alignment.

Nice to have:

  • Experience building AI Assistants or other AI-powered experiences

  • Experience in payments, fintech, or another global regulated product environment

  • Experience building high-throughput APIs for enterprise or platform clients

  • Experience scaling a domain from one team into a multi-team organisation

Send is one of Wise’s most important customer journeys. If you want to shape a journey used by millions and grow great leaders, we’d love to hear from you.

  • DEI @ Wise

  • See what it's like to work at Wise London!

For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.

We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.
Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.

title: Corrugator Lead
description:
Position Title:

Corrugator Lead

Pay Rate:

$28.85

Category/Shift:

Hourly

7a-3pm, 3 pm – 11 pm, 11pm -7 am Monday- Friday(All Shifts)

Physical Location:

Oklahoma City, OK

Summary:

The lead person directs and leads activities such that orders and banded, stored, and delivered according to customer requirements and organization goals are achieved.

The lead person reports to the PIM / Superintendent.

The Job You Will Perform:

  • following all safety rules and practices;

  • conduction safety training and performing safety observations.

  • leading associates, including serving as coach and counselor regarding professional development and when situations arise the affect associates job performance.

  • supervising associates, including prioritizing and assigning work, and monitoring the quality and quantity of the work performed.

  • inventory materials, parts, and supplies as required.

  • establish work practices, and training associates.

  • conducting regular meetings with all associates to provide quality and performance feedback, address operating issues, provide training, and work on continuous improvement projects.

  • implementing quality improvement and cost reduction ideas.

  • taking and maintaining accurate inventories.

  • insuring that associates perform required inspections and test.

  • preparing and maintaining accurate records.

  • maintaining teamwork with other associates.

  • maintaining work areas to plant standards of housekeeping.

  • performing other duties as assigned by the site manager.

The Skills You Will Bring:

  • High School diploma or GED equivalent required.
  • Strong communication, interpersonal skills and organization preferred.
  • Ability to multi-task and prioritize work effectively preferred.
  • Solid computer/systems skillset-working knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite, especially Microsoft Excel is required.
  • Prior experience in parts procurement, inventory management and SAP is preferred.

Qualifications:

  • Must know, or be willing to learn, every position on the corrugator.
  • Must be able to work on any shift.
  • Must be self-driven and show leadership qualities.
  • Minimum of 1 year corrugator experience preferred.
  • Cannot have any discipline above a written warning for safety, attendance or job performance.
  • Certified ability to safely operate a fork lift truck

  • Certified ability to teach the safe operation of fork lift trucks

  • Ability to read, write, and speak English

  • Ability to give instructions

  • Ability to follow instructions, ask questions, and work effectively as a member of a team.

  • The PIM Superintendent evaluates lead persons qualifications.

The Benefits You Will Enjoy:

International Paper offers a benefits package that includes paid time off including vacation and holidays, retirement, pension and 401(k), medical and dental, life and disability insurance, education and development (including tuition reimbursement), and voluntary benefits including insurance for home, auto, vision and pets.

The Career You Will Build:

Promotional opportunities within a global company.

The Impact You Will Make:

We continue to build a better future for people, the planet, and our company! IP has been a good steward of sustainable practices across communities around the world for more than 120 years. Join our team and you’ll see why our team members say they’re Proud to be IP.

The Culture You Will Experience:

International Paper promotes employee well-being by providing safe, caring and inclusive workplaces. You will learn Safety Leadership Principles and have the opportunity to opt into Employee Networking Circles such as IPVets, IPride, Women in IP, and the African American ENC. We invite you to bring your uniqueness, creativity, talents, experiences, and safety mindset to be a part of our increasingly diverse culture.

The Company You Will Join:

International Paper (NYSE: IP) is a leading global supplier of renewable fiber-based products. We produce corrugated packaging products that protect and promote goods, and enable worldwide commerce, and pulp for diapers, tissue and other personal care products that promote health and wellness. Headquartered in Memphis, Tenn., we employ approximately 38,000 colleagues globally. We serve customers worldwide, with manufacturing operations in North America, Latin America, North Africa and Europe. Net sales for 2022 were $21.2 billion. title: Partner Success Executive
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Partner Success Executive based in United States.

This is a full-time individual contributor role focused on building and growing strategic relationships with college and university partners.
You will manage a portfolio of 10–20 institutions, helping them launch, adopt, engage with, and expand academic support programs.
The role combines partner success, strategic account management, engagement, and growth in a collaborative, cross-functional environment.
You will work directly with campus stakeholders to understand their priorities and connect program performance to broader student success goals.
Using relationship-building skills and data-driven insights, you will identify opportunities to strengthen retention, adoption, and partner growth.
You’ll collaborate closely with Sales, Marketing, Operations, and Academic Relations to create a seamless partner experience.
This is an opportunity to take meaningful ownership while contributing to the modernization of peer learning and student support in higher education.

Accountabilities:

  • Manage a strategic portfolio of 10–20 college and university partners, developing engagement strategies that support long-term success and growth.
  • Build trusted relationships with campus stakeholders through regular meetings, strategic touchpoints, proactive communication, and ongoing consultation.
  • Develop and execute partner engagement plans aligned with institutional priorities, program objectives, and student success goals.
  • Support successful partner launches, ongoing program adoption, stakeholder communication, and engagement throughout the partner lifecycle.
  • Lead renewal and retention activities, helping partners understand program value and maximize the impact of their partnership.
  • Identify opportunities for expansion, upselling, referrals, and broader stakeholder adoption, working with Sales and Marketing to develop and pursue opportunities.
  • Conduct regular program reviews and strategic conversations to evaluate progress, address challenges, and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Analyze partner data and translate insights into clear, actionable recommendations that improve program performance, engagement, and impact.
  • Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, Operations, and Academic Relations to ensure alignment and deliver a cohesive partner experience.
  • Work with internal teams to increase program visibility, stakeholder engagement, and adoption across partner campuses.
  • Contribute to knowledge-sharing, process improvements, and strategic initiatives that strengthen partner success practices.
  • Travel as needed to support partner engagement, relationship development, and growth opportunities.

    • Requirements

    • 4–6+ years of experience in higher education, sales, account management, customer success, program management, or partnership management.
    • Experience in EdTech is a plus, particularly within environments focused on higher education, student support, or academic success.
    • Genuine interest in education and student success, with motivation to contribute to initiatives that create tangible outcomes for students.
    • Strong relationship-building and communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with a diverse range of campus stakeholders.
    • Proven ability to manage multiple relationships, accounts, projects, or programs while balancing competing priorities.
    • Proactive, organized, and comfortable taking ownership in a fast-paced and evolving environment.
    • Strong analytical skills and the ability to turn partner data and insights into practical recommendations and next steps.
    • Commercial awareness and the ability to identify partner growth opportunities and collaborate with internal teams to pursue them.
    • Collaborative mindset, with the confidence to contribute as part of a team while independently leading initiatives when needed.
    • Willingness to travel as required for partner engagement and growth.
    • Commitment to teamwork, accessible education, mission-driven work, and improving student success.
    • Additional experience with peer tutoring, peer programs, student support, or direct collaboration with colleges and universities is advantageous.

      • Benefits

      • Competitive salary and vested stock options providing an opportunity for equity ownership.
      • Medical, dental, and vision healthcare benefits.
      • 401(k) retirement plan.
      • Wellness stipend.
      • Flexible paid time off.
      • Remote work flexibility with a monthly work-from-home stipend.
      • Company-sponsored technology and equipment.
      • Company events and team outings.
      • High level of autonomy and ownership.
      • Opportunities for professional growth within a collaborative, mission-driven team.
