title: Associate Director - North American Boarders
description:
Associate Director - North American Boarders

Shawnigan Lake School is a leading independent co-educational boarding school for ages 12-18 (grades 8-12) on Canada’s beautiful west coast. Our world-class facilities situated on a stunning 270-acre campus include ten boarding houses, outstanding sports facilities, a theatre, film lab, an observatory, salmon hatchery, rowing crew house on the lake, dance studio, state of the art learning commons and library, recording studio, and robotics lab. Our diverse, inter-disciplinary and innovative programming helps shape the next generation of global leaders.

For more information, explore our Shawnigan at a Glance.

Staff endorse our School’s values (Curiosity, Compassion, Community and Courage) and are deeply committed to our mission: Spark Minds, Kindle Hearts, Forge Futures.

Shawnigan Lake School is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and expects all staff (and volunteers) to share this commitment. Candidates will be required to undergo child protection screening appropriate to the post, including checks with previous employers and a vulnerable sector criminal record check.

JOB DESCRIPTION



ASSOCIATE DIRECTOR, NORTH AMERICAN BOARDERS

The Associate Director of North American Boarders guides prospective families through the process of discovering and choosing Shawnigan Lake School. Reporting to the Executive Director of Admissions, this position leads recruitment across Canada and the United States by building genuine relationships, representing the school regionally, and managing the enrolment journey from initial inquiry through to registration.

We offer a competitive compensation package and a nurturing, family-friendly workplace.



Appointment: Permanent appointment. Full-time 1.0 FTE position.


Compensation: $72,000 - $85,000 per year. Starting salary is determined based on the successful candidate’s knowledge, experience, and internal parity.

  • After 3 months of employment, a full benefits package and RRSP with employer-matched contributions, paid vacation, a flexible work environment, and a nurturing family-friendly workplace.
  • Subsidized lunch to enjoy delicious meals provided on campus.
  • Campus Gym and Wellness Centre access

Start Date: Immediate (consideration for a later start date may be given).

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES INCLUDE

  • Strategic Family Engagement: Guide prospective families from inquiry to enrolment through personal communication, tours, interviews, and compassionate decision delivery.
  • Admissions Operations: Process applications, collaborate with the Admissions Committee on decisions, handle re-enrolments, and ensure a smooth handover to department heads.
  • Travel & Events: Represent Shawnigan across North America (20–30% travel) at fairs and athletic events, lead info sessions, and manage special initiatives like the Dream Scholarship.
  • Strategic Market Advising: Analyze regional enrolment data, demographics, and trends to advise leadership on high-potential target markets.
  • Cross-Department Collaboration: Partner with Communications & Marketing, Advancement, the Head's Office, and the Learning Centre to streamline admissions projects and welcome new students.

REQUIREMENTS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Marketing, Business, Education, Humanities, or a related field required (advanced degree preferred).
  • Strong written, verbal, organizational, and interpersonal skills.
  • Experience in admissions administration, preferably in a boarding school environment.
  • Admissions, events, community development, communications and/or marketing experience.
  • Ability to connect with a wide variety of people to build meaningful relationships.
  • Proficient in the use of varied technologies, including familiarity with database management systems and generative AI.
  • Ability to deliver enrolment decisions in a respectful, empathetic manner.
  • Proven attention to detail and ability to set priorities and meet deadlines.
  • Ability to uphold best practices in enrolment management.

NEXT STEPS

To apply, please submit a copy of your resume/CV and cover letter via the "apply for this job" button on this page.


We ask you to please provide references at the shortlist stage of the recruitment process.

Shawnigan Lake School is an equal opportunity employer committed to establishing an inclusive, equitable, and accessible environment for all. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, national origin, age, sex, religion, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status or any other basis protected by applicable law.



We express our appreciation to all applicants for their interest in this position, however only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.



Position closes when filled.

title: Director Engineering - UAS/AAM
description:
Join a company that's reintroducing itself to the aviation community we've helped advance for more than a century. At Honeywell Aerospace (NASDAQ: HONA), we're launching as an independent, publicly traded aerospace and defense company built on a legacy of operational excellence and mission-focused execution.

Our new brand identity pairs that heritage with real momentum, as we build technology that helps pilots navigate with confidence, aircraft operate more efficiently, and operators stay ahead of change. With our systems on board 90% of the world's aircraft, your work here has reach that's rare to find anywhere else.

Focusing on our customers, investing in innovation, and building a culture of accountability and performance is how we're shaping what comes next.

Every horizon. Every mission. Every day.

Honeywell Aerospace products and services are found on aircraft across commercial aviation, defense and space. We operate through three business areas:

Electronic Solutions develops the avionics, navigation systems, sensors and electromagnetic defense technology on board 90% of the world's aircraft

Engines & Power Systems provides the propulsion, auxiliary power and electrical systems that keep those aircraft flying

Control Systems supplies the thermal and motion control systems that support takeoff, landing and the safety of everyone on board

With approximately 58,000 employees worldwide and net sales of $17.4B in 2025, we are also advancing systems for autonomous and supersonic platforms — bringing the same focus on safety and efficiency to the next era of flight. Explore our businesses: https://www.honeywellaerospace.com

We are looking for an exceptional Director of Engineering to lead and develop a talented team of scientists, engineers, and technicians developing the next generation of products and technology for Honeywell Aerospace’s Unmanned Aerial Systems (UAS) and Advanced Air Mobility (AAM) business. You will leverage your technical experience and skills to guide your team to investigate and solve challenging technical problems as you develop and apply to UAS and AAM platforms next-generation avionics, actuation, flight control, environmental control, propulsion, and other technologies and products. You will use your leadership skills to motivate and guide teams that are designing new or modifying existing products, parts, and processes. Through extensive collaboration with customers and broader engineering teams, you will balance team workload and drive exceptional team performance with high impact for the business.

Key Responsibilities

  • Guide, coach, and challenge engineering teams to effectively solve complex engineering problems.
  • Champion team engagement and guide self-directed Agile teams to continuously improve R&D effectiveness and velocity.
  • Accelerate innovation and growth while leading a team of talented, experienced managers, engineers, scientists and technicians
  • Partner with customers, technology strategists, offering managers, and broader engineering teams to guide and prioritize development efforts, ensure availability and development of appropriate resources and skills, and drive business growth.
  • Working with Sales, Program Management, and Portfolio Management, truly understand the “why” of customer business needs, and translate these into concrete development plans. Lead execution of these plans to delight customers, motivate the team, and achieve business objectives.
  • Drive organic and inorganic growth by working closely with Advanced Technology, Strategic Marketing, Honeywell Ventures, and Technical Strategy organizations to identify and champion next growth areas, and then leading technical teams to address these areas.

YOU MUST HAVE

  • Bachelor’s Degree in science, engineering or related technical field, significant experience in engineering or R&D
  • 15+ years overall engineering/R&D experience
  • Demonstrated leadership skills and achievements
  • Due to our government contracts, all applicants must be US Citizens.

WE VALUE

  • Master’s or PhD degree in science, engineering or related technical field
  • Experience with avionics, communications, flight control, actuation, and/or propulsion technologies and markets
  • Experience with safety standards, processes, and personnel
  • Experience with aviation airworthiness certification processes and terminology
  • Technical management experience.
  • Entrepreneurial experience in a fast-paced environment
  • Comfortable developing networks & building relationships
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills
  • Reliable and trustworthy with highest ethical standards
  • Flexible to work across cultures and time zones
  • Significant project or line management experience
  • Significant experience in engineering or related field
  • Understanding of industry standards and security practices
  • Experience in an Agile development environment
  • Ability to lead, motivate, develop and mentor others
  • Experience in the developement and certification of Advanced Air Mobility vehicles

Due to compliance with U.S. export control laws and regulations, candidate must be a U.S. Person, which is defined as, a U.S. citizen, a U.S. permanent resident, or have protected status in the U.S. under asylum or refugee status or have the ability to obtain an export authorization.

BENEFITS

Beyond a performance-driven salary, you'll work alongside dedicated experts on technology that's advancing aviation. As a Honeywell Aerospace employee, you're eligible for a comprehensive benefits package that includes:

  • Employer-subsidized medical, dental, vision and life insurance
  • Short-term and long-term disability coverage
  • 401(k) match, flexible spending accounts and health savings accounts
  • Employee assistance program and educational assistance
  • Parental leave and 12 paid holidays
  • Paid time off for vacation, personal and sick time

Explore your benefits:

POSTING TIMELINE

The application period for the job is estimated to be 40 days from the job posting date; however, this may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates.

title: Detailer (hourly) 540520 (Madison, TN)
description:
Overview

Flat Rate Detail Shop Position(s) Available.

Are you a team player who is focused on providing exemplary customer service and who performs well in a fast paced work environment?

Looking for the following position:

Detail Specialist 1 - Some experience

Detail Specialist 2 - 2 plus years experience

Maintain the facilities of the store to produce high quality service. Ensure customers are serviced at the highest level of satisfaction through quality service/products, courteous employees and quick response to all customer inquiries and/or complaints establishing conclusions in a timely manner. Driving, detailing, and cleaning vehicles.

Teph Seal Auto Appearance, a privately-held company, operates detail/reconditioning centers in auto dealerships across the United States. Our strong team of dedicated professionals is our most powerful asset, allowing us to develop dynamic detail solutions for a wide variety of auto dealerships. Our culture of challenging the status quo makes each employee a key contributor to our success and a vital part of our thriving entrepreneurial-minded company culture.

Responsibilities

The detailer will use their manual dexterity and bodily coordination to perform an array of tasks, including washing the exterior of vehicles using various cleaning solutions, may also wax and buff vehicles using cloths and buffing machines, vacuum interior of automobiles to remove dirt and debris, clean upholstery and surfaces, use air compressors and cloths to dry surfaces and apply preservation chemicals to surfaces for protection against spots and stains. May be required to use different types of dyes, paints and waxes to protect the leather or fabric of vehicles. May also be required to clean and remove grease on engines or engine compartments. Must be flexible and willing able to carry out additional duties as assigned by management due to operational needs.

Working Conditions:

  • This physically demanding position requires frequent movement; i.e. bending, lifting, reaching, squatting, and getting into and out of various vehicles repeatedly during the work shift.
  • May require completion of work outdoors and under varying climate conditions.
  • Will work with and move numerous vehicles during the course of the working day.
  • Use of safe and OSHA approved waxes and cleaners such as, window cleaner, tar remover, tire shine, etc.
  • Frequent and continual flexing of spine, hands, wrists and fingers.
  • Occasional pushing, pulling, lifting, or carrying of up to 50 lbs.
  • Constantly receiving detailed information through oral communication.
  • Clarity of vision and hearing.
  • Ability to distinguish small imperfections in your work, such as, streaks left on windows, smudges on windows or painted surfaces, areas of missed vacuuming, etc.
  • Ability to quality inspect your work as well as that of other team members.
  • Work with a sense of urgency that demonstrates the value we place on our customers' time.

  • Strict adherence to our uniform and grooming standards.

Compensation: FLAT RATE

Qualifications

The ideal candidate will have

  • A valid driver's license and a good driving record.
  • Ability to learn quickly.
  • Ability to work as part of a team.
  • Ability to read and comprehend instructions

  • Desire to treat each customer’s personal vehicle with great care and respect

  • The willingness to come to work on time and stay on task when on the clock

  • The ability to drive both automatic and manual shift vehicles

  • The availability to work Saturday or Sunday and holidays as deemed necessary to meet production needs
  • Commitment to report to work on time and stay on task during shift

Teph Seal is a Drug-Free Workplace. All employment is contingent on successful completion of drug and background screening.

We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits package and all the tools necessary to be successful. Our offerings include: Medical, Dental, Vision Plans, Life Insurance, Paid Time Off and 401(k) Retirement Plan with company match.

We provide a collaborative work place with growth opportunities for career minded individuals.

title: Director, Publications & Medical Information
description:
About Us

Kardigan is a heart health company working to make cardiovascular disease preventable, curable and no longer the leading cause of death in the world.

It is Kardigan’s mission to develop multiple targeted treatments in parallel that bring people with cardiovascular diseases to the cures they deserve.
Led by Tassos Gianakakos, Jay Edelberg, M.D., Ph.D., and Bob McDowell, Ph.D., Kardigan’s co-founders have reunited after leading MyoKardia to discover and develop mavacamten, the first cardiac myosin inhibitor, resulting in an acquisition by Bristol Myers Squibb in 2020.
We have a cutting-edge discovery and translational research platform, a pipeline of late-stage candidates, and an industry-leading team that is driven to improve the lives of patients.
At Kardigan, we are motivated by our values which guide how we work, interact, and achieve our goals. Driven by patients and their families, we are deeply committed to improving the lives of patients and prioritizing their needs above all else. We believe in being authentic—leading with truth to bring out the best in others by creating an environment where every person knows they will be fully accepted. With an eagerness to learn, we encourage the highest levels of curiosity and are open to changing our minds. We are committed to winning as a team with urgency, excellence, and intention, and support each other no matter what role we play or where we sit. Lastly, we strive to enable the impossible because patients are counting on us. We are not afraid to take risks to unlock innovation and advance scientific discoveries.
These values are the foundation of our work, empowering us to make a real difference, every day.

At Kardigan, Medical Affairs serves as the scientific bridge between Research & Development, the external medical community, and future commercial stakeholders. Through evidence generation, scientific communications, and external engagement, we help translate science into meaningful impact for patients and healthcare professionals.

Position Summary

The Director, Publications & Medical Information is a strategic leadership role within Scientific Communications and Medical Affairs responsible for developing and executing integrated evidence dissemination strategies across Kardigan's cardiovascular portfolio.

Reporting to the Senior Director, Scientific Communications, this individual will lead publication strategy, publication governance, scientific narrative execution, medical information operations, and scientific content development to ensure that Kardigan's evidence is communicated effectively, consistently, and compliantly.

The successful candidate will help shape how scientific evidence generated across clinical development, translational research, medical affairs, real-world evidence, and health outcomes research is transformed into impactful publications, congress presentations, medical education, scientific exchange, and medical information resources.

Key Responsibilities

Publications Strategy & Planning

  • Co-lead development and execution of integrated publication strategies across all disease areas and development programs.
  • Drive alignment between publication plans and broader scientific communication objectives.
  • Manage publication agencies and external publication partners.
  • Support publication charters and strategic publication plans that align with clinical development milestones, evidence generation strategies, and Medical Affairs objectives.
  • Identify publication opportunities across clinical, translational, biomarker, real-world evidence, implementation science, and disease-state education initiatives.

Publication Development & Governance

  • Oversee publication development from concept through submission and dissemination.
  • Partner with clinical development, biostatistics, regulatory affairs, safety, legal, and research teams throughout publication development.
  • Lead publication operations infrastructure including future publication tracking systems, publication dashboards, annual planning processes, publication metrics, budget tracking, and governance workflows.
  • Ensure adherence to ICMJE guidelines, GPP standards, authorship policies, Sunshine requirements, and publication-related compliance standards.
  • Establish inspection-ready documentation, SOPs, work instructions, and quality management processes supporting publication and medical information activities.

Scientific Narrative & Data Communications

  • Partner with Medical Directors and Scientific Communications leadership to develop and maintain scientific narratives and communication platforms across disease states.
  • Ensure consistent scientific messaging across publications, congress activities, medical education materials, field medical resources, corporate communications, and investor communications.

Scientific Communications Operations & Excellence

  • Lead operational planning, governance, budget management, vendor oversight, and performance reporting across Scientific Communications activities.
  • Develop and maintain dashboards and KPIs to measure publication execution, medical information performance, scientific content utilization, and dissemination effectiveness.
  • Establish scalable systems, processes, and technologies to support publication management, medical information operations, knowledge management, and launch readiness.
  • Identify opportunities to leverage AI and digital solutions to improve efficiency, content development, and insight generation.

Medical Information Leadership

  • Build and operationalize Kardigan's Medical Information capabilities as the company advances toward commercialization.
  • Lead development and maintenance of:
  • Standard Medical Information response documents
  • Scientific response letters
  • Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
  • Medical Information content repositories
  • Scientific exchange materials
  • Establish and continuously improve inquiry intake, triage, escalation, and response processes.
  • Ensure compliance with pharmacovigilance reporting requirements and adverse event identification procedures.
  • Analyze inquiry trends and generate insights that inform Medical Strategy, Evidence Generation, and Medical Education priorities.

Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Serve as a strategic thought partner to Medical Affairs leadership.
  • Collaborate extensively with Clinical Development, Research, Regulatory Affairs, Field Medical, Patient Advocacy, Commercial Strategy, and External Affairs.
  • Contribute to integrated Medical Strategy Planning and evidence dissemination planning.

Qualifications

Required

  • PhD, PharmD or equivalent advanced scientific degree.
  • Demonstrated leadership in publications strategy and execution.
  • Significant experience managing publication agencies and external vendors.
  • Strong understanding of publication guidelines, publication ethics, and scientific communications best practices.
  • Experience leading cross-functional teams in complex development-stage environments.
  • Exceptional scientific writing, communication, and presentation skills.

Preferred

  • 10+ years of pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or medical communications experience preferred
  • Cardiovascular disease experience
  • Experience supporting launch or pre-launch products
  • Medical Information leadership experience
  • CMPP certification

Exact Compensation may vary based on skills, experience and location.

$200,000—$275,000 USD

description:
We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join the Account Sharing team within Wise’s Consumer Squad. The team is focused on building entirely new products in the shared finances space for consumers — including international joint accounts and kid accounts.

Our mission is to make it easy for families, couples, friends, and flatmates across different countries to manage money together seamlessly through Wise. Unlike most existing solutions that are limited to domestic markets, we are building shared financial experiences that work globally.

This is a highly product-oriented engineering role where you’ll help shape products from the ground up. You’ll work closely with Product Managers, Designers, Data Analysts, and User Researchers to deeply understand customer problems and turn ambiguous ideas into scalable financial products used by millions of customers worldwide.

How we work

For everything we build, we keep our customers at the center of decision-making. We prioritize work based on customer research, behavioral data, and direct feedback, and we iterate quickly based on what we learn.

The Account Sharing team operates as a highly collaborative, cross-functional product team. Engineers are not expected to simply implement tickets — they are expected to contribute to product direction, challenge assumptions, influence technical strategy, and help shape the customer experience.

The environment is greenfield and fast-moving. Requirements evolve quickly, and engineers are encouraged to take ownership, drive discussions, and work closely with stakeholders across engineering, product, design, and research.

At Wise, we believe in autonomous teams where everyone contributes ideas, takes ownership, and helps define priorities together.

Your work will directly shape the future of shared finances at Wise.

You’ll help build products that allow families, couples, flatmates, and friends across different countries to manage money together in ways that existing financial products often cannot support today.

title: Sr Advanced R&D Engr/Scientist
description:
As a Sr Advanced R&D Engineer/Scientist here at Solstice, you will drive innovation, develop cutting-edge technologies, and lead advanced research initiatives to enhance aerospace safety, efficiency, and reliability. You will report directly to our R&D Manager, and you’ll work out of our Morris Plains, NJ location on a hybrid schedule.

At Solstice Advanced Materials, we are committed to offering the highest value-add specialty solutions in the advanced materials sector. Our goal is to solve our customers' most complex challenges through a robust and innovative product portfolio and by doing so, deliver exceptional value to our stakeholders. We have identified actionable strategies to grow by expanding into new products and markets and through strategic acquisitions, while keeping our top operating margins. ​

Joining our team means becoming part of an organization which leverages its long-standing reputation to capture growth trends by investing in innovation and manufacturing enhancements and maintaining deep customer relationships. ​

We foster a collaborative and inclusive work environment that values contributions and supports professional development. With a focus on innovation and sustainability, the team is dedicated to delivering value and making a meaningful impact in advancing our customers' success. Let’s make that impact together.

As a Sr Advanced R& D Engineer/Scientist you will develop and apply statistical, machine learning, and scientific modeling methods to accelerate materials discovery, product development, and manufacturing optimization. The role will partner closely with scientists and engineers to transform experimental and process data into validated models, actionable insights, and scalable R&D capabilities. This position is available in Morris Plains, NJ, or Buffalo, NY.

Key Responsibilities

  • Analyze complex experimental, analytical, and manufacturing datasets using statistical and machine learning methods to identify trends, patterns, and relationships.
  • Develop and validate predictive models to improve material performance, evaluate the effects of key variables, and support product and process development.
  • Partner with chemists, materials scientists, engineers, and business stakeholders to define data needs, develop analytical solutions, and influence decisions.
  • Evaluate and implement state-of-the-art data science methods for advanced materials applications, informed by relevant scientific and technical literature.
  • Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines and databases for experimental and analytical data.
  • Establish data quality practices that ensure reliable, traceable, and reproducible datasets and analyses.
  • Communicate findings, recommendations, and technical limitations through clear visualizations, reports, and presentations for technical and non-technical audiences.

Must Have

  • Master’s or Ph.D. in Data Science, Materials Science, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in data analysis or data science roles within a materials science or engineering domain.
  • Proficiency in programming languages such as Python and familiarity with data manipulation libraries relevant to chemistry and materials (e.g., RDKit).
  • Experience developing physics-informed neural networks, surrogate models, cheminformatics models, or quantitative structure–property relationship models.
  • Strong understanding of statistical modeling, machine learning algorithms, and data visualization techniques.
  • Experience with data visualization tools or packages (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Origin, matplotlib, seaborn) and databases (e.g., SQL, NoSQL).

We Value

  • Deep knowledge of advanced materials, including polymers, nanomaterials, ceramics, metals, small molecules, formulations, or composites.
  • Familiarity with experimental methods in materials characterization and testing.
  • Familiarity with chemical manufacturing processes, process modeling, and process optimization.
  • Excellent problem-solving abilities and critical thinking skills.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, capable of engaging with technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
  • Commitment to continuous learning in data science and materials science.

COMPENSATION

The annual base salary range for this position is $146976k - $183425k. Please note that this salary information serves as a general guideline. Solstice Advanced Materials considers various factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to the scope and responsibilities or the position, the candidate's work experience, education and training, key skills, as well as market and business considerations.

title: Night Auditor
description:
The Opportunity

We are seeking a Night Auditor to be the calm, capable presence at our front desk overnight. They are equally adept at balancing the books, welcoming late-arriving guests, and keeping watch over the hotel while the rest of the property sleeps. In this role, you are responsible for closing out the day's financials, running the night audit process, and serving as the primary guest service contact during overnight hours.

The ideal Night Auditor is independent, detail oriented and unbothered by working while most people are asleep. They move comfortably between precise, methodical audit work and warm guest interactions — checking in a late flight arrival with the same genuine hospitality as a midday agent, then quietly running reports and reconciling accounts once the lobby goes quiet. Trustworthy and alert, they take real ownership of the property overnight.

Key Responsibilities

· Perform the nightly audit, balancing all revenue centers (front desk, cafe, bar)

reconciling daily transactions

· Run and distribute end-of-day reports for hotel leadership

· Process room charges, adjustments, and folio corrections accurately in the PMS

· Complete check-ins, check-outs, and reservations for overnight and early-arrival guests

· Answer phones and respond to guest requests promptly and courteously throughout the overnight shift

· Conduct periodic walk-throughs of the lobby and public areas to monitor safety and security

· Serve as the primary point of contact for guest emergencies or unusual situations overnight, following established protocols

· Prepare the front desk and lobby for the morning shift, including reports, cash drawers, and handoff notes

· Hand off the a.m. housekeeping staff with arrival, departure and stayover reports for morning preparedness

· Monitor and respond to fire/life safety alarms or building systems per hotel procedures

· Restock front desk and lobby supplies and maintain a clean, organized work area

· Communicate clearly with the morning team on outstanding guest requests, discrepancies, or maintenance issues

· Maintain accurate cash handling and complete nightly cash reconciliation

Qualifications

· 1+ year of front desk, night audit, or hotel accounting experience preferred

· Experience with hotel PMS systems (e.g., Mews, Opera or similar) and basic accounting/reconciliation tasks

· Strong attention to detail and comfort working independently with minimal supervision

· Calm, level-headed demeanor and sound judgment when handling unexpected situations overnight

· Basic math and cash-handling accuracy

· Ability to stay alert and focused throughout an overnight shift

· Willingness and ability to work overnight hours consistently, including weekends and holidays

· Passion for hospitality and genuine care for guest safety and comfort, even during the quietest hours

Work Environment

· Overnight, guest-facing role at the front desk with frequent computer, phone, and PMS use

· Periodic walking throughout the lobby and public areas for security and safety checks

· Solo or minimally staffed work environment for extended stretches of the shift

· Occasional lifting of guest luggage or packages up to 25 lbs

Benefits

Additional benefits for full-time employees include:

· Eligible to enroll in Medical, dental, and vision insurance with generous company contribution to monthly premium after 60 days of employment

· Eligible to enroll in Voluntary Long-Term, Short-Term Disability Plans, Life Insurance, Accident and Critical Illness Plans, Pet Insurance after 60 days of employment

· 401(k) retirement plan with employer match after 90 days of employment (Full and Part-TIme Employees may be eligible)

· Annual Paid time off: 10 vacation days, 4 Personal Days

· California-mandated paid sick leave (Full and Part-TIme Employees)

· Ash Hotel & F&B discounts

Physical Requirements

Primarily front-desk based during overnight hours, with periodic walks through public areas and extended periods working independently. Requires consistent overnight availability, including weekends and holidays. Ability to stand, walk, and lift up to 25 lbs as needed.

description:

The C2ISR Division is responsible for a diverse portfolio that provides "cradle-to grave" support for the U-2 aircraft, E-8C Joint Surveillance Target Attack Radar System (JSTARS) aircraft, Air Force Distributed Common Ground System (AF DCGS), the Integrated Broadcast Service (IBS) system and other C2ISR programs as they transition to sustainment. The C2ISR Division provides worldwide life cycle support across the spectrum of the C2ISR capabilities based enterprise; including supply, distribution, materiel management, acquisition, system engineering and maintenance, financial planning and budgeting, security, flight test, and contracting functions. The Global Network Systems (GNS) Branch (AFLCMC/ HBGW), located at Hanscom AFB, MA, is one of the numerous branches within the C2ISR Division and reports directly to the C2ISR/HBG Senior Materiel Leader. EPASS support is required to execute the major GNS programs in support of the C2ISR Division, to include: AF DCGS Network Infrastructure Transformation (NIT), Extended Tether Program (ETP), and Global Command and Control System – Air Force Infrastructure (GCCS-AF (I)).

This is a full-time position located at Hanscom AFB, Bedford, MA.

Responsibilities

The Senior Program Manager will provide acquisition and program management support to Government Program Managers and Integrated Product Teams (IPTs) across the acquisition lifecycle. The position supports program execution activities involving cost, schedule, performance, risk management, acquisition documentation, milestone preparation, contractor coordination, and program reporting in support of Air Force acquisition programs.

title: Senior Architectural Modeler
description:
Senior Architectural Modeler / Data Steward


ABOUT US:

Soliel is an innovative, premium engineering company specializing in providing Enterprise Architecture, Network Design, Engineering, and Operations Support, Software Design and Development, Data Center Design, Deployment and Migration, and Systems Engineering services for both public and private sectors. Our Federal systems integration team manages the complexity inherent with technology change, from requirements planning to architecture, testing to deployment, and beyond. We also offer a complete range of industry-leading services, including architecture, systems development, information assurance, solution and platform integration, and program management, functional, and testing services. Over the years, Soliel's team of technical experts has consistently delivered outstanding innovative solutions and services that meet or exceed customer expectations and satisfaction.


LOCATION: Ft. Eustis / Hybrid

START DATE: ASAP

CLEARANCE: Secret or TS


Soliel is seeking a skilled Senior Architectural Modeler/Data Steward to support a stable, fully funded U.S. Army program. In this role, you will translate Army capability, operational, and system requirements into formal UAF and SysML architecture models and related technical specifications. You will lead Architecture Integration Strategy (IS) sessions with government stakeholders, develop and maintain architecture modeling standards and style guides, and oversee the consistency and quality of architecture data across approved repositories. Working with Army architects, functional data managers, developers, and other stakeholders, you will translate architecture requirements into actionable technical information and guide architecture data products through developer hand-off.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Design, author, and maintain digital UAF and SysML architecture models (OV, SV, AV, BDD, IBD) in Cameo/MagicDraw to bridge CAPDEV and MATDEV requirements.
  • Manage the Army Integrated Architecture Data Standards (IADS) process, including Information Exchange Specifications (IES), data quality, architecture data standards, and lifecycle governance.
  • Lead and facilitate IADS working groups and Integration Strategy (IS) meetings to resolve architecture data issues, establish requirements, build stakeholder consensus, and align program goals.
  • Direct inter-agency coordination with Army Functional Data Managers, the Army CDO, and the Architecture Data Board on architecture requirements and policies.
  • Serve as a liaison by briefing Army leadership on strategic architecture status while translating digital models into technical specifications for developers.

description:
Vil du holde påskeferie og tre ugers sammenhængende sommerferie i ugerne 29, 30 og 31, så er du måske vores kommende kollega?

Har du lyst til at arbejde på specialistniveau på Danmarks landsdækkende epilepsihospital, og være med til at gøre en afgørende forskel for patienterne og deres pårørende, så er det dig vi søger. Afsnit for epilepsi med handicap undersøger og behandler de mest komplekse epilepsipatienter.

Barselsvikariatet er i dagvagt på 37 om ugen, med opstart 1. december 2026, eller efter aftale.

Hvad enten du er nyuddannet eller en erfaren sygeplejerske, så tilbyder vi:

  • Tre ugers sammenhængende sommerferie i ugerne 29, 30 og 31 og påskeferie.
  • Gode fysiske rammer og en normering, så du går hjem med god samvittighed og overskud til familien.
  • Ledelse i øjenhøjde, som får arbejdsliv til at hænge sammen med familie og fritid.
  • Mentorordning og introduktionsprogram.
  • Erfarne og kompetente kollegaer, som vægter faglighed, tværfaglighed og samarbejde meget højt. Vi har fokus på den gode stemning, humor og et godt arbejdsmiljø med en uformel og anerkendende tilgang til hinanden.
  • Stillingen indeholder weekendvagt hver anden weekend.

Du vil blive ansat på Epilepsihospitalet i afsnit for epilepsi med handicap. Vores fantastiske patienter kommer fra hele Danmark, og er fysisk og psykisk udviklingshæmmede voksne patienter med kompleks epilepsi. Vores mål er at favne hele patienten og deres pårørende, som ofte er medindlagte for at øge trygheden for patienterne.

Afsnittet er normeret til 10 patienter, og arbejdsopgaverne er mangeartede og indebærer bl.a. anfalds- og adfærdsobservation, varetagelse af komplekse og grundlæggende sygeplejeopgaver, samt tæt samarbejde med pårørende og bosteder_._

Foruden patientplejen har afdelingens personale ansvaret for at døgnbetjene en central overvågningsfunktion, der er placeret i afdelingen. Derudover er LEAN, patientsikkerhed og kvalitetsarbejdet velintegreret og en naturlig del af de daglige opgaver.

Afsnittet er uddannelsessted for sygeplejestuderende og SSA-elever.

Er din nysgerrighed vakt? Så tilbyder vi dig en super spændende stilling, hvor der er rig mulighed for udvikling og læring i et fagligt meget stærkt team.

Vi forventer, at du:

  • udviser loyalitet, respekt og stabilitet i det daglige fremmøde.
  • er opmærksom på egen rolle og tager medansvar for et godt arbejdsmiljø i afdelingen.
  • er fleksibel, initiativrig, løsningsorienteret og har fokus på effektiv ressourceudnyttelse.

Yderligere information kan du få hos oversygeplejerske Henrik Petterson på tlf. 58 27 11 12. Hvis du ønsker at se afdelingen, giver vi gerne en kop kaffe.

Der kan endvidere henvises til hjemmesiden .

title: £300,000 tc - Data Platform Engineer - Leading Hedge Fund
description:
Direct access to the top of the firm, sensitive data, and the freedom to shape the platform a leading hedge fund runs on.

You'd be joining one of the most data-driven hedge funds in the industry, in a role that is not typical software engineering. You won't be building transaction systems. You'll be extending a small, high-trust data team (seven people) and building the platform that turns raw finance and internal data into insight the whole firm relies on.

Finance experience isn't required. Backgrounds in data infrastructure, backend systems or other data-heavy industries are welcome, and this is a great way into a lucrative sector while working close to the business.

Why this role is different

  • Access. You'll work directly with the top ten people across the firm on a regular basis. In a lean, high-performing fund, that level of exposure is rare.
  • Trust. The team looks after some of the most sensitive data in the organisation, so reliability, governance and security are core to the job.
  • Ownership. With a team of seven, your work shapes how the platform is designed, how data is modelled and served, and how it scales.
  • Freedom. If you spot a better tool or a smarter approach, you can propose it and expect to be heard. Your manager will back you and help you grow.

What you'll do

  • Build and own Python-based data pipelines and platform infrastructure at meaningful scale
  • Orchestrate and transform data across a modern stack that currently includes Snowflake, Starburst, Airflow and dbt, alongside SQL Server, with CubeJS serving the semantic layer
  • Work across a broad range of data, from finance data to internal business data
  • Raise data quality, lineage and accessibility for stakeholders across the firm
  • Explain complex technical work clearly and credibly to senior people

What we're looking for

  • Strong Python, with fluent, hands-on pandas or equivalent library.
  • Solid SQL and experience owning data systems at scale, from ingestion and orchestration through to modelling and serving
  • A clear grasp of what makes pipelines reliable and platforms maintainable, and the ability to explain the trade-offs behind your decisions to non technical stakeholders
  • Experience with modern orchestration and cloud data tooling. The stack is deliberately agnostic, so how you think about the problems matters more than the specific tools
  • Confidence with senior stakeholders, and genuine enthusiasm for the work, including the curiosity to keep learning outside working hours

title: National Organizer
description:
Position: National Organizer

Status:Full Time, exempt

Location:This position can be remote or work out of TLC’s offices in Oakland or Brooklyn

Our compensation model is designed to promote equity and alignment with our values. We actively work to reduce pay disparities across roles and responsibilities. We utilize an equitable compensation framework to determine the salaries for each position, and therefore our salaries are not negotiable.

Note: We’re thrilled by the interest in this role! To help our team manage the volume of applications, we kindly ask that you avoid calling or emailing to check on your status. We’ll be sure to reach out if you’re selected to move forward.

About Transgender Law Center

Transgender Law Center (TLC) is the largest national, trans-led organization working to set all people free. We champion the rights of all transgender and gender-nonconforming people to make their own choices and live freely, safely, and authentically. Prioritizing BIPOC, disabled, and HIV+ communities, we advance community-driven strategies that harness trans knowledge, power, and joy to ensure that we all not only survive but thrive at all ages and phases of life.

You can learn more about our work at .

About the Position

Transgender Law Center's National Organizer will build power with trans communities across the country by developing leadership, strengthening local and state organizing efforts, and advancing campaigns rooted in racial, gender, and HIV justice. We are seeking a skilled and self-motivated organizer to design and facilitate trainings, convenings, and cohorts that use popular education techniques to build political analysis and grow community leadership. This person will identify emerging issues, support base-building, campaign, and narrative change work, and translate research and needs assessments into strategies that resource and amplify local organizing.

Working across a national network of staff, community leaders, and partners, this person must be able to build authentic relationships while navigating the distinct needs and contexts of different regions and communities. This role requires strong communication skills, including facilitation and writing, sound judgment in issue identification and campaign development, and the project management skills to keep multiple trainings, partnerships, and deliverables moving forward. The ideal candidate is a true organizer at heart, with the instincts to build relationships, read a room, and move people toward shared action. They are flexible and adaptable as priorities shift, follow through on commitments, and jump in to support teammates with coverage as emerging issues arise. Most importantly, they have a deep commitment to advancing racial, gender, and HIV justice through the collective power of BIPOC trans and disabled communities.

Key Responsibilities

National Organizing & Campaign Leadership

  • Lead national organizing efforts aligned with TLC's key priorities, including but not limited to serving as an organizer for the Positively Trans+ program
  • Co-coordinate advocacy campaigns and on-the-ground ballot measure support in priority states
  • Work with partners to develop advocacy and narrative change strategies addressing HIV criminalization and anti-trans legislation
  • Identify emerging policy issues and translate them into organizing, campaign, and narrative priorities
  • Contribute to and support campaigns and organizing across TLC’s programmatic work

Partnership & Coalition Building

  • Build and steward relationships with coalition partners, community organizations, and allied movements
  • Coordinate and collaborate with the Positively Trans+ National Advisory Board (NAB)
  • Represent TLC in external meetings, advocacy spaces, and conferences
  • Collaborate with TLC staff to advance shared strategic goals across programs

Trainings, Convenings & Leadership Development

  • Plan and facilitate regional convenings and national training institutes
  • Develop curriculum and training materials grounded in popular education techniques
  • Design and lead cohorts and workshops that build political analysis and community leadership
  • Facilitate key internal and external meetings related to program and campaign work

Program Management & Communications

  • Manage day-to-day program operations, including meetings, trainings, convenings, and participant engagement
  • Support participants through ongoing communication and relationship-building
  • Disseminate research and needs-assessment findings to inform narrative change and education efforts
  • Draft memos to partners, conference abstracts, and other written materials supporting program and campaign work
  • Track project timelines and deliverables to ensure programs run smoothly and on schedule
  • Participate in organization-wide activities and shared responsibilities that support team alignment and culture

Qualifications & Requirements

  • 1-3 years of experience in national organizing work
  • Demonstrated experience in relationship-building and community organizing, including base-building, fostering community leadership, and supporting local and state organizing efforts nationally
  • Experience planning and facilitating trainings, convenings, and cohorts using popular education techniques grounded in political and popular education
  • Experience with campaign development and narrative change work, including issue identification and disseminating research (such as needs assessments) to inform strategy
  • Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple trainings, timelines, and deliverables simultaneously
  • Strong communication skills, including facilitation and writing, with the ability to draft curriculum, partner memos, and conference abstracts
  • Demonstrated commitment to racial, gender, and HIV justice
  • Experience working with transgender migrants, Black trans communities, communities of color, poor, working class, transgender youth and disability communities and transgender and gender nonconforming communities.

Benefits

  • Medical/dental/vision (TLC covers 100% of premiums for employees, 80% for dependents)
  • Employer-funded Health Reimbursement Account (currently $3,500 per year)
  • Employer-funded Lifestyle Spending Account (currently $1,500 per year)
  • Optional employee-funded Flexible Spending Account
  • Employee Assistance Fund that can grant financial assistance for certain qualifying disasters and personal hardships
  • Short-term and long-term disability insurance
  • 3 weeks’ sick leave
  • 19 days’ vacation (24 after 3 years’ employment) and 12 holidays
  • Organizational ‘slowdown’ in winter and summer, including, historically, 2 weeks paid time off in the summer and 2 weeks paid time off at the end of the year (separate from employee vacation time)
  • 2-month paid sabbatical program available after 5 years of employment
  • Retirement plan with partial organizational matching
  • Indemnity insurance for critical illness, hospital confinement, and accidents
  • Professional development & coaching
  • Office setup, phone and internet reimbursement (if working from home)
  • Additional mental health, budgeting, travel, and pet benefits

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

Transgender Law Center is proud to be an affirmative action employer. All interested individuals, including Black, Indigenous, and other people of color; women and femmes; people with disabilities; and people who are transgender, intersex, lesbian, gay, bisexual, or queer are particularly urged to apply. title: Engineer I, Configuration
description:
Engineer I, Configuration Company Overview At Mitsubishi Power, we're not just building better clean energy technologies; we're architecting a better future. Our team is boldly redefining power generation to accelerate the world's energy transition. We operate as one team, pushing toward our vision of the future. We value problem solvers, prioritize collaboration, and support each other in an inclusive culture built on accountability and authenticity by demonstrating our values: Safety, Family, Innovative, Inclusive, Accountable & Courageous. Together, we’re building the future we all aspire to - making net zero a reality.

Role Overview

The “Engineer I, Configuration” (or “Configuration Engineer I”) position is an entry-level engineering role responsible for clarifying, defining, maintaining, consolidating, and optimizing the configurations of “parts” (i.e., components, sub-assemblies, assemblies, and/or kits) of gas turbines (GTs), steam turbines (STs), and related auxiliaries to facilitate the reliable and effective service operations of existing and future power generation facilities. This includes—but is not limited to—continuously developing and maintaining the engineering databases, system interfaces, data exchange architecture, business process coordination, and other systems, processes, and improvements necessary to provide and maintain an effective and comprehensive understanding and knowledge base regarding the expanding fleet of GTs and STs sold and/or serviced by Mitsubishi Power Americas, Inc. (MPW-A).

Additionally, this role is responsible for rapidly responding to and supporting incoming customer requests for the quotation and/or purchase of GT, ST, and/or auxiliary (AUX) parts by clarifying/identifying/assigning their respective MPW-A part numbers, as well as ensuring that each such part has sufficient engineering definition available for Sourcing, suppliers, and manufacturers.

Key Responsibilities
  • Collect, analyze, summarize, and understand business requirements and accordingly develop configuration specifications (including design BoMs, service BoMs, parts catalogs, and quotable/procurable part definitions) to accurately document GT, ST, and AUX configurations at their various lifecycle states, including as-built assembly configurations and ongoing maintenance configurations (e.g., after each outage).
  • Review and recommend changes to configuration management processes, develop process improvements to automate and streamline these processes, and suggest environment modifications to support system needs.
  • Provide technical support for system design, testing, and implementation activities to support ongoing part consolidation efforts within MPW-A. Identify shortcomings and missed information that result in business inefficiencies. Apply the principles from industry best practices and remain current on industry and technical skills in the areas of configuration management.
  • Collect and consolidate corporate baseline of GT, ST, and AUX installations supported by MPW-A. Study the aspects of equipment interchangeability and upgrade planning. Develop process improvements that support both the business and engineering teams in rapid access to accurate and current information regarding installation configurations.
  • Rapidly (typically within hours or days) respond to and support daily incoming transactional/LTSA customer requests for quoting/ordering GT, ST, and/or AUX parts, primarily via part clarification, part definition, and/or part publishing (i.e., from PLM system to ERP system).
  • As needed, remotely (via company-issued smartphone and laptop) provide rapid same-day “on-call” support outside of regular business hours (generally including nights, weekends, and holidays) when assigned in advance to do so via internally-maintained “on-call schedule/rotation” (typically for one continuous week, once every one to two months), in order to urgently support active planned/forced outages at customer sites physically serviced by MPW-A.
  • Support ISO 9001 audits and compliance efforts.
  • Limited overnight travel (typically than 5% annually) by land and/or air, with some trips lasting one or more week(s).
  • Perform other such duties as may be required.
Other Duties and Responsibilities
  • Comply with all safety policies, practices and procedures reporting all unsafe activities to Management and/or Human Resources.
  • Participate in proactive team efforts to achieve departmental and company goals.
  • Actively contribute to building a positive and collaborative team spirit.
  • Communicate effectively and professionally with all levels of employees, as well as external parties.
  • Diligently protect all confidential information by not communicating it, disclosing it to, or using it for the benefit of third parties.
  • Maintain the highest degree of honesty and integrity at all times.
Requirements
  • Education and/or Experience: Bachelor of Science (BS) degree(s) in Mechanical and/or Aerospace Engineering from an accredited college or university. Knowledge, familiarity, and/or direct experience regarding any/all of the following area(s) is strongly preferred: configuration engineering (i.e., configuration management); configuration control (i.e., change management); systems engineering; combined-cycle power plants; gas turbines (preferably heavy-duty); steam turbines (preferably industrial); manufacturing engineering; industrial manufacturing; fabrication/machining; engineering drawings (particularly 2D, including hand-drawn), specifications, procedures, CAD (2D and/or 3D), bills of material (BoMs), parts lists, and/or work instructions; materials science and engineering; Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) software (particularly PTC Windchill); Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems (particularly SAP ERP); and/or Customer Relationship Management (CRM) software (particularly Microsoft Dynamics 365).
  • Language Skills: Strong proficiency/fluency in all of the following English language skills are required: ability to verbally and digitally (via typing/text/etc.) communicate effectively with coworkers, management/leadership, and other members of the organization; ability to accurately read/hear, interpret, and comprehend instructions, short correspondence, memos, reports, engineering drawings/specifications, and other technical documentation in a timely manner; ability to write professional business correspondence (including, but not limited to: e-mails; reports; meeting minutes; work instructions; and formal engineering dispositions); and ability to effectively present information (including highly technical content) in one-on-one and group situations to other employees of the organization. Though not required, additional proficiency/fluency in Japanese language skills (particularly a working knowledge of technical/engineering Japanese vocabulary, especially regarding manufacturing and/or the power-generation industry) is highly desirable.
  • Mathematical Skills: Ability to perform necessary calculations to satisfy job requirements (typically not exceeding the scope of college-level precalculus and statistics courses).
  • Reasoning Ability: Ability to accurately adhere to provided instructions and expectations, as well as (when appropriate) make judgment decisions based on specifications, technical requirements, and other applicable resources/guidelines.
  • Computer Skills: To perform this job successfully, an individual should have knowledge of (and familiarity/competence with) all of the following: Internet-browsing software; spreadsheet software; word-processing software; e-mail software; instant-messaging software; PDF-editing software; presentation software; file-sharing software; data-visualization software; PLM software; ERP software; CRM software; and Project Portfolio Management (PPM) software. Particularly, experience with any/all of the following software is highly desirable: Microsoft Windows; Microsoft Edge; Google Chrome; Microsoft Excel (especially advanced proficiency with in-built formulas/functionality, VBA, macros, and/or dealing with very large/complex/interconnected/multiuser workbooks and spreadsheets); Microsoft Word; Microsoft Outlook; Microsoft Teams; Microsoft PowerPoint; Microsoft Visio; Microsoft Power BI; Microsoft OneNote; Microsoft Lists; Microsoft OneDrive; Microsoft SharePoint; Microsoft Copilot; Adobe Acrobat; Citrix Workspace; PTC Windchill (and/or Windchill+); SAP ERP; Microsoft Dynamics 365; Oracle Primavera P6 Professional; PTC Creo Parametric (and/or Creo View); Autodesk AutoCAD; PTC Arbortext (and/or ISODraw); and/or HxGN SDx.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS & WORK ENVIRONMENT

The physical demands and work environment characteristics described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Regularly required to walk, stand, sit, type, talk, and hear. Occasionally required to lift and/or move up to 10 pounds. The noise level in the work environment is usually quiet. The employee may occasionally travel to, and/or work within, certain area(s) requiring their adherence to MPW-A (and, if applicable, customer) safety procedures including, but not limited to, the use of personal protective equipment (e.g., hard hat, safety glasses, goggles, hearing protection, fall protection, steel-toe work boots, etc.). MPW-A supports 24/7/365 service operations for internal and external customers with a mission of providing reliable and excellent customer service, as needed; all employees shall adhere to this mission.

Why Should You Apply?
  • Excellent Benefits (Medical, Dental, Vision & 401K Matching).

  • Paid vacation, sick time, and holidays.

title: Face Deduplication Collection
description:
The objective of this project is to collect a large and diverse dataset of current neutral selfies, head-pose captures, and historical facial images to support machine-learning research and facial recognition model training at TELUS.

Tasks

The focus is on capturing real-world variation across lighting, poses, expressions, accessories, environments, and aging to improve model accuracy and robustness. The collection includes:

Requirements

• Current Neutral Selfies – clean frontal selfies serving as high-quality identity references, with natural variation in appearance and surroundings.

• Current Head-Pose Captures – selfies captured in assigned head directions to introduce pose variation.

• Historical Images – older photos from participants’ galleries to capture natural aging and long-term appearance changes.

Bredsten er en by på lidt over 1900 indbyggere, hvor der i nyere tid begynder at komme et kæmpe ryk på det lokale sammenhold. Det mærker vi også i Brugsen, da det betyder at vi starter nye og spændende samarbejder op på tværs af hele byen

Vi er i øjeblikket på en rejse der handler om lokal forankring, og et stærk kundemøde / indkøbsoplevelse, hvor der er mange nye ting der skal ske i butikken, derfor vil der også være mange store muligheder for at lære og udvikle sig sammen med jobbet.

Butikken har også et tankanlæg og ladestander, som gør indkøbsoplevelsen lettere for kunden.

Bliv en del af den lokale købmand

Som Souschef i Brugsen er du uddelerens sparingspartner, og du er med i alle de driftsmæssige beslutninger i butikken. Du får dermed erfaring med alle ledelsesmæssige opgaver, hvilket betyder at du:

  • har medansvar for den praktiske ledelse i butikken
  • tager medejerskab og forpligter dig professionelt og engageret i forhold til at nå de givne budget- og omsætningsmål
  • udvikler butikken og præger sortimentet

Størstedelen af din tid bruger du blandt medarbejdere og kunder i butikken. Det er vigtigt, at du lærer vores kunder at kende, så vi kan tilbyde et sortiment, der imødekommer deres behov. Her er der i vid udstrækning frie rammer til at udøve ægte købmandsskab og være med til at påvirke sortimentet samt bringe lokale varer ind.

Vær med til at udvikle lokalsamfundet

Som byens lokale købmand er du en aktiv spiller i lokalsamfundet. Sammen med uddeleren er du med til at skabe aktiviteter i byen og lader butikken danne ramme for f.eks. fastelavnsfest, sociale arrangementer, efterårsfester mm.

Købmand til fingerspidserne

  • Du er uddannet som f.eks salgsassistent
  • Du har mindst 3 års praktisk butikserfaring fra detailhandlen
  • Du har god forståelse for tal og regnskaber

Som person er du først og fremmest udadvendt og du kan lide at tale med mennesker. Som leder har du gennemslagskraft og kan sikre resultater. Du er initiativrig og tænker ud ad boksen, således at vi sikrer kunderne en inspirerende butik. Slutteligt går du forrest og viser engagement, som afspejler sig i medarbejdernes motivation.

Vil du vide mere om stillingen?

Du er velkommen til at kigge forbi butikken til en snak.

Send din ansøgning via "Ansøg nu" senest den 30. september 2026

Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende.

I Brugsen er vi tættere på kunderne

I Brugsen arbejder vi ud fra vores DNA, som er kvalitet, ansvarlighed og fællesskab. Det betyder at vi tager ansvar for vores beslutninger, arbejder sammen på tværs for at skabe de bedste resultater, og vi tror på at kvalitet opstår, når vi deler viden, løfter i flok og tager et fælles ansvar.

Brugsen er den lokale købmand og et vigtigt aktiv I de byer, vi er repræsenteret. Vi nyder fordelene af at være en del af en kæde samtidig med, at vi kan drive butikkerne med fokus på lokale Initiativer, lokale varer, osv. Vi er en vigtig brik i byens liv – vi både støtter og tager initiativ til lokale arrangementer, som giver et twist i det daglige arbejde. Vi er desuden mindre butikker med et rigtig godt sammenhold, hvor hver medarbejder får meget ansvar, og vi hjælper hinanden med alle opgaver.

Bliver du ansat i Brugsen bliver du en del af Coop-familien. Vi er omkring 40.000 medarbejdere og sammen med brugsforeningerne har vi en samlet omsætning på mere end 40 milliarder kr. i vores ca. 900 butikker over hele Danmark. Derfor er der mange muligheder for både nye opgaver og uddannelse og ikke mindst jobskifte internt i Coop. Vi er ejet af vores 2 million medlemmer og det andelsejede Energiselskab OK.

Vi værdsætter mangfoldighed og søger kvalificerede kandidater uanset baggrund. Sammen skaber vi plads til forskellighed, faglighed og kvalitet. Derfor sikrer vi en retfærdig rekrutteringsproces, hvor det er op til dig, om du vil vedhæfte ansøgning og billede.

Teph Seal is a Drug-Free Workplace. All employment is contingent on successful completion of drug and background screening.

In over 37 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to over 65,000 staff across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of more than 950 laboratories in over 1,000 companies across 59 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products.

In 2024, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR 6.95 billion; and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years.

Principal Software Engineer – Java

Eurofins IT Solutions, Bengaluru, Karnataka, India

With facilities in Europe, the United States, and Asia, Eurofins Genomics is an internationally leading provider of DNA sequencing services, genotyping services, DNA synthesis products, and bioinformatics services for pharmaceutical, diagnostics, food, agriculture, biotechnology, and research markets.

The Genomics business is powered by global engineering teams building and evolving next-generation applications, Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS), customer portals, and enterprise platforms. As a Principal Software Engineer – Java, you will play a critical hands-on role in designing, developing, and modernizing these platforms, ensuring they are scalable, performant, and reliable.

This role requires deep Java expertise, strong design and problem-solving skills, and the ability to influence engineering direction through code, architecture contributions, and technical mentoring. You will work closely with engineering, architecture, DevOps, QA, and product teams to deliver high-quality solutions aligned with business and technology goals.

This role reports to a Project Manager / Senior Manager.

Primary Responsibilities

Own and drive hands-on design and development of complex, enterprise-scale Java applications.
Lead technical direction for modules or subsystems while remaining actively involved in implementation.
Support modernization initiatives, including migration from legacy or monolithic systems to modern architectures.
Act as a technical mentor and role model for engineers across teams.
Ensure solutions meet performance, scalability, security, and maintainability expectations.
Collaborate closely with product, QA, DevOps, and architecture teams to deliver end-to-end solutions.

Specific Assignments:

Software Engineering & Development

  • Design, develop, and maintain backend and full-stack features using Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, and relational databases.
  • Support modernization of legacy Java applications to modern, cloud-ready architectures.
  • Build modular services and support microservices-based designs where applicable.
  • Design and integrate RESTful APIs, backend services, and data models.
  • Support UI teams building Angular or React frontends by providing robust backend APIs.
  • Implement high-performance data processing and integration logic for analytical workflows.

Design

  • Apply object-oriented design principles and design patterns (SOLID, OOP, layered / hexagonal architecture).
  • Contribute to application and solution architecture discussions.
  • Perform technical trade-off analysis and guide design decisions.
  • Ensure clean, extensible, and maintainable codebases.

Quality, Performance & Reliability

  • Ensure high code quality through unit testing, mocking frameworks, and static code analysis.
  • Perform performance profiling, memory analysis, and JVM tuning to resolve bottlenecks.
  • Support performance tuning and stability improvements in production environments.
  • Work closely with QA teams to ensure strong test coverage and release quality.

Collaboration & Agile Delivery

  • Work within Agile / Scrum teams, contributing to sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives.
  • Support end-to-end product development, including development, deployment, and maintenance.
  • Collaborate with global teams and stakeholders across regions.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentoring to engineers.

Skills Required

Core Technical Skills

Strong hands-on experience with:

  • Java (8+)
  • Spring / Spring Boot
  • RESTful API design
  • SQL
  • Angular
  • React
  • Mongo DB
  • Eclipse RCP
  • AKS, etc
  • Experience with software design patterns, layered architectures, and performance optimization.
  • Proficiency in object-oriented design and clean coding practices.
  • Strong experience with unit testing and mocking frameworks (JUnit, Mockito, etc.).
  • Good hands-on knowledge of performance profiling and memory analysis.

Additional Technical Skills

  • Experience with microservices architecture, service communication, and integration patterns.
  • Working knowledge of Hibernate / JPA and transaction management.
  • Exposure to event-driven or message-based systems is a plus.
  • Exposure to Azure cloud-native development is an advantage.
  • Integration - Experience with API-based, file-based, and message-based integrations (e.g., Azure Service Bus or similar).
  • Domain Exposure - Experience with shipping/logistics workflows or scientific data processing (e.g., Genomics, laboratory systems) is a plus.
  • DevOps - Familiarity with Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, and cloud platforms.
  • Understanding of build and dependency management tools such as Maven or Gradle.

Preferred Qualifications

  • MCA or Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent.
  • 7+ years of hands-on experience in Java-based software development on global or enterprise projects.
  • Proven experience in product development environments.
  • Strong understanding of the Product Development Lifecycle and Lean Agile / Scrum methodologies.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Strong learning mindset and continuous improvement orientation.

Methodologies & Practices

  • The following practices are expected to be actively followed:
  • Scaled Agile, Lean, Kanban, and Zero-Defect Development
  • Daily stand-ups and close collaboration with development teams
  • Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment (CI/CD)
  • Automated builds, deployments, and testing
  • Automated unit and functional testing
  • Adherence to development guidelines and coding standards
  • SonarQube-based static code analysis

Tech Stack

  • Backend: Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs
  • Databases: SQL Server, MongoDB

title: Engineering Technician – Facilities & Maintenance
description:
Engineering Technician – Facilities & Maintenance

Reports To: Engineering Manager

VPI Compounding Pharmacy is looking for a hands-on Engineering Technician – Facilities & Maintenance to support the equipment, utilities, and facility systems that keep our pharmacy operations running safely and efficiently.

This position is a great fit for someone who enjoys troubleshooting, preventative maintenance, working with mechanical systems, and solving day-to-day facility and equipment issues. You will work closely with our Engineering team in a unique pharmaceutical environment while gaining experience with cleanrooms, specialized equipment, preventative maintenance programs, and regulated facility operations.


Key Responsibilities

Equipment & Preventative Maintenance

  • Perform preventative maintenance and basic repairs on facility and pharmacy support equipment.
  • Troubleshoot common mechanical, equipment, and facility issues and help minimize operational downtime.
  • Support maintenance of equipment such as refrigerators, freezers, pumps, autoclaves, BSCs, LAFWs, and other systems as trained.
  • Assist with developing and maintaining preventative maintenance schedules.
  • Identify recurring equipment or facility issues and communicate repair or replacement needs.

Facility & Utility Support

  • Perform general facility repairs involving plumbing, electrical fixtures, doors, drywall, flooring, and other building systems.
  • Monitor HVAC equipment and complete basic preventative maintenance such as filter changes and routine inspections.
  • Support water, drainage, temperature, pressure, and other facility utility systems.

Vendor & Engineering Support

  • Assist with cleanroom, HVAC, equipment, and facility projects as assigned.
  • Help track maintenance requests, completed work, recurring issues, and vendor follow-up.
  • Maintain accurate maintenance records and documentation.

Safety & Compliance

  • Complete maintenance activities safely and in accordance with company procedures.
  • Follow applicable cGMP, cleanroom, safety, and facility requirements.
  • Assist with routine checks of facility safety equipment and emergency systems.
  • Maintain clean and organized work areas and properly document completed maintenance.


Qualifications

  • High School Diploma or GED required.
  • Strong mechanical aptitude and ability to troubleshoot common equipment and facility issues.
  • Experience with preventative maintenance programs preferred.
  • Experience in pharmaceutical, healthcare, laboratory, manufacturing, food production, or another regulated environment is a plus, but not required.
  • Experience with HVAC, plumbing, basic electrical work, pumps, motors, utilities, or similar systems preferred.
  • Comfortable using spreadsheets, maintenance logs, or CMMS systems.
  • Strong organization, communication, problem-solving, and follow-through.
  • Willingness to learn specialized pharmacy and cleanroom equipment.

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to lift up to 50 lbs.
  • Ability to climb ladders and perform bending, reaching, kneeling, and other physical maintenance activities.
  • Ability to stand and walk for extended periods.
  • Ability and willingness to gown and work within cleanroom environments when needed.


Benefits

VPI Compounding offers a competitive benefits package for eligible employees, including:

  • Company-paid health, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401(k) plan with employer match
  • 6 paid company holidays per year
  • 32 hours of paid floating holiday time per year, separate from PTO

title: Senior Scientist I, Pipeline Technology Enablement
description:
AbbVie is at the forefront of cancer research, discovering and developing the next generation of treatments to address unmet medical need for cancer patients. Our robust pipeline includes both small molecule and biologic therapies, featuring first-in-class agents that target multiple pathways critical to the survival and growth of solid and hematological malignancies.

We are seeking a highly motivated Senior Scientist I at AbbVie’s Lake County, Illinois location to join our growing cancer research organization. The scientist will join a team focused on discovering and validating novel cancer targets, driving discovery programs, and leading laboratory-based initiatives. They will propose, develop, and optimize innovative methods, act as the lead in their area of expertise, and critically assess scientific and regulatory developments to integrate into research and development efforts.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and implement novel functional genomics and cell-based high-throughput technologies (pooled and arrayed).
  • Develop and optimize high-throughput, reproducible NGS workflows for the sensitive deconvolution and quantification of pooled cellular assays.
  • Lead and conduct scientific research of early-stage discovery programs.
  • Resolve key project hurdles with available information from literature and internal experts.
  • Possess excellent skills in scientific writing for internal reports, external presentations, and publications in peer-reviewed journals.
  • Analyze, integrate, and interpret large-scale, high-dimensional datasets to drive strategic research decisions.
  • May mentor/supervise scientists and evaluate their performance.

Experience must be in cell/molecular biology, oncogenic pathways, cell death signaling, and/or translational research in Oncology.

  • Experience generating and troubleshooting pooled cell line NGS assays (e.g., 384-well format)
  • Experience in building workflows with external CROs.
  • Hands-on experience with CRISPR/Cas9 gene editing using RNPs (and other equivalent approaches) to generate edited clonal cell lines and cell pools, including gene knockouts, knock-ins, point mutations, and fluorescent tagging.
  • Experience implementing high-throughput pooled cell line assays and perturbations to generate expansive, information-rich datasets.
  • Experience preparing large-scale sample sets for NGS using automated robotic workstations, gel electrophoresis, and amplicon PCR, along with Python-based analysis of gene editing outcomes.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage and mentor junior scientists in technical lab skills, data organization, work efficiency, and scheduling.
  • Ability to work collaboratively across diverse disciplinary environments.
  • Strong written and oral communication skills are essential.

title: Principal Software Engineer (Java Full stack)
description:

Software Engineering & Development

Design
