  • Contribute to application and solution architecture discussions.
  • Perform technical trade-off analysis and guide design decisions.
  • Ensure clean, extensible, and maintainable codebases.

Quality, Performance & Reliability

  • Ensure high code quality through unit testing, mocking frameworks, and static code analysis.
  • Perform performance profiling, memory analysis, and JVM tuning to resolve bottlenecks.
  • Support performance tuning and stability improvements in production environments.
  • Work closely with QA teams to ensure strong test coverage and release quality.

Collaboration & Agile Delivery

  • Work within Agile / Scrum teams, contributing to sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives.
  • Support end-to-end product development, including development, deployment, and maintenance.
  • Collaborate with global teams and stakeholders across regions.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentoring to engineers.

Skills Required

Core Technical Skills

Strong hands-on experience with:
Java (8+), Spring / Spring Boot, RESTful API design, Eclipse, Angular or React, Mongo DB, AKS, etc

  • Experience with software design patterns, layered architectures, and performance optimization.
  • Proficiency in object-oriented design and clean coding practices.
  • Strong experience with unit testing and mocking frameworks (JUnit, Mockito, etc.).
  • Good hands-on knowledge of performance profiling and memory analysis.

Additional Technical Skills

  • Experience with microservices architecture, service communication, and integration patterns.
  • Working knowledge of Hibernate / JPA and transaction management.
  • Exposure to event-driven or message-based systems is a plus.
  • Exposure to Azure cloud-native development is an advantage.
  • Exposure in Eclipse RCP is an advantage.
  • Integration - Experience with API-based, file-based, and message-based integrations (e.g., Azure Service Bus or similar).
  • Domain Exposure - Experience with shipping/logistics workflows or scientific data processing (e.g., Genomics, laboratory systems) is a plus.
  • DevOps - Familiarity with Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, and cloud platforms.
  • Understanding of build and dependency management tools such as Maven or Gradle.

Preferred Qualifications

  • MCA or Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent.
  • 8+ years of hands-on experience in Java-based software development on global or enterprise projects.
  • Proven experience in product development environments.
  • Strong understanding of the Product Development Lifecycle and Lean Agile / Scrum methodologies.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Strong learning mindset and continuous improvement orientation.

Methodologies & Practices

  • The following practices are expected to be actively followed:
  • Scaled Agile, Lean, Kanban, and Zero-Defect Development
  • Daily stand-ups and close collaboration with development teams
  • Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment (CI/CD)
  • Automated builds, deployments, and testing
  • Automated unit and functional testing
  • Adherence to development guidelines and coding standards
  • SonarQube-based static code analysis

Tech Stack

  • Frontend : Angular, React
  • Backend: Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs
  • Databases: SQL Server, MongoDB
  • Integration: REST, messaging, file-based integrations
  • DevOps & Cloud : Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Azure
  • Quality & Code Analysis: JUnit, Mockito, SonarQube

title: Archivist
description:
Job Summary:

The Schlesinger Library ethically collects and stewards archival, published, and digital materials documenting the histories of women and gender-diverse people in the United States. We make these collections accessible to scholars, students, educators, and the public through our reading room, classroom, gallery, and online platforms, advancing our commitment to building a more inclusive historical record. Our collections span equal rights and social justice, women’s health and reproductive lives, gender and sexuality, Radcliffe College, culinary history, and family papers. The Technical Services department plays a central role in the Library’s mission by enabling the discovery, use and management of archival, published, and born-digital collections through accessioning, processing, arrangement and description, metadata creation, and collection management.

We seek an Archivist who is passionate about archival processing and its crucial role in fostering discovery and accessibility; who is committed to equitable representation and inclusive description; and who brings an interest in and facility with both analog and born-digital materials. Reporting to the Lead Processing Archivist, they will work as part of an inclusive team, participating in and contributing to the evolution of a program of thoughtful, flexible, user-centered archival and born-digital processing. The Archivist processes diverse archival collections, arranging and describing materials according to national standards and best practices; highlighting materials for researchers; and providing widespread public access to collections. This is an opportunity for a critical thinker to join an experienced team of archivists and catalogers who are working collectively to evaluate and improve our practices while reaffirming our existing strengths.

Job-Specific Responsibilities:

  • Appraises, arranges, describes, preserves, and catalogs archival collections in both analog and digital formats. This includes evaluating their research value, creating a processing plan, and ensuring projects are completed in a timely fashion.

  • Determines appropriate levels of arrangement and description, using a range of innovative and user-centered approaches to ensure flexible and efficient processing.

  • Creates DACS-compliant archival descriptions, including catalog records and finding aids, following national standards and Schlesinger Library procedures, and applying best practices for inclusive and reparative description.

  • May undertake additional activities such as photograph cataloging, web archiving, metadata remediation for digitization, outreach and instruction, and exhibit work.

  • Covers regular shifts at the Schlesinger Library reference desk.

  • May supervise student assistants and interns, including hiring, training, planning and assigning work, assessing performance, addressing performance issues, and resolving problems.

  • Monitors current developments, trends, and best practices in the archival profession.

  • Fosters collaborative relationships within the department, Schlesinger Library, Radcliffe, and across Harvard Library as appropriate. May represent the department in various collaborative projects and programs within the greater Harvard Library system and beyond.

Working Conditions:

Work conditions involve a climate-controlled, indoor environment with specific temperature and humidity levels to preserve materials. The archivist may encounter dust and mold, necessitating the use of personal protective equipment like masks and gloves. Limited natural light is typical in the workspace, and frequent use of computers and other digital tools is required.

Physical Requirements:

The demands described below are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations will be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • The physical demands of this position include lifting and carrying boxes up to 40 pounds, managing cartloads of material weighing up to 240 pounds, frequent standing, walking, climbing ladders, and bending to retrieve or reshelve collections.
  • Frequent standing, walking, climbing ladders, and bending to retrieve or reshelve collections.
  • Manual dexterity is required to handle delicate archival materials carefully.
  • Prolonged periods of examining documents under magnification and repetitive data entry tasks are also common.

Basic Qualifications:

  • ALA-accredited MLS (Master’s in Library Science) with a concentration in archives management, or an MA in history or a related field.
  • Two or more years of experience processing archival materials in various formats.

Successful candidates will demonstrate:

  • Knowledge of national data content and structure standards related to archival control of collection materials (e.g., DACS, EAD, MARC, LCSH, AAT).
  • Knowledge of archival and library management systems, and proficiency with computer technology (e.g. word processing, spreadsheets, databases, XML).
  • Proven experience processing born digital collections and materials.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work productively both independently and collaboratively in a collegial, team-based environment.
  • Flexibility, innovation, and user focus in their approaches to archival processing.
  • Familiarity with or interest in current approaches and best practices in inclusive and reparative archival description.

Additional Qualifications and Skills:

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, along with critical thinking and listening abilities.
  • Commitment to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace, with the ability to work effectively with a diverse faculty, staff, and student population.
  • Proficiency in one or more foreign languages, particularly Spanish or Chinese preferred.
  • Interest in contemporary U.S. women’s history.
  • Standard Hours/Schedule: 35 hours per week
  • Visa Sponsorship Information: Harvard University is unable to provide visa sponsorship for this position
  • Pre-Employment Screening: Identity, Education, Employment
  • Other Information:

    This description is intended to provide a clear, accurate, yet concise statement of the primary work elements, and to organize the information in a standardized format. It is not intended to describe all the essential responsibilities and duties for this position, nor should it serve as the sole criteria for personnel decisions and actions. This description is neither an employment agreement nor an expressed or implied employment contract, and the Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study may modify it at any time.

    #LI-SS2

title: Enterprise Applications Administrator
description:
Enterprise Applications Administrator

At Mitsubishi Power, we’re not just building better clean energy technologies; we’re architecting a better future. Our team is boldly redefining power generation to accelerate the world’s energy transition. We operate as one team, pushing toward our vision of the future. We value problem solvers, prioritize collaboration, and support each other in an inclusive culture built on accountability and authenticity by demonstrating our values: Safety, Family, Innovative, Inclusive, Accountable, and Courageous. Together, we’re building the future we all aspire to, making net zero a reality.

Role Overview

The Enterprise Applications Administrator is responsible for the administration, configuration, support, and overall health of enterprise platforms and services, ensuring secure, reliable performance and a strong user experience across Microsoft 365, Azure, Adobe AEM, and other enterprise tools. This role requires strong technical expertise, excellent problem-solving skills, and a proactive approach to system ownership and management.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Oversee the administration of Microsoft 365 and Azure environments, ensuring all configurations and settings are optimized for security and performance
  • Manage user roles, permissions, and access controls to maintain a secure and compliant environment
  • Perform Azure administration tasks related to assigning roles, monitoring, app registrations, and security configurations

description:
Module Lead – Java

Eurofins IT Solutions, Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India

Job Description

As a Module Lead, you will play a key role within the eLIMS-Forensics programme,

Eurofins Forensic Services, operating in UK, Netherlands, France, Germany and Belgium, sits at the core of European criminal justice systems, acting as the trusted scientific partner to police forces and courts, and providing critical evidence that enables fair and accurate outcomes in serious criminal investigations.
For software engineers, this is a rare opportunity to build systems where code directly impacts real-world justice—supporting DNA analysis, Forensic Case Management, and forensic workflows that can identify suspects and strengthen legal decision-making.

The UK forensic ecosystem remains one of the most advanced globally, combining cutting-edge science, strict regulatory standards, and continuous innovation; advances in data science, AI, and trace analysis are actively transforming how evidence is detected, interpreted, and used in investigations.
As part of the acquisition of Qualitype, Eurofins’ internal model already emphasises the integration of software development, quality engineering, and forensic domain expertise, giving engineers direct exposure to highly specialized scientific applications rarely found in traditional tech roles.

A compelling real-world example is the re‑analysis of cold cases using modern DNA techniques—some decades old—which have led to successful convictions years later, demonstrating how advances in forensic technology can fundamentally change investigative outcomes and deliver long-overdue justice.
In short, a role at Eurofins Forensics offers a unique combination of technical challenge, societal impact, and domain depth—where engineers are not just building software, but enabling a system that underpins public safety and the pursuit of truth.

description:
About this job

Stuvex werft aan!

Jouw verantwoordelijkheden

Bij Stuvex beschermen we werknemers en industriële installaties tegen stofexplosies.

In de procesindustrie zijn dit geen uitzonderingen, maar reële risico’s. Wij ontwerpen, bouwen en onderhouden systemen die incidenten voorkomen of de impact ervan beperken– van detectie en preventie tot actieve beveiliging en isolatie.

Onze oplossingen worden toegepast in sectoren zoals voeding, chemie, pharma, houtindustrie, enerie en afvalverwerking. We werken end-to-end: van engineering en productontwikkeling tot installatie, commissioning en onderhoud.

Met een team van ongeveer 50 mensen en vestigingen in meerdere Europese landen maken we sinds 2025 deel uit van de STIF Group. We groeien, en dat brengt ons op het moment waar we meer structuur nodig hebben in onze technische processen.

Functieomschrijving:

Stuvex groeit sterk en we hebben nood aan heldere, consistente technische documentatie. Daarom zoeken we een creatieve Technical Writer met oog voor detail, zin voor structuur en passie voor duidelijke communicatie van complexe materie.

Je vervult een rol waar structuur, taal en techniek samenkomen — tegelijk organisatorisch én inhoudelijk. Je bouwt het kader uit waarbinnen onze technische communicatie groeit, en je levert zelf de documenten die daar het verschil maken.

Concreet ben je verantwoordelijk voor volgend takenpakket:

Je brengt orde in de technische documentatie

  • Je zet een logische documentatiestructuur op (database, mappen, naamgeving, versies)
  • Je definieert standaarden voor manuals, datasheets en technische documenten
  • Je zorgt dat iedereen met dezelfde, correcte versie werkt

Je bewaakt inhoud en consistentie

  • Je bewaakt wat er in de documentatie komt – en hoe
  • Engineers en product development leveren input; Jij maakt er een werkbaar, consistent geheel van en vertaalt zo complexe technische input naar heldere, bruikbaare documentatie
  • Je zorgt ervoor dat technische info correct volledig en eenduidig is
  • Je stelt standaarden vast voor technische communicatie

Je bouwt mee aan schaalbaarheid

  • Je legt de basis voor herbruikbare content (templates, standaardteksten, structuur)
  • Je maakt het mogelijk om later sneller te groeien in Dynamics Nav teksten, white papers, website content en technische sales ondersteuning

Wie zoeken we:

  • Bachelor opleiding Marketing of Communicatie
  • Technische affiniteit en ervaring met technische documentatie in een industriële context
  • Ervaring met documentatietools

Jij bent:

  • Vlot in taal, sterk in structuur: je kan documentatiestructuur opzetten, je schrijft helder en consistent
  • Nieuwsgierig naar techniek en anlystisch sterk: je hoeft geen ingenieur te zijn, maar je wil begrijpen hoe een systeem werkt vooraleer je het beschrijft
  • Een bruggenbouwer: je werkt vlot samen met engineering, sales en service en weet vlot de juiste informatie bij de juiste afdeling te verkrijgen
  • Flexibel: Je voelt je thuis in een KMO waar nog niet alles vastlig

title: Laboratory Technician I
description:
Elemental - 3rd shift (midnight - 8:30am) Tue - Sat or Sun - Thur

  • Understand and follow Quality System documents relevant to responsibilities, e.g., Quality Manual, SOPs, and Methods.
  • Adhere to appropriate quality measures to meet or exceed the standards set by ISO/IEC 17025, government regulatory (cGMP, GLP), and company requirements relevant to assigned duties.
  • Adhere to all health, safety, and environmental regulations relative to assigned analytical work; maintain and assist others in maintaining a clean, safe work environment.
  • Demonstrate proficiency in at least one core method and ability to conduct at least one other assigned method with no more than 25% supervision.
  • Demonstrate ability to operate all required basic lab equipment within department.
  • Set up batches of samples to weigh and weigh samples.
  • Perform timely and accurate analysis of samples to meet customer commitments, including but not limited to, preparing samples for analysis, using appropriate analysis methods and techniques, and applying appropriate data reduction.
  • Maintain a neat and accurate record system; keep accurate records of work performed on a daily basis and as needed for quality control tests or regulatory purposes; record test data and results for samples in logbook, record book or BookMaster and enter the data or results into eLIMS either manually or through automatic export. in a timely and accurate manner.
  • Identify from samples assayed the need for rechecks.
  • Maintain clean glassware and prepare solutions for use in the daily testing of assigned samples.
  • Identify method/matrix/analytical difficulties and report these together with proposed solutions to Department Leader or supervisor.
  • Ensure that proprietary methodologies are not disclosed to non-employees except as approved in writing by the Laboratory Manager or appointed designate.
  • Maintain a perpetual state of readiness and willingness to respond to the queries and needs of clients, staff, and co-workers.
  • Remain current on technical, industry, and business advancements and trends as suggested by the Department Leader or supervisor.
  • Recommend more accurate or efficient laboratory equipment or procedures.
  • Maintain cooperative working relationships with all company employees. Communicate orally and in writing to co-workers. This includes “intra” and “inter” departmental employees.
  • Promote the company image through the exercising of sound and ethical business practices as related to the public and our customers.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned.
  • Excellent interpersonal, organizational, and analytical skills.
  • Excellent communication skills.
  • Responsive, independent problem solver and action oriented
  • Bachelor or Associate degree or with 1+ years experience

Candidates currently living within a commutable distance of Des Moines, IA are encouraged to apply.

What we offer:

  • Excellent full time benefits including comprehensive medical coverage, dental, and vision options
  • Life and disability insurance
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Paid vacation and holidays

title: Project Manager - Substations
description:
We are seeking an experienced EPC Project Manager to join the Construction Strategy Team, delivering critical equipment investments across major UK electricity transmission programmes.

You will take ownership of multiple projects covering the procurement, manufacture, delivery and handover of high-value, long-lead equipment. Working with the Senior Project Manager, engineering specialists, original equipment manufacturers and key stakeholders, you will guide projects from development and sanction through tendering, delivery, testing, commissioning and close-out.

The role directly supports the timely supply of essential equipment for the transmission investment portfolio for T3 and beyond. It offers broad exposure across commercial management, global supply chains, manufacturing assurance, logistics, project governance and regulated infrastructure delivery.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead a portfolio of equipment procurement and delivery projects through pre-construction, sanction, execution and close-out in line with the Network Development Process.

• Manage project performance across scope, programme, cost, quality, risk, budget and governance.

• Act as NEC Project Manager, or equivalent, maintaining contractual compliance and effective delivery assurance.

• Support contracting strategy, tendering and the development of clear, robust Works Information.

  • project assessment.

  • Provide regular project status reports giving accurate financial forecasting, SHESQ performance, milestone progress & risk management data

  • Act as/support the NEC Project Manager (or equivalent for other contract types).

  • Drive customer and stakeholder satisfaction through positive engagement working pro-actively to avoid issues. Supported by a matrix organisation manage third party issues, land, consents, grantors, public relations, and local community stakeholder relationships to preserve the clients reputation.

  • Where relevant, effectively lead, manage and co-ordinate the preparation & submission of a compliant Development Consent Order (DCO) application.

  • Coordinate equipment allocation across projects to improve delivery certainty, optimise portfolio use and minimise storage requirements.

  • Manage OEM contractors, logistics providers and global supply-chain requirements.

  • Oversee contractor delivery, site compliance, factory acceptance testing and manufacturing assurance.

  • Build trusted stakeholder relationships and provide clear reporting, forecasting and performance updates.

  • Ensure compliance with CDM, SHESQ, safety, environmental, regulatory and organisational requirements.

  • Own project documentation, testing, commissioning, asset handover and close-out activities.

  • Mentor junior colleagues and maintain relevant professional authorisation standards.

Essential Experience and Knowledge

• Strong project management experience in energy, utilities, infrastructure, engineering, construction, manufacturing or another complex delivery environment.

• Demonstrable responsibility for scope, schedule, cost, risk, quality and delivery performance.

• Experience leading cross-functional teams and managing contractors, suppliers and multidisciplinary stakeholders.

• Sound commercial, contract-management and project-governance capability.

• Experience of financial forecasting, budget management, reporting and performance management.

• Clear communication, negotiation, decision-making and problem-solving skills.

• A customer-focused approach with a commitment to continuous improvement.

• Understanding of relevant safety and environmental legislation.

• A relevant degree, professional qualification or equivalent practical experience.

• A full UK driving licence and flexibility to travel to project and supplier locations.

Desirable Experience and Knowledge

• Experience working with NEC3 or NEC4 contracts, ideally as Project Manager or in a contract-management role.

• Knowledge of electricity transmission, substations, high-voltage equipment or power-system infrastructure.

• Experience procuring or delivering long-lead equipment such as transformers, switchgear, reactors, cables or associated electrical assets.

• Familiarity with EPC, OEM or direct equipment-purchase delivery models.

• Experience of factory acceptance testing, manufacturing assurance, international logistics or global supply chains.

• Knowledge of RIIO, regulated utilities or major UK infrastructure investment programmes.

• Relevant professional membership or recognised project management accreditation.

Role Features

Work Location & Pattern : Hybrid (3:2) from a clients office in Sheffield.

Equality, Diversity & Inclusion

We at EGIS are an Equal Opportunities employer and we recognise the value of a Diverse Organisation. EGIS appreciates all job applications. If you decide to apply for an opportunity at EGIS, your application will be assessed based purely on your experience, the essential and desirable criteria, and your suitability for the role. We value each and everyone’s contribution as this builds our culture and means, if you work for EGIS, you will be included, listened to, and respected.

title: Senior Software Engineer I - Risk Control & Governance
description:
Job Description

We're looking for an experienced Senior Product Engineer to join the Risk & Control Governance team / Risk Assessment Group. You'll be instrumental in building the governance, assurance, and data foundations that ensure every risk decision at Wise is consistent, explainable, auditable, and continuously monitored.

This role works at the intersection of the Risk API platform, Product, and Financial Crime (FinCrime) teams — offering a unique opportunity to build the systems that give Wise confidence in every risk assessment it operates at scale.

You will be the driving force behind the platform's trustworthiness and integrity, focusing on:

  • Data Governance: Building and maintaining data ownership, lineage, and quality monitoring systems that ensure every risk decision is powered by trusted data.

  • Control Assurance: Designing continuous monitoring and validation systems that verify controls perform as intended — including trigger validation, drift detection, coverage analysis, and control health scoring.

  • Auditability & Explainability: Implementing end-to-end audit trails, change history tracking, and explainability tooling that enables one-click regulatory evidence generation.

  • Scalable Solutions: Designing robust, high-throughput solutions that handle large volumes of data and can be quickly understood and scaled across multiple distinct risk domains.

What will you be working on?

You will join the team at a pivotal moment, with your contributions being immediately visible and critical to the success of the entire Risk Assessment platform's governance layer.

The core challenge for the team — and your immediate focus — is to build the assurance and governance foundations that the platform currently lacks, ensuring every control can answer: Was the right trigger used? Was the right data available? Was the right decision made? Is the control still effective?

Your immediate impact will be to:

  • Build Data Trust: Implement data quality monitoring, data contracts, and lineage tracking that give the organisation full traceability from risk decisions back to source data.

  • Deliver Continuous Assurance: Design and build automated monitoring systems that continuously validate control effectiveness — detecting drift, false positives/negatives, and coverage gaps before they become incidents.

  • Enable Auditability: Create audit trail infrastructure and explainability tooling that dramatically reduces the effort required for regulatory reporting and compliance evidence generation.

  • Integrate with Risk API: Work closely with the Risk API team to embed governance and assurance capabilities into the core platform, ensuring clean integration points and shared data contracts.

Qualifications

What do you need?

  • Strong Backend Engineering: Proven experience building high-throughput, data-intensive systems in Java. Hands-on expertise with Kafka, SQL and NoSQL databases, and designing for scale and reliability.

  • Data Engineering Aptitude: Experience with data quality frameworks, pipeline orchestration, or lineage tracking. You understand what it takes to make data trustworthy at scale.

  • Systems Thinking: Ability to reason about complex distributed systems, identify failure modes, and design solutions that are both robust and operationally simple.

  • Ownership & Autonomy: Comfortable operating with ambiguity, defining your own work from high-level objectives, and driving delivery end-to-end without close direction.

  • Collaborative Mindset: Ability to work effectively across team boundaries — particularly with the Risk API team, Product, and FinCrime stakeholders — to align on contracts, data models, and integration patterns.

Additional information

We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.
Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.

title: Digital Advisory Senior Consultant
description:
As a Senior Consultant in Netcompany’s Digital Transformation Advisory team you will operate at the forefront of client engagement to shape, define and mobilise digital transformation initiatives.

This is a role spanning business consulting, presales and early-stage delivery. You will:

  • Engage clients at a business challenge level, not just technical solutioning
  • Translate complex organisational challenges into actionable transformation opportunities
  • Support the development of strategic opportunities and downstream delivery
  • Support discovery and problem-shaping engagements

You will play a critical role in connecting client needs to Netcompany’s broader capabilities, including platforms, data, AI and digital services.

Key responsibilities

  • Client Engagement: Work directly with client stakeholders to identify, analyze, and prioritize business challenges and opportunities. Facilitate workshops, interviews and analysis to build a shared understanding of current state and future ambition
  • Discovery & Analysis: Support early-stage discovery engagements, helping clients articulate problems, opportunities and transformation priorities to ensure technology initiatives align with business objectives and deliver sustainable outcomes
  • Solution Shaping: Translate business requirements into transformation strategies that balance business value, user needs, and technical feasibility
  • Transformation planning: Support the development of business cases, roadmaps, and implementation strategies
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Work alongside delivery teams, architects, and subject matter experts to ensure seamless transition from advisory to execution
  • Thought Leadership: Contribute to thought leadership and share best practices within the advisory and broader organization

  • Experience in consulting or advisory roles focused on digital transformation, strategy or business change
  • Demonstrated ability to work across both presales and delivery contexts
  • Experience shaping early-stage opportunities, business cases or transformation roadmaps
  • Experience in one of the following areas advantageous but not essential: Transport and Logistics, Defence Manufacturing

Skills & Capabilities

  • Problem Solving & Structuring: Strong ability to frame ambiguous problems and structure them into actionable components
  • Communication & Storytelling: Ability to translate complex ideas into clear, compelling narratives, confident facilitating workshops and presenting to senior stakeholders
  • Collaboration: Strong relationship-building skills across clients and internal teams, comfortable

Benefits:

  • Hybrid working model with some flexible working
  • 25 days’ holiday
  • Private Medical Health care via Vitality
  • Pension contribution, Life Assurance
  • Professional certifications supported as part of learning and development.
  • A range of retail discounts to enhance your lifestyle, encompassing restaurants, supermarkets, travel, leisure activities and health and well-being services.
  • Access to our Employee Resource Groups, our groups represent diverse backgrounds and provide a platform for colleagues to connect, learn, and support one another.

Join Netcompany, where we proudly hold the 5th position on the esteemed UK Top 50 Best Places to Work in the Glassdoor Employees’ Choice Awards for 2024.

At Netcompany, we pride ourselves on our entrepreneurial spirit and our capacity for doing things differently. Our culture is built on fostering low bureaucracy, emphasizing high agility and promoting flexibility, enabling everyone to contribute their best.

Our journey began in the UK with the acquisition of Hunter Macdonald in 2017. As one of Northern Europe's most accomplished IT companies, we have expanded our headcount globally to 7400+ employees and have offices in UK, Denmark, Norway, Poland, Holland and Vietnam.

title: Senior Software Engineer

Docusign brings agreements to life. Over 1.5 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Using Docusign’s Intelligent Agreement Management platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the #1 company in e-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).

The Customer Admin team builds and operates complex solutions for global business challenges that cross cultures, legal jurisdictions, and impact millions of people. You will work in a focused scrum team obsessed with creating elegant, yet simple user-interaction for complex workflows that delight customers.   • Experience with either C#, Java, C++, NodeJS or another backend programming language

  • Experience working the full stack in one or more of object-oriented programming languages like C# and Java

  • Experience working with Designers and Usability Researchers

  • Experience developing software solutions using object-oriented methodologies and design patterns

  • Experience working in an agile development environment

  • Experience with Git, continuous integration and deployment tools

Preferred

  • Passion for UI with a good sense of usability and design

  • Experience with consuming and building RESTful web-services, React, Typescript, GraphQL and Node.js

  • Experience working with cross-browser behaviors and quirks

  • Ability to learn and curious about new technologies and tool sets

Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal.

title: Mechanical Simulation Engineer
description:
As a Mechanical Simulation Engineer, you will join an international team of experts developing leading edge mechanical technologies and solutions for the industry’s most demanding HDD products. As part of a cross functional team, you will be working within a broad collection of engineering disciplines all focused on delivering exceptional products.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Simulation of complex HDD servo-mechanical systems using various finite element analysis methods, including statics, dynamics, electromagnetics, vibro-acoustic and computational fluid dynamics.
  • Perform correlation experiments to validate simulation results.
  • Partner with mechanical and servo design engineers to optimized designs and recommend novel solutions to achieve demanding product requirements.

Working with internal manufacturing teams, perform various analysis to ensure robust, high volume manufacturing tooling and processes.

This role is part of WD's early career development program. WD's early career development program is ideal for individuals at the early stages of their professional career. Participants receive foundational training through structured onboarding, mentorship, and a curated development curriculum. The responsibilities of this role are typically aligned with candidates who have approximately 0–2+ years of relevant professional experience, though candidates of all experience levels are encouraged to apply.

Required:

  • Currently pursuing or recently completed an MS or Ph.D. in Mechanical Engineering
  • Minimum of 3.0 GPA
  • Demonstrated analysis skills through industrial experience and/or academic projects.
  • Proficient using mechanical analysis & design tools (e.g. ANSYS, Hyperworks, Matlab, SolidWorks).
  • Fundamental knowledge of dynamics and vibration control, testing & associated data analysis.
  • Hands-on laboratory experience using Laser Doppler Vibrometers, Fourier analyzers, oscilloscopes, etc.

Preferred:

  • Working knowledge of machine learning a plus.
  • Ideal candidate will have strong academic credentials combined with relevant work experience performing finite element analysis of complex structures and systems.

Skills:

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills

title: Lead Product Security
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Lead Product Security based in Canada.

This is a senior technical leadership role responsible for embedding security throughout the product development lifecycle.
You will shape secure architecture, design reviews, threat modeling, and secure-by-default standards across product engineering.
The role combines hands-on security expertise with developer enablement, mentoring, and organizational security maturity.
You will work across application security tooling, secure code review, product supply chain security, and vulnerability response.
A key focus is scaling security capabilities through Security Champions, training, reusable guidance, and measurable improvement programs.
You will collaborate closely with engineering, security operations, PSIRT, and other stakeholders on high-impact security initiatives.
The position offers broad autonomy and the opportunity to influence how secure software is designed, built, assessed, and maintained.

Accountabilities:

  • Lead security architecture and design reviews across core product lines, providing actionable guidance before implementation begins.
  • Contribute to and scale threat modeling practices by coaching engineers to conduct their own models and reviewing results.
  • Define security requirements, design gates, product security baselines, and standards that establish a practical definition of secure-by-default.
  • Build and measure secure development lifecycle practices across SCA, SAST, DAST, secret scanning, dependency management, and build pipeline integrity.
  • Conduct deep secure code reviews in high-risk areas such as authentication, authorization, cryptography, secrets management, and input validation.
  • Strengthen product supply chain and release security, including SBOM generation and the integrity of build and distribution artifacts.
  • Develop and expand the Security Champions program through recruitment, training, enablement content, office hours, and outcome tracking.
  • Mentor engineers and security professionals on secure design, threat modeling, and secure code review to scale security expertise across teams.
  • Coordinate penetration tests and third-party security assessments, triaging findings and driving remediation through completion.
  • Partner with PSIRT on product vulnerability triage, remediation, and coordinated response, using root-cause insights to improve engineering and SDLC controls.
  • Assess product security maturity using frameworks such as BSIMM or SAMM and drive a prioritized improvement roadmap.
  • Support secure-by-design regulatory requirements, including the EU Cyber Resilience Act, through technical evidence and process improvements.
  • Provide subject matter expertise for customer security questionnaires, audits, RFPs, and security escalations, while building reusable, vetted response documentation.
  • Support incident response involving product code, build systems, or product infrastructure with product-specific security expertise and remediation guidance.
  • Lead discrete technical workstreams, track milestones, and contribute to application security tooling evaluations and proof-of-concepts.

    • Requirements

    • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience.
    • 8+ years of experience in product security, application security, or software security engineering, with strong hands-on experience in secure design reviews, threat modeling, and secure code review.
    • Experience building or operating a Security Champions program, developer security training initiative, or comparable security enablement program.
    • Strong knowledge of application security tooling, including SCA, SAST, DAST, and secret scanning, along with an understanding of their detection capabilities and limitations.
    • Practical secure coding and code review experience in at least one commercial software programming language, with the ability to assess unfamiliar code.
    • Experience defining security requirements, standards, or design gates that have been adopted by engineering teams.
    • Familiarity with AWS, Azure, or GCP from a product security perspective, including container and infrastructure-as-code security.
    • Experience coordinating penetration tests or third-party assessments and driving identified issues through remediation.
    • Demonstrated ability to mentor engineers and lead technical initiatives without relying on formal management authority.
    • Awareness of AI and LLM security risks, including prompt injection, sensitive data exposure, and the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications.
    • Practical experience using AI and LLM tools to accelerate security work, with sound judgment around validating AI-generated outputs before they are acted upon or shared.
    • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical security concepts to engineering, security, and non-technical stakeholders.
    • Experience with PSIRT or equivalent product vulnerability response processes, including CVSS scoring and coordinated disclosure, is a plus.
    • Familiarity with BSIMM, SAMM, secure-by-design practices, or EU Cyber Resilience Act requirements is a plus.
    • Certifications such as CSSLP, CISSP, GWAPT, OSWE, or relevant cloud security certifications are a plus.
    • Experience supporting customer security questionnaires, RFPs, or third-party risk assessments is a plus.
    • Comfortable working extensively at a computer and participating in occasional phone-based communication, with the ability to lift or move items up to 20 pounds when required.
    • Willingness to travel occasionally as needed.

      • Benefits

      • CAD $117,000–$150,000 salary range.
      • Remote position based in Canada.
      • Opportunity to influence product security strategy and secure software development practices at scale.
      • Broad technical ownership with significant autonomy and cross-functional exposure.
      • Opportunities to mentor engineers and develop security capabilities across product teams.
      • Exposure to modern application security, cloud security, AI/LLM security, software supply chain security, and vulnerability management.
      • Potential opportunities to contribute to regulatory readiness and security maturity initiatives.
      • Occasional travel opportunities as required by the role.

description:

Candidates may live in the following cities:

  • Los Angeles, CA
  • Dallas, TX

Purpose Statement:

The Associate Director, Oncology Field Reimbursement leads a regional team of Field Reimbursement Managers (FRMs) providing compliant access, reimbursement, and affordability support across the oncology portfolio. This leader is accountable for building, hiring, onboarding, coaching, and developing a high-performing FRM team that can execute across today’s portfolio while scaling for future launch needs. The role translates portfolio access strategy into disciplined field execution and partners cross-functionally with Patient Services, Market Access, Sales, Brand, Training, Analytics, Operations, Legal, Regulatory, Compliance, hub, and vendor partners.

Responsibilities

  • Lead, coach, develop, and manage a regional Oncology FRM team.
  • Build, hire, and onboard a portfolio-ready team with clear role expectations, territory readiness, development plans, and a culture of accountability, teamwork, compliance, customer focus, and high performance.
  • Set and reinforce expectations for field execution, customer engagement, account prioritization, business planning, performance management, and compliant use of approved resources.
  • Coach FRMs through field travel, ride-alongs, team meetings, business reviews, and individualized development plans.
  • Ensure FRMs educate appropriate HCP office staff and account stakeholders on coverage, coding, billing, reimbursement, benefit verification, prior authorization, appeals, payer requirements, product acquisition, specialty pharmacy/distribution, and affordability support.
  • Translate oncology portfolio strategy, franchise priorities, payer dynamics, patient support objectives, and multiple myeloma launch readiness into regional execution plans.
  • Partner cross-functionally to define training, tools, workflows, dashboards, account education priorities, and feedback loops for portfolio and launch readiness.
  • Monitor team activity, capacity, account coverage, quality, compliance, and performance through analytics, reporting tools, field insights, and business reviews.
  • Engage key oncology and hematology accounts, when appropriate, to understand access barriers and support resolution of complex reimbursement or affordability challenges.
  • Capture and escalate field insights related to payer policies, coverage barriers, prior authorization trends, site-of-care issues, coding/billing challenges, specialty distribution dynamics, customer education needs, and portfolio or launch risks.

  • Ensure all activities comply with AbbVie policies, applicable laws and regulations, compliance requirements, and approved materials and processes.

  • Launch, indication expansion, territory buildout, or organizational scaling experience strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated understanding of coverage, coding, billing, reimbursement, benefit verification, prior authorization, appeals, claims submission, payer policy, affordability support, and patient support program operations.
  • Ability to lead through ambiguity, build team capability, manage change, and deliver results in a matrixed, regulated environment.

Skills and Abilities

  • Strong people leadership, coaching, talent development, and performance management skills.
  • Ability to build and scale teams during growth, change, portfolio expansion, or launch readiness.
  • Strong understanding of oncology access and reimbursement dynamics, including payer policy, coding, claims submission, prior authorization and appeals, product acquisition, specialty pharmacy/distribution, and white-bagging.
  • Ability to translate portfolio and launch strategy into clear field execution priorities and measurable action plans.
  • Strong business planning, account prioritization, analytical, problem-solving, communication, presentation, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills.

title: Portfolio Director, Harvard Institutes for Higher Education
description:
As integral members of the HGSE Professional Education team Portfolio Directors join a dynamic group of colleagues focused on empowering educators to build competencies, skills, and networks necessary to have positive impact in the field of education. Directors build, lead, and cultivate a portion of Professional Education program offerings. All programs are designed to support our mission of equipping education leaders, practitioners, and advocates with knowledge and skills to improve student access, opportunity, and success.

The Portfolio Director for the Harvard Institutes of Higher Education (HIHE) is responsible for designing and implementing a strategy to nurture, assess, refine and expand a portfolio of professional development offerings for higher education professionals, faculty, and leaders across the US and globally. Programs may be delivered in a variety of modalities including on-campus, at client sites in the US and overseas, online live with facilitation, asynchronous online programs, and on-demand models. The HIHE Director leads and manages this portfolio in close collaboration with PPE leadership, HGSE and Harvard faculty, and key institutional stakeholders.

Position Description

Portfolio Development and Management

  • Serve as an administrative leader of a portfolio of executive education programs and related professional development opportunities as part of HGSE’s Professional Education program designed to support educational leaders across the US and globally.
  • Build and maintain a deep understanding of the broad landscape of professional development programs serving higher education leaders and proactively cultivate robust relationships with lead organizations, colleges, universities, and individuals to stay abreast of trends in the field.
  • Work with HGSE faculty to explore new HIHE programs that best serve the needs of the field as informed by data and active discourse with sector leaders and key PPE client organizations.
  • In collaboration with the Senior Portfolio Director, research, propose and vet ideas regarding a strategic direction for the overall size and shape of the portfolio with attention to portfolio coherence as well as program quality, relevance, accessibility, and sustainability.
  • Collect, analyze, and utilize data to inform and implement PPE decisions about program frequency, updates, and retirements.

Program Design and Delivery

  • Collaborate with faculty on overarching program vision and architecture. Work with faculty chairs and the Marketing team to develop program learning objectives and descriptions, and to determine the characteristics of target audiences. Collaborate with and work in support of faculty chairs to determine program presenters and learning activities. Identify, train, and manage program facilitators.
  • With support from the Finance team, develop and manage program budgets, contributing to cost-effective program management.
  • Inform, monitor, and participate in marketing and admissions processes for assigned programs to develop optimal cohorts, identify growth opportunities, and suggest mitigation strategies for enrollment challenges in partnership with PPE’s Marketing and Client Engagement teams.
  • Work closely with the PPE Program Delivery Team to collaboratively plan and execute all aspects of program delivery to ensure a high-quality learner experience in every program modality (residential, live online, asynchronous online, blended).
  • Collaborate with PPE’s Innovation and Insights Team to conduct program debriefs. Identify and drive follow-up on strengths and areas for development. Leverage best-practices in learning design to foster interactivity and the application of learning to problems of practice.

Strategic Outreach and Internal/External Relationship Management

  • Plan and implement strategic outreach to organizations, colleges, universities, government agencies, and/or donors to build robust participant pools for programs in the portfolio.
  • Conduct sector outreach (webinars, conferences, direct relationship-building with clients), engagement, and program alumni relations activities, ensuring that prospective and past participants have ongoing connection to each other, HIHE, and HGSE.
  • Initiate and steward relationships with internal and external stakeholders and expand our network to advance potential new partnerships and programs.
  • Develop custom engagements for learners and organizations within and outside the U.S. as applicable, with a particular focus on international universities.
  • Identify subject areas where HGSE and Harvard faculty bring unique value to the field.

Other duties as assigned

Basic Qualifications:

  • Advanced degree in a relevant field;
  • 5 years of college or university administrative or other directly related experience.
  • Night and weekend hours required during peak periods.
  • Some travel required.
  • Any candidate wishing to be considered must supply a cover letter in addition to their resume.

Additional Qualifications and Skills:

  • Prior leadership experience in higher education strongly desired. A strong candidate has a deep understanding of and experience with the challenges, opportunities, and leadership context of higher education administrators and faculty, preferably from multiple institutions.
  • Demonstrated experience collaborating successfully with senior faculty is highly desirable.
  • Excellent organizational skills and ability to manage competing deadlines or priorities.
  • Strong oral and written communication skills.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and experience developing partnerships to achieve strategic goals.
  • Experience working as both a team player and leader across departments.
  • Proven ability to prepare, work within, and manage budgets and deadlines.
  • Experience in B2B business development a plus.
  • Proven ability to problem-solve and respond effectively to shifting team needs.
  • Experience developing and delivering professional/executive education programs with a leadership or education focus a plus.
  • Standard Hours/Schedule: 35 hours per week
  • Compensation Range/Rate (including Shift Differential if applicable): $90,000 - 100,000 commensurate with experience
  • Visa Sponsorship Information: Harvard University is unable to provide visa sponsorship for this position
  • Pre-Employment Screening: Identity and Education

Work Format Details

This position has been determined by school or unit leaders that some of the duties and responsibilities can be effectively performed at a non-Harvard location. The work schedule and location will be set by the department at its discretion and based upon operational needs. When not working at a Harvard or Harvard-designated location, employees in hybrid positions must work in a Harvard registered state in compliance with the University’s Policy on Employment Outside of Massachusetts. Additional details will be discussed during the interview process. Certain visa types and funding sources may limit work location. Individuals must meet work location sponsorship requirements prior to employment.

This position is salary grade level 058. Please visit Harvard's Salary Ranges to view the corresponding salary range and related information.

Benefits

Harvard offers a comprehensive benefits package that is designed to support a healthy work-life balance and your physical, mental and financial wellbeing. Because here, you are what matters. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

  • Generous paid time off including parental leave
  • Medical, dental, and vision health insurance coverage starting on day one
  • Retirement plans with university contributions
  • Wellbeing and mental health resources
  • Support for families and caregivers
  • Professional development opportunities including tuition assistance and reimbursement
  • Commuter benefits, discounts and campus perks

Learn more about these and additional benefits on our Benefits & Wellbeing Page.

Samtidig arbejder vi i et stadigt mere reguleret marked, hvor governance, transparens og compliance er afgørende for vores succes. Du bliver en del af et stærkt trading-team, hvor du kombinerer deltagelse i vagtordningen og den daglige handel og optimering med opgaver inden for compliance (inkl. opfølgning), regulatoriske krav, intern governance og kommerciel forståelse.

Velkommen til Bioenergy
Du bliver del af Day Ahead Trading, hvor du sammen med dine kolleger får en vigtig rolle i vores daglige handel med el samt i arbejdet med at sikre, at vores handelsaktiviteter lever op til gældende regler, processer og compliancekrav. Ved løbende at følge op på vores compliancehåndtering, analysere processer og understøtte efterlevelsen af regulatoriske krav får du mulighed for at gøre en reel forskel i krydsfeltet mellem forretning og compliance.

I vores team arbejder vi sammen om vores fælles mål i en hverdag, hvor videndeling, sparring og hjælpsomhed er en naturlig del af kulturen. Vi tager ansvar for både egne og fælles leverancer og lykkes bedst i flok.

I jobbet vil du:

  • deltage i handel med el på europæiske markeder som en del af teamets vagtordning – bemærk venligst vagtordningen omfatter ligeledes weekendvagter og telefon
  • bidrage til optimering af værdien af virksomhedens produktion
  • understøtte efterlevelsen af relevante markedsregler og compliancekrav
  • koordinere og følge op på interne processer, kontroller og governance-aktiviteter
  • bidrage til dialog med interne interessenter inden for Legal og Compliance
  • deltage i projektopgaver relateret til regulatoriske ændringer, procesforbedringer og implementering af nye krav.

For at få succes i denne rolle forventer vi, at du:

  • er en holdspiller, der samtidig arbejder selvstændigt og tager ansvar for egne opgaver
  • har en struktureret og detaljeorienteret tilgang til dit arbejde og er god til at kommunikere og samarbejde på tværs af faglige områder
  • kan bevare overblikket i et miljø præget af højt tempo og skiftende prioriteringer
  • har interesse for/eller erfaring med compliance, regulering og/eller governance
  • har en relevant uddannelsesmæssig baggrund inden for økonomi, finans, jura, statskundskab eller tilsvarende
  • har lyst til at lære nyt samt udvikle både forretningsmæssige og regulatoriske kompetencer.

**Send din ansøgning og CV til os så hurtigt som muligt.

**For denne stilling er det forventede grundlønsniveau kr. 45.360,- - kr. 68.040,- for lokationen i jobannoncen. title: Senior Associate Restructuring & Insolvency
description:
The Role

Our Amsterdam Restructuring & Insolvency team is Band 1 in the Dutch market and part of one of the strongest international restructuring practices in the world. We act for lenders, borrowers, sponsors, investors and companies on out-of-court restructurings, liability management exercises, rescue and new money financings, WHOA plans and their interaction with foreign schemes, security and enforcement questions, distressed M&A and insolvency scenarios.

Most of our matters cross borders. You will work closely with colleagues across our global firm, including in London, Frankfurt, Paris, Luxembourg, Madrid and New York. You will also collaborate with our Banking & Finance, Corporate, Real Estate, Tax and Litigation & Dispute Resolution teams.

The focus of this role is advisory and transactional. You will help shape the strategy, structure and negotiations that move a restructuring forward. When a matter becomes contentious, you will work alongside our Litigation & Dispute Resolution colleagues.

What you will do

  • Advise financial institutions, companies, sponsors and investors on complex, cross-border restructurings, from the first signs of distress through to implementation.
  • Structure and negotiate amend-and-extend transactions, rescue and new money financings, liability management exercises, security packages and enforcement scenarios.
  • Advise on WHOA plans and their interaction with foreign restructuring schemes and insolvency proceedings.
  • Assess insolvency, security and property law risks in novel situations, then turn your analysis into clear advice that clients can act on.
  • Work closely with colleagues across practices and offices to deliver joined-up advice.
  • Build trusted client relationships and develop your profile in the Dutch restructuring market.

What you bring

  • At least 6 years’ experience as a Dutch-qualified lawyer in banking & finance, predominantly in private practice. Have 4 to 5 years and the right transactional background? We would like to hear from you as well.
  • Solid finance transaction experience, and the ambition to specialize in restructuring and take on a broader advisory role.
  • A genuine interest in insolvency law and goederenrecht, with the ambition to develop deeper knowledge in both areas.
  • A strong academic background and first-class drafting skills.
  • At ease in an international team: you enjoy cross-border work, complex fact patterns and clients who expect judgement rather than analysis alone.
  • Fluent in Dutch and English, with highly developed analytical and project management skills.
  • A collaborative, solution-focused approach.

What we offer

  • A seat in a Band 1 restructuring practice, on the mandates that set the tone in the Dutch and European market.
  • The chance to convert your finance transaction experience into a genuine restructuring specialization, with partners who will invest in getting you there.
  • Direct client contact and meaningful responsibility from the start.
  • An international practice in the fullest sense: shared mandates, secondments and development opportunities across our global firm.
  • An ambitious, informal and collegial team where your contribution is visible.

Interested? Submit your CV and cover letter to apply. For further questions, contact Gabriella Khohonggiem (Talent Acquisition Manager) at gabriella.khohonggiem@cliffordchance.com or +31 6 28 33 01 95.

description:
Module Lead – Java

Eurofins IT Solutions, Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India

Job Description

As a Module Lead, you will play a key role within the eLIMS-Forensics programme,

Eurofins Forensic Services, operating in UK, Netherlands, France, Germany and Belgium, sits at the core of European criminal justice systems, acting as the trusted scientific partner to police forces and courts, and providing critical evidence that enables fair and accurate outcomes in serious criminal investigations.
For software engineers, this is a rare opportunity to build systems where code directly impacts real-world justice—supporting DNA analysis, Forensic Case Management, and forensic workflows that can identify suspects and strengthen legal decision-making.

The UK forensic ecosystem remains one of the most advanced globally, combining cutting-edge science, strict regulatory standards, and continuous innovation; advances in data science, AI, and trace analysis are actively transforming how evidence is detected, interpreted, and used in investigations.
As part of the acquisition of Qualitype, Eurofins’ internal model already emphasises the integration of software development, quality engineering, and forensic domain expertise, giving engineers direct exposure to highly specialized scientific applications rarely found in traditional tech roles.

A compelling real-world example is the re‑analysis of cold cases using modern DNA techniques—some decades old—which have led to successful convictions years later, demonstrating how advances in forensic technology can fundamentally change investigative outcomes and deliver long-overdue justice.
In short, a role at Eurofins Forensics offers a unique combination of technical challenge, societal impact, and domain depth—where engineers are not just building software, but enabling a system that underpins public safety and the pursuit of truth.

The position focuses on full lifecycle delivery including technical design, implementation, system evolution and automation, ensuring solutions are robust, scalable and aligned with forensic operational processes and compliance requirements.

title: Machine learning Engineer
description:
What you will do
As an expert in the field of Machine Learning Engineering you will be responsible for the growth of our Data team, both professionally as well as in size. You will be in charge of shaping and executing the future of your expertise within Sia. You will work on client projects as well as on building our own Sia AI solutions, together with our Dutch team of Data Scientists, our French Data Engineering team, and other business units of Sia Global.

Your responsibilities include:

  • Leading an internal team towards the development of AI products;
  • Working in a multidisciplinary team on client projects as an expert on your subject;
  • Making architectural and design decisions for cloud environments;
  • Building production level ML/AI solutions with solid software engineering;
  • Guiding Data Scientists to scale up their models into production (parallelizing, optimizing, tuning, testing, and wrapping);
  • Giving trainings, leading internal meetings and organizing external events;
  • Participating in team meetings and workshops with clients;
  • Writing blog articles, presenting at conferences and sending out press releases on the subject that you lead.

Who you will work with
The Data Science team is young, diverse and growing (10+). You will join a team that will challenge you and invest in your professional development. We have a flat structure and rely on the entrepreneurial spirit of our members: initiative is highly encouraged. We are striving for well-being, diversity and knowledge-sharing inside the team, so that we can grow together.

Who you are

  • You are an established technical professional that wants to make the next step in their career, taking on more leadership responsibilities.
  • You have first-rate project management and time management skills.
  • You are a true problem solver, you turn complex issues into simple and impactful business solutions.
  • You are enthusiastic for applying Data Science/Engineering solutions to business problems.
  • You have excellent communication skills and can present complicated concepts in a synthetic way.
  • You have the ability to adapt rapidly and work on a range of different business areas within a challenging environment.
  • You have the ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.

    In return, you can expect:

    • An international company that gives importance to diversity, inclusion, employee well-being and corporate social responsibilities actions.
    • A great working atmosphere with friendly and professional colleagues where innovation and entrepreneurship are encouraged
    • A personal development plan with a regular follow-up as well training opportunities to develop yourself
    • A competitive salary with great advantages, like mobility budget, hospital insurance, performance -related bonus,...
    • MSc level education in Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Artificial Intelligence, Embedded Systems or related field of study.
    • 2-4 years of experience in building production-quality ML/Deep Learning pipelines and models.
    • Good understanding of Machine Learning fundamentals and strong knowledge in a specific domain (e.g., Computer Vision, Deep Learning, NLP).
    • Expert coding skills in Python and at least one of these languages: Scala, C++, Java.
    • Hands-on experience with database management languages (e.g., SQL, PostgreSQL).
    • Hands-on experience in cloud-based infrastructures (AWS/GCP/Azure).
    • Hands-on experience with Unix-based command line and DevOps tools (Git, Docker, Kubernetes).
    • Hands-on experience with big data technologies (e.g. Spark, Hadoop, Databricks).
    • You have a strong interest in data and AI-related topics, the ability to quickly build expertise in these areas, and you’re excited about helping our clients seize the opportunities they offer.
    • Experience with coaching/mentoring other engineers.
    • Prior experience in Management Consulting is a strong plus.
    • Willingness to travel and work at local and international clients.
    • Fluency in spoken and written English and Dutch is required.

title: Turnaround Planner til Studstrupværket
description:
Forestil dig en fremtid, hvor du er med til at sikre Danmarks energiforsyning, og hvor dit arbejde har direkte betydning for forsyningssikkerheden i Danmark

Ansøgningsfrist

18. oktober 2026 , 23:59 CET

Land Denmark

Lokation Studstrup Power Station

Arbejdssted

On-site

_

On-site
On-site

_

Arbejdstid 37

Jobtype Permanent

Juridisk enhed Ørsted Bioenergy & Thermal Power A/S

Nogle af vores fordele:

Dokumenteret høj medarbejdertilfredshed og motivation

Løbende muligheder for læring og udvikling

Konkurrencedygtig løn og attraktiv pensions- og ferieordning

Fokus på sundhed, herunder sundhedsforsikring, sund og lækker mad og fitness på flere lokationer.

I denne rolle vil du blive en central drivkraft i planlægningen af Ørsteds vedligeholdelses- og revisionsstop på Studstrupværket. Du bliver en nøgleperson i arbejdet med at sikre, at anlæggene vedligeholdes sikkert, effektivt og til tiden, så de fortsat kan levere fjernvarme og grøn energi til hundredtusindvis af danskere. Du får ansvaret for at planlægge komplekse vedligeholdelses-, inspektions- og projektaktiviteter, hvor sikkerhed, kvalitet, økonomi og fremdrift skal gå op i en højere enhed, og en unik mulighed for at arbejde tæt sammen med specialister, projektledere, drift, vedligehold og leverandører.

**Velkommen til Studstrupværket
**Du bliver del af Turnaround Management, hvor du sammen med dine kolleger er ansvarlig for planlægning og gennemførelse af revisionsstop på Ørsteds danske kraftværker – heriblandt Studstrupværket. I teamet arbejder vi med nogle af de mest komplekse og kritiske aktiviteter på anlæggene. Vi kombinerer teknisk indsigt, stærk planlægning og tæt samarbejde for at sikre, at hver revision gennemføres sikkert, effektivt og inden for de aftalte rammer. Vi tilbyder et fagligt stærkt miljø, frihed under ansvar, korte beslutningsveje og gode faglige/personlige udviklingsmuligheder.

Vores team er et stærkt fagligt fællesskab, hvor sikkerhed, samarbejde og udvikling er fundamentet for vores succes. Vi arbejder selvstændigt, men samtidig som et team. Tonen er uformel, og tilliden er stor.

I jobbet vil du:

  • udvikle og vedligeholde detaljerede turnaround-planer for større revisionsstop
  • sikre, at arbejdsopgaver er fuldt klargjorte med arbejdsbeskrivelser, materialer, reservedele og ressourcer inden udførelse
  • koordinere aktiviteter mellem drift, vedligehold, teknik, projektafdelinger og eksterne entreprenører
  • identificere og koordinere kritiske veje, afhængigheder, risici og flaskehalse i revisionsforløbet, herunder drive løbende forbedringer af planlægningsprocesser, metoder og værktøjer
  • bidrage til ressourceforberedelse og leverandørstyring
  • understøtte budgetlægning og opfølgning på omkostninger i planlægningsfasen.

For at få succes i denne rolle forventer vi, at du:

  • er uddannet maskinmester, ingeniør eller har tilsvarende teknisk baggrund
  • har erfaring med planlægning, vedligehold, shutdowns, turnarounds eller projekter inden for energi-, proces- eller industrisektoren – har du erfaring med større revisionsstop, kraftværker eller procesanlæg vil det være en fordel, men ikke et krav
  • trives med at koordinere mange interessenter og skabe fremdrift i komplekse opgaver
  • arbejder struktureret og har stærke evner inden for planlægning og prioritering – ligeledes er du god til at analysere tekniske problemstillinger, herunder omsætte dem til gennemarbejdede og realistiske planer
  • har erfaring med SAP eller tilsvarende vedligeholdelsessystemer
  • kommunikerer professionelt på både dansk og engelsk.

Selvom din profil ikke matcher alle punkterne, har du måske andre kompetencer, der vil være relevante. Mener du, at du kan bidrage til teamet, så send os din ansøgning.

**Form fremtiden med os
**Send din ansøgning og CV til os så hurtigt som muligt.

Hvis du ønsker at anmode om justering af arbejdsmetoder eller arbejdsmønstre eller hjælp til rekrutteringsprocessen, så send en e-mail til accommodation@orsted.com.

Bemærk venligst, at din ansøgning kun bliver taget i betragtning, hvis den indsendes via vores online karriereside. Vi tager ikke ansøgninger eller forespørgsler fra eksterne rekrutteringsbureauer eller bureauer i betragtning til denne stilling.

**Lønramme:
**For denne stilling er det forventede grundlønsniveau kr. 45.125,- - kr. 52.250,- for lokationen i jobannoncen. Den endelige løn fastsættes på baggrund af relevante kompetencer, erfaring og forventet opfyldelse af rollen inden for det angivne løninterval for at sikre et fair og konkurrencedygtigt tilbud. Denne jobannonce henvender sig primært til kandidater, der er tidligt i deres karriere eller fortsat opbygger erfaring inden for området. Lønniveauet vil derfor typisk ligge i den lavere del af det samlede interval for stillingen. Vi byder dog også ansøgninger fra alle kvalificerede kandidater velkommen, uanset erfaringsniveau. Hvor det er relevant, kan du desuden være berettiget til variabel løn og en omfattende fordelspakke.

**Vores fordelspakke:
**I denne stilling får medarbejdere, der opfylder berettigelseskravene, adgang til: arbejdsgiverbetalt pension (11 % indbetaling), fuld forsikringsdækning (ulykke, liv, kritisk sygdom og sundhedsforsikring); fem ugers betalt ferie plus 10 ekstra betalte fridage/feriefridage pr. ferieår; 3 % feriepengetillæg; adgang til Ørsted Life & Fitness Vitality, herunder holdtræning, fysioterapi, massage og trivselstilbud; en multimediepakke (mobiltelefon, pc, og internet); medlemskab af personaleklub med sports- og kulturaktiviteter samt adgang til virksomhedens kantine (månedlig frokostordning eller dagsbilletter).

**Baggrundstjek før ansættelse:
**Denne stilling kræver et baggrundstjek som en del af ansættelsesprocessen, og jobtilbuddet er afhængigt af resultatet af dette tjek. Du vil modtage yderligere information i løbet af rekrutteringsforløbet. Baggrundstjekket udføres af en ekstern udbyder i overensstemmelse med lokal lovgivning.

title: Senior Software Engineer II- Regional Expansion
description:
We are expanding our Latam & Mea Payments Team and are looking for ambitious and highly skilled Senior Software Engineers to join the engineering team.

You will lead the development of the critical integrations enabling money movement across the Latam & Mea regions. By integrating directly with local payment systems and sophisticated cross-border payment systems, you will unlock essential functionality that accelerates our growth, building products that empower consumers and businesses to manage their finances globally.

Your Role:

Your role involves implementing integrations with local banks, payment providers, and connecting our platform to local payment systems as well as optimizing funnels to handle the complexities of cross-country money movement within your specific area.

This role requires a high level of technical and product excellence and a passion for building high-quality, scalable, and compliant solutions tailored for the unique financial infrastructure and regulatory landscape of our region. Beyond writing good code, you will propose solid technical designs, participate in code and design reviews, and collaborate with global engineering teams to build the core infrastructure that unlocks and grows new markets.

  • Define the technical direction by advocating for high-quality designs, providing critical feedback in peer reviews, and actively shaping the future roadmap for our payments ecosystem.

  • Take your local in-market learnings and work with global engineering teams to ensure the systems you build seamlessly influence and integrate with our worldwide platform.

  • Participate in on-call rotations to support operational teams and address incidents, ensuring our platform remains secure and consistently available for our customers.

  • Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, including product managers, designers, and engineers in our other global offices, to align on product vision and technical implementation for regional expansion

Qualifications

  • A proactive and ambitious mindset, with a desire to take ownership and make a significant impact

  • Autonomous team player able to work effectively with minimal supervision.

  • Proven experience as a Senior Software Engineer, with a strong track record of delivering high-quality, scalable systems and a strong Product mindset

  • Deep technical expertise in back-end development and microservices architecture

  • Experience in designing and building software systems and collaborating on technical designs within a team or domain

  • Strong ability to provide constructive feedback during code and design reviews

  • Experience working on payments systems, money movement, financial integrations
