title: Test Engineer
description:
Position Summary

Our client is seeking an experienced Systems Test Engineer to support the testing and validation of mission-critical software, telecommunications infrastructure, network components, and radio/telephone communication systems. This individual will be responsible for verifying that integrated hardware and software solutions meet defined technical, functional, performance, and customer requirements.

The role will support multiple phases of system testing, including internal verification, formal qualification and acceptance testing, and testing conducted directly with customers. The Systems Test Engineer will also work closely with engineering teams, technical partners, and customers to understand system and site requirements, develop appropriate test strategies, troubleshoot issues, and validate solutions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, document, and execute comprehensive test plans, procedures, scripts, and specifications based on system, software, hardware, and customer requirements.

  • Perform a variety of system-level testing, including functional, performance, reliability, stability/load, security, environmental, voice-quality, maintenance, inspection, and analytical testing.

  • Support informal testing, formal Factory Acceptance/Qualification Testing (FAT/FQT), customer acceptance testing, and other system verification activities.

  • Manage assigned test environments, including configuration of test systems, test scripts, equipment, and supporting infrastructure.

  • Develop verification approaches based on technical requirements, product specifications, system use cases, and expected operating conditions.

  • Analyze system and software requirements to determine testability and identify appropriate verification methods.

  • Identify, investigate, and thoroughly document software, hardware, network, or system defects discovered during testing.

  • Provide detailed steps and supporting information needed to reproduce defects and unexpected system behavior.

  • Partner with engineering teams to recreate, troubleshoot, and resolve identified technical issues.

  • Maintain organized testing documentation and records, including test results, defect information, and historical test data.

  • Analyze test results to identify trends, recurring issues, and potential areas for improvement.

  • Communicate testing status, technical concerns, defects, and project information to engineering teams, test leadership, customers, and other stakeholders.

  • Collaborate with Engineering and Technical Support teams to perform root-cause analysis of issues identified in test and live production environments.

  • Recommend improvements to testing practices and broader engineering processes based on lessons learned during system verification activities.

  • Participate in technical discussions with customers and external partners regarding system requirements, site-specific configurations, testing approaches, and proposed solutions.



Requirements

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline; equivalent professional experience may be considered.

  • Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in software, systems, hardware, or integration testing.

  • Candidates without a related bachelor's degree should have at least 3 years of relevant experience working with IT and telecommunications hardware and software, in addition to demonstrating the technical capabilities required for the position.

  • Experience developing formal test plans, procedures, and supporting documentation for internal and customer-facing testing.

  • Experience testing complex technical systems, preferably involving mission-critical or high-availability hardware and software in a production or operational environment.

  • Hands-on experience with telecommunications and telephony technologies such as VoIP, T1, ISDN, POTS, and TDM.

  • Ability to translate technical and system requirements into clear, repeatable test procedures.

  • Experience identifying and documenting defects with sufficient technical detail to support troubleshooting and resolution.

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and technical troubleshooting capabilities.

Preferred Skills & Experience

  • Experience working across multiple operating systems, including Linux and Windows/Windows Server environments.

  • Familiarity with network monitoring and protocol-analysis tools such as Wireshark or comparable technologies.

  • Experience with defect-tracking and test-management platforms such as JIRA, JAMA, or similar systems.

  • Familiarity with commercial performance, simulation, telecommunications, or system-analysis testing tools.

  • Experience working with relational databases such as PostgreSQL or similar database technologies.

  • Working knowledge of quality assurance methodologies and software development/testing life cycles.

  • Experience working within Agile/Scrum development environments.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, particularly when communicating technical information to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Ability to manage multiple testing activities and project priorities simultaneously.

  • Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a cross-functional technical team.

  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to communicate project status, technical risks, and issues to the appropriate stakeholders.

Additional Requirements

  • Ability to travel up to 30% based on project requirements.

  • Travel may include visits to customer locations for on-site system testing, implementation support, troubleshooting, and related technical activities.

  • Occasional international travel may be required for technical training or project-related activities.

  • Must be able to complete required background screening, which may include fingerprinting and consumer/credit background checks.

  • Must be eligible to obtain a Public Trust and any other access authorization required for assigned government facilities or projects.

  • Must be authorized to work in the United States and meet applicable requirements for access to U.S. Government sites.

title: Partner Risk Assessment Specialist
description:
Role & Job purpose

As a Partner Risk Assessment Specialist, you will play a critical role in ensuring that Wise adheres to regulatory and compliance requirements. You will be responsible for onboarding and risk assessing banks and online platforms partnering with Wise. This position offers the unique opportunity to influence Wise’s mission and establish partnerships that facilitate instant, borderless money for more people.

Your mission

Wise Platform helps financial institutions and large enterprises leverage Wise’s infrastructure to offer their customers world class payments products through their own platforms. Wise Platform is a start-up within a scale up. We’re a cross functional team across sales, account management, product, engineering, compliance, analytics and many other functions. We’re based across the world – from London to Singapore, Austin and beyond.

Your primary mission will be to onboard banks and online platforms, assessing their compliance policies, producing comprehensive compliance memos to determine partner risk and hand-holding partners through their KYC journey.

Job Responsibilities

  • Policy and Procedure Review:

    • Conduct thorough and detailed due diligence on our banks and online platforms to assess their compliance with regulatory requirements, internal policies, and industry standards.

    • Review partners’ documentation, including Know Your Customer (KYC) information, legal agreements, and other relevant materials to ensure accuracy and completeness.

    • Document your findings in compliance memos that summarize potential risks.

    • Assist in the development and improvement of the compliance onboarding process to enhance efficiency and effectiveness.

  • Onboarding New Partners:

    • Manage the onboarding process for banks and online platforms, ensuring seamless integration with Wise Platform.

    • Keep abreast of regulatory developments and industry best practices to ensure that the onboarding process aligns with the latest compliance standards.

    • Develop and maintain strong relationships with partners to facilitate smooth onboarding and address any compliance-related queries or concerns.

  • Risk Assessment and Control Recommendations:

    • Evaluate and recommend appropriate monitoring controls based on the inherent risks identified during the onboarding process.

    • Apply broad industry, operational risk, and regulatory knowledge to drive onboarding excellence

  • Cross team collaboration:

    • Collaborate with internal stakeholders, such as Legal, Risk Management, and Business Development, to obtain necessary information and approvals for client onboarding.

    • Act as a SME to senior stakeholders and/or other team members related to Enterprise Due Diligence processes and compliance requirements

  • A minimum of 2+ years of financial services industry compliance experience, preferably at a bank, trading, payments, or fintech institution

  • Skilled in investigation and business notation, specializing in evaluating risk assessments and compliance documentation, able to make decisions based on these

  • Proven experience onboarding large enterprises to financial platforms, effectively managing complex organisational structures and processes

  • Strong capabilities in documenting business processes and compliance measures with clarity and precision

  • Understanding of risk-based approaches and assessments as well as control design and implementation in Risk and Compliance

For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.

We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.
Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.

title: Digital Design Specialist
description:
Reporting directly to the UK Digital Design Lead, you will specialise in the practical application of artificial intelligence, automation and data-driven workflows across 10 Design’s UK and international projects. Working closely with project teams, you will identify, test and implement tools that improve design exploration, knowledge access, model checking, coordination, visualisation and project delivery. BIM and advanced Revit capability are essential requirements and provide the technical foundation for integrating AI-enabled workflows into live architectural projects. You will contribute to the global 10N technology strategy through implementation, documentation and knowledge sharing, within priorities and governance set by the UK Digital Design Lead and Head of Digital.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Project BIM Setup, Standards, Documentation

  • Lead or support the setup of Revit projects, including models, worksets, coordinates, links, templates, family libraries views, sheets and shared parameters.

  • Implement and promote practice BIM standards, templates, protocols and workflows across project teams.

  • Contribute to the preparation and maintenance of BIM Execution Plans (BEPs), responsibility matrices, and project BIM documentation.

  • Develop workflows that align with client information requirements, internal QA processes and ISO 19650 principles.

  • Monitor model health, file structure, naming conventions and data integrity

  • Contribute to structured information delivery planning, including awareness of the Master Information Delivery Plan (MIDP) and Task Information Delivery Plan (TIDP) processes as defined under ISO 19650.

BIM + Model Management

  • Provide day-to-day BIM and Revit coordination across all project work stages.

  • Coordinate architectural models with other design team disciplines’ models.

  • Contribute to federated model workflows, including clash detection, issue tracking and model exchange.

  • Undertake model audits, clash reviews and drawing-output checks to support accurate and coordinated information.

  • Resolve model coordination issues efficiently, including linked models, families, views, sheets and data consistency.

Common Data Environment Governance & Information Coordination

  • Support the setup and governance of Common Data Environments in accordance with project protocols, using Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC), ProjectWise or similar platforms.

  • Define and communicate requirements for model exchanges, issue tracking and information workflows. Routine uploads and transmittals should remain with the relevant project team, with the Digital Design Specialist providing guidance and oversight.

  • Undertake periodic checks of information structure, naming and model exchange processes, escalating recurring or material non-compliance where appropriate.

  • Support digital handover processes, including structured model data, asset information and COBie where applicable.

AI, Automation + Innovation

  • Identify, test and implement AI-assisted workflows that improve design quality, project coordination, information access and delivery efficiency, under the direction of the UK Digital Design Lead.

  • Develop proofs of concept, document outcomes and support the controlled adoption of AI tools, plug-ins and automated workflows within live project environments.

  • Connect AI and automation initiatives with BIM data, openBIM workflows, IFC and interoperability processes.

  • Evaluate emerging technologies, including generative AI, machine learning, automation, computational design and data-driven workflows, and translate relevant opportunities into practical, secure and scalable applications.

Teams Support + Training

  • Provide practical Revit support and troubleshooting to project teams.

  • Support the development of Revit templates, families, shared parameters and content libraries, with a focus on structured data that can enable automation and AI-assisted workflows.

  • Deliver or support internal training, guidance and knowledge-sharing on BIM, AI-assisted tools, automation and responsible digital practice.

  • Promote consistent, efficient and high-quality modelling practices across the studio.

  • Act as a first point of contact for BIM/Revit queries, escalating complex issues where appropriate.

Education

  • Degree in architecture, engineering, architectural technology, or a related relevant field.

  • Revit exam certification is beneficial

Experience

  • 3+ years’ experience in digital design or BIM within an architectural practice, together with practical evidence of applying AI-assisted tools, automation or data-driven methods to project workflows.

  • Experience coordinating with models from other design team disciplines.

  • Working knowledge of clash detection, model auditing and issue management processes.

  • Familiarity with the UK BIM Framework and ISO 19650 principles, including BEPs and CDE workflows.

Essential software proficiency

  • Advanced Revit proficiency, with experience across multiple RIBA stages.

  • Strong understanding of model setup, coordinates, worksharing, linked models and drawing production workflows.

  • Proficiency with BIM tools and platforms such as Navisworks, Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC), Autodesk Forma, Revizto, Solibri or similar.

Desirable software proficiency

  • Experience contributing to BIM setup, BEPs and client information requirements (EIR/AIR).

  • Experience managing Revit content libraries and standards.

  • Experience driving automation on projects using Dynamo visual scripting, or C# programming.

  • Experience managing interoperability workflows with Rhino using tools such as Rhino.Inside or Beam

  • Experience working with real-time rendering tools such as Enscape or Twinmotion.

Working Arrangements

  • Right to work in the UK is required.

  • Hybrid working with a minimum of 4 days per week in the London studio, requiring flexibility depending on project requirements and business needs

  • The role may involve working across multiple projects and teams.

  • Other duties may be required in line with the needs of the business.

Career Development

10 Design supports ongoing professional development, with opportunities to grow into senior digital leadership roles, alongside access to structured training, mentoring, and development initiatives.

Equality, Diversity & Inclusion

10 Design is an equal opportunities employer. We value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Director of Product, Subscriber Value
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Director of Product, Subscriber Value based in United States.

This is a director-level individual contributor role responsible for shaping the strategy that delivers meaningful value to subscribers while accelerating subscription growth.
You will own membership portfolio architecture, pricing, packaging, freemium features, and premium partner offerings across a large-scale consumer product.
The role combines strategic product leadership with hands-on execution across engineering, design, analytics, machine learning, finance, and business development.
You will identify opportunities to increase subscriber satisfaction, revenue per membership, and the long-term value of paid memberships.
You will lead experimentation and use data, AI, and rapid validation to turn customer insights into measurable product outcomes.
As a senior product leader, you will influence executive-level decisions and establish the direction for one of the organization’s highest-leverage product areas.
This is an AI-native environment where modern tooling is embedded into research, analysis, prototyping, financial modeling, experimentation, and product delivery.

Accountabilities:

  • Own the subscriber value strategy, including membership portfolio architecture, tier design, bundling and unbundling decisions, and the balance between internally developed and partner-powered offerings.
  • Define and execute the subscriber value roadmap, including freemium features designed to increase measurable customer value and satisfaction.
  • Develop strategies to grow revenue per membership while determining when incremental monetization is appropriate versus when deeper tier value should be prioritized.
  • Lead the portfolio of premium services delivered through third-party partners, from opportunity identification and partner selection through launch, performance management, and ongoing growth.
  • Own pricing and packaging strategy, including price architecture, promotional and discount approaches, and the execution of pricing changes across app stores and web billing platforms.
  • Build compelling business cases for pricing and packaging changes and guide initiatives through executive-level review and approval.
  • Establish a strong culture of experimentation, using data science, AI, and rapid validation methods to test ideas and accelerate learning.
  • Operate as an AI-native product leader by embedding AI into research, decision-making, product specifications, experimentation, reporting, and day-to-day workflows.
  • Create reusable AI-driven processes and artifacts that increase team leverage and help establish effective practices for AI-native product management.
  • Advocate for subscriber value across the organization and represent the product strategy with senior leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.

    • Requirements

    • 10+ years of experience in consumer product management, including at least 5 years owning subscription monetization at scale, ideally within a business with millions of paying subscribers and direct accountability for revenue outcomes.
    • Demonstrated success developing subscription strategies that generated business growth and launching features that delivered measurable value and improved subscriber satisfaction.
    • Extensive hands-on experience with pricing and packaging, including successfully implementing price increases, repackaging initiatives, or comparable monetization changes.
    • Proven experience delivering product initiatives through commercial partnerships, including revenue-share or embedded integrations that increased product value.
    • Deep knowledge of mobile subscription mechanics, including App Store and Google Play architecture, proration, mid-cycle upgrades, refunds, cancellations, web billing, and global subscription regulations.
    • Strong command of subscription unit economics, including lifetime value, gross margin, customer acquisition cost, cohort retention, and contribution per member, with the ability to build and stress-test financial models.
    • Director-level strategic experience setting multi-quarter direction across a portfolio of products or surfaces, making prioritization decisions, and managing constrained resources.
    • Strong analytical, commercial, and product judgment, with the ability to translate customer needs and business opportunities into measurable outcomes.
    • Hands-on experience using current AI tools for research, analysis, financial modeling, product specifications, prototyping, analytics, experimentation, and reporting.
    • Ability to critically review and take full accountability for AI-generated outputs while using AI to increase speed, leverage, and product impact.
    • Willingness to share effective AI practices, improve team workflows, and continuously learn as AI tooling evolves.
    • Strong customer empathy and an understanding of how monetization decisions can affect trust, particularly when building products that support families and their safety.

      • Benefits

      • US base salary range of $201,000–$294,000 USD, with final compensation determined based on relevant background, knowledge, skills, experience, and geographic location.
      • Total compensation includes equity in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs).
      • Comprehensive benefits including medical, dental, vision, financial, and other employee benefits.
      • Life and disability insurance coverage, with medical, dental, and supplemental options.
      • 401(k) plan with company matching.
      • Paid parental leave.
      • Mental Wellness Program and Employee Assistance Program (EAP).
      • Flexible paid time off, companywide holidays, and summer and winter shutdown periods.
      • Learning and development programs to support continued professional growth.
      • Equipment, tools, and reimbursement support for a productive remote work environment.
      • Remote-first working environment, with the role designed to be performed remotely within the United States.
      • Complimentary premium membership and connected tracking-device benefits.

They're quick on their feet with our property management system, comfortable juggling phones, walk-ups, and special requests all at once, and calm under pressure when things don't go exactly to plan. · Warmly welcome guests at check-in and check-out, setting the tone for a memorable stay from the first hello

· Operate the property management system (PMS) to process reservations, check-ins/outs, room assignments, and payments accurately

· Handle cash, credit transactions, and folio adjustments with precision and full accountability

· Answer phone and email inquiries promptly, providing accurate information on rates, availability, and hotel services

· Anticipate guest needs and offer personalized recommendations on local dining, activities, and Venice Beach attractions

· Resolve guest concerns and service issues with empathy, discretion, and a solutions-first mindset, escalating when appropriate

· Coordinate with housekeeping and maintenance to ensure rooms are ready and guest requests are fulfilled promptly

· Maintain accurate guest records, shift logs, and reports

· Support group check-ins, special events, and VIP arrivals with extra attention to detail

· Stay current on hotel promotions, packages, and property knowledge to confidently upsell when appropriate

· Maintain a clean, organized, and welcoming front desk area at all times

title: Conveyance Coordinator **3rd Shift
description:

  • Support the coordination of POM-owned and rental mobile equipment, including availability, service needs, and maintenance follow-up.
  • Act as the department lead in the Conveyance Supervisor’s absence when assigned by management.
  • Provide coverage and operational support to other supply chain departments as directed.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

SEASONAL POMEGRANATE HARVEST – YARD COORDINATION RESPONSIBILITIES

During the pomegranate season, the Conveyance Coordinator will provide additional support for the coordination and control of fresh-fruit trailer traffic and yard operations. These responsibilities include:

Trailer Coordination & Yard Management

  • Verify trailer identification, load information, and required documentation before directing trailers to designated locations.

  • Ability to read, write, and understand work instructions in English
  • Bilingual in English and Spanish preferred

  • Basic knowledge of GMP, food safety, and workplace safety requirements

  • Computer proficiency in Microsoft Office
  • Working knowledge of Oracle or the ability to learn applicable systems
  • Strong organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills
  • Customer-service oriented and able to work effectively with internal departments and external partners
  • Self-motivated and able to prioritize work in a fast-paced, changing environment
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team
  • Ability to work all shifts, overtime, weekends, and holidays as required by management

High school diploma or GED, or an equivalent combination of education, training, and experience that demonstrates the ability to perform the duties of the position. title: Senior QA Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior QA Engineer II based in Canada .

The Senior QA Engineer II will lead quality efforts across products supporting healthcare providers, patient workflows, and diagnostic reporting. The role combines hands-on testing with technical leadership and cross-functional collaboration throughout the product development lifecycle. You will shape risk-based test strategies, strengthen automation, and improve quality standards across teams. The position covers web and mobile applications, REST APIs, backend services, accessibility, and CI/CD workflows. You will help identify systemic quality risks, lead root cause analysis, and drive improvements through completion. Working in a fully remote environment, you will also mentor colleagues and help build a strong culture of shared quality ownership.

Accountabilities:

  • Partner with product managers, designers, engineers, and other stakeholders to embed quality throughout the development lifecycle.
  • Analyze requirements, architecture, interfaces, integrations, and dependencies to create comprehensive, risk-based testing strategies.
  • Define and continuously improve QA standards, testing practices, processes, strategies, test plans, cases, and supporting documentation.
  • Perform manual and automated testing across web and mobile applications, including exploratory, functional, acceptance, regression, end-to-end, and UI testing.
  • Test native and cross-platform mobile applications across devices, operating-system versions, screen sizes, and network conditions.

  • Communicate test strategies, quality risks, release readiness, and technical tradeoffs to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Identify systemic quality and process issues and coordinate practical improvements through completion.
  • Mentor engineers and other team members, strengthening QA capabilities and shared ownership of quality.
  • Evaluate applications against accessibility standards such as WCAG using manual and automated testing approaches.
  • Contribute to performance and security testing according to product risks and team priorities.

    • Requirements

    • 7+ years of professional software quality assurance experience, with demonstrated success leading quality initiatives across cross-functional teams.
    • Strong knowledge of QA methodologies, test design techniques, and risk-based testing for complex systems.
    • Solid understanding of web and mobile technologies, client-server architecture, APIs, integrations, and system dependencies.
    • Hands-on experience testing native or cross-platform iOS and Android applications across different devices, operating systems, screen sizes, and network conditions.
    • Experience testing REST APIs and backend services.
    • Proficiency in at least one programming language such as JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, or Java.
    • Experience developing or improving test automation frameworks, standards, coverage, reliability, and maintainability.
    • Experience with modern web or mobile automation frameworks and CI/CD integration.
    • Knowledge of accessibility testing and WCAG, including tools such as Axe, Lighthouse, or screen readers.
    • Experience with defect tracking and test-management tools such as Jira within an Agile environment.
    • Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to explain quality risks and technical tradeoffs to diverse audiences.
    • Proven ability to drive cross-functional quality and process improvements through completion.
    • Experience mentoring technical and non-technical colleagues and developing quality capabilities across teams.
    • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
    • Self-directed, organized, collaborative, and comfortable taking ownership in a continuously evolving environment.

      • Benefits

      • Regular opportunities for team connection, collaboration, and social interaction.

title: Culinary Services Director
description:
POSITION SUMMARY

The Culinary Services Director (CSD) is the department head responsible for the overall leadership, financial performance, culinary quality, hospitality, staffing, regulatory compliance, and day-to-day operation of Culinary Services.

This is a hands-on, working leadership position. The CSD is expected to spend the majority of their working time actively engaged in culinary operations, including cooking, food preparation, training, coaching, and developing team members in the kitchen. Administrative responsibilities are an important part of the position but should support, rather than replace, active leadership within the operation.

The CSD is accountable for both front-of-house (FOH) and back-of-house (BOH) operations and is expected to lead by example, maintain a visible presence during meal periods, and step directly into production and service as operational needs require.

RESPONSIBILITIES include but are not limited to the following:

Culinary Operations & Hands-On Leadership

  • Maintain a consistent and visible presence in the kitchen and dining operation, with the majority of working time spent actively supporting culinary production, training, coaching, and service execution.
  • Regularly work alongside the culinary team in food preparation, cooking, plating, and execution of meal periods.
  • Lead by example and be prepared to work any culinary station when operationally necessary.
  • Demonstrate proper culinary techniques, recipe execution, presentation standards, sanitation practices, organization, and efficient kitchen workflow.
  • Use daily production as an opportunity to evaluate team performance, identify skill gaps, and provide real-time coaching and development.
  • Oversee daily culinary operations to ensure efficient, consistent, and high-quality meal service.
  • Ensure company recipes, menus, portion standards, presentation standards, and production expectations are consistently followed.
  • Maintain responsibility for food quality, taste, presentation, consistency, and overall execution.

Leadership, Staffing, & Team Development

  • Provide strategic leadership for the Culinary Services department in alignment with community and company goals.
  • Lead, mentor, coach, and develop the culinary team while promoting a culture of accountability, hospitality, excellence, teamwork, and continuous improvement.
  • Maintain appropriate staffing levels through proactive recruiting, interviewing, onboarding, scheduling, training, retention, coaching, and performance management.
  • Directly lead and develop cooks, sous chefs, servers, dishwashers, and other Culinary Services team members.
  • Provide hands-on culinary training to develop the technical skills and confidence of the culinary team.
  • Conduct performance evaluations and provide ongoing feedback, coaching, accountability, and opportunities for professional growth.
  • Address performance and accountability concerns promptly and consistently.
  • Develop the Sous Chef and other emerging leaders to create departmental succession and operational coverage.

Front-of-House & Back-of-House Operation

  • Maintain full operational ownership of both front-of-house and back-of-house Culinary Services operations.
  • Ensure proper execution of kitchen production, dining room service, sanitation, dishwashing, opening and closing procedures, and meal-period readiness.
  • Establish and maintain appropriate schedules based on resident census, meal volumes, operational requirements, and approved labor targets.
  • Maintain a visible leadership presence during meal periods and actively support both culinary production and dining service.
  • Ensure resident preferences are accommodated and excellent service is consistently provided to residents and guests.
  • Establish clear expectations and accountability for service standards across the entire department.

Financial & Business Performance

  • Own departmental financial performance, including food cost, labor, productivity, overtime, inventory, purchasing, waste, operating expenses, kitchen maintenance, and budget compliance.
  • Analyze financial and operational results to identify trends, opportunities, and areas requiring corrective action.
  • Monitor established performance indicators including Food Per Resident Day (PRD), Labor Per Resident Day (PRD), RPLH/Productivity, inventory, overtime, budget variance, and resident satisfaction.
  • Implement corrective action when departmental performance falls outside established targets.
  • Maintain appropriate inventory levels while minimizing waste and unnecessary spending.

Menu, Production, & Resident Experience

  • Execute the company's standardized corporate menu program with consistency and attention to quality, while incorporating approved seasonal rotations, resident feedback, and dietary needs within established guidelines. Communicate menu feedback or improvement suggestions through proper channels to home office leadership.
  • Ensure standardized recipes, portion standards, presentation standards, and production requirements established by the corporate menu program are consistently followed.
  • Regularly engage directly with residents to gather feedback regarding food quality, menu preferences, service, dietary needs, and overall dining satisfaction.
  • Respond promptly and professionally to resident dining concerns and implement appropriate corrective action.
  • Organize and actively participate in food preparation and execution for special events, holidays, themed meals, and other culinary initiatives designed to enhance the resident experience, utilizing approved company resources and guidelines.

Special Diets & Clinical Coordination

  • Partner with community leadership, clinical teams, residents, families, and dietitians as appropriate to ensure dietary requirements are properly executed.
  • Ensure accurate execution of therapeutic diets, texture modifications, food allergies, documented resident preferences, and other dietary requirements.
  • Ensure culinary employees understand and follow established procedures related to special diets, allergens, cross-contact prevention, and resident safety.

Food Safety, Sanitation, & Compliance

  • Serve as the departmental leader for food safety, sanitation, and regulatory compliance.
  • Maintain strong working knowledge of food safety, sanitation, infection prevention, allergen management, temperature control, cross-contamination prevention, and applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Maintain the department in a constant state of readiness for health department inspections, company audits, and other regulatory reviews.
  • Ensure proper documentation of food temperatures, sanitation requirements, cleaning schedules, and other required food-safety records.
  • Conduct routine inspections of kitchens, storage areas, dining areas, equipment, and sanitation practices.
  • Immediately address identified food-safety or sanitation concerns.
  • Ensure employees receive appropriate food-safety training and maintain required certifications.

Systems, Technology, & Administrative Accountability

  • Maintain proficiency with company technology platforms used for menus, recipes, production, ordering, inventory, financial tracking, food safety, POS, training, and operational reporting.
  • Ensure required information is entered accurately and completed within established deadlines.
  • Maintain accurate inventory, purchasing, financial, production, and operational records.
  • Complete required company reporting accurately and on time.
  • Ensure culinary employees are properly trained on systems and technology required for their positions.
  • Balance administrative responsibilities with the expectation that the CSD remains a hands-on culinary leader actively engaged in daily operations.

Community Leadership

  • Serve as an active member of the community leadership team.
  • Maintain regular communication with the Executive Director regarding staffing, financial performance, resident concerns, operational challenges, regulatory compliance, and departmental priorities.
  • Participate in community leadership meetings and operational reviews as required.
  • Proactively communicate challenges and request support before operational issues negatively impact residents or employees.
  • Partner with other department heads to support overall community operations and resident experience.

Purchasing, Vendors, & Equipment

  • Follow company purchasing standards and utilize approved vendors, products, contracts, and purchasing programs.
  • Maintain appropriate inventory and ordering practices to ensure adequate product availability while controlling costs and waste.
  • Monitor kitchen and dining equipment for proper operation and maintenance.
  • Promptly report equipment failures and coordinate repairs through established company procedures.

title: Manufacturing RF Product Engineer II
description:
As a Producibility Engineer II here at Honeywell Aerospace, you will support MMIC products across post-production and development phases, including wafer probe, packaging, and final RF test. This role focuses on monitoring test yields and product performance through detailed electrical analysis (S-parameters, power, gain, efficiency), driving yield improvements, and leading root cause investigations for performance variability and defects. The engineer develops and optimizes test methodologies, correlates wafer-level and packaged results and ensures robust test documentation and production readiness.

In product development, the role includes test fixture and PCB design, lab-based RF characterization, and data analysis to define product specifications and improve device models and design kits. The position works closely with design, process, and test teams to resolve issues, validate models through measurement and back-fitting, and support high-frequency package design. Additional responsibilities include failure analysis support (SEM, FIB, electrical methods), prototype assembly, inspection, and preparation of technical reports to enable successful product release and delivery.

You will report directly to our Engineering Program Manager, and you’ll work out of our Richardson, TX location on an On-site work schedule.

In this role, you will impact the successful execution of producibility engineering projects that align with business objectives, contributing to revenue growth, customer satisfaction, and market competitiveness. Your technical skills and collaboration will help Honeywell develop and launch innovative aerospace products that meet evolving customer needs.

  • Collaborate with design teams to ensure MMIC designs meet manufacturability (DFM) and testability (DFT) requirements, supporting modeling, simulation, and design improvements
  • Develop and execute wafer-level and packaged test plans, including RF/microwave characterization (S-parameters, power, noise figure) and acceptance testing
  • Design, validate, and optimize test fixtures, probe cards, IC packages, and evaluation PCBs for pre-production and characterization
  • Perform lab-based device testing and data analysis to define specifications, identify performance gaps, and assess yield risks
  • Support process development, qualification, and fabrication optimization for MMIC technologies (GaAs, GaN, InP) prior to volume production
  • Conduct model validation through measurement-to-simulation correlation and refine device model kits
  • Generate test procedures, qualification plans, datasheets, and technical reports; support customer applications and engineering documentation

You will be responsible for implementing high-quality software solutions, optimizing application performance, and contributing to the architecture and long-term evolution of our systems. Working closely with cross-functional teams, you will participate in technical design discussions, mentor fellow engineers, and promote engineering best practices. This role requires deep technical expertise in Python, Django, distributed systems, and modern software engineering principles.

  • Solid experience working with relational databases, particularly MySQL.

  • Strong understanding of object-oriented programming, software design patterns, clean architecture, and distributed system design.

description:

title: Family Worker
description:
Mission

Shasta Head Start, a non-profit agency, is dedicated to making a positive difference in the lives of young children, one family at a time. We provide opportunities for education, parenting support and resources to families in our communities.

Position Summary

Family Workers work in collaboration with center staff to ensure children and families receive comprehensive services according to Head Start Performance standards.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

title: Conversational AI Engineer
description:
THE POSITION:

The Conversational AI Engineer is responsible for designing, building, and supporting intelligent virtual agents using NICE Cognigy, with a focus on digital chat and conversational experiences. This role partners with business, IT, and experience design teams to create scalable, reliable chatbot and virtual assistant solutions that deflect contacts, streamline customer journeys, and integrate seamlessly with the broader contact center ecosystem. Experience with the Cognigy conversational AI platform is highly desirable to support advanced NLU, dialog orchestration, and enterprise‑grade automation use cases.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
Our employees are tasked with delivering excellent business results through the efforts of their teams. These results are achieved by:

  • Design, build, test, and maintain NICE virtual agents, with a primary focus on digital chat and self‑service use cases.
  • Develop and manage conversation flows, intents, entities, dialog logic, and handoff scenarios to live agents across voice and digital channels.
  • Configure and tune natural language understanding (NLU) models to improve intent recognition, accuracy, and customer experience.
  • Implement and maintain integrations between Cognigy and backend systems, including CRM, knowledge bases, APIs, and automation services.
  • Support human handoff and omnichannel continuity, ensuring context is preserved when escalating from bot to live agent.
  • Monitor and optimize bot performance using analytics, transcripts, and interaction data to improve containment and task completion.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve production issues related to bot behavior, NLU accuracy, integrations, and platform performance.
  • Maintain detailed technical documentation for conversation designs, configurations, and integrations.
  • Ensure all conversational AI solutions comply with security, privacy, accessibility, and compliance standards.
  • All other duties as assigned

It is the policy of EVERSANA to provide reasonable accommodation when requested by an employee with a disability, unless such accommodation would cause an undue hardship for EVERSANA. If reasonable accommodation is needed to perform the essential functions of your job position, please contact Human Resources.

EXPECTATIONS OF THE JOB:

  • Collaborate closely with Business Analysts, CX designers, product owners, and stakeholders during discovery and design workshops.
  • Participate in design reviews, backlog refinement, and release planning for virtual agent initiatives.
  • Communicate clearly with technical and non‑technical partners regarding bot capabilities, limitations, and release readiness.
  • Follow established change management, testing, and documentation standards for all chatbot deployments.
  • Stay current on advancements in conversational AI, NLU, generative AI, and chatbot design best practices.
  • Support production releases and provide after‑hours support as needed for critical issues.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to expand self‑service and automation use cases.

Travel: N/A (or limited travel as needed for workshops, vendor sessions, or team meetings)

Hours: 40 hours per week, Monday–Friday; occasional after‑hours support may be required for major releases or critical production issues

The above list reflects the general details necessary to describe the expectations of the position and shall not be construed as the only expectations that may be assigned for the position.

MINIMUM KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:

The requirements below are representative of the experience, education, knowledge, skills, and abilities required to perform this job effectively.

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Experience and/or Training

  • 3–5 years of experience developing or supporting conversational AI, chatbots, or virtual assistant solutions.
  • Hands‑on experience building chatbots using NICE Cognigy or comparable virtual agent platforms.
  • Strong understanding of conversational design, NLU concepts, intent modeling, and dialog management.
  • Experience integrating chatbots with enterprise systems using APIs and web services.
  • Experience supporting solutions in a production, enterprise IT environment.

Technology / Equipment

  • Experience with chatbot development tools, NLU platforms, and analytics dashboards.
  • Familiarity with REST APIs, JSON payloads, and system integrations.
  • Experience using ticketing, backlog, and documentation tools (e.g., Jira, Confluence, ServiceNow).

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

The qualifications below are preferred and may be used to distinguish top candidates.

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in a technical or analytical discipline.
  • Advanced coursework or training in systems analysis, product management, or customer experience technologies.

Experience and/or Training

  • Hands‑on experience with the Cognigy conversational AI platform.
  • Experience supporting voice and digital virtual agents, including omnichannel handoff.
  • Experience tuning NLU models using real interaction data and transcripts.
  • Experience in large‑scale or regulated contact center environments.
  • Familiarity with AI‑assisted agent tools and downstream analytics..

Licenses/Certificates preferred:

  • NICE Cognigy certifications.
  • NiCE platform training or certification.
  • Agile, SAFe, or product delivery certifications.

  • Exposure to advanced NLU, LLM‑based conversational enhancements, or generative AI use cases.
  • Experience analyzing bot performance metrics and interaction outcomes.
  • Familiarity with security, privacy, and compliance considerations for customer interaction data.

Projects include but are not limited to scientific content development, conference engagements, data visualization, healthcare provider key opinion leader (KOL) engagement, speaker program development and training, advisory boards, virtual and live educational events and innovative omnichannel educational initiatives.   • Sound analytical skills

description:

Job Description

Title: Scientific Product Owner

Location: Cambridge, MA


About the role:

As the Scientific Product Owner, you will define, deliver, and continuously improve digital products supporting Takeda’s Nonclinical Safety and Pharmacology functions, Drug Discovery Units (DDUs), and Plasma-Derived Therapies (PDT) R&D. You will support pathology, in vivo research, comparative medicine, nonclinical regulatory writing, safety and toxicology, pharmacology, discovery research, and PDT R&D activities. You will also serve as the specialized owner for the Research Control Tower, providing an integrated view of research portfolios, studies, milestones, risks, dependencies, decisions, data, and regulatory deliverables. You will also be working across global scientific, business, data, technology, quality, and regulatory stakeholders, the role will translate research needs into product strategies, roadmaps, capabilities, and prioritized backlogs. You will enable improved scientific decision-making, operational transparency, data accessibility, collaboration, compliance, and execution across Takeda’s research ecosystem.


How will you contribute:


Product Strategy and Vision

  • Define and communicate the product vision, strategy, objectives, and roadmap for digital products serving Nonclinical Safety, Pharmacology, DDUs, and PDT R&D.
  • Establish the strategy for the Research Control Tower as an integrated source of insight across research portfolios, studies, programs, milestones, risks, decisions, and deliverables.
  • Align product priorities with R&D strategy, DDU and PDT portfolio needs, scientific objectives, technology architecture, data governance, quality requirements, and regulatory expectations.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify processes, improve transparency, increase data reuse, and accelerate research decisions.

Scientific Function Enablement

  • Partner with leaders and subject-matter experts across Nonclinical Safety, Pharmacology, DDUs, and PDT R&D to understand workflows, data requirements, and unmet needs.
  • Translate scientific processes and user needs into clear product requirements and measurable outcomes.
  • Support integration of study data, pathology findings, toxicology results, pharmacology observations, PDT research information, regulatory content, and program milestones.
  • Improve traceability from research planning and execution through interpretation, reporting, governance, and regulatory support.
  • Enable consistent global processes while accommodating valid differences across scientific functions, programs, sites, and regions.

Research Control Tower Product Ownership

  • Own the Research Control Tower product vision, roadmap, backlog, release planning, and lifecycle management.
  • Establish capabilities for:
  • Research and portfolio visibility
  • Study and program tracking
  • Milestone and deliverable management
  • Risk, issue, and dependency monitoring
  • Decision logging
  • Governance and status reporting
  • PDT and DDU portfolio oversight
  • Define dashboards and user experiences for scientists, study directors, program teams, research leaders, governance forums, and senior leadership.
  • Establish metrics for research progress, study execution, resource utilization, turnaround time, quality, risks, dependencies, and delivery confidence.
  • Promote interoperability with research, laboratory, document, data, analytics, regulatory, and portfolio systems.
  • Ensure the product provides trusted, governed, and actionable information for research oversight.
  • Enable faster, higher-quality decisions across Nonclinical Safety, Pharmacology, DDUs, and PDT R&D.
  • Provide a unified view of research plans, studies, programs, milestones, results, risks, dependencies, decisions, and regulatory deliverables.
  • Improve collaboration across scientific functions and research organizations.
  • Reduce manual reporting, duplicate data entry, fragmented information, and process variation.
  • Strengthen traceability, data quality, reuse, and inspection readiness.
  • Deliver scalable digital capabilities that support both small molecule/biologic discovery and PDT R&D.
  • Apply analytics, automation, AI/ML, and GenAI responsibly to scientific and operational challenges.
  • Maintain a user-centered, scientifically credible, secure, governed, compliant, and sustainable product ecosystem.

Product Delivery and Agile Execution

  • Lead discovery, user research, design thinking, requirements gathering, prioritization, and iterative delivery.
  • Maintain and prioritize the product backlog based on scientific value, business impact, user needs, risk, compliance, and technical feasibility.
  • Develop epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and outcome measures.
  • Collaborate with engineering, architecture, data, analytics, UX, quality, validation, and vendor teams.
  • Plan and oversee pilots, minimum viable products, releases, adoption activities, and continuous improvements.
  • Manage product lifecycle activities from concept through implementation, sustainment, optimization, and retirement.

Data, Technology, and Compliance

  • Define requirements for data integration, metadata, data quality, lineage, access, interoperability, and reporting.
  • Partner with data and technology teams to develop scalable cloud, analytics, AI/ML, and GenAI capabilities where appropriate.
  • Address GxP and Non-GxP requirements, data integrity, privacy, cybersecurity, validation, auditability, and records management.
  • Collaborate with Quality, Regulatory, Legal, Privacy, and Information Security stakeholders.
  • Establish appropriate controls for governed data, role-based access, controlled terminology, and product documentation.
  • Support standards for nonclinical, pharmacology, DDU, and PDT research data.

Stakeholder Leadership and Change Management

  • Build trusted relationships with global scientific, DDU, PDT, business, data, and technology stakeholders.
  • Facilitate alignment among scientists, study directors, toxicologists, pathologists, pharmacologists, regulatory writers, DDU teams, PDT R&D teams, research operations, and IT.
  • Communicate product progress, risks, decisions, value, and outcomes to governance forums and senior leaders.
  • Lead change management, training, communications, and adoption activities.
  • Represent the product in portfolio, architecture, data governance, quality, and technology planning forums.
  • Influence without direct authority across functions, regions, and cultures.


What you bring to Takeda:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in biology, pharmacology, toxicology, pathology, veterinary medicine, life sciences, computer science, information systems, business, or related discipline.
  • 6 or more years of relevant experience in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, life sciences, research technology, scientific operations, product management, or digital transformation.
  • Experience supporting one or more of the following: nonclinical safety, pharmacology, pathology, toxicology, in vivo re-search, comparative medicine, discovery research, DDUs, or PDT R&D.
  • Demonstrated experience managing digital products through strategy, discovery, delivery, adoption, and continuous improvement.
  • Experience with agile product development, roadmaps, backlog management, and release planning.
  • Strong ability to translate scientific and business needs into product requirements.
  • Excellent communication, facilitation, negotiation, and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Experience working with global, cross-functional, and virtual teams.
  • Understanding of data governance, data quality, security, privacy, and regulated environments.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree, doctoral degree, DVM, or equivalent advanced qualification in a relevant scientific discipline.
  • Experience with nonclinical regulatory submissions, regulatory writing, pathology data, toxicology systems, laboratory sys-tems, research data platforms, or control tower solutions.
  • Experience supporting Drug Discovery Units or Plasma-Derived Therapies R&D.
  • Experience delivering dashboards, data products, analytics, AI/ML, or GenAI solutions.
  • Experience with AWS or comparable cloud platforms, data lakes, APIs, and enterprise integration.
  • Experience with GxP and Non-GxP product development, validation, inspection readiness, and quality systems.
  • Product management, agile, or design-thinking certification.

title: Team Lead — Compliance Monitoring, Assurance & Testing (CMAT)
description:
The Team Lead for the Compliance Monitoring, Assurance & Testing (CMAT) team is responsible for designing and running Binance ADGM's independent, risk-based compliance monitoring and assurance programme. The role assures the Board, Senior Management and the FSRA that the firm's AML/CFT, market conduct, client-asset, and prudential controls are operating effectively and remain compliant with the ADGM Financial Services Regulatory Authority (FSRA) rulebooks and applicable UAE federal requirements.

This is a senior second-line-of-defence leadership role accountable for the disciplined testing of controls, timely escalation of findings, and evidence-based regulatory reporting that stands up to FSRA supervisory scrutiny.

Responsibilities

Compliance Monitoring & Testing Programme

  • Own and maintain a risk-based annual Compliance Monitoring & Assurance Plan (CMAP), refreshed on risk assessment outcomes, FSRA thematic reviews, and changes in regulatory posture.

  • Design and execute control testing across AML/CFT, sanctions, market abuse, client-asset safeguarding, complaint handling, outsourcing, and technology/cyber governance.

  • Apply full-cycle assurance methodology: scoping → walkthroughs → sampling → testing → root-cause analysis → findings rating → remediation tracking → closure validation.

  • Deliver thematic deep-dives aligned to FSRA supervisory priorities (e.g., transaction monitoring effectiveness, Travel Rule compliance, EDD for high-risk clients, market abuse surveillance).

Regulatory Alignment (FSRA)

  • Ensure monitoring activities map to the FSRA AML/CFT Rulebook, Conduct of Business (COBS), General (GEN), Prudential (PRU), and Virtual Asset framework obligations.

  • Support the Compliance Officer and MLRO in demonstrating effective oversight under FSRA's risk-based supervision model.

  • Maintain evidence trails that satisfy FSRA information requests, on-site inspections, and thematic reviews.

  • Monitor regulatory change (FSRA consultations, ADGM notices, UAE Federal Decree-Law 20/2018 and its Executive Regulations, MoE/EO AML guidance) and reflect updates in the plan.

Findings, Reporting & Escalation

  • Produce clear, board-ready assurance reports with quantified findings, severity ratings, and management action plans.

  • Operate a robust issue-management and remediation-tracking framework with escalation protocols for overdue or high-risk items.

  • Present monitoring results to Risk Committees, Compliance Committees, and where required the Board/Audit Committee.

  • Liaise with Internal Audit and external auditors to ensure complementary (non-duplicative) coverage.

AML/CFT & Financial Crime Assurance

  • Test the effectiveness of CDD/EDD, KYC onboarding, periodic review, PEP/sanctions screening, transaction monitoring, and SAR/STR escalation processes.

  • Assess suspicious activity identification and reporting effectiveness, including FIU-UAE submission quality.

  • Verify Targeted Financial Sanctions (TFS) and asset-freeze controls.

Leadership & Team Management

  • Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing assurance team — setting testing standards, quality review, and coaching.

  • Foster a culture of challenge, professional scepticism, and integrity, consistent with SMCR conduct expectations.

  • Manage resource allocation against the CMAP and ensure delivery within agreed SLAs.

Governance & Continuous Improvement

  • Maintain CMAT policies, methodologies, and documentation to an auditable standard.

  • Drive automation and data analytics to strengthen monitoring coverage and efficiency.

  • Embed lessons learned into first- and second-line processes and training.

Requirements

Essential

  • 7–10+ years in compliance, assurance, internal audit, or regulatory supervision within financial services, fintech, preferably within crypto/VASP environments.

  • 3+ years leading teams or workstreams in a second-line or audit function.

  • Strong working knowledge of ADGM FSRA rulebooks and the UAE AML/CFT landscape; comparable MAS, HKMA, FCA, or DIFC/DFSA experience will be considered.

  • Proven track record designing and executing risk-based compliance monitoring/testing programmes.

  • Depth in AML/CFT, sanctions, and financial-crime control testing.

  • Excellent written and verbal English; strong report-writing and stakeholder-presentation skills.

Desirable

  • CAMS, CGSS, CRMA, CIA, ACCA/ACA, ICA, or equivalent certification

  • Prior experience in a regulated crypto/VASP or high-growth fintech.

  • Data analytics, SQL, or audit-automation tooling skills.

  • Arabic language proficiency (advantageous, not required).

title: Indskolingslærer
description:
Indskolingslærer søges til Køng Friskole.

Har du en stærk pædagogisk faglighed, blik for børn og lyst til at være en del af en lille friskole, hvor relationer, fællesskab og faglighed går hånd i hånd? Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter.

På Køng Friskole søger vi en ny kollega, som primært skal have timer i Lillegruppen, men som også skal kunne varetage undervisning og andre opgaver i vores fællesskab.

Vi søger dig, som først og fremmest har en solid pædagogisk faglighed.

Du behøver ikke have mange års erfaring, men du skal have en forståelse og lyst til de yngste i skolen.

For os er det vigtigste ikke den rigtige titel på dit eksamensbevis.

Det vigtigste er, at du er den rigtige voksne for børnene og den rigtige kollega på Køng Friskole.

Vi forestiller os, at du

  • har en stærk pædagogisk faglighed og forståelse for børns udvikling.

  • kan skabe trygge, tydelige og nærværende rammer.

  • er god til relationer og har blik for det enkelte barn.

  • kan arbejde struktureret og tage ansvar for en børnegruppe.

  • har lyst til at undervise og udvikle din lærerfaglighed.

  • kan samarbejde tæt med både kolleger og forældre.

  • er nysgerrig, fleksibel og har lyst til at være en aktiv del af fællesskabet.

  • kan se dig selv i en friskole, hvor vi kender hinanden, hjælper hinanden og tager ansvar for helheden.

Din hverdag på Køng Friskole

Du vil primært være tilknyttet Lillegruppen, hvor det pædagogiske arbejde, relationerne og børnenes udvikling står centralt. Men du kan også sagtens blive en del af Mellem- eller måske Storegruppen i enkelte timer, på særlige dage eller på ture ud af huset.

Du vil være i Lillegruppen hele ugen, hvor du er den struktur- og kulturbærende.

Vi er en lille skole, og derfor er det vigtigt, at du både kan fordybe dig i dine egne opgaver og samtidig har lyst til at være en del af det fælles.

Vi tror på, at struktur og relation er hinandens forudsætninger, og at børn udvikler sig bedst, når de mødes af voksne, som både kan sætte rammer og være nærværende.

Du kan starte allerede nu.

Derfor er der mulighed for at begynde nu i en tidsbegrænset stilling på 80-85 % frem til 30. november 2026.

Herefter er planen, at stillingen fortsætter som en fast stilling på 80-85% fra 1. december 2026, hvis det er det rigtige for os begge.

Det betyder også, at du ikke behøver vente på den faste ansættelse for at lære børnene, kollegerne og KØNG at kende.

Hvad får du hos os?

Du får en arbejdsplads, hvor vi:

  • prioriterer relationer og fællesskab.

  • tager børns perspektiver alvorligt.

  • arbejder med både trivsel, læring og udvikling.

  • har korte beslutningsveje og plads til idéer.

  • forventer noget af hinanden – og hjælper hinanden.

  • tror på, at den gode skole skabes af voksne, der vil hinanden og børnene.

Vi vil meget gerne høre fra dig, hvis du kan se dig selv hos os.

Send din ansøgning og CV til sofia@koeng.dk og skriv 'Ansøgning indskoling' i emnefeltet.

Vi holder samtaler løbende, så send gerne din ansøgning i dag.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte skoleleder Chiara Sofia på 40705283.

title: Network Engineer
description:
The Network Engineer is responsible for the technical implementation, maintenance, and day-to-day health of Harvard’s Network. This role focuses on ensuring system stability, implementing automation, and resolving technical issues.

Success requires a commitment to operational excellence and operational transparency. This role requires the diligent use of enterprise ticketing and project management systems to track all work activities, providing visibility to ensure seamless team collaboration. This position includes participation in a 24/7 on-call rotation.

Job-Specific Responsibilities:

Service Context

  • Lead the installation, configuration, and maintenance of Network systems in alignment with HUIT standards.
  • Identifies bespoke or undocumented network configurations and ensures they are formally documented, reviewed, and integrated into standard change management and visibility processes.
  • Manage system monitoring and telemetry to proactively identify issues.
  • Participate in 24/7 on-call rotation; perform root-cause analysis and document long-term fixes in version-controlled SOPs.

Ownership

  • Serve as an escalation point for service risks and user impacting incidents.
  • Owns assigned service incident tickets and projects to ensure completeness and meet operational requirements.
  • Contributes to defined network strategy and security policies to ensure the network is in compliance.

Service Delivery and Performance Management

  • Contributes to the development and maintenance of clear service definitions, including scope, ownership, dependencies, support models, and escalation paths.
  • Monitor service performance and risk indicators
  • Ensure services remain reliable during periods of vendor-driven, compliance-driven and institutional- required change.
  • Contributes to both discretionary (project) and operations (incl. tickets) workloads

Security, Process Compliance, and Risk Coordination

  • Contributes to defining and maintaining clear security, compliance, and risk management practices
  • Partner closely with other appropriate teams to:
    • Implement user protections and infrastructure controls
    • Align all services with identity lifecycle and security strategies
  • Ensure network vulnerabilities (physical infrastructure and security application) are identified and addressed.
  • Surface issues as identified

User Experience, Adoption, and Change Management

Contribute to and lead appropriate service changes. Including:

  • Lead user-visible changes.
  • Ensure major changes are:
    • Well-coordinated
    • Clearly communicated to users and schools
    • Implemented with appropriate support and documentation
  • Reduce friction between central services and distributed IT organizations.

Leadership and People Management

Contribute to team efficacy. Including:

  • Build leadership and resilience in a dependency-heavy service environment.
  • Develop and improve business processes to optimize team efficiencies
  • Demonstrates collaborative, positive, empathetic, and growth mindset

Cross-Functional & Enterprise Partnership

Partner closely with appropriate teams when needed including, but not limited to:

  • Information Security and Data Privacy (ISDP) teams
  • Identity & Access Management for identity, provisioning, and access governance
  • Platform Services for hosting, automation, and operational dependencies
  • Schools and distributed IT leaders across a federated environment

Basic Qualifications:

Basic Qualifications are the minimum threshold a candidate must meet in order to be considered for this role.

  • Minimum of two years’ post-secondary education or relevant work experience


Additional Qualifications and Skills:

The following qualifications are strongly preferred. If you meet some, but not all, you are still encouraged to apply; we value employees with a willingness to learn.

  • Knowledge of configuration and maintenance of IT infrastructure systems within an enterprise environment
  • Demonstrated team performance skills, service mindset approach, and the ability to act as a trusted advisor
  • Working Conditions: Onsite work is performed in an office setting
  • Hybrid: Onsite as needed with advance notice
  • Visa Sponsorship Information: Harvard University is unable to provide visa sponsorship for this position
  • Pre-Employment Screening: Identity
  • Other Information:
    Please provide a cover letter and resume as one document with your application.
    This position has an 180-day orientation and review period.

#LI-JD3

Work Format Details

This position has been determined by school or unit leaders that some of the duties and responsibilities can be effectively performed at a non-Harvard location. The work schedule and location will be set by the department at its discretion and based upon operational needs. When not working at a Harvard or Harvard-designated location, employees in hybrid positions must work in a Harvard registered state in compliance with the University’s Policy on Employment Outside of Massachusetts. Additional details will be discussed during the interview process. Certain visa types and funding sources may limit work location. Individuals must meet work location sponsorship requirements prior to employment.

Salary Grade and Ranges

This position is salary grade level 057. Please visit Harvard's Salary Ranges to view the corresponding salary range and related information.

Benefits

Harvard offers a comprehensive benefits package that is designed to support a healthy work-life balance and your physical, mental and financial wellbeing. Because here, you are what matters. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

  • Generous paid time off including parental leave
  • Medical, dental, and vision health insurance coverage starting on day one
  • Retirement plans with university contributions
  • Wellbeing and mental health resources
  • Support for families and caregivers
  • Professional development opportunities including tuition assistance and reimbursement
  • Commuter benefits, discounts and campus perks

Learn more about these and additional benefits on our Benefits & Wellbeing Page.

EEO/Non-Discrimination Commitment Statement

Harvard University is committed to equal opportunity and non-discrimination. We seek talent from all parts of society and the world, and we strive to ensure everyone at Harvard thrives. Our differences help our community advance Harvard's academic purposes.

Harvard has an equal employment opportunity policy that outlines our commitment to prohibiting discrimination on the basis of race, ethnicity, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, religion, disability, or any other characteristic protected by law or identified in the university's non-discrimination policy. Harvard's equal employment opportunity policy and non-discrimination policy help all community members participate fully in work and campus life free from harassment and discrimination.

title: Java Tech Lead
description:
Module Lead – Java

Eurofins IT Solutions, Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India

Job Description

As a Module Lead, you will play a key role within the eLIMS-Forensics programme,

Eurofins Forensic Services, operating in UK, Netherlands, France, Germany and Belgium, sits at the core of European criminal justice systems, acting as the trusted scientific partner to police forces and courts, and providing critical evidence that enables fair and accurate outcomes in serious criminal investigations.
For software engineers, this is a rare opportunity to build systems where code directly impacts real-world justice—supporting DNA analysis, Forensic Case Management, and forensic workflows that can identify suspects and strengthen legal decision-making.

The UK forensic ecosystem remains one of the most advanced globally, combining cutting-edge science, strict regulatory standards, and continuous innovation; advances in data science, AI, and trace analysis are actively transforming how evidence is detected, interpreted, and used in investigations.
As part of the acquisition of Qualitype, Eurofins’ internal model already emphasises the integration of software development, quality engineering, and forensic domain expertise, giving engineers direct exposure to highly specialized scientific applications rarely found in traditional tech roles.

A compelling real-world example is the re‑analysis of cold cases using modern DNA techniques—some decades old—which have led to successful convictions years later, demonstrating how advances in forensic technology can fundamentally change investigative outcomes and deliver long-overdue justice.
In short, a role at Eurofins Forensics offers a unique combination of technical challenge, societal impact, and domain depth—where engineers are not just building software, but enabling a system that underpins public safety and the pursuit of truth.

The position focuses on full lifecycle delivery including technical design, implementation, system evolution and automation, ensuring solutions are robust, scalable and aligned with forensic operational processes and compliance requirements.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Own and contribute to architecture and development of enterprise Java applications
  • Provide technical guidance on design and implementation across distributed teams
  • Support modernisation and evolution of legacy forensic systems
  • Ensure scalable, maintainable and high-performance solutions
  • Share knowledge and support capability development across nearshore and offshore teams
  • Collaborate with product, QA, DevOps and architecture stakeholders

Specific Assignments

  • Software Engineering & Full-Stack Development
  • Develop enterprise applications across client and server components
  • Work with:
  • Java 11 / Java 17
  • Java EE / Jakarta EE
  • Eclipse RCP, SWT & JFace (rich client applications)
  • WildFly Application Server
  • Support modularisation of legacy systems and development of new platforms
  • Implement integration and high-performance processing logic

Architecture & Design

  • Define software architecture for enterprise applications
  • Apply object-oriented design and design patterns (SOLID, Clean Code)
  • Support modular system design and decomposition
  • Contribute to technical concept design and implementation

Database & Backend Engineering

Design and optimise backend services and data models

  • PostgreSQL
  • JPA / Hibernate
  • JPQL / CriteriaBuilder
  • Ensure scalability, integrity and performance of data-intensive systems

DevOps, CI/CD & Automation

  • Work within Git-based development processes
  • Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps
  • Manage containerised environments (Docker)
  • Use Maven / Eclipse Tycho for build management
  • Implement automated build, deployment and release processes

Quality, Performance & Reliability

  • Ensure high code quality through testing and best practices
  • Perform performance profiling and optimisation (JVM tuning)
  • Support production stability and continuous improvement
  • Work closely with QA for test coverage and release quality

Collaboration & Delivery

  • Work within Agile / Scrum delivery teams
  • Collaborate across UK, Europe, nearshore and offshore delivery centres
  • Support team mobilisation, onboarding, training and knowledge transfer
  • Act as a technical interface between business and IT teams

Skills Required:

Core Technical Skills

  • Java (11 / 17)
  • Java EE / Jakarta EE
  • Eclipse RCP, SWT, JFace
  • PostgreSQL
  • WildFly Application Server

Architecture & Development

  • Enterprise software architecture
  • Object-oriented development
  • Clean Code and Design Patterns
  • Modularisation of applications
  • Legacy system evolution

Backend & Data

  • JPA / Hibernate
  • JPQL / CriteriaBuilder

DevOps & Tooling

  • Git / Git-based workflows
  • Azure DevOps
  • CI/CD pipelines
  • Docker
  • Maven / Eclipse Tycho
  • Automated build and release processes

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Degree in Computer Science, Engineering or related field
  • Extensive experience (10yr ++) in enterprise Java development and DevOps practices
  • Proven experience in architecture and hands-on development
  • Experience working in regulated or complex operational environments (Forensics, LIMS, etc.)
  • Strong collaboration skills across distributed delivery teams
    • MCA or Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent.
    • 8+ years of hands-on experience in Java-based software development on global or enterprise projects.
    • Proven experience in product development environments.
    • Strong understanding of the Product Development Lifecycle and Lean Agile / Scrum methodologies.
    • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
    • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
    • Strong learning mindset and continuous improvement orientation.
